teaching_sense.en_definition: To have information about something or to be familiar with someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 掌握某件事的信息，或对某个人、事物有所了解；马耳他语 naf 表示“我知道”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollok tagħrif dwar xi ħaġa jew tkun familjari ma' xi ħadd jew ma' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 知道某个事实或答案，或认识、熟悉某个人或事物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikollok informazzjoni dwar fatt jew tweġiba, jew tkun taf lil xi persuna jew tkun familjari ma' xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you know something, you have information about it or are familiar with it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作为词形名称提及的 naf，意思是“我知道”；这里指这个语言形式本身。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-forma 'naf', li tfisser li jien għandi tagħrif dwar xi ħaġa, meta tissemma bħala kelma fiha nfisha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When mentioned as a word, 'naf' names the Maltese form meaning 'I know'.

formal.mt: Qabel jibda l-eżami, kull student għandu jkun jaf kemm għandu ħin biex iwieġeb il-mistoqsijiet.
formal.en: Before the examination begins, every student should know how much time they have to answer the questions.
formal.zh: 考试开始前，每位学生都应知道自己有多少时间回答问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taf fejn hi l-librerija? Mark: Iva, naf fejn hi. Ejja miegħi u nurik.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you know where the library is? Mark: Yes, I know where it is. Come with me and I'll show you.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你知道图书馆在哪里吗？Mark：知道，我知道在哪里。跟我来，我指给你看。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你知道图书馆在哪里吗？
messages.en: Do you know where the library is?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, naf fejn hi. Ejja miegħi u nurik.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, naf fejn hi. Ejja miegħi u nurik.
messages.zh: 知道，我知道在哪里。跟我来，我指给你看。
messages.en: Yes, I know where it is. Come with me and I'll show you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 naf 和“我知道答案”一起记，再用 Taf fejn hi l-librerija? 练习向别人询问；通过问答区分“我知道”和“你知道”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An instrument containing ink that you use for writing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 装有墨水、用来书写的笔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda li fiha l-linka u li tintuża biex tikteb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 笔，指使用墨水书写的工具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għodda tal-kitba li tuża l-linka biex tħalli marki fuq il-karta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pen is an instrument that you use to write with ink.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钢笔笔尖，指接触纸面并引出墨水的部分。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-parti tal-pinna stilografika li tmiss il-karta u li minnha tgħaddi l-linka waqt il-kitba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The nib of a fountain pen is the part through which ink reaches the paper.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 笔帽，指套在笔的书写端、用来遮盖和保护笔尖的盖子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għatu li jitqiegħed fuq it-tarf tal-kitba ta' pinna biex jgħatti u jipproteġi l-ponta tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The cap of a pen is the cover placed over its writing tip.

collocations.en: to clean the nib of a fountain pen
to put the cap on the pen

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok, uża tokka bil-linka sewda biex timla l-formola u ffirma fl-aħħar paġna.
formal.en: Please use a pen with black ink to complete the form and sign on the last page.
formal.zh: 请用黑色墨水笔填写表格，并在最后一页签名。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek tokka? Irrid nikteb in-numru. Mark: Iva, ħu din. Maja: Grazzi, nagħtihielek lura minnufih.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you got a pen? I want to write down the number. Mark: Yes, take this one. Maja: Thanks, I'll give it back to you straight away.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有笔吗？我想把号码记下来。马克：有，拿这支吧。玛雅：谢谢，我马上还给你。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你有笔吗？我想把号码记下来。
messages.en: Have you got a pen? I want to write down the number.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，拿这支吧。
messages.en: Yes, take this one.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谢谢，我马上还给你。
messages.en: Thanks, I'll give it back to you straight away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一支笔的三个画面记忆：拿笔写字、笔尖落纸、笔帽盖好。tokka 的具体意思要结合动作和上下文判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Short, distinct ticking sounds, such as those made by a clock.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 短促而清晰的滴答声，例如钟表运行时发出的声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħsejjes qosra u ċari li jinstemgħu wieħed wara l-ieħor, bħal dawk ta' arloġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 滴答声中的短促敲击声，尤其指钟表发出的声音。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħoss qasir bħal dak li jagħmel arloġġ waqt li jkun qed jimmarka l-ħin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tock is a short sound made by a clock as it ticks.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吸香烟的一口，即一次把香烟的烟吸入口中的动作；所给释义使用了字母拖长的写法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nifs ta' duħħan li persuna tiġbed minn sigarett meta tpejjep.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A puff on a cigarette is one act of drawing smoke from it.

collocations.en: the ticking sounds of the clock
to take two puffs on the cigarette

formal.mt: Fis-skiet tal-kamra tal-qari, it-tokki tal-arloġġ fuq il-ħajt kienu jinstemgħu b'mod ċar.
formal.en: In the silence of the reading room, the ticking sounds of the clock on the wall could be heard clearly.
formal.zh: 阅览室里一片安静，墙上钟表的滴答声清晰可闻。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Diġà spiċċajt is-sigarett? Pawlu: Le, ħadt biss żewġ tokki. Se nitfih issa. Sara: Tajjeb, imbagħad nidħlu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you already finished the cigarette? Pawlu: No, I've only taken two puffs. I'm going to put it out now. Sara: Okay, then we'll go inside.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你已经抽完那支烟了吗？保罗：没有，我只吸了两口。我现在就把它熄灭。萨拉：好，然后我们就进去。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你已经抽完那支烟了吗？
messages.en: Have you already finished the cigarette?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ħadt biss żewġ tokki. Se nitfih issa.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ħadt biss żewġ tokki. Se nitfih issa.
messages.zh: 没有，我只吸了两口。我现在就把它熄灭。
messages.en: No, I've only taken two puffs. I'm going to put it out now.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，然后我们就进去。
messages.en: Okay, then we'll go inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tokki 放进两个场景记：钟旁听一声声滴答，香烟旁数一口口吸入；用 arloġġ 和 sigarett 这些上下文提示区分词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Willingness to accept differences in other people's beliefs, opinions, or behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对他人不同的信仰、意见或行为持接纳态度，即使自己并不赞同。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-rieda li taċċetta differenzi fit-twemmin, fl-opinjonijiet jew fl-imġiba ta' ħaddieħor, anki meta ma taqbilx magħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宽容；对与自己不同的信仰、意见或行为予以接纳，或对令人不快的事物有所容忍。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-aċċettazzjoni ta' twemmin, opinjonijiet jew imġiba differenti minn tiegħek, jew il-ħila li tissaporti xi ħaġa li ddejqek.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Tolerance is the willingness to accept differences or put up with things that you find disagreeable.

formal.mt: L-iskola tħeġġeġ it-tolleranza lejn opinjonijiet differenti u titlob lill-istudenti jiddiskutu n-nuqqas ta' qbil b'rispett.
formal.en: The school encourages tolerance of different opinions and asks students to discuss disagreements respectfully.
formal.zh: 学校鼓励包容不同意见，并要求学生以尊重的态度讨论分歧。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ma naqbilx ma' dak li qal Pawlu. Nina: Lanqas jien, imma ftit tolleranza tgħin. Nistgħu nisimgħuh u mbagħad ngħidu x'naħsbu.
colloquial.en: Lara: I don't agree with what Pawlu said. Nina: Neither do I, but a little tolerance helps. We can hear him out and then say what we think.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我不同意 Pawlu 说的话。Nina：我也不同意，但多一点包容会有帮助。我们可以先听他说完，再表达自己的想法。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma naqbilx ma' dak li qal Pawlu.
messages.mt_standard: Ma naqbilx ma' dak li qal Pawlu.
messages.zh: 我不同意 Pawlu 说的话。
messages.en: I don't agree with what Pawlu said.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lanqas jien, imma ftit tolleranza tgħin. Nistgħu nisimgħuh u mbagħad ngħidu x'naħsbu.
messages.mt_standard: Lanqas jien, imma ftit tolleranza tgħin. Nistgħu nisimgħuh u mbagħad ngħidu x'naħsbu.
messages.zh: 我也不同意，但多一点包容会有帮助。我们可以先听他说完，再表达自己的想法。
messages.en: Neither do I, but a little tolerance helps. We can hear him out and then say what we think.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tolleranza 放进“意见不同也先听完”的画面中记忆；搭配 ftit tolleranza，记成“多一点包容”，理解宽容可以与保留自己的意见并存。

gloss_zh: 词义未明；所给释义“thu”不足以确定含义

teaching_sense.en_definition: An item labelled as an auxiliary in the packet, with no clearly identifiable meaning established by the supplied gloss 'thu'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 材料中标为助动词的条目；所给释义“thu”无法明确说明其含义，因此暂不能提供可靠的实际用法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Din hija forma mmarkata bħala awżiljarju fil-materjal mogħti, iżda l-glossa 'thu' ma tippermettix li tiġi stabbilita tifsira ċara jew użu affidabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 所给释义为“thu”，其含义不明，无法据此确定该助动词条目的准确中文释义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-glossa mogħtija hija 'thu', iżda t-tifsira tagħha mhix ċara biżżejjed biex jiġi spjegat dan l-element immarkat bħala awżiljarju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The packet labels this item as an auxiliary, but the supplied gloss does not establish a clear meaning.

collocations.zh: “tomato suase”这一形式（用于讨论条目本身）
“tomato suase”的含义（用于询问或核实词义）

formal.mt: Il-forma 'tomato suase' hija mmarkata bħala awżiljarju fil-materjal mogħti, iżda l-glossa 'thu' mhix biżżejjed biex tispjega l-użu tagħha.
formal.en: The form 'tomato suase' is labelled as an auxiliary in the supplied material, but the gloss 'thu' is insufficient to explain its use.
formal.zh: 所给材料将“tomato suase”标为助动词，但释义“thu”不足以说明其用法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'tomato suase'? Pawlu: Ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti minn din il-glossa biss; għandna bżonn aktar kuntest.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'tomato suase' mean? Pawlu: We cannot be certain from this gloss alone; we need more context.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：'tomato suase'是什么意思？保罗：仅凭这条释义还无法确定；我们需要更多上下文。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 'tomato suase'是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tomato suase' mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti minn din il-glossa biss; għandna bżonn aktar kuntest.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti minn din il-glossa biss; għandna bżonn aktar kuntest.
messages.zh: 仅凭这条释义还无法确定；我们需要更多上下文。
messages.en: We cannot be certain from this gloss alone; we need more context.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把此条放进“待核实词卡”：记住原样拼写和词义未明的状态，先用元语言讨论条目，不凭外形猜测含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality or manner of a voice or expression that conveys an attitude or feeling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 声音或表达方式所呈现的调子、语气或口吻，能够传达说话者或作者的态度与情绪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità jew il-mod tal-vuċi jew tal-espressjoni li jwassal l-attitudni jew is-sentiment ta' min jitkellem jew jikteb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 声音的调子，或言语、文字中体现态度和情绪的语气、口吻。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-mod kif tinstema' vuċi jew kif jiġi espress messaġġ, li jista' juri sentiment jew attitudni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The tone of someone's voice or writing is the quality or manner that expresses their feelings or attitude.

formal.mt: Fl-ittra lill-klijent, uża ton formali u rispettuż biex tispjega d-deċiżjoni b'mod ċar.
formal.en: In the letter to the client, use a formal and respectful tone to explain the decision clearly.
formal.zh: 在写给客户的信中，请用正式而尊重的口吻清楚说明这项决定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed titkellem b'dak it-ton? Mark: Skużani, jien għajjien. Nipprova nitkellem b'ton aktar kalm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you speaking in that tone? Mark: Sorry, I'm tired. I'll try to speak in a calmer tone.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么用那种语气说话？马克：对不起，我累了。我会试着用更平静的语气说话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么用那种语气说话？
messages.en: Why are you speaking in that tone?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Skużani, jien għajjien. Nipprova nitkellem b'ton aktar kalm.
messages.mt_standard: Skużani, jien għajjien. Nipprova nitkellem b'ton aktar kalm.
messages.zh: 对不起，我累了。我会试着用更平静的语气说话。
messages.en: Sorry, I'm tired. I'll try to speak in a calmer tone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ton 联想到英语 tone 的拼写，作为记忆提示：同一句话用平静或生气的语气说，改变的就是 ton。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that is round has the shape of a circle or a ball.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形状像圆或球的；圆形或球形的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu forma ta' ċirku jew ta' ballun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 圆的；形状像圆或球的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li għandha forma ta' ċirku jew ta' ballun.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is round has the shape of a circle or a ball.

formal.mt: Id-disinn juri ġnien tond b'mogħdija madwaru.
formal.en: The design shows a round garden with a path around it.
formal.zh: 设计图展示了一个圆形花园，周围有一条小路。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema platt trid, it-tond jew il-kwadru? Mark: It-tond, jekk jogħġbok. Għandi bżonnu għall-kejk.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which plate do you want, the round one or the square one? Mark: The round one, please. I need it for the cake.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你要哪个盘子，圆的还是方的？Mark：请给我圆的。我要用它来放蛋糕。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema platt trid, it-tond jew il-kwadru?
messages.mt_standard: Liema platt trid, it-tond jew il-kwadru?
messages.zh: 你要哪个盘子，圆的还是方的？
messages.en: Which plate do you want, the round one or the square one?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tond, jekk jogħġbok. Għandi bżonnu għall-kejk.
messages.mt_standard: It-tond, jekk jogħġbok. Għandi bżonnu għall-kejk.
messages.zh: 请给我圆的。我要用它来放蛋糕。
messages.en: The round one, please. I need it for the cake.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象圆盘配圆桌：platt tond 是圆盘，mejda tonda 是圆桌；把圆形画面与形容词的阴阳性变化一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tonsil is either of the two small masses of tissue at the back of your throat that help protect your body against infection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 扁桃体，通常指位于咽喉后部两侧、帮助身体抵御感染的两个小组织团块之一。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waħda miż-żewġ mases żgħar ta' tessut limfatiku fuq kull naħa tan-naħa ta' wara tal-gerżuma, li jgħinu lill-ġisem jiddefendi ruħu kontra l-infezzjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扁桃体；通常指咽喉后部两侧参与免疫防御的两个小组织团块之一。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Waħda miż-żewġ mases żgħar ta' tessut limfatiku fuq kull naħa tan-naħa ta' wara tal-gerżuma, li għandhom sehem fid-difiża tal-ġisem kontra l-infezzjonijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tonsil is one of the two small masses of tissue at the back of your throat that help your body fight infection.

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżami tal-gerżuma, it-tabib innota li t-tonsilla tax-xellug kienet minfuħa.
formal.en: During the throat examination, the doctor noted that the left tonsil was swollen.
formal.zh: 检查咽喉时，医生发现左侧扁桃体肿大。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qallek it-tabib dwar griżmejk? Mark: Qalli li għandi tonsilla minfuħa. Għalhekk tweġġagħni meta nibla'.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did the doctor tell you about your throat? Mark: He said I have a swollen tonsil. That's why it hurts when I swallow.
colloquial.zh: Maja：医生怎么说你的喉咙问题？Mark：他说我有一侧扁桃体肿大。所以我吞咽时会疼。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 医生怎么说你的喉咙问题？
messages.en: What did the doctor tell you about your throat?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qalli li għandi tonsilla minfuħa. Għalhekk tweġġagħni meta nibla'.
messages.mt_standard: Qalli li għandi tonsilla minfuħa. Għalhekk tweġġagħni meta nibla'.
messages.zh: 他说我有一侧扁桃体肿大。所以我吞咽时会疼。
messages.en: He said I have a swollen tonsil. That's why it hurts when I swallow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tonsilla 与英语 tonsil 对照记忆，再想象医生检查喉咙的画面；单个用 tonsilla，复数用 tonsilli。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inflammation of the tonsils, the two masses of tissue at the back of the throat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 扁桃体的炎症；扁桃体位于咽喉后部两侧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Infjammazzjoni tat-tunsilli, iż-żewġ mases ta' tessut li jinsabu fuq iż-żewġ naħat ta' wara tal-gerżuma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扁桃体炎，即咽喉后部两侧扁桃体发生的炎症。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-tonsillite hija infjammazzjoni tat-tunsilli li tista' tikkawża uġigħ fil-gerżuma u diffikultà biex wieħed jibla'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Tonsillitis is a condition in which your tonsils become inflamed, often causing a sore throat and difficulty swallowing.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport mediku ġie rreġistrat li l-pazjent kellu tonsillite akuta.
formal.en: The medical report recorded that the patient had acute tonsillitis.
formal.zh: 医疗报告记录，该患者患有急性扁桃体炎。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex ma ġejtx ilbieraħ? Pawlu: Kelli tonsillite u kont qed nistrieħ id-dar.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why didn't you come yesterday? Pawlu: I had tonsillitis and was resting at home.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你昨天为什么没来？Pawlu：我得了扁桃体炎，在家休息。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你昨天为什么没来？
messages.en: Why didn't you come yesterday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kelli tonsillite u kont qed nistrieħ id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Kelli tonsillite u kont qed nistrieħ id-dar.
messages.zh: 我得了扁桃体炎，在家休息。
messages.en: I had tonsillitis and was resting at home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tonsillite 和“喉咙后部两侧的扁桃体发炎”这一画面一起记，再用 tonsillite akuta 巩固“急性扁桃体炎”的搭配。

gloss_zh: 局部外用的（尤指药物或治疗）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Applied directly to a particular part of the body, especially the skin, for treatment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 直接用于身体某个局部、尤其是皮肤表面以进行治疗的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiġi applikat direttament fuq parti partikolari tal-ġisem, speċjalment fuq il-ġilda, għal skop ta' kura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 局部外用的，指药物或治疗直接作用于身体某个部位，尤其是皮肤表面。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mediċina jew trattament topiku jiġi applikat direttament fuq il-parti tal-ġisem li tkun teħtieġ il-kura, speċjalment fuq il-ġilda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A topical medicine or treatment is applied directly to the part of the body that needs treatment, especially the skin.

formal.mt: It-tikketta tindika li l-prodott huwa maħsub għall-użu topiku fuq il-ġilda.
formal.en: The label indicates that the product is intended for topical use on the skin.
formal.zh: 标签注明，该产品用于皮肤局部外用。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Xi jfisser li dan il-prodott huwa għall-użu topiku? Lara: Ifisser li jintuża direttament fuq parti tal-ġisem, bħal fuq il-ġilda.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does it mean that this product is for topical use? Lara: It means it is used directly on a part of the body, such as the skin.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这个产品写着“供局部外用”，是什么意思？Lara：意思是直接用在身体某个部位，例如皮肤上。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser li dan il-prodott huwa għall-użu topiku?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser li dan il-prodott huwa għall-użu topiku?
messages.zh: 这个产品写着“供局部外用”，是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean that this product is for topical use?

messages.speaker: Lara (药剂师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li jintuża direttament fuq parti tal-ġisem, bħal fuq il-ġilda.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li jintuża direttament fuq parti tal-ġisem, bħal fuq il-ġilda.
messages.zh: 意思是直接用在身体某个部位，例如皮肤上。
messages.en: It means it is used directly on a part of the body, such as the skin.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 topiku 和“药膏涂在皮肤某一小块区域”的画面联系起来，再整组记住 għall-użu topiku，表示“供局部外用”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The shape and arrangement of the physical features of an area of land.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某一地区地表的形状，以及山丘、山谷和平地等自然地理特征的分布。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għamla tal-wiċċ tal-art f'żona u l-mod kif ikunu mqassma l-karatteristiċi fiżiċi tagħha, bħall-għoljiet, il-widien u l-pjanuri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地形，指某地区地表的高低起伏及其自然地理特征的分布。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-karatteristiċi fiżiċi tal-wiċċ tal-art f'żona, inklużi l-għoli, l-għoljiet, il-widien u l-pjanuri tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The topography of an area is the shape of its land and the arrangement of features such as hills, valleys, and plains.

formal.mt: Qabel ma ntgħażlet ir-rotta tat-triq il-ġdida, l-inġiniera studjaw it-topografija taż-żona.
formal.en: Before the route of the new road was chosen, the engineers studied the topography of the area.
formal.zh: 在确定新道路的路线之前，工程师研究了该地区的地形。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex din il-mixja hi daqshekk diffiċli? Pawlu: Minħabba t-topografija tal-post: hemm ħafna għoljiet u ftit art ċatta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is this walk so difficult? Pawlu: Because of the topography here: there are lots of hills and very little flat ground.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这段路怎么走得这么费劲？Pawlu：因为这里的地形，山丘很多，平地很少。

messages.speaker: Maja (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex din il-mixja hi daqshekk diffiċli?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex din il-mixja hi daqshekk diffiċli?
messages.zh: 这段路怎么走得这么费劲？
messages.en: Why is this walk so difficult?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-topografija tal-post: hemm ħafna għoljiet u ftit art ċatta.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-topografija tal-post: hemm ħafna għoljiet u ftit art ċatta.
messages.zh: 因为这里的地形，山丘很多，平地很少。
messages.en: Because of the topography here: there are lots of hills and very little flat ground.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 topografija 和一张立体地形图一起记：手指沿山丘上升、沿山谷下降，联想整片土地的起伏与分布。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An opening in a lock into which a key is inserted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 锁上供钥匙插入，以便开锁或上锁的小孔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fetħa f'serratura li fiha tiddaħħal iċ-ċavetta biex is-serratura tinfetaħ jew tingħalaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钥匙孔，即锁上供相应钥匙插入的小孔。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-toqba fis-serratura li ddaħħal iċ-ċavetta fiha biex tiftaħ jew tissakkar bieb jew oġġett ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A keyhole is a small opening in a lock where you insert a key to operate the lock.

collocations.en: to insert the key into the keyhole

formal.mt: Daħħal iċ-ċavetta fit-toqba tas-serratura u dawwarha bil-mod biex tiftaħ il-bieb.
formal.en: Insert the key into the keyhole and turn it gently to open the door.
formal.zh: 把钥匙插入锁孔，轻轻转动以打开门。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ma nistax insib it-toqba tas-serratura fid-dlam. Mark: Stenna, nixgħellek bid-dawl tal-mowbajl.
colloquial.en: Lara: I can't find the keyhole in the dark. Mark: Wait, I'll shine my phone's light for you.
colloquial.zh: Lara：太黑了，我找不到锁孔。Mark：等一下，我用手机灯给你照一下。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nistax insib it-toqba tas-serratura fid-dlam.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nistax insib it-toqba tas-serratura fid-dlam.
messages.zh: 太黑了，我找不到锁孔。
messages.en: I can't find the keyhole in the dark.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 等一下，我用手机灯给你照一下。
messages.en: Wait, I'll shine my phone's light for you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 toqba tas-serratura 整体配上钥匙插入锁孔的画面记忆，再边做插钥匙动作边朗读，让词组与动作相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The opening at the end of the digestive tract through which faeces leave the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 消化道末端供粪便排出体外的开口，即肛门。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fetħa fit-tarf tal-apparat diġestiv li minnha joħroġ l-ippurgar mill-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肛门；消化道末端供粪便排出体外的开口。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-toqba tat-tint hija l-fetħa fit-tarf tal-apparat diġestiv li minnha l-ġisem joħroġ l-ippurgar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The anus is the opening at the end of the digestive tract through which faeces leave the body.

formal.mt: Fit-tpinġija tal-apparat diġestiv, it-toqba tat-tint hija mmarkata bħala l-fetħa li minnha joħroġ l-ippurgar.
formal.en: In the diagram of the digestive tract, the anus is marked as the opening through which faeces leave the body.
formal.zh: 在消化道示意图中，肛门被标为粪便排出体外的开口。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'toqba tat-tint'? Rita: Hija l-fetħa li minnha joħroġ l-ippurgar mill-ġisem.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'toqba tat-tint' mean? Rita: It is the opening through which faeces leave the body.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：'toqba tat-tint'是什么意思？丽塔：就是粪便排出身体的开口，也就是肛门。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 'toqba tat-tint'是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'toqba tat-tint' mean?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija l-fetħa li minnha joħroġ l-ippurgar mill-ġisem.
messages.mt_standard: Hija l-fetħa li minnha joħroġ l-ippurgar mill-ġisem.
messages.zh: 就是粪便排出身体的开口，也就是肛门。
messages.en: It is the opening through which faeces leave the body.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在消化道示意图的末端开口旁写下整个词组，把它与“肛门”的位置对应记忆。

gloss_zh: 铺设屋顶用的尘土或泥土层；一堆尘土

teaching_sense.en_definition: A layer of dust or earth used when laying a roof in stone masonry, or a quantity of dust.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 石砌建筑铺设屋顶时使用的尘土或泥土层；也指一定量或一堆尘土。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Saff ta' trab jew ħamrija użat fit-tqegħid tas-soqfa fil-bini tal-ġebel, jew kwantità ta' trab.

sense_translations.en_definition: layer of dust or earth used in the laying of roofs (stone-masonry)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 石砌建筑铺设屋顶时使用的一层尘土或泥土。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-torba hija saff ta' trab jew ħamrija li jitqiegħed waqt il-kostruzzjoni tas-soqfa fil-bini tal-ġebel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In stone masonry, torba is a layer of dust or earth used when a roof is laid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一定量的尘土；一堆尘土。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-torba hija kwantità ta' trab li tista' tkun miġbura jew akkumulata f'post wieħed.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A torba is a quantity of dust, such as an amount that has collected in one place.

collocations.en: a layer of dust or earth used in roofing
collocations.zh: 铺设屋顶用的一层尘土或泥土

formal.mt: Il-bennej qiegħed saff ta' torba waqt il-kostruzzjoni tas-saqaf tal-bini tal-ġebel.
formal.en: The builder laid a layer of dust or earth during the construction of the stone building's roof.
formal.zh: 建造这座石砌建筑的屋顶时，建筑工人铺设了一层尘土或泥土。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara kemm hemm torba taħt l-armarju! Mark: Se niġborha bil-pala u l-pinzell.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look how much dust there is under the cupboard! Mark: I'll gather it up with the dustpan and brush.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看，柜子下面积了这么多尘土！马克：我用簸箕和刷子把它收起来。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm hemm torba taħt l-armarju!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm hemm torba taħt l-armarju!
messages.zh: 看，柜子下面积了这么多尘土！
messages.en: Look how much dust there is under the cupboard!

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 我用簸箕和刷子把它收起来。
messages.en: I'll gather it up with the dustpan and brush.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅图记忆：屋顶上铺开的一层土，柜子下积起的一堆尘土；两种场景都对应 torba。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Responsibility for a mistake, problem, or harmful result.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某人因造成错误、问题或不良后果而应承担的责任或过错。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-responsabbiltà li jkollu xi ħadd għal żball, problema jew ħsara li jkun ikkawża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对错误、问题或不良后果所负的责任；归于某人的过错。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ir-responsabbiltà għal xi ħaġa ħażina li tkun ġrat u li tiġi attribwita lil persuna jew lil xi ħadd ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Blame is the responsibility that someone has, or is said to have, for something bad that has happened.

collocations.en: to put the blame on someone else

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega min għandu t-tort għall-iżball u jipproponi miżuri biex dan ma jerġax iseħħ.
formal.en: The report explains who is to blame for the mistake and proposes measures to prevent it from happening again.
formal.zh: 报告说明了谁应对这一错误负责，并提出防止同类错误再次发生的措施。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ma ġibtx il-biljetti? Mark: Skużani, it-tort tiegħi. Ħallejthom id-dar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why didn't you bring the tickets? Mark: Sorry, it's my fault. I left them at home.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你怎么没带票？Mark：对不起，是我的错。我把票落在家里了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么没带票？
messages.en: Why didn't you bring the tickets?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 对不起，是我的错。我把票落在家里了。
messages.en: Sorry, it's my fault. I left them at home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tort 放进认错句 it-tort tiegħi“我的错”一起记，再用“谁该负责”的场景巩固它表示过错与责任的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A baked food that may be a sweet or savoury pastry with a filling, or a sweet cake.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种烘焙食品，可指带甜馅或咸馅的馅饼、挞，也可指蛋糕，具体含义取决于语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikel moħmi li jista' jkun magħmul minn għaġina b'mili ħelu jew mielaħ, jew ikun kejk ħelu, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用面皮包住或盖住馅料烘烤而成的馅饼，馅料可以是甜的或咸的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikel magħmul minn għaġina li tagħlaq jew tgħatti mili ħelu jew mielaħ u li jinħema fil-forn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pie is a baked dish in which pastry encloses or covers a sweet or savoury filling.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由面粉、糖等原料混合后烘焙而成的蛋糕，可加奶油或其他装饰。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Deżerta magħmula minn taħlita ta' dqiq, zokkor u ingredjenti oħra, moħmija fil-forn u li tista' tkun imżejna bil-krema.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cake is a sweet baked food made from a mixture of flour, sugar, and other ingredients.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以面皮为底、通常不加顶层面皮的甜馅烘焙点心，如水果挞。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Deżerta magħmula minn bażi tal-għaġina b'mili ħelu li normalment jibqa' mikxuf fil-wiċċ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tart is a pastry dish with a sweet filling that is usually left uncovered.

collocations.en: a piece of pie or cake

formal.mt: Wara l-ikla, il-mistednin ingħataw biċċa torta tat-tuffieħ bħala deżerta.
formal.en: After the meal, the guests were served a piece of apple pie for dessert.
formal.zh: 饭后，客人们各获一块苹果馅饼作为甜点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' nieħu biċċa torta? Elena: Iva. Trid torta tat-tuffieħ jew torta taċ-ċikkulata? Maja: Taċ-ċikkulata, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I have a piece of pie or cake? Elena: Yes. Would you like apple pie or chocolate cake? Maja: Chocolate cake, please.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我可以吃一块馅饼或蛋糕吗？埃莱娜：可以。你要苹果馅饼还是巧克力蛋糕？玛雅：请给我巧克力蛋糕。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我可以吃一块馅饼或蛋糕吗？
messages.en: Can I have a piece of pie or cake?

messages.speaker: Elena (主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva. Trid torta tat-tuffieħ jew torta taċ-ċikkulata?
messages.mt_standard: Iva. Trid torta tat-tuffieħ jew torta taċ-ċikkulata?
messages.zh: 可以。你要苹果馅饼还是巧克力蛋糕？
messages.en: Yes. Would you like apple pie or chocolate cake?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 请给我巧克力蛋糕。
messages.en: Chocolate cake, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 torta 放进点心柜来记：苹果馅饼、巧克力蛋糕和水果挞都可对应它；看到配料和场景，再判断具体是哪一种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A savoury pie made with a filling of dorado fish.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以鲯鳅鱼肉为馅料、用面皮包裹或覆盖后烘烤制成的咸味馅饼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Torta mielħa magħmula minn għaġina b'mili li fih il-laħam tal-lampuki, u moħmija fil-forn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以鲯鳅鱼肉为主要馅料烘制的咸味鱼馅饼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Torta mielħa li jkollha mili bil-laħam tal-lampuki, magħluq jew mgħotti bl-għaġina u moħmi fil-forn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dorado fish pie is a savoury baked dish with pastry and a filling made from dorado fish.

collocations.en: to prepare a dorado fish pie
a portion of dorado fish pie
a recipe for dorado fish pie

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta tispjega kif tipprepara torta tal-lampuki b'għaġina u mili tal-ħut.
formal.en: The recipe explains how to prepare a dorado fish pie with pastry and a fish filling.
formal.zh: 这份食谱说明如何用面皮和鱼肉馅制作鲯鳅鱼馅饼。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'hemm għall-ikel illum? Rita: Għamilt torta tal-lampuki. Trid biċċa? Mark: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Inħobb ħafna l-ħut.
colloquial.en: Mark: What's for lunch today? Rita: I made a dorado fish pie. Would you like a piece? Mark: Yes, please. I really like fish.
colloquial.zh: 马克：今天午饭吃什么？丽塔：我做了鲯鳅鱼馅饼。你要一块吗？马克：好，请给我一块。我很喜欢吃鱼。

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 今天午饭吃什么？
messages.en: What's for lunch today?

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.zh: 我做了鲯鳅鱼馅饼。你要一块吗？
messages.en: I made a dorado fish pie. Would you like a piece?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Inħobb ħafna l-ħut.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Inħobb ħafna l-ħut.
messages.zh: 好，请给我一块。我很喜欢吃鱼。
messages.en: Yes, please. I really like fish.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语想成一张菜单图片：torta 提醒你看馅饼，tal-lampuki 提醒你看里面的鲯鳅鱼肉；连着画面一起记住菜名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The deliberate infliction of severe physical or mental suffering on someone, often as punishment or to obtain information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 故意使人遭受严重身体或精神痛苦的行为，常用于惩罚或逼取信息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti apposta ta' tbatija fiżika jew mentali kbira lil persuna, spiss bħala kastig jew biex tinkiseb informazzjoni mingħandha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 酷刑；故意施加严重身体或精神痛苦的折磨。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Att li bih persuna ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd isofri uġigħ fiżiku jew tbatija mentali kbira apposta, pereżempju biex tikkastigah jew iġġiegħlu jagħti informazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Torture is the act of deliberately causing someone severe physical or mental suffering, especially to punish them or obtain information.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jikkundanna l-użu tat-tortura kontra l-priġunieri.
formal.en: The report condemns the use of torture against prisoners.
formal.zh: 报告谴责对囚犯使用酷刑。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi t-tortura? Samwel: Hi meta xi ħadd iġiegħel lil persuna tbati ħafna apposta, pereżempju biex iġegħelha tagħti informazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is torture? Samwel: It's when someone deliberately makes a person suffer severely, for example to force them to give information.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：什么是酷刑？萨姆韦尔：就是有人故意让一个人遭受严重痛苦，例如逼迫对方提供信息。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 什么是酷刑？
messages.en: What is torture?

messages.speaker: Samwel (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hi meta xi ħadd iġiegħel lil persuna tbati ħafna apposta, pereżempju biex iġegħelha tagħti informazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Hi meta xi ħadd iġiegħel lil persuna tbati ħafna apposta, pereżempju biex iġegħelha tagħti informazzjoni.
messages.zh: 就是有人故意让一个人遭受严重痛苦，例如逼迫对方提供信息。
messages.en: It's when someone deliberately makes a person suffer severely, for example to force them to give information.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tortura 与“酷刑受害者”这个完整情境一起记：核心是故意造成严重痛苦，而不是普通的不舒服。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A portable light held in the hand to illuminate dark places.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拿在手中、用于照亮黑暗处的照明工具，如手电筒或火把。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda li tinżamm fl-id u tintuża biex iddawwal post mudlam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 手持照明工具，通常指手电筒，也可指火把。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għodda li tinġarr fl-id u tagħti d-dawl biex wieħed ikun jista' jara fid-dlam.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A torch is a portable light that you carry in your hand to see in the dark.

formal.mt: Qabel ma jidħlu fil-mina, il-viżitaturi għandhom jiċċekkjaw li t-torċa tagħhom taħdem.
formal.en: Before entering the tunnel, visitors should check that their torch works.
formal.zh: 进入隧道前，参观者应检查自己的手电筒是否正常工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek torċa? Hawn dlam. Pawlu: Iva, ħudha biex tara t-triq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you got a torch? It's dark here. Pawlu: Yes, take it so you can see the path.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你有手电筒吗？这里很暗。Pawlu：有，拿去吧，这样你就能看清路了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你有手电筒吗？这里很暗。
messages.en: Have you got a torch? It's dark here.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，拿去吧，这样你就能看清路了。
messages.en: Yes, take it so you can see the path.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 torċa 和黑暗中手持一束光的画面一起记，再用 torċa elettrika 记住“手电筒”的常用搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to Tuscany, a region of Italy, or to its people, language, or culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与意大利托斯卡纳地区及其居民、语言或文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mat-Toskana, reġjun fl-Italja, jew man-nies, il-lingwa jew il-kultura tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 托斯卡纳的；与意大利托斯卡纳地区、当地居民、语言或文化有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ġej mit-Toskana jew li huwa marbut ma' dan ir-reġjun Taljan, mal-abitanti tiegħu, mal-lingwa jew mal-kultura tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is Tuscan comes from Tuscany or is associated with the people, language, or culture of that Italian region.

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jiddeskrivi l-istil toskan tal-bini u jagħti eżempji minn diversi bliet fit-Toskana.
formal.en: The catalogue describes the Tuscan style of the buildings and provides examples from several towns in Tuscany.
formal.zh: 目录介绍了这些建筑的托斯卡纳风格，并列举了托斯卡纳多个城镇的实例。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Jogħġbok dan il-pajsaġġ toskan fir-ritratt? Mark: Iva, dawk l-għoljiet sbieħ! Nixtieq immur hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you like this Tuscan landscape in the photo? Mark: Yes, those hills are beautiful! I'd like to go there.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你喜欢照片里的这片托斯卡纳风景吗？马克：喜欢，那些丘陵真美！我想去那里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢照片里的这片托斯卡纳风景吗？
messages.en: Do you like this Tuscan landscape in the photo?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dawk l-għoljiet sbieħ! Nixtieq immur hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dawk l-għoljiet sbieħ! Nixtieq immur hemm.
messages.zh: 喜欢，那些丘陵真美！我想去那里。
messages.en: Yes, those hills are beautiful! I'd like to go there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 toskan 放进 pajsaġġ toskan“托斯卡纳风景”一起记，想象一张当地丘陵的照片，记住它是描述地域关联的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to poison or harm living things because of its chemical properties.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因其化学性质而能使生物中毒或受到伤害的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jivvelena jew jagħmel ħsara lill-bnedmin, lill-annimali jew lill-pjanti minħabba l-proprjetajiet kimiċi tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有毒的；因其化学性质而能使人、动物或植物中毒或受到伤害的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa tossika tista' tikkawża avvelenament jew ħsara lill-bnedmin, lill-annimali jew lill-pjanti minħabba l-proprjetajiet kimiċi tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A substance that is toxic can poison or harm people, animals, or plants because of its chemical properties.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li l-iskart tossiku għandu jinżamm f'kontenituri magħluqa u mmarkati b'mod ċar.
formal.en: The report indicates that toxic waste should be kept in closed, clearly labelled containers.
formal.zh: 报告指出，有毒废物应存放在密闭且标识清晰的容器内。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex hemm sinjal ta' periklu fuq dan il-flixkun? Pawlu: Għax il-likwidu fih huwa tossiku. Tmissux.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why is there a danger sign on this bottle? Pawlu: Because the liquid inside is toxic. Don't touch it.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：为什么这个瓶子上有危险标志？保罗：因为里面的液体有毒。别碰它。

messages.speaker: Marta (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm sinjal ta' periklu fuq dan il-flixkun?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm sinjal ta' periklu fuq dan il-flixkun?
messages.zh: 为什么这个瓶子上有危险标志？
messages.en: Why is there a danger sign on this bottle?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-likwidu fih huwa tossiku. Tmissux.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-likwidu fih huwa tossiku. Tmissux.
messages.zh: 因为里面的液体有毒。别碰它。
messages.en: Because the liquid inside is toxic. Don't touch it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tossiku 和贴着危险标志的瓶子一起记：看到 gass tossiku 就想到“有毒气体”，看到 skart tossiku 就想到“有毒废物”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Including every part or amount, or complete in extent or degree.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 包括所有部分或数量的；也指在范围或程度上完全的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinkludi l-partijiet jew il-kwantitajiet kollha ta' xi ħaġa, jew li huwa komplet fil-firxa jew fil-grad tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 总的；包含全部部分或数量的；也可表示程度上的完全。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa totali tinkludi l-partijiet jew il-kwantitajiet kollha; il-kelma tista' wkoll turi li xi ħaġa hija kompleta fil-grad tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use total to describe an amount that includes everything, or a state that is complete in degree.

formal.mt: L-ammont totali fuq il-fattura jinkludi l-prezz tal-prodotti u l-ispiża tal-kunsinna.
formal.en: The total amount on the invoice includes the price of the products and the delivery cost.
formal.zh: 发票上的总金额包括产品价格和配送费用。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm ġie l-kont totali? Mark: Tletin ewro, bix-xorb inkluż. Lara: Mela ħmistax-il ewro kull wieħed.
colloquial.en: Lara: How much was the total bill? Mark: Thirty euros, including drinks. Lara: So fifteen euros each.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：账单总共多少钱？马克：三十欧元，饮料也算在内。拉拉：那就是每人十五欧元。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 账单总共多少钱？
messages.en: How much was the total bill?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 三十欧元，饮料也算在内。
messages.en: Thirty euros, including drinks.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那就是每人十五欧元。
messages.en: So fifteen euros each.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 totali 记在账单最后的总金额旁：各项全部加起来就是 ammont totali；修饰“缺乏”时，则理解为“完全缺乏”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Completely or entirely, without any part or aspect being excluded.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某种状态、变化或判断是完全的，没有任何部分或方面例外。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod sħiħ jew assolut, mingħajr ma titħalla barra ebda parti jew aspett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 完全地；彻底地；表示程度达到全部，没有例外或保留。
sense_translations.mt_definition: B'mod sħiħ jew assolut, mingħajr ebda eċċezzjoni jew riżerva.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this adverb to emphasize that something is complete or applies without exception.

formal.mt: Wara r-reviżjoni, il-pjan il-ġdid huwa totalment differenti mill-proposta oriġinali.
formal.en: After the revision, the new plan is totally different from the original proposal.
formal.zh: 修改之后，新计划与原来的提案完全不同。

colloquial.mt: Marija: L-iskeda nbidlet totalment? Pawlu: Iva, issa nibdew siegħa wara.
colloquial.en: Marija: Has the schedule changed completely? Pawlu: Yes, we now start an hour later.
colloquial.zh: Marija：时间安排完全变了吗？Pawlu：对，现在我们晚一个小时开始。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.zh: 时间安排完全变了吗？
messages.en: Has the schedule changed completely?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 对，现在我们晚一个小时开始。
messages.en: Yes, we now start an hour later.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 totalment 联想成进度条填满到百分之百：强调“完全、彻底”，再用“完全不同”这一搭配巩固记忆。

gloss_zh: 将某物反复放入臀部并抽出

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put something into the posterior and pull it out again repeatedly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指将某物放入臀部后再抽出，并反复进行这一动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iddaħħal xi ħaġa fil-warrani u terġa' toħroġha, filwaqt li tirrepeti din l-azzjoni diversi drabi.

sense_translations.en_definition: the action of putting something in your posterior and pulling it out again repeatedly
sense_translations.zh_definition: 将某物放入自己的臀部，再将其抽出，如此反复进行的动作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li ddaħħal xi ħaġa fil-warrani tiegħek u terġa' toħroġha, għal darba wara l-oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This verb describes an action in which you repeatedly put something into your posterior and pull it out again.

formal.mt: It-tifsira tal-verb 'totorġu' għandha tiġi spjegata b'lingwaġġ newtrali u preċiż.
formal.en: The meaning of the verb 'totorġu' should be explained in neutral and precise language.
formal.zh: 动词 totorġu 的含义应当用中性、准确的语言解释。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Xi jfisser 'totorġu' f'din l-entrata? Pawlu: Ifisser li ddaħħal xi ħaġa fil-warrani tiegħek u terġa' toħroġha, għal darba wara l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Marija: What does 'totorġu' mean in this entry? Pawlu: It means putting something into your posterior and pulling it out again, repeatedly.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这个词条里的 totorġu 是什么意思？Pawlu：意思是将某物放入自己的臀部再抽出，如此反复。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.zh: 这个词条里的 totorġu 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'totorġu' mean in this entry?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li ddaħħal xi ħaġa fil-warrani tiegħek u terġa' toħroġha, għal darba wara l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li ddaħħal xi ħaġa fil-warrani tiegħek u terġa' toħroġha, għal darba wara l-oħra.
messages.zh: 意思是将某物放入自己的臀部再抽出，如此反复。
messages.en: It means putting something into your posterior and pulling it out again, repeatedly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“放入—抽出—反复”三个语义环节记忆 totorġu，并记住这个词条限定的身体位置是臀部；这是释义记忆法，不是词源拆解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A proper name used to identify a place or entity called Tottenham.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 专有名称“托特纳姆”，用于指称以 Tottenham 为名的地方或实体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem proprju li jirreferi għal post jew entità msejħa Tottenham.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 托特纳姆；指称特定地方或实体的专有名称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tottenham huwa isem proprju li jintuża biex jidentifika post jew entità b'dan l-isem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Tottenham is a proper name that identifies a particular place or entity.

collocations.zh: 一份关于托特纳姆的报告

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, l-isem Tottenham għandu jinkiteb b'ittra kapitali fil-bidu.
formal.en: In the report, the name Tottenham should be written with an initial capital letter.
formal.zh: 在报告中，Tottenham 这个名称的首字母应当大写。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif nikteb Tottenham? Mark: B'T kbira fil-bidu u b'żewġ t wara l-o.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do I spell Tottenham? Mark: With a capital T at the beginning and two t's after the o.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：Tottenham 怎么拼写？马克：开头用大写 T，o 后面有两个 t。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: Tottenham 怎么拼写？
messages.en: How do I spell Tottenham?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: B'T kbira fil-bidu u b'żewġ t wara l-o.
messages.mt_standard: B'T kbira fil-bidu u b'żewġ t wara l-o.
messages.zh: 开头用大写 T，o 后面有两个 t。
messages.en: With a capital T at the beginning and two t's after the o.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Tottenham 当作姓名卡上的专名来记：中文对应“托特纳姆”，书写时注意开头大写 T，以及 o 后连续两个 t。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Bread that has been browned and made crisp by heat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经过烘烤，表面变成金黄色并变得酥脆的面包。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħobż li jissaħħan sakemm jieħu kulur dehbi u jsir iqarmeċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烤至表面金黄、口感酥脆的面包。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-towst huwa ħobż mixwi li jkun sar iqarmeċ u jkun ħa kulur dehbi bis-sħana.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Toast is bread that you heat until its surface becomes brown and crisp.

formal.mt: Għall-kolazzjon, il-mistednin jistgħu jagħżlu towst bil-butir jew bil-ġamm.
formal.en: For breakfast, guests can choose toast with butter or jam.
formal.zh: 早餐时，客人可以选择配黄油或果酱的烤面包。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid towst bil-butir? Mark: Iva, grazzi. Għamillu ftit ġamm ukoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like toast with butter? Mark: Yes, thanks. Put a little jam on it too.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想吃涂黄油的烤面包吗？马克：想，谢谢。再涂一点果酱吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想吃涂黄油的烤面包吗？
messages.en: Would you like toast with butter?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi. Għamillu ftit ġamm ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi. Għamillu ftit ġamm ukoll.
messages.zh: 想，谢谢。再涂一点果酱吧。
messages.en: Yes, thanks. Put a little jam on it too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 towst 和早餐时金黄酥脆的面包片联系起来，再连着记 towst bil-butir“黄油烤面包”，用食物画面帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A kitchen appliance used to toast bread.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把面包片烤热、烤脆的厨房电器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat tal-kċina li jintuża biex jixwi l-ħobż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用来烘烤面包的器具，即烤面包机。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Towster huwa apparat li jixwi l-ħobż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A toaster is a kitchen appliance that heats bread until it becomes crisp.

formal.mt: Il-kċina tal-uffiċċju għandha towster biex l-impjegati jkunu jistgħu jixwu l-ħobż għall-kolazzjon.
formal.en: The office kitchen has a toaster so that employees can toast bread for breakfast.
formal.zh: 办公室厨房配有烤面包机，方便员工烤面包作为早餐。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid il-ħobż mixwi? Pawlu: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Fejn hu t-towster? Lara: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn il-kitla.
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like your bread toasted? Pawlu: Yes, please. Where is the toaster? Lara: On the table, next to the kettle.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你想把面包烤一下吗？保罗：想，谢谢。烤面包机在哪里？拉拉：在桌上，水壶旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 你想把面包烤一下吗？
messages.en: Would you like your bread toasted?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Fejn hu t-towster?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Fejn hu t-towster?
messages.zh: 想，谢谢。烤面包机在哪里？
messages.en: Yes, please. Where is the toaster?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 在桌上，水壶旁边。
messages.en: On the table, next to the kettle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 towster 与早餐时面包片烤脆的画面绑定，看到这个词就想起烤面包机。

gloss_zh: 动词形式，所给材料未说明具体词义

teaching_sense.en_definition: A verb entry written as 'tozboq', whose specific meaning is not supplied.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 材料中写作 tozboq 的动词条目；材料未提供足以确定其具体含义的释义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Din hija entrata verbali miktuba 'tozboq', iżda l-materjal mogħti ma jispeċifikax it-tifsira tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原释义仅重复 tozboq，未说明这个动词的具体含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-glossa tirrepeti biss il-forma 'tozboq' u ma tagħtix definizzjoni tat-tifsira tal-verb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This entry identifies a verb, but its supplied gloss does not explain what the verb means.

collocations.zh: 动词 tozboq（用于谈论该词的表达）
tozboq 的含义（用于询问词义的表达）

formal.mt: Il-materjal jelenka 'tozboq' bħala verb, iżda ma jagħtix definizzjoni li tispjega t-tifsira tiegħu.
formal.en: The material lists 'tozboq' as a verb but provides no definition explaining its meaning.
formal.zh: 材料将 tozboq 列为动词，但没有提供解释其含义的定义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'tozboq' f'din il-lista? Mark: Il-lista tgħid li hu verb, iżda ma tispjegax it-tifsira tiegħu. Maja: Mela nniżżel li t-tifsira għad trid tiġi ċċarata.

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make fabric or other items by forming linked loops of yarn with a crochet hook.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用钩针将纱线钩成相连的线圈，从而制作织物或其他物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel drapp jew oġġetti oħra billi tifforma ħoloq tal-ħajt magħqudin ma' xulxin permezz ta' ganċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用钩针把纱线钩成相互连接的线圈，制作衣物、饰品等。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taħdem il-ħajt b'ganċ biex toħloq ħoloq magħqudin ma' xulxin u tagħmel oġġetti bħal xalel, kutri jew tiżjin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you crochet, you use a crochet hook to form yarn into connected loops and make things such as scarves or blankets.

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni tal-artiġjanat, l-istudenti jitgħallmu t-tifsira tal-verb 'tpannit' billi jagħmlu kampjun żgħir bil-ħajt u bil-ganċ.
formal.en: In the crafts lesson, students learn the meaning of the verb 'tpannit' by making a small sample with yarn and a crochet hook.
formal.zh: 在手工课上，学生用纱线和钩针制作一小块样品，学习动词“tpannit”的含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'tpannit'? Rita: Ifisser taħdem il-ħajt bil-ganċ, bħal meta tagħmel xalla. Maja: Mela għandi bżonn ganċ u ħajt biex nipprova!
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'tpannit' mean? Rita: It means working yarn with a crochet hook, like when you make a shawl. Maja: Then I need a crochet hook and some yarn to try it!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：“tpannit”是什么意思？丽塔：就是用钩针编织纱线，比如钩一条披肩。玛雅：那我要准备钩针和纱线来试试！

messages.speaker: Maja (手工初学者)
messages.zh: “tpannit”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tpannit' mean?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser taħdem il-ħajt bil-ganċ, bħal meta tagħmel xalla.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser taħdem il-ħajt bil-ganċ, bħal meta tagħmel xalla.
messages.zh: 就是用钩针编织纱线，比如钩一条披肩。
messages.en: It means working yarn with a crochet hook, like when you make a shawl.

messages.speaker: Maja (手工初学者)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela għandi bżonn ganċ u ħajt biex nipprova!
messages.mt_standard: Mela għandi bżonn ganċ u ħajt biex nipprova!
messages.zh: 那我要准备钩针和纱线来试试！
messages.en: Then I need a crochet hook and some yarn to try it!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tpannit 和“一支钩针、一团纱线、一圈接一圈”的画面绑定，记住它表示钩织。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To stop something from happening or stop someone from doing something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某件事情不发生，或使某人无法做某件事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Twaqqaf xi ħaġa milli sseħħ jew lil xi ħadd milli jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 采取措施或形成阻碍，使某事不发生，或使某人不能进行某项行动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tieħu miżuri jew toħloq ostaklu biex xi ħaġa ma sseħħx jew biex xi ħadd ma jkunx jista' jagħmel xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you prevent something, you stop it from happening; if you prevent someone from doing something, you stop them from doing it.

formal.mt: Fil-materjal tat-taħriġ dwar is-sigurtà, il-verb 'tpreventa' huwa spjegat permezz ta' miżuri li jwaqqfu l-inċidenti milli jseħħu.
formal.en: In the safety training materials, the verb 'tpreventa' is explained through measures that stop accidents from happening.
formal.zh: 在安全培训材料中，动词“tpreventa”通过防止事故发生的措施来解释。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Xi jfisser 'tpreventa'? Sara: Ifisser twaqqaf xi ħaġa milli tiġri, bħal meta timsaħ l-ilma mill-art biex ħadd ma jiżloq. Mark: Issa fhimt: tieħu ħsieb il-periklu qabel ma jiġri l-inċident.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does 'tpreventa' mean? Sara: It means stopping something from happening, like wiping water off the floor so nobody slips. Mark: Now I understand: you deal with the danger before the accident happens.
colloquial.zh: 马克：“tpreventa”是什么意思？萨拉：就是防止某事发生，比如把地上的水擦干，让人不会滑倒。马克：我明白了，就是在事故发生前处理危险。

messages.speaker: Mark (新同事)
messages.zh: “tpreventa”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tpreventa' mean?

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser twaqqaf xi ħaġa milli tiġri, bħal meta timsaħ l-ilma mill-art biex ħadd ma jiżloq.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser twaqqaf xi ħaġa milli tiġri, bħal meta timsaħ l-ilma mill-art biex ħadd ma jiżloq.
messages.zh: 就是防止某事发生，比如把地上的水擦干，让人不会滑倒。
messages.en: It means stopping something from happening, like wiping water off the floor so nobody slips.

messages.speaker: Mark (新同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa fhimt: tieħu ħsieb il-periklu qabel ma jiġri l-inċident.
messages.mt_standard: Issa fhimt: tieħu ħsieb il-periklu qabel ma jiġri l-inċident.
messages.zh: 我明白了，就是在事故发生前处理危险。
messages.en: Now I understand: you deal with the danger before the accident happens.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tpreventa 与英文 prevent 配对记忆，想象先擦干地上的水，防止别人滑倒；重点是让事情不发生。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of comparing prices offered by different sellers before deciding where to buy something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 购买前比较不同商家对商品或服务的报价，以决定在哪里购买的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li tqabbel il-prezzijiet ta' prodotti jew servizzi għand bejjiegħa differenti qabel tiddeċiedi mingħand min tixtri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 购买前比较不同商家的价格，以选择合适购买渠道的活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-attività li tiċċekkja u tqabbel il-prezzijiet għand ħwienet jew bejjiegħa differenti qabel tixtri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Comparison shopping is the activity of checking prices from different sellers before deciding where to buy something.

collocations.en: comparison of prices across different shops
collocations.zh: 不同商店之间的价格比较

formal.mt: It-tqabbil tal-prezzijiet jgħin lill-konsumaturi jagħżlu offerta li taqbel mal-baġit tagħhom.
formal.en: Comparing prices helps consumers choose an offer that suits their budget.
formal.zh: 比价有助于消费者选择符合自身预算的优惠方案。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se tixtri dan il-friġġ illum? Mark: L-ewwel nagħmel tqabbil tal-prezzijiet; forsi nsibu orħos f'ħanut ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you buying this fridge today? Mark: I'll compare prices first; perhaps we can find it cheaper in another shop.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你今天就买这台冰箱吗？Mark：我先比比价，也许我们能在另一家店找到更便宜的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天就买这台冰箱吗？
messages.en: Are you buying this fridge today?

messages.speaker: Mark (购物者)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel nagħmel tqabbil tal-prezzijiet; forsi nsibu orħos f'ħanut ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel nagħmel tqabbil tal-prezzijiet; forsi nsibu orħos f'ħanut ieħor.
messages.zh: 我先比比价，也许我们能在另一家店找到更便宜的。
messages.en: I'll compare prices first; perhaps we can find it cheaper in another shop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组词想成购物前的固定动作：同一商品看三家，把价格并排比较，再决定购买。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To accept or put up with something unpleasant without stopping it or reacting strongly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对令人不快的事物加以忍受或容忍，没有立即制止或作出强烈反应。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tissaporti xi ħaġa li ddejqek mingħajr ma twaqqafha jew tirreaġixxi b'mod qawwi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 忍受或容忍令人不快的情况、行为或事物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taċċetta jew tissaporti sitwazzjoni, imġiba jew ħaġa li ddejqek, mingħajr ma twaqqafha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you tolerate something unpleasant, you allow it to continue or endure it without reacting strongly.

formal.mt: Waqt ix-xogħol ta' manutenzjoni, tqanna l-istorbju għal ftit ħin u segwi l-istruzzjonijiet tal-persunal.
formal.en: During maintenance work, tolerate the noise for a short time and follow the staff's instructions.
formal.zh: 维修期间，请暂时忍受噪声，并遵从工作人员的指示。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan l-istorbju qed idejjaqni! Pawlu: Tqanna ftit; ix-xogħol dalwaqt jispiċċa.
colloquial.en: Sara: This noise is bothering me! Pawlu: Put up with it for a little while; the work will be finished soon.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这噪声真让我受不了！Pawlu：再忍一会儿，施工很快就结束了。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 这噪声真让我受不了！
messages.en: This noise is bothering me!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.zh: 再忍一会儿，施工很快就结束了。
messages.en: Put up with it for a little while; the work will be finished soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想隔壁短暂施工的场景：声音让人烦，但先忍一会儿，用这个画面记住“忍受、容忍”。

gloss_zh: 勉强维持生计；设法收支相抵

teaching_sense.en_definition: To manage with limited money so that essential living expenses can be paid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在收入有限的情况下设法支付基本生活开支，使收支勉强相抵。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tlaħħaq mal-ispejjeż essenzjali tal-ħajja bil-ftit flus li jkollok.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 设法用有限的收入支付生活必需开支，勉强维持生计。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirnexxilek tħallas għall-ħtiġijiet bażiċi minkejja li jkollok ftit flus.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone makes ends meet, they manage to pay for their basic needs with the money available.

collocations.en: make ends meet on a low income
collocations.zh: 靠微薄收入勉强维持生计

collocations.en: make ends meet to cover the bills
collocations.zh: 设法维持收支以支付账单

formal.mt: B'dħul limitat u spejjeż għoljin, il-familja kellha tqanqeċ biex tħallas għall-ħtiġijiet ta' kuljum.
formal.en: With limited income and high expenses, the family had to make ends meet to pay for everyday necessities.
formal.zh: 收入有限而开支很高，这家人只得精打细算，勉强支付日常必需品的费用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sejra l-familja tiegħek? Mark: Bħalissa trid tqanqeċ biex tlaħħaq mal-kontijiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is your family doing? Mark: At the moment, my family has to make ends meet to cover the bills.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你家最近怎么样？Mark：眼下家里得精打细算，才能勉强付清账单。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你家最近怎么样？
messages.en: How is your family doing?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bħalissa trid tqanqeċ biex tlaħħaq mal-kontijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Bħalissa trid tqanqeċ biex tlaħħaq mal-kontijiet.
messages.zh: 眼下家里得精打细算，才能勉强付清账单。
messages.en: At the moment, my family has to make ends meet to cover the bills.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tqanqeċ 联想成月底核对钱包和账单的画面：钱刚够支付基本开支，记住的是“勉强维持生计”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Possibly to make an effort to do something; the supplied meaning is tentative.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可能指为了做成某事而努力或使劲；所给释义带有疑问，暂作此解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Skont it-tifsira proviżorja mogħtija, tfisser li tagħmel sforz biex tagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 努力去做某事，或为完成某事而使劲（所给释义尚未确定）。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira mogħtija tissuġġerixxi li tagħmel sforz biex twettaq xi ħaġa, iżda din it-tifsira għadha mhix ikkonfermata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss tentatively suggests that someone tries hard to do or achieve something.

collocations.en: make an effort to succeed (tentative reading)
collocations.zh: 为取得成功而努力（按暂定词义理解）

collocations.en: make an effort to finish the work (tentative reading)
collocations.zh: 为完成工作而努力（按暂定词义理解）

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, 'tqanżah' qed tintuża proviżorjament fis-sens li tagħmel sforz biex twettaq xi ħaġa.
formal.en: In this exercise, 'tqanżah' is provisionally used to mean making an effort to accomplish something.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，tqanżah 暂按“为完成某事而努力”的意思使用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'tqanżah' hawn? Mark: Skont it-tifsira mogħtija, tfisser li tagħmel sforz, iżda rridu nikkonfermawha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'tqanżah' mean here? Mark: According to the supplied meaning, it means making an effort, but we need to confirm that.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里的 tqanżah 是什么意思？Mark：按给出的释义，是“努力”的意思，不过这个解释还需要确认。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这里的 tqanżah 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tqanżah' mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Skont it-tifsira mogħtija, tfisser li tagħmel sforz, iżda rridu nikkonfermawha.
messages.mt_standard: Skont it-tifsira mogħtija, tfisser li tagħmel sforz, iżda rridu nikkonfermawha.
messages.zh: 按给出的释义，是“努力”的意思，不过这个解释还需要确认。
messages.en: According to the supplied meaning, it means making an effort, but we need to confirm that.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tqanżah 做一张“努力完成任务”的画面卡，并在旁边保留问号，提醒自己这只是材料提供的暂定词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small drops of liquid scattered onto a surface, or the scattering of those drops.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 液体以小滴形式向外溅散的现象，也指飞溅到表面的液滴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qtar żgħir ta' likwidu li jinxtered fuq wiċċ, jew it-tixrid ta' dan il-qtar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 飞溅的液滴，或液体以小滴形式溅散的现象。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Qtar ta' likwidu li jinxtered u jaqa' fuq wiċċ, jew l-att ta' dan it-tixrid.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Spatter is liquid that scatters in small drops, or the scattering of these drops onto a surface.

collocations.zh: 保护地面免受液滴飞溅

formal.mt: Qabel tibda tiżbogħ, għatti l-art biex tipproteġiha mit-tqatter taż-żebgħa.
formal.en: Before you start painting, cover the floor to protect it from paint spatter.
formal.zh: 开始刷漆前，先盖好地面，以免漆滴飞溅到上面。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għattejt l-art? Pawlu: Biex nipproteġiha mit-tqatter taż-żebgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you cover the floor? Pawlu: To protect it from paint spatter.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么把地面盖起来了？保罗：为了防止漆滴飞溅到地上。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把地面盖起来了？
messages.en: Why did you cover the floor?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 为了防止漆滴飞溅到地上。
messages.en: To protect it from paint spatter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刷漆时小漆滴四处飞溅，把 tqatter 与地上的点点漆斑联系起来记。

gloss_zh: 投放市场；使产品进入市场供应

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of making a product available for purchase on the market.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使产品进入市场、可供购买的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih prodott isir disponibbli għax-xiri fis-suq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使产品在市场上可供购买；投放市场。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih prodott jitqiegħed fis-suq sabiex ikun disponibbli għal min irid jixtrih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Making a product available on the market means offering it so that customers can buy it.

collocations.en: making a new product available on the market
the date when a product becomes available on the market

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija se tivverifika l-kwalità tal-prodott qabel it-tqegħid tiegħu fis-suq.
formal.en: The company will check the product's quality before making it available on the market.
formal.zh: 公司将在产品投放市场前检查其质量。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Meta se jkun jista' jinxtara l-prodott il-ġdid? Mark: It-tqegħid fis-suq tiegħu hu ppjanat għax-xahar id-dieħel.
colloquial.en: Lara: When will people be able to buy the new product? Mark: It is scheduled to become available on the market next month.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：大家什么时候能买到这款新产品？马克：计划下个月投放市场。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta se jkun jista' jinxtara l-prodott il-ġdid?
messages.mt_standard: Meta se jkun jista' jinxtara l-prodott il-ġdid?
messages.zh: 大家什么时候能买到这款新产品？
messages.en: When will people be able to buy the new product?

messages.speaker: Mark (产品经理)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tqegħid fis-suq tiegħu hu ppjanat għax-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.mt_standard: It-tqegħid fis-suq tiegħu hu ppjanat għax-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.zh: 计划下个月将它投放市场。
messages.en: It is scheduled to become available on the market next month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tqegħid fis-suq 想成新产品进入市场、顾客终于可以买到的那一步，整组记作“投放市场”。

exact_key: tqegħid ta' merkanzija taħt proċedura doganali
gloss_zh: 将货物纳入海关程序；货物海关程序申报

teaching_sense.en_definition: The formal act of placing goods under a customs procedure so that they are dealt with according to that procedure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正式将货物纳入某项海关程序，使货物按照该程序接受处理的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att formali li bih merkanzija titqiegħed taħt proċedura doganali biex tiġi ttrattata skont dik il-proċedura.

sense_translations.en_definition: entry of goods for a customs procedure
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为使某项海关程序适用于货物而办理的正式申报。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-dikjarazzjoni formali ta' merkanzija sabiex tiġi applikata għaliha proċedura doganali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When goods are entered for a customs procedure, they are formally declared so that the procedure can apply to them.

sense_translations.en_definition: placing of goods under a customs procedure
sense_translations.zh_definition: 将货物置于某项海关程序之下，使其按照该程序接受处理的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li bih merkanzija titqiegħed taħt proċedura doganali u ssir soġġetta għat-trattament previst minn dik il-proċedura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The placing of goods under a customs procedure is the act of bringing them within the arrangements of that procedure.

collocations.mt: talba għat-tqegħid ta' merkanzija taħt proċedura doganali
collocations.en: an application to place goods under a customs procedure
collocations.zh: 将货物纳入海关程序的申请

collocations.mt: id-data tat-tqegħid ta' merkanzija taħt proċedura doganali
collocations.en: the date on which goods are placed under a customs procedure
collocations.zh: 货物纳入海关程序的日期

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tqegħid ta' merkanzija taħt proċedura doganali u jagħti d-dettalji tal-merkanzija kkonċernata.
formal.en: The report describes the placing of goods under a customs procedure and provides details of the goods concerned.
formal.zh: 报告说明了将货物纳入海关程序的情况，并列出了相关货物的详细信息。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Xi tfisser 'tqegħid ta' merkanzija taħt proċedura doganali' fuq din il-formola? Lara: Tfisser li l-merkanzija titqiegħed taħt proċedura doganali partikolari biex tiġi ttrattata skont dik il-proċedura.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does 'placing goods under a customs procedure' mean on this form? Lara: It means that the goods are placed under a particular customs procedure so that they are dealt with according to that procedure.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这张表上的“将货物纳入海关程序”是什么意思？拉拉：意思是让货物适用某项具体的海关程序，并按照该程序接受处理。

messages.speaker: Mark (货主)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'tqegħid ta' merkanzija taħt proċedura doganali' fuq din il-formola?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'tqegħid ta' merkanzija taħt proċedura doganali' fuq din il-formola?
messages.zh: 这张表上的“将货物纳入海关程序”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'placing goods under a customs procedure' mean on this form?

messages.speaker: Lara (报关员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li l-merkanzija titqiegħed taħt proċedura doganali partikolari biex tiġi ttrattata skont dik il-proċedura.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li l-merkanzija titqiegħed taħt proċedura doganali partikolari biex tiġi ttrattata skont dik il-proċedura.
messages.zh: 意思是让货物适用某项具体的海关程序，并按照该程序接受处理。
messages.en: It means that the goods are placed under a particular customs procedure so that they are dealt with according to that procedure.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语想成给货物贴上一张海关程序标签：重点是货物被纳入某项程序，而不只是搬进海关大楼。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have been brought up and cared for during childhood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在童年时期受到照料和养育，逐渐长大。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li persuna tkun ġiet imrobbija u ngħatat il-kura matul it-tfulija tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到抚养和照料而长大。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li persuna tkun ġiet imrobbija u ħadu ħsiebha waqt li kienet qed tikber.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone was raised in a particular family or environment, they were cared for and brought up there as a child.

collocations.en: raised with a great deal of love
collocations.zh: 在充满关爱的照料下长大
在给予支持的环境中长大

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, il-kelma 'trabbut' tirreferi għat-trobbija u l-kura li persuna rċeviet matul it-tfulija tagħha.
formal.en: In this exercise, the word 'trabbut' refers to the upbringing and care that a person received during childhood.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，“trabbut”指一个人在童年时期所受到的养育和照料。

colloquial.mt: Maja: 'Trabbut' hawn għandha x'taqsam ma' kif xi ħadd kiber? Pawlu: Iva, tirreferi għall-fatt li xi ħadd ġie mrobbi u ħadu ħsiebu meta kien tifel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does 'trabbut' here have to do with how someone grew up? Pawlu: Yes, it refers to someone being brought up and cared for as a child.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的“trabbut”与一个人怎样长大有关吗？保罗：是的，它指一个人在小时候受到养育和照料。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: 'Trabbut' hawn għandha x'taqsam ma' kif xi ħadd kiber?
messages.mt_standard: 'Trabbut' hawn għandha x'taqsam ma' kif xi ħadd kiber?
messages.zh: 这里的“trabbut”与一个人怎样长大有关吗？
messages.en: Does 'trabbut' here have to do with how someone grew up?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tirreferi għall-fatt li xi ħadd ġie mrobbi u ħadu ħsiebu meta kien tifel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tirreferi għall-fatt li xi ħadd ġie mrobbi u ħadu ħsiebu meta kien tifel.
messages.zh: 是的，它指一个人在小时候受到养育和照料。
messages.en: Yes, it refers to someone being brought up and cared for as a child.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时联想一本童年相册：每一页都有人照顾孩子，帮助你把这个词与“被抚养长大”的意思联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device or arrangement intended to catch an animal or person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为捕捉动物或使人落入其中而设置的陷阱、圈套。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mezz jew arranġament imħejji biex jaqbad annimal jew persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于捕捉动物或困住人的陷阱；也可指诱人上当的圈套。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mezz biex jinqabad annimal jew persuna, jew qerq imħejji biex xi ħadd jitqarraq u jidħol f'diffikultà.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A trap or snare is a device designed to catch an animal or person, or a scheme intended to deceive someone.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif l-annimal inqabad fi trabokk u nħeles mingħajr ma weġġa'.
formal.en: The report describes how the animal was caught in a trap and released without being injured.
formal.zh: 报告描述了这只动物如何落入陷阱，并在未受伤的情况下获救。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak il-wajer mal-art. Taħseb li hemm trabokk? Mark: Jista' jkun. Tmissu xejn u ejja nitbiegħdu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that wire on the ground. Do you think there is a trap? Mark: There might be. Don't touch it, and let's move away.
colloquial.zh: Maja：看地上那根铁丝。你觉得那里有陷阱吗？Mark：有可能。别碰它，我们离远一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak il-wajer mal-art. Taħseb li hemm trabokk?
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak il-wajer mal-art. Taħseb li hemm trabokk?
messages.zh: 看地上那根铁丝。你觉得那里有陷阱吗？
messages.en: Look at that wire on the ground. Do you think there is a trap?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jista' jkun. Tmissu xejn u ejja nitbiegħdu.
messages.mt_standard: Jista' jkun. Tmissu xejn u ejja nitbiegħdu.
messages.zh: 有可能。别碰它，我们离远一点。
messages.en: There might be. Don't touch it, and let's move away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 trabokk 和“脚边藏着陷阱”的画面配对，再用 jaqa' fi trabokk 练习表达“落入陷阱”。这是情景记忆法，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool with a spiral metal point used to remove a cork from a bottle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有金属螺旋尖头、用于拔出瓶中软木塞的开瓶器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'ponta tal-metall f'forma ta' spirali, li tintuża biex jitneħħa tapp tas-sufra minn flixkun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将螺旋金属尖头旋入软木塞后，用来把软木塞从瓶口拔出的工具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għodda li l-ponta spirali tagħha tiddaħħal f'tapp tas-sufra biex it-tapp ikun jista' jinġibed minn flixkun.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A corkscrew is a tool whose spiral metal point is twisted into a cork so that the cork can be pulled out of a bottle.

collocations.en: open a bottle with a corkscrew
collocations.zh: 用螺旋开瓶器打开瓶子

formal.mt: Biex jitneħħa t-tapp tas-sufra, daħħal il-ponta spirali tat-trabuxù fiċ-ċentru tat-tapp u dawwarha bil-mod.
formal.en: To remove the cork, insert the spiral point of the corkscrew into the centre of the cork and turn it slowly.
formal.zh: 要取出软木塞，请将螺旋开瓶器的尖头插入木塞中央，再慢慢旋转。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu t-trabuxù? Irrid niftaħ dan il-flixkun. Mark: Fil-kexxun ħdejn il-kuċċarini. Ħa nġibhulek.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the corkscrew? I want to open this bottle. Mark: In the drawer next to the teaspoons. I'll get it for you.
colloquial.zh: Maja：螺旋开瓶器在哪里？我想打开这瓶酒。Mark：在抽屉里，茶匙旁边。我给你拿来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu t-trabuxù? Irrid niftaħ dan il-flixkun.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu t-trabuxù? Irrid niftaħ dan il-flixkun.
messages.zh: 螺旋开瓶器在哪里？我想打开这个瓶子。
messages.en: Where is the corkscrew? I want to open this bottle.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 在抽屉里，茶匙旁边。我给你拿来。
messages.en: In the drawer next to the teaspoons. I'll get it for you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 trabuxù 时，想象金属螺旋慢慢旋入软木塞，再把木塞拔出；将词语与完整开瓶动作一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of betraying the trust or loyalty owed to a person, group, or country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 违背对个人、团体或国家应有的信任与忠诚的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att li bih xi ħadd jikser il-fiduċja jew il-lealtà lejn persuna, grupp jew pajjiż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 背信弃义；辜负他人信任、违背忠诚的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Imġiba li biha persuna tikser il-fiduċja li ħaddieħor ikollu fiha jew tonqos mil-lealtà lejh.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Treachery is behaviour in which someone deliberately betrays another person's trust or loyalty.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 叛国；背叛自己国家的行为，例如帮助敌国。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li bih persuna tittradixxi lil pajjiżha, pereżempju billi tgħin lill-għadu tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Treason is the crime of betraying your country, for example by helping its enemies.

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-kxif tas-sigriet lill-għadu jitqies bħala att ta' tradiment.
formal.en: In the novel, revealing the secret to the enemy is regarded as an act of betrayal.
formal.zh: 在小说中，向敌人泄露秘密被视为背叛行为。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għedtlek sigriet, u inti għedtu lil kulħadd. Għalija dan hu tradiment. Mark: Għandek raġun. Ksirt il-fiduċja tiegħek, u jiddispjaċini.
colloquial.en: Maja: I told you a secret, and you told everyone. To me, that is betrayal. Mark: You're right. I broke your trust, and I'm sorry.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我告诉你一个秘密，你却告诉了所有人。对我来说，这就是背叛。Mark：你说得对。我辜负了你的信任，对不起。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għedtlek sigriet, u inti għedtu lil kulħadd. Għalija dan hu tradiment.
messages.mt_standard: Għedtlek sigriet, u inti għedtu lil kulħadd. Għalija dan hu tradiment.
messages.zh: 我告诉你一个秘密，你却告诉了所有人。对我来说，这就是背叛。
messages.en: I told you a secret, and you told everyone. To me, that is betrayal.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun. Ksirt il-fiduċja tiegħek, u jiddispjaċini.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun. Ksirt il-fiduċja tiegħek, u jiddispjaċini.
messages.zh: 你说得对。我辜负了你的信任，对不起。
messages.en: You're right. I broke your trust, and I'm sorry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tradiment 放进“托付秘密却被泄露”的画面，记住它指背叛这件事；对象换成国家时，可表示叛国。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who betrays someone else's trust or is disloyal to their group or country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 辜负他人信任，或背叛自己所属团体、国家的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tikser il-fiduċja ta' ħaddieħor jew tittradixxi lill-grupp jew lill-pajjiż tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 叛徒；背叛他人信任、所属团体或自己国家的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tittradixxi lil min jafdaha, lill-grupp li tagħmel parti minnu jew lil pajjiżha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A traitor is someone who betrays a person, group, or country to which they owe loyalty.

collocations.mt: iqis lil xi ħadd bħala traditur

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-membri tal-grupp iqisu lil Pawlu bħala traditur għax għadda informazzjoni sigrieta lill-għadu.
formal.en: In the novel, the group members regard Pawlu as a traitor because he passed secret information to the enemy.
formal.zh: 在小说中，团体成员把 Pawlu 视为叛徒，因为他向敌人传递了秘密情报。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex fil-film isejħulu traditur? David: Għax għen lill-għadu u kixef il-pjan ta' sħabu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do they call him a traitor in the film? David: Because he helped the enemy and revealed his companions' plan.
colloquial.zh: Sara：电影里他们为什么叫他叛徒？David：因为他帮助敌人，还泄露了同伴们的计划。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影里他们为什么叫他叛徒？
messages.en: Why do they call him a traitor in the film?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għen lill-għadu u kixef il-pjan ta' sħabu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għen lill-għadu u kixef il-pjan ta' sħabu.
messages.zh: 因为他帮助敌人，还泄露了同伴们的计划。
messages.en: Because he helped the enemy and revealed his companions' plan.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象故事里把同伴计划交给敌人的那个人，用 traditur 给这个人物贴上“叛徒”标签，记住它指人。

gloss_zh: 已翻译的；译成另一种语言的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rendered from one language into another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指文字或话语已从一种语言转换成另一种语言的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġie maqlub minn lingwa għal oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已从一种语言译成另一种语言的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi test jew diskors li ġie maqlub minn lingwa għal oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A translated text expresses in another language what the original text says.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tradott għall-Malti se jkun disponibbli fuq is-sit tal-istituzzjoni.
formal.en: The report translated into Maltese will be available on the institution's website.
formal.zh: 译成马耳他语的报告将在该机构的网站上提供。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ktieb miktub bil-Malti? Leo: Iva, imma hu tradott mill-Ingliż.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this book written in Maltese? Leo: Yes, but it is translated from English.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这本书是用马耳他语写的吗？Leo：是的，不过它是从英语翻译过来的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这本书是用马耳他语写的吗？
messages.en: Is this book written in Maltese?

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，不过它是从英语翻译过来的。
messages.en: Yes, but it is translated from English.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tradott 贴在一本译本的封面上，联想“这本书已经译好了”；搭配 ktieb tradott 记住它描述已翻译的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who translates written texts from one language into another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将书面文本从一种语言翻译成另一种语言的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tittraduċi testi miktuba minn lingwa għal oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把一种语言的书面文本译成另一种语言的人；译者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Traduttur huwa persuna li taqleb testi miktuba minn lingwa għal oħra filwaqt li żżomm it-tifsira tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A translator is someone who expresses written material in another language while preserving its meaning.

formal.mt: It-traduttur għandu jiċċekkja t-termini tekniċi qabel ma jibgħat it-traduzzjoni finali lill-klijent.
formal.en: The translator should check the technical terms before sending the final translation to the client.
formal.zh: 译者应在向客户提交最终译文之前核查专业术语。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min se jittraduċi dan id-dokument? Mark: Se nqabbad traduttur professjonali.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is going to translate this document? Mark: I am going to hire a professional translator.
colloquial.zh: Sara：谁来翻译这份文件？Mark：我打算请一位专业译者。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 谁来翻译这份文件？
messages.en: Who is going to translate this document?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 我打算请一位专业译者。
messages.en: I am going to hire a professional translator.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位手拿两种语言文本的人，给他挂上 traduttur 名牌；用 traduttur professjonali“专业译者”整组记忆，突出它指做翻译的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The illegal trade or transfer of arms.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 违反法律买卖、运输或转移武器的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività illegali ta' xiri, bejgħ, trasport jew trasferiment ta' armi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非法买卖、运输或转移武器的活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-attività ta' xiri, bejgħ jew trasferiment ta' armi bi ksur tal-liġi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Illicit arms trafficking is the buying, selling, or transfer of arms in violation of the law.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 违反法律进行的武器交易或贩运活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kummerċ jew it-trasport ta' armi li jsir bi ksur tal-liġi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Illicit trafficking in arms involves trading or transporting arms in ways that break the law.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非法交易、运输或转移武器的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-attività illegali li tinvolvi l-bejgħ, it-trasport jew it-trasferiment ta' armi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Illicit trafficking in weapons is the unlawful trading, transportation, or transfer of weapons.

collocations.mt: il-ġlieda kontra t-traffikar illeċitu ta' armi
