collocations.en: the fight against illicit arms trafficking
the prevention of illicit arms trafficking

collocations.mt: investigazzjoni dwar it-traffikar illeċitu ta' armi
collocations.en: an investigation into illicit arms trafficking
collocations.zh: 对非法武器贩运的调查

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jenfasizza l-ħtieġa ta' kooperazzjoni bejn il-pajjiżi biex jiġi miġġieled it-traffikar illeċitu ta' armi.
formal.en: The report stresses the need for cooperation between countries to combat illicit arms trafficking.
formal.zh: 报告强调，各国需要合作打击非法武器贩运。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fuq xiex kien dak ir-rapport fl-aħbarijiet? Mark: Kien dwar it-traffikar illeċitu ta' armi. Maja: Issa fhimt għaliex kienu qed jitkellmu dwar il-kooperazzjoni bejn il-pajjiżi.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was that report on the news about? Mark: It was about illicit arms trafficking. Maja: Now I understand why they were talking about cooperation between countries.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：新闻里那则报道讲的是什么？马克：讲的是非法武器贩运。玛雅：现在我明白他们为什么在谈各国之间的合作了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq xiex kien dak ir-rapport fl-aħbarijiet?
messages.mt_standard: Fuq xiex kien dak ir-rapport fl-aħbarijiet?
messages.zh: 新闻里那则报道讲的是什么？
messages.en: What was that report on the news about?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien dwar it-traffikar illeċitu ta' armi.
messages.mt_standard: Kien dwar it-traffikar illeċitu ta' armi.
messages.zh: 讲的是非法武器贩运。
messages.en: It was about illicit arms trafficking.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa fhimt għaliex kienu qed jitkellmu dwar il-kooperazzjoni bejn il-pajjiżi.
messages.mt_standard: Issa fhimt għaliex kienu qed jitkellmu dwar il-kooperazzjoni bejn il-pajjiżi.
messages.zh: 现在我明白他们为什么在谈各国之间的合作了。
messages.en: Now I understand why they were talking about cooperation between countries.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按意思分块记忆：traffikar 表示贩运，illeċitu 表示非法，ta' armi 表示涉及武器；把三块连成“非法贩运武器”，再联想新闻中的调查报道。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The movement of vehicles along roads, or the vehicles using a road.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 道路上车辆的通行活动，也指在道路上行驶的车辆整体，即车流。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moviment tal-vetturi fit-toroq, jew il-vetturi li jkunu għaddejjin minn triq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 交通，尤指道路上的车辆通行或来往车流；该词本身不一定表示堵车。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-moviment tal-vetturi fit-toroq jew il-vetturi li jkunu qed jużaw triq f'ħin partikolari, mingħajr ma dan neċessarjament ifisser konġestjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Traffic refers to vehicles moving along roads or using a particular road at a given time, whether they are moving freely or slowly.

collocations.zh: 繁忙的交通；密集的车流

formal.mt: L-istudju janalizza l-fluss tat-traffiku fit-toroq ewlenin tal-belt matul is-sigħat ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: The study analyses the flow of traffic on the city's main roads during the morning hours.
formal.zh: 该研究分析了早晨时段城市主要道路上的车流情况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex wasalt tard? Mark: Kien hemm ħafna traffiku dalgħodu, u l-karozzi bilkemm kienu mexjin. Maja: Mela għada nitilqu ftit qabel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you arrive late? Mark: There was a lot of traffic this morning, and the cars were barely moving. Maja: Then let's leave a little earlier tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么迟到了？马克：今天早上车很多，车子几乎都走不动。玛雅：那我们明天早点出发吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么迟到了？
messages.en: Why did you arrive late?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm ħafna traffiku dalgħodu, u l-karozzi bilkemm kienu mexjin.
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm ħafna traffiku dalgħodu, u l-karozzi bilkemm kienu mexjin.
messages.zh: 今天早上车很多，车子几乎都走不动。
messages.en: There was a lot of traffic this morning, and the cars were barely moving.

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 那我们明天早点出发吧。
messages.en: Then let's leave a little earlier tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 traffiku 与英语 traffic 对照记忆，脑中想象道路上的来往车辆；搭配 ħafna traffiku 记“车很多”，但不要把这个词单独理解成“堵车”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The movement of vehicles along roads, especially when considered in terms of their number and flow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 道路上车辆的通行情况，尤指车流的数量与流动状况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moviment tal-vetturi fit-toroq, speċjalment meta jitqiesu l-għadd tagħhom u kif ikunu għaddejjin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 交通；道路上来往行驶的车辆及其通行状况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-vetturi li jkunu għaddejjin fit-toroq u l-mod kif jimxu minn post għal ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Traffic consists of the vehicles moving along roads and can be described according to how busy or slow it is.

collocations.zh: 繁忙的交通；密集的车流

formal.mt: Minħabba t-traficu qawwi qrib l-iskola, is-sewwieqa huma mitluba jsuqu bil-mod.
formal.en: Due to heavy traffic near the school, drivers are asked to drive slowly.
formal.zh: 由于学校附近车流密集，请驾驶员减速行驶。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se naslu tard? Mark: Jista' jkun; hemm ħafna traficu llum.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are we going to arrive late? Mark: We might; there's a lot of traffic today.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们会迟到吗？马克：有可能，今天路上的车很多。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们会迟到吗？
messages.en: Are we going to arrive late?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jista' jkun; hemm ħafna traficu llum.
messages.mt_standard: Jista' jkun; hemm ħafna traficu llum.
messages.zh: 有可能，今天路上的车很多。
messages.en: We might; there's a lot of traffic today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 traficu 和上学路上的车流画面联系起来：看到一辆辆车缓慢前行，就回想“交通、车流”；再用 ħafna traficu 记住“车很多”的表达。

gloss_zh: 英式分层海绵蛋糕卡仕达甜点

teaching_sense.en_definition: A layered dessert made with sponge cake and custard.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种将海绵蛋糕与卡仕达蛋奶酱分层叠放而成的甜点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Deżerta magħmula minn saffi ta' kejk sponża u krema tal-bajd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由海绵蛋糕和卡仕达蛋奶酱分层组成的英式甜点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Deżerta li fiha saffi ta' kejk sponża jitqiegħdu flimkien ma' saffi ta' krema tal-bajd.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Trifle is a dessert in which sponge cake and custard are arranged in layers.

collocations.zh: 制作分层蛋糕卡仕达甜点
一碗分层蛋糕卡仕达甜点

formal.mt: Għad-deżerta, ippreparajna trajfil b'saffi ta' kejk sponża u krema tal-bajd.
formal.en: For dessert, we prepared a trifle with layers of sponge cake and custard.
formal.zh: 我们准备了海绵蛋糕与卡仕达蛋奶酱分层组成的甜点，作为餐后甜点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid ftit trajfil? Mark: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Għoġbuni ħafna s-saffi tal-kejk u l-krema.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like some trifle? Mark: Yes, please. I really liked the layers of cake and custard.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想吃点分层蛋糕卡仕达甜点吗？马克：好的，谢谢。我很喜欢里面一层层的蛋糕和蛋奶酱。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想吃点分层蛋糕卡仕达甜点吗？
messages.en: Would you like some trifle?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Għoġbuni ħafna s-saffi tal-kejk u l-krema.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Għoġbuni ħafna s-saffi tal-kejk u l-krema.
messages.zh: 好的，谢谢。我很喜欢里面一层层的蛋糕和蛋奶酱。
messages.en: Yes, please. I really liked the layers of cake and custard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 trajfil 配上一幅透明甜点碗的图：蛋糕一层、蛋奶酱一层，用分层画面记住这个甜点名。

gloss_zh: Trajjeb（专名，英语对应名称为 Triple the Tajjeb）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The proper name corresponding to the English name Triple the Tajjeb.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 专名 Trajjeb，其英语对应名称为 Triple the Tajjeb。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem proprju Trajjeb, li jikkorrispondi għall-isem Ingliż "Triple the Tajjeb".

sense_translations.zh_definition: 专名 Trajjeb 的英语对应名称：Triple the Tajjeb。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-isem proprju Trajjeb, li bl-Ingliż jingħata bħala "Triple the Tajjeb".
sense_translations.en_explanation: Trajjeb is a proper name whose English equivalent is Triple the Tajjeb.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-isem Trajjeb jikkorrispondi għall-isem Ingliż "Triple the Tajjeb".
formal.en: In this exercise, the name Trajjeb corresponds to the English name "Triple the Tajjeb".
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，Trajjeb 这个名字对应的英语名称是“Triple the Tajjeb”。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif jinkiteb l-isem Trajjeb? Mark: B'ittra kbira fil-bidu u b'żewġ j fin-nofs.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do you spell the name Trajjeb? Mark: With a capital letter at the beginning and two j's in the middle.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：Trajjeb 这个名字怎么拼写？马克：开头用大写字母，中间有两个 j。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: Trajjeb 这个名字怎么拼写？
messages.en: How do you spell the name Trajjeb?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: B'ittra kbira fil-bidu u b'żewġ j fin-nofs.
messages.mt_standard: B'ittra kbira fil-bidu u b'żewġ j fin-nofs.
messages.zh: 开头用大写字母，中间有两个 j。
messages.en: With a capital letter at the beginning and two j's in the middle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Trajjeb 与 Triple the Tajjeb 写在同一张专名卡片上，圈出大写 T 和连续两个 j，配对记忆名称与拼写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A vehicle with three wheels, typically moved by pedalling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 装有三个车轮的车辆，通常通过脚踏驱动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vettura bi tliet roti li normalment titmexxa bil-pedali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 三轮车，通常指通过脚踏驱动的三轮车辆。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Vettura li għandha tliet roti u li normalment wieħed isuq billi jagħfas il-pedali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tricycle is a vehicle with three wheels that you usually move by pushing pedals with your feet.

formal.mt: Waqt l-attività fil-bitħa, kull tifel jew tifla jistgħu jsuqu trajsikil taħt is-superviżjoni ta' adult.
formal.en: During the activity in the yard, each child may ride a tricycle under adult supervision.
formal.zh: 在院子里的活动期间，每名儿童都可以在成人监督下骑三轮车。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Trid issuq it-trajsikil fil-bitħa? Leo: Iva! Tista' tgħinni ndur? Marta: Żgur, se nimxi ħdejk.
colloquial.en: Marta: Do you want to ride the tricycle in the yard? Leo: Yes! Can you help me turn? Marta: Of course, I'll walk beside you.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你想在院子里骑三轮车吗？利奥：想！你能帮我转弯吗？玛尔塔：当然，我会走在你旁边。

messages.speaker: Marta (母亲)
messages.zh: 你想在院子里骑三轮车吗？
messages.en: Do you want to ride the tricycle in the yard?

messages.speaker: Leo (儿子)
messages.zh: 想！你能帮我转弯吗？
messages.en: Yes! Can you help me turn?

messages.speaker: Marta (母亲)
messages.zh: 当然，我会走在你旁边。
messages.en: Of course, I'll walk beside you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把trajsikil和孩子踩着三轮车在院子里转弯的画面绑定，数清三个轮子，再连读isuq trajsikil，记住“骑三轮车”。

gloss_zh: 船行后留下的尾流；船迹

teaching_sense.en_definition: The trail of disturbed water left behind a moving ship or other vessel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 船只行驶后在其后方水面留下的波纹或扰动水流。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Traċċa ta' ilma mċaqlaq jew mewġ li bastiment jew dgħajsa jħallu warajhom waqt li jimxu fl-ilma.

sense_translations.en_definition: wake left in the water by a seafaring vessel, such as a ship
sense_translations.zh_definition: 船舶等水上航行器驶过后，在后方水面留下的尾流或波纹痕迹。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Traċċa fl-ilma magħmula minn mewġ jew ilma mċaqlaq li titħalla wara bastiment jew dgħajsa waqt li jkunu mexjin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A vessel's wake is the trail of waves or disturbed water that remains behind it as it moves.

formal.mt: Hekk kif il-bastiment ħareġ mill-port, ħalla warajh tranja twila li kienet tidher ċar minn fuq ix-xatt.
formal.en: As the ship left the harbour, it left a long wake behind it that was clearly visible from the shore.
formal.zh: 船舶驶离港口时，在后方留下了一道长长的尾流，从岸上可以清楚地看见。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dik il-linja bajda wara d-dgħajsa! Pawlu: Dik it-tranja tagħha, il-mewġ li tħalli warajha. Maja: Issa naraha; tasal sa hawn?
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that white line behind the boat! Pawlu: That's its wake, the waves it leaves behind. Maja: I see it now; will it reach us here?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看船后面那条白线！保罗：那是它的尾流，就是它在后方留下的波浪。玛雅：现在我看到了；会传到我们这里吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dik il-linja bajda wara d-dgħajsa!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dik il-linja bajda wara d-dgħajsa!
messages.zh: 看船后面那条白线！
messages.en: Look at that white line behind the boat!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik it-tranja tagħha, il-mewġ li tħalli warajha.
messages.mt_standard: Dik it-tranja tagħha, il-mewġ li tħalli warajha.
messages.zh: 那是它的尾流，就是它在后方留下的波浪。
messages.en: That's its wake, the waves it leaves behind.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 现在我看到了；会传到我们这里吗？
messages.en: I see it now; will it reach us here?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象船驶过后，水面拖着一条逐渐散开的白色波纹，把这条船后水迹标成tranja，配合“船走了，尾流还在”的画面记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Calm and peaceful, without noise, worry, or disturbance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人、环境或情境安静平和，没有喧闹、忧虑或干扰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiddeskrivi persuna, atmosfera jew sitwazzjoni kalma u paċifika, mingħajr storbju, tħassib jew tfixkil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宁静平和的；没有喧闹、烦扰或不安的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tiddeskrivi persuna, atmosfera jew sitwazzjoni li fiha hemm il-kalma u ma hemmx storbju, tħassib jew tfixkil.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a person, place, or situation is tranquil, they are calm and peaceful, with little noise or disturbance.

formal.mt: Il-librerija toffri atmosfera trankwilla fejn l-istudenti jistgħu jistudjaw mingħajr storbju.
formal.en: The library offers a tranquil atmosphere where students can study without noise.
formal.zh: 图书馆提供宁静的氛围，让学生能够不受噪声干扰地学习。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kienet il-bajja dalgħodu? Lara: Kienet trankwilla ħafna; kien hemm ftit nies biss.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was the beach like this morning? Lara: It was very peaceful; there were only a few people.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今天早上海滩怎么样？Lara：非常宁静，只有几个人。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天早上海滩怎么样？
messages.en: What was the beach like this morning?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kienet trankwilla ħafna; kien hemm ftit nies biss.
messages.mt_standard: Kienet trankwilla ħafna; kien hemm ftit nies biss.
messages.zh: 非常宁静，只有几个人。
messages.en: It was very peaceful; there were only a few people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 trankwilla 和清晨人少的海滩画面一起记，再朗读 atmosfera trankwilla，把词义与宁静氛围联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An electrical device that raises or lowers the voltage of an alternating electrical supply.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于升高或降低交流电压的电气装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat elettriku li jgħolli jew ibaxxi l-vultaġġ ta' provvista ta' kurrent alternanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变压器：用于改变交流电压高低的电气装置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Transformer huwa apparat elettriku li jintuża biex jgħolli jew ibaxxi l-vultaġġ ta' kurrent alternanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A transformer is an electrical device that changes an alternating supply from one voltage level to another.

formal.mt: F'din is-sistema, it-transformer ibaxxi l-vultaġġ minn 230 volt għal 12-il volt.
formal.en: In this system, the transformer lowers the voltage from 230 volts to 12 volts.
formal.zh: 在这个系统中，变压器将电压从230伏降低到12伏。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'jagħmel dan it-transformer? Rita: Ibaxxi l-vultaġġ għal-livell li jeħtieġ l-apparat.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does this transformer do? Rita: It lowers the voltage to the level the equipment needs.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这个变压器有什么作用？Rita：它把电压降低到设备所需的水平。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 这个变压器有什么作用？
messages.en: What does this transformer do?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ibaxxi l-vultaġġ għal-livell li jeħtieġ l-apparat.
messages.mt_standard: Ibaxxi l-vultaġġ għal-livell li jeħtieġ l-apparat.
messages.zh: 它把电压降低到设备所需的水平。
messages.en: It lowers the voltage to the level the equipment needs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 transformer 想成交流电压的升降机，脑中画出两个不同高度的电压刻度，记住它能升高或降低电压。

gloss_zh: 翻译；把内容从一种语言译成另一种语言

teaching_sense.en_definition: To express the meaning of spoken or written material in another language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把口头或书面内容从一种语言转换成另一种语言，并传达原来的意思。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tesprimi b'lingwa oħra t-tifsira ta' kliem mitkellem jew ta' test miktub.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 翻译，把一种语言中的话语或文字转换成另一种语言。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taqleb kliem jew test minn lingwa għal oħra filwaqt li żżomm it-tifsira oriġinali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you translate something, you express its meaning in a different language.

collocations.zh: 从马耳他语翻译成英语

formal.mt: Translatja t-test li ġej mill-Malti għall-Ingliż, filwaqt li żżomm it-tifsira u t-ton tal-oriġinal.
formal.en: Translate the following text from Maltese into English, preserving the meaning and tone of the original.
formal.zh: 请将以下文本从马耳他语翻译成英语，保留原文的意思和语气。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Translatja dan il-messaġġ għall-Ingliż, jekk jogħġbok. Lara: Iva, mela. Tridu formali jew kif nitkellmu bejnietna?
colloquial.en: Maja: Translate this message into English, please. Lara: Sure. Do you want it formal or the way we talk to each other?
colloquial.zh: Maja：请把这条消息翻译成英语。Lara：当然。你想要正式一点，还是像我们平时聊天那样？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Translatja dan il-messaġġ għall-Ingliż, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Translatja dan il-messaġġ għall-Ingliż, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请把这条消息翻译成英语。
messages.en: Translate this message into English, please.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, mela. Tridu formali jew kif nitkellmu bejnietna?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, mela. Tridu formali jew kif nitkellmu bejnietna?
messages.zh: 当然。你想要正式一点，还是像我们平时聊天那样？
messages.en: Sure. Do you want it formal or the way we talk to each other?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 translatja 和英语 translate 联想记忆：想象同一条消息先用马耳他语写，再用英语表达；语言换了，意思保留。这只是学习联想。

gloss_zh: 远期交易；现在约定价格等条件、在未来约定日期进行的交易

teaching_sense.en_definition: A financial transaction in which parties agree now on terms for buying or selling an asset at a specified future date.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 交易双方现在约定价格等条件，并约定在未来某一日期买卖某项资产的金融交易。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tranżazzjoni finanzjarja li fiha żewġ partijiet jiftiehmu minn qabel dwar il-prezz u l-kundizzjonijiet għax-xiri jew il-bejgħ ta' assi f'data futura speċifikata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 远期交易，指双方现在谈定价格等条件、约定未来日期买卖资产的一笔交易。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ftehim bejn żewġ partijiet biex jixtru jew ibigħu assi f'data futura, bi prezz u kundizzjonijiet miftiehma minn qabel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A forward deal is an agreement to buy or sell an asset at a future date on terms agreed in advance.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 远期交易，指按照预先约定的价格等条件，在指定未来日期进行资产买卖的交易。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tranżazzjoni ta' xiri jew bejgħ ta' assi għal data futura speċifikata, skont prezz u kundizzjonijiet stabbiliti meta jsir il-ftehim.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A forward transaction involves buying or selling an asset for a specified future date under terms established when the agreement is made.

collocations.en: the agreed price in a forward transaction
collocations.zh: 远期交易中约定的价格

collocations.en: a forward transaction in foreign currency

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija daħlet fi tranżazzjoni forward mal-bank biex tixtri dollari Amerikani fi tliet xhur, b'rata tal-kambju miftiehma llum.
formal.en: The company entered into a forward transaction with the bank to buy US dollars in three months at an exchange rate agreed today.
formal.zh: 公司与银行订立了一笔远期交易，约定三个月后按今天商定的汇率买入美元。

colloquial.mt: Mark: F'din it-tranżazzjoni forward, ir-rata niftiehmu fuqha llum? Sara: Iva, illum naqblu fuq ir-rata, u l-munita tixtriha fid-data li niftiehmu fuqha.
colloquial.en: Mark: In this forward transaction, do we agree on the rate today? Sara: Yes, we agree on the rate today, and you buy the currency on the date we agree on.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这笔远期交易的汇率，是今天商定吗？Sara：对，我们今天商定汇率，你在双方约定的日期买入货币。

messages.speaker: Mark (客户)
messages.mt_spoken: F'din it-tranżazzjoni forward, ir-rata niftiehmu fuqha llum?
messages.mt_standard: F'din it-tranżazzjoni forward, ir-rata niftiehmu fuqha llum?
messages.zh: 这笔远期交易的汇率，是今天商定吗？
messages.en: In this forward transaction, do we agree on the rate today?

messages.speaker: Sara (银行职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, illum naqblu fuq ir-rata, u l-munita tixtriha fid-data li niftiehmu fuqha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, illum naqblu fuq ir-rata, u l-munita tixtriha fid-data li niftiehmu fuqha.
messages.zh: 对，我们今天商定汇率，你在双方约定的日期买入货币。
messages.en: Yes, we agree on the rate today, and you buy the currency on the date we agree on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住两个时间点：今天商定条件，未来约定日期交易。看到 tranżazzjoni forward，就联想一张写着今天价格、标着未来日期的交易日历。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A business exchange involving the purchase or sale of goods or services.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在商业活动中进行的、涉及商品或服务买卖的交易。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Skambju fil-qasam tan-negozju li jinvolvi x-xiri jew il-bejgħ ta' oġġetti jew servizzi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 商业活动中涉及商品或服务买卖的交易。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tranżazzjoni li ssir bħala parti minn attività kummerċjali u li tinvolvi x-xiri jew il-bejgħ ta' oġġetti jew servizzi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A commercial transaction is an exchange in which goods or services are bought or sold as part of a business activity.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贸易活动中的一笔商品或服务买卖交易。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tranżazzjoni fil-kummerċ li fiha parti tixtri oġġetti jew servizzi mingħand parti oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A trade transaction is a particular purchase or sale of goods or services carried out between trading parties.

collocations.en: the details of a commercial transaction
collocations.zh: 一笔商业交易的详细信息

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija rreġistrat it-tranżazzjoni kummerċjali u żammet kopja tal-fattura.
formal.en: The company recorded the commercial transaction and kept a copy of the invoice.
formal.zh: 公司记录了这笔商业交易，并保存了一份发票副本。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Lestejna t-tranżazzjoni kummerċjali mal-fornitur? Mark: Iva, ħallasna u rċevejna l-oġġetti dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have we completed the commercial transaction with the supplier? Mark: Yes, we paid and received the goods this morning.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们和供应商的这笔商业交易完成了吗？Mark：完成了，我们已经付款，今天早上也收到了货。

messages.speaker: Maja (采购员)
messages.zh: 我们和供应商的这笔商业交易完成了吗？
messages.en: Have we completed the commercial transaction with the supplier?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħallasna u rċevejna l-oġġetti dalgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħallasna u rċevejna l-oġġetti dalgħodu.
messages.zh: 完成了，我们已经付款，今天早上也收到了货。
messages.en: Yes, we paid and received the goods this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组配上“订货、付款、收货”的商业画面来记；tranżazzjoni 表示交易，kummerċjali 限定为商业性质。

gloss_zh: 替代交易；代替原交易的新交易

teaching_sense.en_definition: A transaction carried out in place of another transaction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为代替另一笔交易而进行的交易。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tranżazzjoni li ssir minflok tranżazzjoni oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 代替另一笔交易而进行的新交易。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tranżazzjoni ġdida li tieħu post tranżazzjoni oħra, pereżempju meta t-tranżazzjoni oriġinali ma tkunx tista' titwettaq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A substitute transaction is a new transaction that takes the place of another transaction, for example when the original cannot be completed.

collocations.en: the cost of a substitute transaction

formal.mt: Meta l-fornitur ma setax iwassal l-oġġetti, il-kumpanija għamlet tranżazzjoni sostituta ma' fornitur ieħor.
formal.en: When the supplier could not deliver the goods, the company carried out a substitute transaction with another supplier.
formal.zh: 原供应商无法交货时，公司与另一家供应商进行了一笔替代交易。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-fornitur ħassar l-ordni tagħna. X'nagħmlu issa? Pawlu: Nistgħu nagħmlu tranżazzjoni sostituta ma' fornitur ieħor.
colloquial.en: Sara: The supplier cancelled our order. What do we do now? Pawlu: We can carry out a substitute transaction with another supplier.
colloquial.zh: Sara：供应商取消了我们的订单。我们现在怎么办？Pawlu：我们可以和另一家供应商做一笔替代交易。

messages.speaker: Sara (采购员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-fornitur ħassar l-ordni tagħna. X'nagħmlu issa?
messages.mt_standard: Il-fornitur ħassar l-ordni tagħna. X'nagħmlu issa?
messages.zh: 供应商取消了我们的订单。我们现在怎么办？
messages.en: The supplier cancelled our order. What do we do now?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (采购经理)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nagħmlu tranżazzjoni sostituta ma' fornitur ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nagħmlu tranżazzjoni sostituta ma' fornitur ieħor.
messages.zh: 我们可以和另一家供应商做一笔替代交易。
messages.en: We can carry out a substitute transaction with another supplier.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象原交易的卡片被一张新交易卡片替换：tranżazzjoni 是交易，sostituta 提醒你这笔交易承担替代作用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flag that identifies a transaction as an agency cross transaction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于标明某笔交易属于代理交叉交易的标识。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dan huwa indikatur li jidentifika tranżazzjoni bħala waħda tat-tip agency cross.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 代理交叉交易标识；用于标明交易属于该类型的标记。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dan huwa indikatur li jintuża biex jimmarka tranżazzjoni bħala waħda tat-tip agency cross.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An agency cross transaction flag is a marker used to identify a transaction as belonging to this transaction type.

collocations.mt: l-indikatur ta' tranżazzjoni tat-tip agency cross
il-kamp għall-indikatur ta' tranżazzjoni tat-tip agency cross
collocations.en: the field for the agency cross transaction flag
collocations.zh: 用于填写代理交叉交易标识的字段

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju ta' reġistru, il-kamp 'tranżazzjoni tat-tip agency cross' fih indikatur li jidentifika t-tip tat-tranżazzjoni.
formal.en: In this example record, the field 'agency cross transaction' contains a flag identifying the transaction type.
formal.zh: 在这份示例记录中，“代理交叉交易”字段内有一个标识，用于注明交易类型。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'ifisser l-indikatur ħdejn 'tranżazzjoni tat-tip agency cross'? Pawlu: Juri li t-tranżazzjoni hija ta' dak it-tip. Marta: Mela qed naqra l-indikatur tat-tip tat-tranżazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Marta: What does the flag beside 'agency cross transaction' mean? Pawlu: It shows that the transaction is of that type. Marta: So I am reading the transaction type flag.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：旁边写着“代理交叉交易”的那个标识是什么意思？保罗：它表示这笔交易属于那种类型。玛尔塔：也就是说，我看到的是交易类型标识。

messages.speaker: Marta (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ifisser l-indikatur ħdejn 'tranżazzjoni tat-tip agency cross'?
messages.mt_standard: X'ifisser l-indikatur ħdejn 'tranżazzjoni tat-tip agency cross'?
messages.zh: 旁边写着“代理交叉交易”的那个标识是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the flag beside 'agency cross transaction' mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Juri li t-tranżazzjoni hija ta' dak it-tip.
messages.mt_standard: Juri li t-tranżazzjoni hija ta' dak it-tip.
messages.zh: 它表示这笔交易属于那种类型。
messages.en: It shows that the transaction is of that type.

messages.speaker: Marta (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela qed naqra l-indikatur tat-tip tat-tranżazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Mela qed naqra l-indikatur tat-tip tat-tranżazzjoni.
messages.zh: 也就是说，我看到的是交易类型标识。
messages.en: So I am reading the transaction type flag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象交易记录旁贴着一张写有 agency cross 的类型标签：本词条的给定义项指这张“交易标识”，学习时把交易类型与标识的用途一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The movement of goods through a customs territory under customs supervision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 货物在海关监管下通过关境或在海关地点之间转运的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dan huwa l-moviment ta' merkanzija minn territorju doganali jew bejn postijiet doganali taħt is-superviżjoni tad-dwana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海关过境；货物在海关监管下通过关境或在海关地点之间转运的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dan huwa l-proċess li bih il-merkanzija tgħaddi minn territorju doganali jew tiċċaqlaq bejn postijiet doganali taħt is-superviżjoni tad-dwana.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Customs transit is the movement of goods through a customs territory or between customs locations under customs supervision.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 过境；中转；经过某地前往另一目的地的过程，在本词组中用于海关运输语境。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dan huwa l-proċess ta' passaġġ minn post fi triq lejn destinazzjoni oħra; f'din l-espressjoni, il-passaġġ ikun marbut mad-dwana.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Transit is the process of passing through a place on the way to another destination, here in a customs context.

collocations.zh: 处于海关过境运输中的货物
海关过境运输所需的文件

formal.mt: Il-merkanzija tinsab fi tranżitu doganali u se tkompli lejn id-destinazzjoni tagħha taħt is-superviżjoni tad-dwana.
formal.en: The goods are in customs transit and will continue to their destination under customs supervision.
formal.zh: 这批货物正处于海关过境运输中，将在海关监管下继续运往目的地。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din il-merkanzija se tibqa' hawn? Mark: Le, tinsab fi tranżitu doganali u għadha sejra lejn id-destinazzjoni tagħha. Lara: Mela qiegħda tgħaddi minn hawn biss.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are these goods staying here? Mark: No, they are in customs transit and are still on their way to their destination. Lara: So they are only passing through here.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这批货物会留在这里吗？马克：不会，它们正在进行海关过境运输，还要继续运往目的地。拉拉：也就是说，它们只是经过这里。

messages.speaker: Lara (新同事)
messages.zh: 这批货物会留在这里吗？
messages.en: Are these goods staying here?

messages.speaker: Mark (物流同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tinsab fi tranżitu doganali u għadha sejra lejn id-destinazzjoni tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tinsab fi tranżitu doganali u għadha sejra lejn id-destinazzjoni tagħha.
messages.zh: 不会，它们正在进行海关过境运输，还要继续运往目的地。
messages.en: No, they are in customs transit and are still on their way to their destination.

messages.speaker: Lara (新同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela qiegħda tgħaddi minn hawn biss.
messages.mt_standard: Mela qiegħda tgħaddi minn hawn biss.
messages.zh: 也就是说，它们只是经过这里。
messages.en: So they are only passing through here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一辆货车经过海关检查点后继续驶向目的地：用“经过这里、继续前行”记住 tranżitu，再把 doganali 与整词的海关监管语境一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The transit of plants, plant products, or other goods subject to plant-health requirements through a territory.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物、植物产品或其他受植物卫生要求约束的货物经过某一地区的过境运输。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mogħdija minn territorju ta' pjanti, prodotti tal-pjanti jew oġġetti oħra soġġetti għal rekwiżiti dwar is-saħħa tal-pjanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涉及植物、植物产品等货物，并受植物卫生要求约束的过境运输。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-mogħdija ta' konsenja minn territorju meta l-pjanti, il-prodotti tal-pjanti jew oġġetti oħra li jkun fiha jkunu soġġetti għal rekwiżiti fitosanitarji.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Phytosanitary transit is the passage through a territory of plants, plant products, or other goods subject to requirements concerning plant health.

collocations.zh: 植物检疫过境运输要求
植物检疫过境运输文件

formal.mt: Qabel it-tluq tal-konsenja tal-pjanti, il-kumpanija vverifikat ir-rekwiżiti għat-tranżitu fitosanitarju.
formal.en: Before the consignment of plants departed, the company checked the requirements for phytosanitary transit.
formal.zh: 这批植物启运前，公司核查了植物检疫过境运输要求。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dawn il-pjanti se jgħaddu minn pajjiż ieħor? Lara: Iva, għalhekk irridu niċċekkjaw ir-rekwiżiti għat-tranżitu fitosanitarju qabel nibagħtuhom.
colloquial.en: Mark: Will these plants pass through another country? Lara: Yes, so we need to check the requirements for phytosanitary transit before sending them.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这些植物会经过另一个国家吗？拉拉：会，所以我们寄出前得核查植物检疫过境运输要求。

messages.speaker: Mark (苗圃职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn il-pjanti se jgħaddu minn pajjiż ieħor?
messages.mt_standard: Dawn il-pjanti se jgħaddu minn pajjiż ieħor?
messages.zh: 这些植物会经过另一个国家吗？
messages.en: Will these plants pass through another country?

messages.speaker: Lara (物流协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għalhekk irridu niċċekkjaw ir-rekwiżiti għat-tranżitu fitosanitarju qabel nibagħtuhom.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għalhekk irridu niċċekkjaw ir-rekwiżiti għat-tranżitu fitosanitarju qabel nibagħtuhom.
messages.zh: 会，所以我们寄出前得核查植物检疫过境运输要求。
messages.en: Yes, so we need to check the requirements for phytosanitary transit before sending them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一批盆栽过境：tranżitu 记“过境运输”，fitosanitarju 记“涉及植物卫生”，合起来就是植物检疫过境运输。

gloss_zh: 内部转运；内部转运程序

teaching_sense.en_definition: The movement of goods within a specified territory, or the administrative procedure governing that movement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 货物在指定区域内部的转运，也可指管理这种转运的行政程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moviment ta' merkanzija fi ħdan territorju speċifikat, jew il-proċedura amministrattiva li tirregola dak il-moviment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 货物在指定区域内部的转运。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-moviment ta' merkanzija minn post għal ieħor fi ħdan territorju speċifikat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Internal transit is the movement of goods between places within a specified territory.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 管理货物在指定区域内部转运的行政程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċedura amministrattiva li tirregola kif il-merkanzija tiġi ttrasportata minn post għal ieħor fi ħdan territorju speċifikat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An internal transit procedure is an administrative process governing the movement of goods within a specified territory.

collocations.zh: 处于内部转运中的货物

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tranżitu intern tal-merkanzija u l-proċedura amministrattiva marbuta miegħu.
formal.en: The report describes the internal transit of the goods and the administrative procedure associated with it.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了货物的内部转运及其相关行政程序。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser 'tranżitu intern' f'din il-formola? Pawlu: Hawnhekk ifisser il-proċedura għat-trasport tal-merkanzija fi ħdan it-territorju indikat.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does 'internal transit' mean on this form? Pawlu: Here it means the procedure for transporting goods within the territory indicated.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这张表上的“内部转运”是什么意思？保罗：这里指的是在所注明的区域内运输货物的程序。

messages.speaker: Nina (新入职物流职员)
messages.zh: 这张表上的“内部转运”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'internal transit' mean on this form?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (物流主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk ifisser il-proċedura għat-trasport tal-merkanzija fi ħdan it-territorju indikat.
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk ifisser il-proċedura għat-trasport tal-merkanzija fi ħdan it-territorju indikat.
messages.zh: 这里指的是在所注明的区域内运输货物的程序。
messages.en: Here it means the procedure for transporting goods within the territory indicated.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个圈，再画货车在圈内移动：tranżitu 记“转运”，intern 记“内部的”；看到表格或手续语境时，再联想到管理这种转运的程序。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool or fitted cutting piece used to bore holes in a material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于在材料上钻孔的工具，或安装在钻孔机器上的切削钻头。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda jew biċċa li titwaħħal f'magna tat-tħaffir biex tagħmel toqob f'materjal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 螺旋钻，带有螺旋形工作部分、用于在木材等材料上钻孔的工具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għodda b'parti spirali li tintuża biex tħaffer toqob fl-injam jew f'materjal ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An auger is a tool with a spiral cutting section that is used to bore holes in wood or other materials.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钻头，安装在钻孔机器上、通过旋转切削材料而形成孔洞的部件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa li taqta', ġeneralment tal-metall, li titwaħħal f'magna tat-tħaffir u ddur biex tagħmel toqba f'materjal.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A drill bit is the cutting piece fitted to a drill that rotates to make a hole in a material.

collocations.en: an auger or drill bit for wood
fit the drill bit into the machine

formal.mt: Qabel tibda tħaffer, agħżel trapan adattat għall-materjal u waħħlu sew fil-magna tat-tħaffir.
formal.en: Before you begin drilling, choose a drill bit suitable for the material and secure it firmly in the drill.
formal.zh: 开始钻孔前，请选择适合该材料的钻头，并将其牢固地安装在钻孔机器上。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Liema trapan nuża biex nagħmel toqba żgħira f'dan l-injam? Rita: Uża dak irqiq, u waħħlu sew fil-magna.
colloquial.en: Mark: Which drill bit should I use to make a small hole in this wood? Rita: Use the thin one, and secure it firmly in the drill.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我要在这块木头上钻个小孔，该用哪个钻头？Rita：用那个细的，把它牢牢装在钻孔机器上。

messages.speaker: Mark (木工学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema trapan nuża biex nagħmel toqba żgħira f'dan l-injam?
messages.mt_standard: Liema trapan nuża biex nagħmel toqba żgħira f'dan l-injam?
messages.zh: 我要在这块木头上钻个小孔，该用哪个钻头？
messages.en: Which drill bit should I use to make a small hole in this wood?

messages.speaker: Rita (木工师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Uża dak irqiq, u waħħlu sew fil-magna.
messages.mt_standard: Uża dak irqiq, u waħħlu sew fil-magna.
messages.zh: 用那个细的，把它牢牢装在钻孔机器上。
messages.en: Use the thin one, and secure it firmly in the drill.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 trapan 和“旋转钻孔”的画面绑定：手持的螺旋钻、装在机器上的钻头，都围绕“钻出一个孔”来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of moving someone or something from one place, position, account, or institution to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将人或事物从一个地点、职位、账户或机构转到另一个的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li persuna jew ħaġa titmexxa minn post, kariga, kont jew istituzzjoni għal oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 转移或调动，指人或事物从一处转到另一处；用于资金时可指转账。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih persuna jew ħaġa tgħaddi minn post, kariga jew istituzzjoni għal oħra, jew li bih flus jintbagħtu minn kont għal ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A transfer is the process of moving a person or thing from one place, position, institution, or account to another.

formal.mt: It-talba għat-trasferiment tal-istudent lejn skola oħra għandha tinkludi d-dettalji tal-iskola l-ġdida.
formal.en: The request for the student's transfer to another school should include the details of the new school.
formal.zh: 学生转往另一所学校的申请应包含新学校的详细信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għamilt it-trasferiment tal-flus? Daniel: Iva, bgħatthom dalgħodu. Iċċekkja l-kont tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you made the money transfer? Daniel: Yes, I sent the money this morning. Check your account.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你转账了吗？Daniel：转了，我今天早上把钱转过去了。查一下你的账户。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你转账了吗？
messages.en: Have you made the money transfer?

messages.speaker: Daniel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bgħatthom dalgħodu. Iċċekkja l-kont tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bgħatthom dalgħodu. Iċċekkja l-kont tiegħek.
messages.zh: 转了，我今天早上把钱转过去了。查一下你的账户。
messages.en: Yes, I sent the money this morning. Check your account.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 trasferiment 记成一支“从甲到乙”的箭头：钱从一个账户到另一个账户，学生从一所学校到另一所学校，都体现“转移”。

gloss_zh: 企业内部调动；公司内部调任

teaching_sense.en_definition: The movement of an employee between posts or units within the same company or corporate group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 员工在同一企业或企业集团内部不同职位或单位之间的调动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moviment ta' impjegat minn kariga jew unità għal oħra fi ħdan l-istess ażjenda jew grupp ta' ażjendi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 同一公司或企业集团内部的员工调动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Trasferiment ta' impjegat bejn karigi jew unitajiet li jagħmlu parti mill-istess ażjenda jew grupp ta' ażjendi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An intra-corporate transfer occurs when an employee moves to another post or unit within the same company or corporate group.

collocations.en: a request for an intra-corporate transfer

formal.mt: Id-dipartiment tar-riżorsi umani approva t-talba għal trasferiment intra-ażjendali mill-uffiċċju ta' Malta għall-uffiċċju ta' Ruma.
formal.en: The human resources department approved the request for an intra-corporate transfer from the Malta office to the Rome office.
formal.zh: 人力资源部批准了从马耳他办事处调往罗马办事处的企业内部调动申请。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se titlaq mill-kumpanija? Mark: Le, se nagħmel trasferiment intra-ażjendali. Se naħdem fl-uffiċċju ta' Ruma. Maja: Mela se tibqa' mal-istess kumpanija!
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you leaving the company? Mark: No, I'm making an intra-corporate transfer. I'll work at the Rome office. Maja: So you'll stay with the same company!
colloquial.zh: Maja：你要离开公司吗？Mark：不是，我要进行企业内部调动，去罗马办事处工作。Maja：那你还是留在同一家公司啊！

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你要离开公司吗？
messages.en: Are you leaving the company?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, se nagħmel trasferiment intra-ażjendali. Se naħdem fl-uffiċċju ta' Ruma.
messages.mt_standard: Le, se nagħmel trasferiment intra-ażjendali. Se naħdem fl-uffiċċju ta' Ruma.
messages.zh: 不是，我要进行企业内部调动，去罗马办事处工作。
messages.en: No, I'm making an intra-corporate transfer. I'll work at the Rome office.

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 那你还是留在同一家公司啊！
messages.en: So you'll stay with the same company!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象员工的工牌不变，只把办公桌搬到公司另一处：用这个画面记住整个短语表示企业内部调动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The reassignment of responsibility for optimising reserves from one person, unit, or body to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将负责优化储备配置或使用的职能，从一个人、部门或机构转交给另一个人、部门或机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-trasferiment tar-responsabbiltà għat-titjib tal-allokazzjoni jew tal-użu tar-riservi minn persuna, dipartiment jew korp għal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将储备优化这项职能及相应责任转交给其他负责方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bidla fil-persuna, fid-dipartiment jew fil-korp responsabbli għall-funzjoni li ttejjeb l-allokazzjoni jew l-użu tar-riservi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A transfer of the reserves optimisation function occurs when responsibility for improving the allocation or use of reserves passes from one responsible party to another.

collocations.en: a plan for transferring the reserves optimisation function
collocations.zh: 储备优化职能转移计划

collocations.en: implementation of the transfer of the reserves optimisation function
collocations.zh: 实施储备优化职能转移

formal.mt: Il-bord approva t-trasferiment tal-funzjoni tal-ottimizzazzjoni tar-riservi lid-dipartiment il-ġdid, li se jkun responsabbli għall-allokazzjoni u l-użu effiċjenti tagħhom.
formal.en: The board approved the transfer of the reserves optimisation function to the new department, which will be responsible for their allocation and efficient use.
formal.zh: 董事会批准将储备优化职能移交给新部门，由该部门负责储备的配置及高效使用。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'ifisser it-trasferiment tal-funzjoni tal-ottimizzazzjoni tar-riservi? Pawlu: Ifisser li minn issa d-dipartiment il-ġdid se jieħu ħsieb kif jintużaw aħjar ir-riservi. Sara: Mela qed tinbidel ir-responsabbiltà.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does the transfer of the reserves optimisation function mean? Pawlu: It means that from now on the new department will take care of making better use of the reserves. Sara: So the responsibility is changing hands.
colloquial.zh: Sara：储备优化职能转移是什么意思？Pawlu：就是说，从现在起由新部门负责研究如何更好地使用储备。Sara：也就是负责方变了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 储备优化职能转移是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the transfer of the reserves optimisation function mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (部门主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li minn issa d-dipartiment il-ġdid se jieħu ħsieb kif jintużaw aħjar ir-riservi.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li minn issa d-dipartiment il-ġdid se jieħu ħsieb kif jintużaw aħjar ir-riservi.
messages.zh: 就是说，从现在起由新部门负责研究如何更好地使用储备。
messages.en: It means that from now on the new department will take care of making better use of the reserves.

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 也就是负责方变了。
messages.en: So the responsibility is changing hands.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按意义分块记忆：trasferiment 是转移，tal-funzjoni 指职能，tal-ottimizzazzjoni 指优化，tar-riservi 指储备；想象把写着“储备优化”的职责牌交给新部门。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The transfer from one party to another of capacity available to help balance supply and demand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将可用于帮助平衡供需的容量从一方转移给另一方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih il-kapaċità disponibbli biex tgħin tibbilanċja l-provvista u d-domanda tiġi ttrasferita minn parti għal oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将用于平衡供需的可用容量从一方转移给另一方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-trasferiment minn parti għal oħra ta' kapaċità disponibbli biex tgħin iżżomm bilanċ bejn il-provvista u d-domanda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A transfer of balancing capacity occurs when capacity available to balance supply and demand is transferred from one party to another.

collocations.mt: talba għal trasferiment tal-kapaċità ta' bbilanċjar
collocations.en: a request for a transfer of balancing capacity
approval of the transfer of balancing capacity
collocations.zh: 对平衡容量转移的批准

collocations.en: conditions for the transfer of balancing capacity

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-trasferiment tal-kapaċità ta' bbilanċjar bejn iż-żewġ operaturi u jispeċifika l-kapaċità li għandha tiġi ttrasferita.
formal.en: The report describes the transfer of balancing capacity between the two operators and specifies the capacity to be transferred.
formal.zh: 报告说明了两家运营商之间的平衡容量转移，并明确了拟转移的容量。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għadna qed nistennew l-approvazzjoni għat-trasferiment tal-kapaċità ta' bbilanċjar? Pawlu: Iva, imma bgħatna d-dokumenti kollha dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Marta: Are we still waiting for approval for the transfer of balancing capacity? Pawlu: Yes, but we sent all the documents this morning.
colloquial.zh: Marta：我们还在等平衡容量转移的批准吗？Pawlu：是的，不过我们今天早上已经把所有文件都发过去了。

messages.speaker: Marta (运营协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadna qed nistennew l-approvazzjoni għat-trasferiment tal-kapaċità ta' bbilanċjar?
messages.mt_standard: Għadna qed nistennew l-approvazzjoni għat-trasferiment tal-kapaċità ta' bbilanċjar?
messages.zh: 我们还在等平衡容量转移的批准吗？
messages.en: Are we still waiting for approval for the transfer of balancing capacity?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma bgħatna d-dokumenti kollha dalgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma bgħatna d-dokumenti kollha dalgħodu.
messages.zh: 是的，不过我们今天早上已经把所有文件都发过去了。
messages.en: Yes, but we sent all the documents this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按意义分块记忆：trasferiment 是“转移”，kapaċità 是“容量”，bbilanċjar 是“平衡”。想象把一块标着“平衡供需”的容量配额从甲方移交给乙方，就能记住整个词组。

gloss_zh: 风险转移；风险由一方转由另一方承担

teaching_sense.en_definition: The passage of responsibility for a possible loss or damage from one party to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对可能发生的损失或损害所承担的风险，从一方转移到另一方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih ir-riskju ta' telf jew ħsara jgħaddi minn parti għal oħra, u għalhekk il-parti l-oħra tibda ġġorr dak ir-riskju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 风险从一方转由另一方承担这一转移，尤其指可能发生的损失或损害由谁承担。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-bidla li sseħħ meta r-riskju ta' telf jew ħsara jgħaddi minn parti għal oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The passage of risk is the change by which one party begins to bear a risk of loss or damage previously borne by another.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将可能发生的损失或损害的风险，从原承担方转移至另一方的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih parti tieqaf iġġorr riskju partikolari ta' telf jew ħsara u parti oħra tibda ġġorru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The passing of risk occurs when responsibility for a possible loss or damage moves from one party to another.

collocations.en: the moment of passage of risk
a clause on the passing of risk
passage of risk from the seller to the buyer
collocations.zh: 风险从卖方转移至买方

formal.mt: Għall-finijiet ta' dan l-eżempju, il-kuntratt jistabbilixxi li t-trasferiment tar-riskju jseħħ meta x-xerrej jirċievi l-merkanzija.
formal.en: For the purposes of this example, the contract stipulates that the passage of risk occurs when the buyer receives the goods.
formal.zh: 在本例中，合同约定风险在买方收到货物时转移。

colloquial.mt: Lara: F'dan il-kuntratt, meta jseħħ it-trasferiment tar-riskju? Mark: Meta nirċievu l-merkanzija. Lara: Mela nniżżlu l-ħin meta tasal.
colloquial.en: Lara: In this contract, when does the passage of risk occur? Mark: When we receive the goods. Lara: Then let's record the time they arrive.
colloquial.zh: Lara：按这份合同，风险什么时候转移？Mark：我们收到货物的时候。Lara：那我们就记下货物到达的时间。

messages.speaker: Lara (采购员)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dan il-kuntratt, meta jseħħ it-trasferiment tar-riskju?
messages.mt_standard: F'dan il-kuntratt, meta jseħħ it-trasferiment tar-riskju?
messages.zh: 按这份合同，风险什么时候转移？
messages.en: In this contract, when does the passage of risk occur?

messages.speaker: Mark (采购同事)
messages.zh: 我们收到货物的时候。
messages.en: When we receive the goods.

messages.speaker: Lara (采购员)
messages.zh: 那我们就记下货物到达的时间。
messages.en: Then let's record the time they arrive.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 riskju 记作“风险”，把整个词组想成一张写着“谁承担损失”的卡片从甲方交到乙方手中。记忆重点是承担风险的一方发生变化；两个英语义项都围绕这一含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Changed substantially in form, appearance, condition, or use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形态、外观、状态或用途已经发生显著变化的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li nbidel b'mod sostanzjali fil-forma, fid-dehra, fil-qagħda jew fl-użu tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已经发生显著改变的；经过改造或转变的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għadda minn bidla kbira u sar differenti minn kif kien qabel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is transformed has changed greatly in its appearance, condition, character, or purpose.

formal.mt: L-ispazju trasformat issa jinkludi librerija u sala għal-laqgħat tal-komunità.
formal.en: The transformed space now includes a library and a hall for community meetings.
formal.zh: 经过改造的空间如今设有图书馆和供社区开会使用的大厅。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt il-ġnien wara x-xogħol li għamlu? Mark: Iva, jidher kompletament trasformat! Lara: Issa hemm fejn noqogħdu bilqiegħda fid-dell.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you seen the garden after the work they did? Mark: Yes, it looks completely transformed! Lara: Now there is somewhere for us to sit in the shade.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看过他们整修后的花园了吗？马克：看过，感觉完全变样了！拉拉：现在我们有地方坐在树荫下了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt il-ġnien wara x-xogħol li għamlu?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt il-ġnien wara x-xogħol li għamlu?
messages.zh: 你看过他们整修后的花园了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen the garden after the work they did?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 看过，感觉完全变样了！
messages.en: Yes, it looks completely transformed!

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa hemm fejn noqogħdu bilqiegħda fid-dell.
messages.mt_standard: Issa hemm fejn noqogħdu bilqiegħda fid-dell.
messages.zh: 现在我们有地方坐在树荫下了。
messages.en: Now there is somewhere for us to sit in the shade.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象旧建筑改造后的照片：trasformat 描述的是“已经变样”的状态。把 bini trasformat 整组记作“经过改造的建筑”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A substantial change in the form, appearance, condition, or use of someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人或事物在形态、外观、状态或用途上发生的显著变化，也指这种变化的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bidla sostanzjali fil-forma, fid-dehra, fil-qagħda jew fl-użu ta' persuna jew ħaġa, jew il-proċess li jwassal għal din il-bidla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人或事物显著改变的转变、改造或变革，也指其过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew ir-riżultat ta' bidla kbira li tagħmel lil persuna jew ħaġa differenti minn kif kienet qabel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A transformation is a major change that makes someone or something substantially different from before.

formal.mt: It-trasformazzjoni tal-fabbrika f'ċentru kulturali ħolqot spazju ġdid għall-arti u għall-attivitajiet tal-komunità.
formal.en: The transformation of the factory into a cultural centre created a new space for art and community activities.
formal.zh: 将工厂改造成文化中心，为艺术和社区活动创造了新的空间。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif sejra t-trasformazzjoni tal-kċina? Pawlu: Kważi lesta! Għad irridu niżbgħu l-ħitan. Nina: Mela dalwaqt nistgħu nsajru fiha!
colloquial.en: Nina: How is the kitchen transformation going? Pawlu: Almost finished! We still need to paint the walls. Nina: So we can cook in it soon!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：厨房改造得怎么样了？保罗：快完工了！我们还得把墙刷好。妮娜：那我们很快就能在里面做饭了！

messages.speaker: Nina (妻子)
messages.zh: 厨房改造得怎么样了？
messages.en: How is the kitchen transformation going?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (丈夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi lesta! Għad irridu niżbgħu l-ħitan.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi lesta! Għad irridu niżbgħu l-ħitan.
messages.zh: 快完工了！我们还得把墙刷好。
messages.en: Almost finished! We still need to paint the walls.

messages.speaker: Nina (妻子)
messages.zh: 那我们很快就能在里面做饭了！
messages.en: So we can cook in it soon!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把厨房改造前后的两张照片连成一段过程：这次“改造、转变”就是 trasformazzjoni。与描述改造后状态的 trasformat 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A medical procedure in which blood is given to a person through a vein.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过静脉将血液输入人体的医疗操作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċedura medika li fiha persuna tingħata demm permezz ta' vina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 输血，即通过静脉向人体输入血液的医疗操作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċedura medika li biha d-demm jiddaħħal fil-ġisem ta' persuna permezz ta' vina.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A blood transfusion is a medical procedure in which someone receives blood through a vein.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport mediku jindika li l-pazjenta rċeviet trasfużjoni tad-demm waqt il-kura fl-isptar.
formal.en: The medical report indicates that the patient received a blood transfusion during her hospital treatment.
formal.zh: 医疗报告表明，这名女患者在住院治疗期间接受了输血。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif inhu missierek illum? Pawlu: Aħjar, grazzi. Ilbieraħ irċieva trasfużjoni tad-demm.
colloquial.en: Marija: How is your father today? Pawlu: Better, thanks. He received a blood transfusion yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你爸爸今天怎么样？保罗：好些了，谢谢。他昨天接受了输血。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你爸爸今天怎么样？
messages.en: How is your father today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar, grazzi. Ilbieraħ irċieva trasfużjoni tad-demm.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar, grazzi. Ilbieraħ irċieva trasfużjoni tad-demm.
messages.zh: 好些了，谢谢。他昨天接受了输血。
messages.en: Better, thanks. He received a blood transfusion yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语与“血袋通过输液管输入静脉”的画面绑定，再用“接受输血”和“需要输血”两个搭配反复练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The task of putting spoken words into writing or making a written copy of a text.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将口头话语记录成文字，或将已有文本另行誊写的工作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħidma li biha kliem mitkellem jitniżżel bil-miktub jew issir kopja bil-miktub ta' test.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 转录或誊写，即把口头话语记录成文字，或照原文抄写文本。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħidma li biha dak li jingħad jitniżżel bil-miktub jew test jiġi kkupjat bil-miktub.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you transcribe speech or a text, you write down what is said or make a written copy.

formal.mt: Il-folja tal-eżerċizzju tagħti din l-istruzzjoni: 'Isma' r-reġistrazzjoni u traskrivi l-kliem kollu li tisma'.'
formal.en: The worksheet gives this instruction: 'Listen to the recording and transcribe every word you hear.'
formal.zh: 练习单给出以下指示：“听录音，并把听到的每一个词都转录下来。”

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandi r-reġistrazzjoni tal-intervista. X'għandi nagħmel issa? Mark: Traskrivi l-intervista, imbagħad aqra t-test biex tiċċekkja l-iżbalji.
colloquial.en: Lara: I have the interview recording. What should I do now? Mark: Transcribe the interview, then read the text to check for mistakes.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我有访谈录音了。现在该做什么？马克：把访谈转录下来，再读一遍文本，检查有没有错误。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi r-reġistrazzjoni tal-intervista. X'għandi nagħmel issa?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi r-reġistrazzjoni tal-intervista. X'għandi nagħmel issa?
messages.zh: 我有访谈录音了。现在该做什么？
messages.en: I have the interview recording. What should I do now?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Traskrivi l-intervista, imbagħad aqra t-test biex tiċċekkja l-iżbalji.
messages.mt_standard: Traskrivi l-intervista, imbagħad aqra t-test biex tiċċekkja l-iżbalji.
messages.zh: 把访谈转录下来，再读一遍文本，检查有没有错误。
messages.en: Transcribe the interview, then read the text to check for mistakes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己戴着耳机，边听访谈边逐字打字；再想象照着原文手抄一遍，用这两个动作记住“转录、誊写”。

gloss_zh: 马虎的；粗心的；疏忽失责的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing insufficient care, attention, or diligence in work, conduct, or responsibilities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容做事不够仔细、行为粗心，或未认真履行应尽责任。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li ma jagħtix biżżejjed kas jew attenzjoni, jew xogħol li ma jsirx bil-kura meħtieġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马虎潦草的；因做得不仔细而显得凌乱或质量欠佳的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xogħol jew mod ta' kif issir xi ħaġa li jkun fih nuqqas ta' ordni, preċiżjoni jew attenzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Work or behaviour that is sloppy lacks the care and precision needed for a satisfactory result.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粗心的；未给予足够注意，容易出错或遗漏的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li ma joqgħodx attent biżżejjed għal dak li qed jagħmel u għalhekk jista' jiżbalja jew jinsa xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is careless does not pay enough attention to what they are doing and may make avoidable mistakes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 疏忽失责的；未尽到某项职责或情境所要求的合理注意义务的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jonqos milli jieħu l-prekawzjonijiet meħtieġa jew milli jwettaq dmiru bil-kura li wieħed jistenna minnu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is negligent fails to exercise the care that their duties or circumstances reasonably require.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport kien traskurat: kien fih żbalji fil-kalkoli u diversi taqsimiet ma kinux kompluti.
formal.en: The report was sloppy: it contained calculation errors, and several sections were incomplete.
formal.zh: 这份报告做得很马虎：其中有计算错误，而且几个部分没有完成。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed terġa' tagħmel ix-xogħol? Mark: Għax kont traskurat u ħallejt barra paġna sħiħa. Maja: Ejja niċċekkjawh flimkien din id-darba.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you doing the work again? Mark: Because I was careless and left out a whole page. Maja: Let's check it together this time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么要重做这项工作？马克：因为我太粗心，漏掉了整整一页。玛雅：这次我们一起检查吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么要重做这项工作？
messages.en: Why are you doing the work again?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kont traskurat u ħallejt barra paġna sħiħa.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kont traskurat u ħallejt barra paġna sħiħa.
messages.zh: 因为我太粗心，漏掉了整整一页。
messages.en: Because I was careless and left out a whole page.

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这次我们一起检查吧。
messages.en: Let's check it together this time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 traskurat 联想到一份漏页又算错的作业：看成品是“马虎”，看做事的人是“粗心”，涉及应尽职责时则是“疏忽失责”。这是情境记忆，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of sending or passing something from one place, person, or system to another, including signals, information, power, or disease.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某种事物从一处、一人或一个系统传到另一处、一人或另一个系统的过程，可指信号或信息的传输、节目的播送、动力的传递或疾病的传播。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa tgħaddi minn post, persuna jew sistema għal oħra, bħal sinjali, informazzjoni, qawwa mekkanika jew mard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 传输或传递的过程；依语境可指信号、数据或节目的传送与播送，机械动力的传递，或疾病的传播。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jiġu mgħoddija sinjali, data, programmi, qawwa mekkanika jew mard minn sors għal destinazzjoni jew minn persuna għal oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Transmission is the process by which something such as information, signals, power, or disease passes from one place or person to another.

formal.mt: Matul it-test, it-trasmissjoni tad-data bejn iż-żewġ kompjuters waqfet għal ftit sekondi minħabba problema fil-konnessjoni.
formal.en: During the test, data transmission between the two computers stopped for a few seconds because of a connection problem.
formal.zh: 测试期间，由于连接出现问题，两台计算机之间的数据传输中断了几秒钟。

colloquial.mt: Sara: It-trasmissjoni diretta tal-kunċert bdiet? Pawlu: Iva, għadha kif bdiet, imma l-ħoss qed jinqata'. Sara: Ħa nipprova niftaħha fuq it-telefon.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has the live broadcast of the concert started? Pawlu: Yes, it has just started, but the sound keeps cutting out. Sara: Let me try opening it on my phone.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：音乐会的直播开始了吗？保罗：开始了，刚刚开始，不过声音总是断断续续。萨拉：我试试用手机打开。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 音乐会的直播开始了吗？
messages.en: Has the live broadcast of the concert started?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadha kif bdiet, imma l-ħoss qed jinqata'.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadha kif bdiet, imma l-ħoss qed jinqata'.
messages.zh: 开始了，刚刚开始，不过声音总是断断续续。
messages.en: Yes, it has just started, but the sound keeps cutting out.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我试试用手机打开。
messages.en: Let me try opening it on my phone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 trasmissjoni 画成“来源→接收端”的箭头：数据沿箭头传输，节目沿箭头播送，动力沿箭头传递；再搭配 diretta 记住“直播”。这是语义联想，不是词源拆解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process by which price changes in one market or stage of a supply chain affect prices in another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某一市场或供应链环节的价格变化影响另一市场或环节价格的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih bidliet fil-prezzijiet f'suq jew fi stadju tal-katina tal-provvista jinfluwenzaw il-prezzijiet f'suq jew fi stadju ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 价格传导，即一个市场或供应链环节的价格变化传递到其他市场或环节并影响其价格的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-trasmissjoni tal-prezzijiet hija l-proċess li bih bidla fil-prezzijiet f'parti mis-suq jew mill-katina tal-provvista twassal għal bidliet fil-prezzijiet f'partijiet oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Price transmission occurs when a change in prices in one market or part of a supply chain affects prices in another.

collocations.en: price transmission along the supply chain
collocations.zh: 沿供应链进行的价格传导

collocations.mt: trasmissjoni tal-prezzijiet mis-swieq internazzjonali għas-suq lokali
collocations.en: price transmission from international markets to the local market
collocations.zh: 从国际市场向本地市场的价格传导

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina t-trasmissjoni tal-prezzijiet mill-produtturi għall-bejjiegħa bl-imnut u janalizza kemm iż-żidiet jaslu malajr għand il-konsumaturi.
formal.en: The report examines price transmission from producers to retailers and analyses how quickly the increases reach consumers.
formal.zh: 该报告考察价格从生产商向零售商的传导，并分析涨价以多快的速度影响消费者。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Il-qamħ għola. Għaliex id-dqiq għadu bl-istess prezz? Mark: It-trasmissjoni tal-prezzijiet tista' tieħu ż-żmien; forsi l-ħanut għadu jbigħ mill-istokk il-qadim.
colloquial.en: Anna: Wheat has become more expensive. Why is flour still the same price? Mark: Price transmission can take time; perhaps the shop is still selling its old stock.
colloquial.zh: Anna：小麦涨价了，为什么面粉还是原价？Mark：价格传导可能需要时间；也许商店还在卖之前的库存。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-qamħ għola. Għaliex id-dqiq għadu bl-istess prezz?
messages.mt_standard: Il-qamħ għola. Għaliex id-dqiq għadu bl-istess prezz?
messages.zh: 小麦涨价了，为什么面粉还是原价？
messages.en: Wheat has become more expensive. Why is flour still the same price?

messages.speaker: Mark (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: It-trasmissjoni tal-prezzijiet tista' tieħu ż-żmien; forsi l-ħanut għadu jbigħ mill-istokk il-qadim.
messages.mt_standard: It-trasmissjoni tal-prezzijiet tista' tieħu ż-żmien; forsi l-ħanut għadu jbigħ mill-istokk il-qadim.
messages.zh: 价格传导可能需要时间；也许商店还在卖之前的库存。
messages.en: Price transmission can take time; perhaps the shop is still selling its old stock.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“小麦涨价→面粉涨价→面包涨价”的箭头链记住整条短语：重点是价格变化在不同环节之间传递。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Allowing you to see through something, or making information and decisions clear and open.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物体能让人透过它看见另一侧，也指信息、程序或决策清楚公开、便于了解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħalli d-dawl jgħaddi u jippermetti li tara minn ġo fih, jew li jagħmel l-informazzjoni, il-proċeduri u d-deċiżjonijiet ċari u miftuħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 透明的，能透过其看见另一侧的；也可形容程序、信息或决策公开清楚、易于了解。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa trasparenti tħallik tara minn ġo fiha; proċess trasparenti jkollu informazzjoni u regoli ċari, sabiex in-nies ikunu jistgħu jifhmu kif jittieħdu d-deċiżjonijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is transparent allows you to see through it; a transparent process makes its information and decisions clear and open.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat għandu jiżgura proċess trasparenti billi jippubblika l-kriterji tal-għażla u jispjega r-raġunijiet għad-deċiżjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: The committee should ensure a transparent process by publishing the selection criteria and explaining the reasons for its decision.
formal.zh: 委员会应公布遴选标准并解释其决定的理由，以确保程序公开透明。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għażilt dan il-kontenitur? Lara: Għax hu trasparenti u nista' nara x'hemm fih mingħajr ma niftaħ l-għatu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you choose this container? Lara: Because it is transparent and I can see what is inside without opening the lid.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么选这个容器？Lara：因为它是透明的，不打开盖子也能看见里面有什么。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么选这个容器？
messages.en: Why did you choose this container?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu trasparenti u nista' nara x'hemm fih mingħajr ma niftaħ l-għatu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu trasparenti u nista' nara x'hemm fih mingħajr ma niftaħ l-għatu.
messages.zh: 因为它是透明的，不打开盖子也能看见里面有什么。
messages.en: Because it is transparent and I can see what is inside without opening the lid.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把透明容器和公开的评选流程并排想象：前者让你看清里面，后者让你看清决定如何作出，两者都可用 trasparenti。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of allowing things to be seen through, or of making information and decisions open and clear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体能让人透视的性质；也指信息、程序或决定公开清楚，便于人们了解和检查。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' materjal li jħalli d-dawl jgħaddi u jippermetti li wieħed jara minn ġo fih, jew ta' proċess li jagħmel l-informazzjoni u d-deċiżjonijiet ċari u aċċessibbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 透明性，指能透过物体看见另一侧的性质；也指办事过程及相关信息公开、清晰的程度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-trasparenza hija l-proprjetà li tippermetti li wieħed jara minn ġo materjal; tintuża wkoll għall-ftuħ u ċ-ċarezza fl-għoti tal-informazzjoni u fit-teħid tad-deċiżjonijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Transparency is the quality of being easy to see through, or of allowing people to understand how decisions are made.

formal.mt: Biex tiżdied it-trasparenza, il-kumitat ippubblika r-rapport finanzjarju u spjega kif ittieħdu d-deċiżjonijiet.
formal.en: To increase transparency, the committee published the financial report and explained how the decisions were made.
formal.zh: 为提高透明度，委员会公布了财务报告，并解释了各项决定是如何作出的。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex poġġew l-ispejjeż kollha fuq is-sit? Mark: Għat-trasparenza, biex kulħadd ikun jista' jara kif intefqu l-flus.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did they put all the expenses on the website? Mark: For transparency, so everyone can see how the money was spent.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他们为什么把所有开支都放到网站上？马克：为了公开透明，让每个人都能看到钱是怎么花的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex poġġew l-ispejjeż kollha fuq is-sit?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex poġġew l-ispejjeż kollha fuq is-sit?
messages.zh: 他们为什么把所有开支都放到网站上？
messages.en: Why did they put all the expenses on the website?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-trasparenza, biex kulħadd ikun jista' jara kif intefqu l-flus.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-trasparenza, biex kulħadd ikun jista' jara kif intefqu l-flus.
messages.zh: 为了公开透明，让每个人都能看到钱是怎么花的。
messages.en: For transparency, so everyone can see how the money was spent.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 trasparenza 联想成一块透明玻璃：既能看穿玻璃，也能看清办事过程；从“看得见”记住“透明性、公开透明”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The movement of people or goods from one place to another, or the vehicles and services used for this.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将人员或货物从一地运送到另一地的活动，也指用于这一目的的交通工具和运输服务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ġarr ta' nies jew merkanzija minn post għal ieħor, jew il-vetturi u s-servizzi li jintużaw għal dan il-għan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 运输，指人员或货物在不同地点之间的运送，也可指承担这种运送的交通工具或服务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-trasport huwa l-ġarr ta' persuni jew oġġetti minn post għal ieħor, kif ukoll is-sistema ta' vetturi u servizzi li tagħmel dan possibbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Transport is the movement of people or goods between places, or the vehicles and services that make this possible.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija se torganizza t-trasport tal-merkanzija mill-maħżen sal-ħwienet kull nhar ta' Tnejn.
formal.en: The company will arrange the transport of goods from the warehouse to the shops every Monday.
formal.zh: 公司将安排每周一把货物从仓库运送到各家商店。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif se tasal ix-xogħol għada? Mark: Se nuża t-trasport pubbliku. Hemm karozza tal-linja li tieqaf ħdejn l-uffiċċju.
colloquial.en: Maja: How will you get to work tomorrow? Mark: I'll use public transport. There's a bus that stops near the office.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你明天怎么去上班？马克：我会坐公共交通。有一趟公交车在办公室附近停靠。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你明天怎么去上班？
messages.en: How will you get to work tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nuża t-trasport pubbliku. Hemm karozza tal-linja li tieqaf ħdejn l-uffiċċju.
messages.mt_standard: Se nuża t-trasport pubbliku. Hemm karozza tal-linja li tieqaf ħdejn l-uffiċċju.
messages.zh: 我会坐公共交通。有一趟公交车在办公室附近停靠。
messages.en: I'll use public transport. There's a bus that stops near the office.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 trasport，就想象一辆车把人或货物从甲地送到乙地；再用 trasport pubbliku“公共交通”巩固记忆。

gloss_zh: 运送；发运；运输路线安排；货物运输

teaching_sense.en_definition: The organized movement of goods from one place to another, including their dispatch, routing, and delivery.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将货物从一地运往另一地的活动，包括发运、运输路线安排和交付。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ġarr organizzat ta' merkanzija minn post għal ieħor, inklużi t-tluq tagħha, l-għażla tar-rotta u t-twassil fid-destinazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将货物运送并交付到指定地点或收货人手中的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih il-merkanzija tinġarr u titwassal fil-post indikat jew għand il-persuna li għandha tirċeviha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The delivery of goods is the process of taking them to the person or place for which they are intended.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 安排货物离开发货地点并启程运往目的地的过程；发运。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess tal-organizzazzjoni u t-tluq tal-merkanzija mill-post minn fejn tintbagħat sabiex tibda l-vjaġġ lejn id-destinazzjoni tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Dispatching is the process of arranging for goods to leave their starting point and begin their journey.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为运送货物选择或安排运输路线的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess tal-għażla jew l-ippjanar tar-rotta li minnha għandha tgħaddi l-merkanzija waqt il-ġarr tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Routing is the process of deciding which route goods should follow to reach their destination.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过陆路、海路或空路将货物从发货地点运往目的地的运输活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-attività li biha l-merkanzija tintbagħat u tinġarr mill-post tat-tluq lejn id-destinazzjoni tagħha fuq l-art, bil-baħar jew bl-ajru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Shipment is the sending of goods from one place to another by land, sea, or air.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija se torganizza t-trasportazzjoni tal-merkanzija mill-maħżen sal-ħanut, u l-ispiża se tkun inkluża fil-prezz.
formal.en: The company will organize the transportation of the goods from the warehouse to the shop, and the cost will be included in the price.
formal.zh: 公司将安排把货物从仓库运到商店，运输费用将包含在价格内。

colloquial.mt: Mark: It-trasportazzjoni tal-mejda hija inkluża fil-prezz? Rita: Iva, inwassluhielek id-dar għada filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is transportation of the table included in the price? Rita: Yes, we'll deliver it to your home tomorrow morning.
colloquial.zh: 马克：桌子的运输费包含在价格里吗？丽塔：是的，我们明天上午送到你家。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 桌子的运输费包含在价格里吗？
messages.en: Is transportation of the table included in the price?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.zh: 是的，我们明天上午送到你家。
messages.en: Yes, we'll deliver it to your home tomorrow morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“仓库发货—选择路线—途中运输—送达商店”的画面中记忆；四个义项分别关注同一运输流程的不同环节。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Medical care given for an illness or injury, or the way a person or thing is dealt with.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 针对疾病或伤势进行的治疗，也指对待某人或处理某物的方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kura mogħtija għal marda jew korriment, jew il-mod kif persuna tiġi ttrattata jew xi ħaġa tiġi pproċessata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为改善疾病或伤势而提供的医疗措施；也指对待人的方式，或为达到某种效果而对物品进行的处理。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kura mogħtija biex titjieb marda jew korriment; il-kelma tirreferi wkoll għall-mod kif wieħed jittratta persuna jew għall-proċess li jsir fuq materjal biex jinkiseb riżultat partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Treatment is medical care given for an illness or injury, and it can also mean how someone is dealt with or a process applied to a material.

formal.mt: Il-politika tal-iskola titlob trattament ugwali għall-istudenti kollha, irrispettivament minn fejn ġejjin.
formal.en: The school's policy requires equal treatment for all students, regardless of where they come from.
formal.zh: 学校政策要求平等对待所有学生，无论他们来自哪里。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sejjer it-trattament għall-irkoppa? Pawlu: Sejjer tajjeb; issa nista' nimxi b'inqas uġigħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is the treatment for your knee going? Pawlu: It's going well; I can walk with less pain now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的膝盖治疗得怎么样了？保罗：挺顺利的，现在走路没那么疼了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的膝盖治疗得怎么样了？
messages.en: How is the treatment for your knee going?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sejjer tajjeb; issa nista' nimxi b'inqas uġigħ.
messages.mt_standard: Sejjer tajjeb; issa nista' nimxi b'inqas uġigħ.
messages.zh: 挺顺利的，现在走路没那么疼了。
messages.en: It's going well; I can walk with less pain now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个搭配串联记忆：医生给予治疗，学校给予平等对待，工匠进行木材处理；根据对象判断 trattament 的具体意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Treatment that gives a person, group, or country advantages over others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给予某个人、群体或国家比其他对象更有利的条件、便利或优先权的待遇。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mod kif persuna, grupp jew pajjiż jingħataw vantaġġi jew kundizzjonijiet aħjar minn dawk mogħtija lil oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某个人、群体或国家获得比其他对象更有利条件或优先权的待遇。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Trattament li jagħti lil persuna, grupp jew pajjiż vantaġġi, prijorità jew kundizzjonijiet aktar favorevoli minn dawk mogħtija lil oħrajn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone receives preferential treatment, they are given advantages or opportunities that other people do not receive.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega għaliex ċerti applikanti ngħataw trattament preferenzjali waqt il-proċess tal-għażla.
formal.en: The report explains why certain applicants were given preferential treatment during the selection process.
formal.zh: 报告解释了为何某些申请人在选拔过程中获得了优先待遇。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dawk il-klijenti jinqdew l-ewwel? Mark: Għandhom trattament preferenzjali għax huma membri tal-klabb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are those customers being served first? Mark: They get preferential treatment because they are club members.
colloquial.zh: Maja：为什么先接待那些顾客？Mark：因为他们是俱乐部会员，享有优先待遇。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 为什么先接待那些顾客？
messages.en: Why are those customers being served first?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandhom trattament preferenzjali għax huma membri tal-klabb.
messages.mt_standard: Għandhom trattament preferenzjali għax huma membri tal-klabb.
messages.zh: 因为他们是俱乐部会员，享有优先待遇。
messages.en: They get preferential treatment because they are club members.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语联想成“会员优先窗口”：同样来办事，有人先获服务或享有更好条件，就能记住“优惠待遇、优先待遇”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The way goods are treated under customs tariff rules, including the duties applied to them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 货物在关税制度下适用的待遇，包括适用税率以及是否享有关税减免。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mod kif ir-regoli dwar it-tariffi doganali jiġu applikati għall-merkanzija, inklużi r-rati tad-dazju u kwalunkwe tnaqqis jew eżenzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 依照关税规则对货物适用税率、征收关税或给予关税减免的待遇。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kundizzjonijiet li japplikaw għall-merkanzija skont it-tariffi doganali, bħar-rata tad-dazju li trid titħallas u jekk jingħatax tnaqqis jew eżenzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The tariff treatment of goods determines which customs duties apply to them and whether any reductions or exemptions are available.

formal.mt: Il-ftehim propost jistabbilixxi t-trattament tariffarju applikabbli għall-merkanzija importata.
formal.en: The proposed agreement establishes the tariff treatment applicable to imported goods.
formal.zh: 拟议协议规定了进口货物适用的关税待遇。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex id-dazju fuq din il-merkanzija huwa aktar baxx? Pawlu: Għax din il-merkanzija tgawdi minn trattament tariffarju aktar favorevoli.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is the customs duty on these goods lower? Pawlu: Because these goods receive more favourable tariff treatment.
colloquial.zh: Lara：为什么这批货物的关税较低？Pawlu：因为这批货物享有更有利的关税待遇。

messages.speaker: Lara (进口商)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex id-dazju fuq din il-merkanzija huwa aktar baxx?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex id-dazju fuq din il-merkanzija huwa aktar baxx?
messages.zh: 为什么这批货物的关税较低？
messages.en: Why is the customs duty on these goods lower?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (报关代理)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax din il-merkanzija tgawdi minn trattament tariffarju aktar favorevoli.
messages.mt_standard: Għax din il-merkanzija tgawdi minn trattament tariffarju aktar favorevoli.
messages.zh: 因为这批货物享有更有利的关税待遇。
messages.en: Because these goods receive more favourable tariff treatment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象货物过海关时拿到一张“关税待遇卡”，卡上写着适用税率和减免条件，用这个画面记住整个短语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Treatment under tariff rules that gives goods or an importer an advantage, such as a lower rate of customs duty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在适用关税规则时给予货物或进口商的有利待遇，例如适用较低的关税税率。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Trattament skont ir-regoli tat-tariffi li jagħti vantaġġ lil merkanzija jew lil importatur, pereżempju permezz ta' rata aktar baxxa ta' dazju doganali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在关税适用方面给予的有利待遇，例如对符合条件的货物适用较低税率。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Trattament vantaġġuż fl-applikazzjoni tat-tariffi doganali, bħal meta merkanzija li tissodisfa ċerti kundizzjonijiet tkun soġġetta għal rata aktar baxxa ta' dazju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If goods receive favourable tariff treatment, the customs duties applied to them are more advantageous than those that would otherwise apply.

collocations.zh: 符合享受有利关税待遇的条件

formal.mt: L-importatur talab li l-merkanzija tingħata trattament tariffarju favorevoli u ppreżenta d-dokumenti meħtieġa biex isostni t-talba tiegħu.
formal.en: The importer requested favourable tariff treatment for the goods and submitted the documents required to support his request.
formal.zh: 进口商申请给予该批货物有利关税待遇，并提交了支持其申请所需的文件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din il-merkanzija tista' tibbenefika minn trattament tariffarju favorevoli? Pawlu: Jista' jkun. L-ewwel irridu niċċekkjaw liema rata tapplika u jekk għandniex id-dokumenti meħtieġa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can these goods benefit from favourable tariff treatment? Pawlu: Possibly. First we need to check which rate applies and whether we have the required documents.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这批货物能享受有利关税待遇吗？保罗：有可能。我们得先核实适用哪种税率，以及所需文件是否齐全。

messages.speaker: Lara (进口商)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-merkanzija tista' tibbenefika minn trattament tariffarju favorevoli?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-merkanzija tista' tibbenefika minn trattament tariffarju favorevoli?
messages.zh: 这批货物能享受有利关税待遇吗？
messages.en: Can these goods benefit from favourable tariff treatment?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (报关代理)
messages.mt_spoken: Jista' jkun. L-ewwel irridu niċċekkjaw liema rata tapplika u jekk għandniex id-dokumenti meħtieġa.
messages.mt_standard: Jista' jkun. L-ewwel irridu niċċekkjaw liema rata tapplika u jekk għandniex id-dokumenti meħtieġa.
messages.zh: 有可能。我们得先核实适用哪种税率，以及所需文件是否齐全。
messages.en: Possibly. First we need to check which rate applies and whether we have the required documents.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把短语分成“待遇 trattament＋关税的 tariffarju＋有利的 favorevoli”三块记忆，想象进口商看到较低税率后说：“这个待遇对我有利。”

teaching_sense.en_definition: Special tariff treatment that gives eligible goods lower customs duties or exemption from duty under a preferential arrangement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依据优惠安排，向符合条件的货物给予较低关税或免税的特殊关税待遇。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Trattament tariffarju speċjali li, skont arranġament preferenzjali, jagħti lil merkanzija eliġibbli rati aktar baxxi ta' dazju doganali jew eżenzjoni mid-dazju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 依据特定优惠安排给予符合资格的货物的关税待遇，通常包括减征或免征关税。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Trattament skont arranġament preferenzjali li jippermetti li merkanzija li tissodisfa l-kundizzjonijiet stabbiliti tidħol b'dazju doganali mnaqqas jew mingħajr dazju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When goods receive preferential tariff treatment, they qualify under a particular arrangement for lower customs duties or exemption from those duties.
