colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word 'turrufnati' mean? Mark: I don't know; we need more context.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：“turrufnati”这个词是什么意思？马克：我不知道；我们需要更多上下文。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: “turrufnati”这个词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word 'turrufnati' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx; għandna bżonn aktar kuntest.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx; għandna bżonn aktar kuntest.
messages.zh: 我不知道；我们需要更多上下文。
messages.en: I don't know; we need more context.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 turrufnati 写在带问号的词卡上，暂记拼写和名词身份，等词义明确后再补图像，切勿猜义硬记。

gloss_zh: 大量；一堆或一丘；一条牛轧糖（通常约三十厘米长）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large quantity or a pile of something; also a piece of nougat usually about thirty centimetres long.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指大量的某种东西或堆起的一堆东西；也指一条通常约三十厘米长的牛轧糖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kwantità kbira jew munzell ta' xi ħaġa; ukoll biċċa qubbajt li ġeneralment tkun twila madwar tletin ċentimetru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大量；很多，强调数量大。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kwantità kbira ta' xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A turrun of something is a large quantity of it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一堆；堆积起来的一丘或一小堆东西。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Munzell jew għolja żgħira magħmula minn affarijiet jew materjal miġburin fuq xulxin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A turrun is a pile or mound formed by things or material heaped together.

sense_translations.en_definition: a piece of nougat, usually around 30cm long
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一条牛轧糖，通常约三十厘米长。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa qubbajt li ġeneralment tkun twila madwar tletin ċentimetru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A turrun is a piece of nougat that is usually about thirty centimetres long.

formal.mt: Waqt it-tindif tas-sit, il-ħaddiema ġabru l-ġebel f'turrun wieħed ħdejn id-daħla.
formal.en: While clearing the site, the workers gathered the stones into a single pile near the entrance.
formal.zh: 清理场地时，工人们把石头集中堆放在入口附近。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad għandek ħafna xogħol? Mark: Iva, għandi turrun xogħol illum. Maja: Meta tlesti, naqsmu turrun qubbajt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you still have a lot of work? Mark: Yes, I have loads of work today. Maja: When you finish, we'll share a bar of nougat.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你还有很多工作吗？马克：是啊，我今天有一大堆工作。玛雅：等你做完，我们分着吃一条牛轧糖。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还有很多工作吗？
messages.en: Do you still have a lot of work?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，我今天有一大堆工作。
messages.en: Yes, I have loads of work today.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 等你做完，我们分着吃一条牛轧糖。
messages.en: When you finish, we'll share a bar of nougat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 turrun 画三格词卡：大量工作、一堆石头、一条约三十厘米的牛轧糖；靠搭配分清三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rude boldness or excessive confidence shown by speaking or acting without proper restraint.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说话或做事时不顾应有分寸而表现出的厚脸皮、放肆或冒失大胆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' mistħija jew kunfidenza żejda li biha wieħed jitkellem jew jaġixxi bla ma jqis il-limiti xierqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 厚脸皮；无礼的大胆或放肆。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' mistħija li jidher f'diskors jew imġiba bla rispett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Cheek is rude boldness shown when someone speaks or behaves without proper respect.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冒失大胆；过分主动或自信，以至于超出交往中应有的分寸。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Imġiba żżejjed kunfidenti jew diretta li taqbeż il-limiti xierqa fil-mod kif wieħed jittratta ma' ħaddieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Forwardness is excessive confidence or directness that goes beyond what a social situation calls for.

formal.mt: Il-kumment sar b'tustaġni żejda u wera nuqqas ta' rispett lejn il-kelliema.
formal.en: The comment was made with excessive forwardness and showed a lack of respect for the speakers.
formal.zh: 这番评论过于冒失放肆，表现出对发言者的不尊重。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħa l-aħħar biċċa kejk mingħajr ma staqsa lil ħadd! Mark: Dik tustaġni! Seta' staqsa l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Maja: He took the last piece of cake without asking anyone! Mark: That's cheek! He could have asked first.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他谁也没问，就拿走了最后一块蛋糕！马克：真厚脸皮！他本可以先问一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħa l-aħħar biċċa kejk mingħajr ma staqsa lil ħadd!
messages.mt_standard: Ħa l-aħħar biċċa kejk mingħajr ma staqsa lil ħadd!
messages.zh: 他谁也没问，就拿走了最后一块蛋糕！
messages.en: He took the last piece of cake without asking anyone!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 真厚脸皮！他本可以先问一下。
messages.en: That's cheek! He could have asked first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tustaġni 联想到不问别人就拿走最后一块蛋糕的场景：大胆越过礼貌分寸，就成了厚脸皮或冒失放肆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small, dark blackberry consisting of many tiny, rounded parts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 黑莓，一种由许多细小圆粒聚合而成、成熟时颜色深黑的浆果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frotta żgħira u skura magħmula minn ħafna partijiet żgħar u tondi miġbura flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黑莓，一种成熟时颜色深黑、表面由许多小圆粒组成的浆果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Frotta żgħira li tkun skura meta timmatura u li tkun magħmula minn ħafna partijiet żgħar miġbura flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A blackberry is a small, dark fruit made up of many tiny, rounded parts.

formal.mt: Qabel ma tittiekel, it-tuta għandha tinħasel sew b'ilma nadif.
formal.en: Before being eaten, the blackberry should be washed thoroughly with clean water.
formal.zh: 食用前，应当用清水把黑莓彻底洗净。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid idduq din it-tuta? Pawlu: Iva, tidher misjura u ħelwa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like to taste this blackberry? Pawlu: Yes, it looks ripe and sweet.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：想尝尝这颗黑莓吗？保罗：想，看起来又熟又甜。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 想尝尝这颗黑莓吗？
messages.en: Would you like to taste this blackberry?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 想，看起来又熟又甜。
messages.en: Yes, it looks ripe and sweet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tuta 和一颗表面有许多小圆粒的黑莓图片一起记，再用 tuta ħelwa 练习说“一颗甜黑莓”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Black mulberries, the small, dark fruits of a mulberry tree.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 黑桑葚的复数形式，指桑树上成熟后呈深黑色的多颗果实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frott żgħir tas-siġra taċ-ċawsli li jkun ta' lewn iswed meta jimmatura; il-kelma tintuża fil-plural.

sense_translations.en_definition: black mulberries [9789990984057, 9789993270706 both give pl tutiet and coll tut, and do not give tuti as on your website]
sense_translations.zh_definition: 黑桑葚，复数名词，指桑树上成熟后呈深黑色的多颗果实。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-frott tas-siġra taċ-ċawsli li jkun iswed meta jimmatura, imsemmi b'forma fil-plural.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Black mulberries are small, dark fruits that grow on a mulberry tree.

formal.mt: Għall-ġamm, għandhom jintgħażlu tutiet misjura u jinħaslu sew qabel it-tisjir.
formal.en: For the jam, ripe black mulberries should be selected and washed thoroughly before cooking.
formal.zh: 制作果酱时，应挑选成熟的黑桑葚，并在烹煮前彻底洗净。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'se tagħmel b'dawn it-tutiet? Nina: Se nagħmel il-ġamm, imma nħalli ftit biex niekluhom friski.
colloquial.en: Sara: What are you going to do with these black mulberries? Nina: I'll make jam, but I'll keep a few for us to eat fresh.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这些黑桑葚你打算怎么处理？妮娜：我要做果酱，不过会留几颗给我们鲜吃。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这些黑桑葚你打算怎么处理？
messages.en: What are you going to do with these black mulberries?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nagħmel il-ġamm, imma nħalli ftit biex niekluhom friski.
messages.mt_standard: Se nagħmel il-ġamm, imma nħalli ftit biex niekluhom friski.
messages.zh: 我要做果酱，不过会留几颗给我们鲜吃。
messages.en: I'll make jam, but I'll keep a few for us to eat fresh.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tutiet 配上一碗黑桑葚的图片，整词记成“多颗黑桑葚”；再用 ġamm tat-tutiet 联想到桑葚果酱。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small window; the diminutive form of tieqa.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小窗户；tieqa（窗户）的指小形式，用于表示尺寸较小的窗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tieqa ta' daqs żgħir; il-kelma hija forma diminuttiva ta' tieqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小窗户，是 tieqa（窗户）的指小形式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tieqa żgħira f'ħajt jew f'bini; twejqa hija l-forma diminuttiva ta' tieqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A twejqa is a small window, and the word is the diminutive form of tieqa.

formal.mt: It-twejqa fil-ħajt ta' fuq iddaħħal id-dawl naturali fil-kamra.
formal.en: The small window high in the wall lets natural light into the room.
formal.zh: 墙壁高处的小窗让自然光照进房间。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tista' tiftaħ it-twejqa tal-kċina? Mark: Iva, hekk tidħol ftit arja.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you open the small kitchen window? Mark: Yes, that will let some air in.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你能打开厨房的小窗吗？马克：可以，这样就能透点气。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 你能打开厨房的小窗吗？
messages.en: Can you open the small kitchen window?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 可以，这样就能透点气。
messages.en: Yes, that will let some air in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一大一小两扇窗，大窗旁写 tieqa，小窗旁写 twejqa，用图片对照记住这个已给出的指小关系。

gloss_zh: 信念；相信某事为真的看法

teaching_sense.en_definition: The acceptance that something is true, or a conviction that a person holds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 相信某事真实或正确的心理状态，也指一个人所持的信念或看法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-konvinzjoni li xi ħaġa hija vera jew tajba, jew fehma li persuna taċċetta bħala vera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 信念；对某事真实或正确的确信，也可指所相信的具体看法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Konvinzjoni jew fehma li persuna żżomm għax tqis li xi ħaġa hija vera jew tajba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A belief is a conviction or an idea that someone accepts as true.

formal.mt: L-awtur jesprimi t-twemmien tiegħu li l-edukazzjoni għandha tkun aċċessibbli għal kulħadd.
formal.en: The author expresses his belief that education should be accessible to everyone.
formal.zh: 作者表达了自己的信念：教育应当人人可及。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tibqa' tipprova? Pawlu: Għandi twemmien sod li nista' nitgħallem, anki jekk niżbalja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you keep trying? Pawlu: I have a firm belief that I can learn, even if I make mistakes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么一直坚持尝试？保罗：我坚信自己能够学会，即使会犯错。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么一直坚持尝试？
messages.en: Why do you keep trying?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi twemmien sod li nista' nitgħallem, anki jekk niżbalja.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi twemmien sod li nista' nitgħallem, anki jekk niżbalja.
messages.zh: 我坚信自己能够学会，即使会犯错。
messages.en: I have a firm belief that I can learn, even if I make mistakes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 twemmien 写在“我相信自己能学会”的便签上，再搭配 sod 记成“坚定的信念”，通过具体想法记住抽象名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take part in a fight or physical struggle with another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与他人打斗或发生肢体争斗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tiġġieled jew tidħol f'taqbida ma' persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打斗；与别人发生肢体争斗。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tieħu sehem fi ġlied jew f'taqbida ma' ħaddieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone fights, they take part in a physical struggle with another person.

collocations.en: the use of 'twissina' in the sense of fighting

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju tal-vokabularju, 'twissina' għandha t-tifsira ta' ġlied jew taqbida bejn persuni.
formal.en: In this vocabulary exercise, 'twissina' has the meaning of fighting or struggling between people.
formal.zh: 在这项词汇练习中，“twissina”表示人与人之间的打斗或争斗。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'twissina' f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Mark: Hawn tfisser li tiġġieled ma' xi ħadd.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'twissina' mean in this exercise? Mark: Here it means to fight with someone.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这道练习里的“twissina”是什么意思？Mark：这里指与别人打斗。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这道练习里的“twissina”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'twissina' mean in this exercise?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser li tiġġieled ma' xi ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser li tiġġieled ma' xi ħadd.
messages.zh: 这里指与别人打斗。
messages.en: Here it means to fight with someone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本条给定的“打斗”义，把词卡与两个人发生争斗的画面配对记忆；这是情景联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or habit of doing what someone in authority tells you to do.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 遵从有权威者的命令、要求或指示的行为或习惯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-imġiba jew id-drawwa li tagħmel dak li jgħidlek tagħmel xi ħadd li għandu awtorità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 服从；按照有权威者的命令或指示行事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-għemil ta' min jobdi l-ordnijiet jew l-istruzzjonijiet ta' persuna li għandha awtorità.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Obedience is the behaviour of doing what someone in authority tells you to do.

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżerċizzju ta' evakwazzjoni, l-ubbidjenza lejn l-istruzzjonijiet tal-għalliema għenet biex l-istudenti joħorġu b'mod sigur.
formal.en: During the evacuation drill, obedience to the teachers' instructions helped the students leave safely.
formal.zh: 在疏散演练中，学生听从教师的指示，有助于他们安全离开。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'ubbidjenza'? Pawlu: Meta tagħmel dak li jgħidlek xi ħadd li għandu awtorità, bħal meta tobdi lill-għalliema waqt eżerċizzju ta' sigurtà.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'ubbidjenza' mean? Pawlu: It means doing what someone in authority tells you, like following your teacher's instructions during a safety drill.
colloquial.zh: Maja：“ubbidjenza”是什么意思？Pawlu：就是听从有权威者的要求，比如在安全演练时听从老师的指示。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: “ubbidjenza”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ubbidjenza' mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tagħmel dak li jgħidlek xi ħadd li għandu awtorità, bħal meta tobdi lill-għalliema waqt eżerċizzju ta' sigurtà.
messages.mt_standard: Meta tagħmel dak li jgħidlek xi ħadd li għandu awtorità, bħal meta tobdi lill-għalliema waqt eżerċizzju ta' sigurtà.
messages.zh: 就是听从有权威者的要求，比如在安全演练时听从老师的指示。
messages.en: It means doing what someone in authority tells you, like following your teacher's instructions during a safety drill.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象安全演练时听到老师指示便照着行动，把“指示—听从—行动”这条情景链与“服从”联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Eggs that have spoiled and are no longer suitable for eating.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经腐坏、不宜食用的蛋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bajd li tħassar u li ma għadux tajjeb għall-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 腐坏的蛋，即已经变质、不宜食用的蛋。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bajd imħassar li ma għadux tajjeb biex jittiekel u li jista' jkollu riħa tinten.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Rotten eggs are eggs that have gone bad and are no longer suitable for eating.

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni tal-kċina, instab udiegħ f'kontenitur u tneħħa minnufih miż-żona fejn jitħejja l-ikel.
formal.en: During the kitchen inspection, rotten eggs were found in a container and immediately removed from the food preparation area.
formal.zh: 检查厨房时，人们在一个容器内发现了腐坏的蛋，并立即将其移出备餐区。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhi dik ir-riħa tinten? Omm: Hemm udiegħ f'din il-kaxxa. Se narmih u naħsel idejja.
colloquial.en: Nina: What's that awful smell? Mum: There are rotten eggs in this box. I'll throw them away and wash my hands.
colloquial.zh: Nina：那股臭味是什么？妈妈：这个盒子里有臭蛋。我会把它们扔掉，然后洗手。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 那股臭味是什么？
messages.en: What's that awful smell?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm udiegħ f'din il-kaxxa. Se narmih u naħsel idejja.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm udiegħ f'din il-kaxxa. Se narmih u naħsel idejja.
messages.zh: 这个盒子里有臭蛋。我会把它们扔掉，然后洗手。
messages.en: There are rotten eggs in this box. I'll throw them away and wash my hands.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象打开蛋盒闻到臭味，立即把坏蛋挑出来；用“蛋盒—臭味—坏蛋”的连续画面记住本条名词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A group of people who watch or listen to a performance, speech, or programme.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 观看演出、收看节目或聆听演讲等活动的一群人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' nies li jaraw jew jisimgħu spettaklu, diskors jew programm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 观看演出、收看节目或聆听演讲的观众或听众群体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-udjenza hija l-grupp ta' nies li jaraw jew jisimgħu spettaklu, diskors jew programm.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An audience is a group of people who watch or listen to a performance, speech, or programme.

collocations.zh: 人数众多的观众或听众

formal.mt: Fi tmiem il-kunċert, l-udjenza ċapċpet għal diversi minuti.
formal.en: At the end of the concert, the audience applauded for several minutes.
formal.zh: 音乐会结束时，观众鼓掌了好几分钟。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kien hemm udjenza kbira għall-kunċert? Mark: Iva, is-sala kienet mimlija u kulħadd ħa gost.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was there a large audience at the concert? Mark: Yes, the hall was full and everyone enjoyed it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：音乐会的观众多吗？马克：多，整个大厅都坐满了，大家都很尽兴。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 音乐会的观众多吗？
messages.en: Was there a large audience at the concert?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, is-sala kienet mimlija u kulħadd ħa gost.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, is-sala kienet mimlija u kulħadd ħa gost.
messages.zh: 多，整个大厅都坐满了，大家都很尽兴。
messages.en: Yes, the hall was full and everyone enjoyed it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 udjenza 和舞台前的一整群观众联系起来记：台上有人表演，台下这群人就是 udjenza。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A room or place where administrative or professional work is carried out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进行行政、文书或专业工作的房间或场所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kamra jew post fejn isir xogħol amministrattiv jew professjonali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供人员处理行政事务、文书或专业工作的办公室或办公场所。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Uffiċċju huwa kamra jew post fejn in-nies jagħmlu xogħol amministrattiv jew professjonali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An office is a room or place where people carry out administrative or professional work.

formal.mt: L-uffiċċju jinsab fit-tieni sular tal-bini u jiftaħ fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: The office is on the second floor of the building and opens at nine in the morning.
formal.zh: 办公室位于该楼的二层，每天上午九点开门。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Illum se taħdem mid-dar jew mill-uffiċċju? Mark: Mill-uffiċċju, għax għandi laqgħa mal-kollegi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you going to work from home or from the office today? Mark: From the office, because I have a meeting with my colleagues.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天在家办公还是去办公室？马克：去办公室，因为我要和同事开会。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum se taħdem mid-dar jew mill-uffiċċju?
messages.mt_standard: Illum se taħdem mid-dar jew mill-uffiċċju?
messages.zh: 你今天在家办公还是去办公室？
messages.en: Are you going to work from home or from the office today?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 去办公室，因为我要和同事开会。
messages.en: From the office, because I have a meeting with my colleagues.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 uffiċċju 放进上班画面中记忆：推门看见办公桌、电脑和文件，就想到“办公室”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An office where customs officials handle matters concerning goods entering or leaving a country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 海关工作人员处理货物进出境相关事务的办事机构或办公场所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uffiċċju fejn l-uffiċjali tad-dwana jittrattaw kwistjonijiet dwar merkanzija li tidħol f'pajjiż jew toħroġ minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 负责办理货物进出境相关海关事务的办事机构或办公场所。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Uffiċċju doganali huwa post fejn jaħdmu uffiċjali tad-dwana u jiġu ttrattati kwistjonijiet marbuta mad-dħul u l-ħruġ tal-merkanzija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A customs office is a place where customs officials deal with goods entering or leaving a country.

collocations.en: the address of the customs office

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija kkuntattjat l-uffiċċju doganali biex titlob informazzjoni dwar id-dokumenti tal-merkanzija.
formal.en: The company contacted the customs office to request information about the goods documentation.
formal.zh: 该公司联系了海关办事处，咨询货物单证的相关信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn nista' nistaqsi dwar id-dokumenti għal din il-merkanzija? Mark: Tista' tikkuntattja l-uffiċċju doganali; għandi n-numru tat-telefon hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where can I ask about the documents for these goods? Mark: You can contact the customs office; I have the phone number here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我可以向哪里咨询这批货物的单证问题？马克：你可以联系海关办事处，我这里有电话号码。

messages.speaker: Maja (货主)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn nista' nistaqsi dwar id-dokumenti għal din il-merkanzija?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn nista' nistaqsi dwar id-dokumenti għal din il-merkanzija?
messages.zh: 我可以向哪里咨询这批货物的单证问题？
messages.en: Where can I ask about the documents for these goods?

messages.speaker: Mark (物流工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tikkuntattja l-uffiċċju doganali; għandi n-numru tat-telefon hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tikkuntattja l-uffiċċju doganali; għandi n-numru tat-telefon hawn.
messages.zh: 你可以联系海关办事处，我这里有电话号码。
messages.en: You can contact the customs office; I have the phone number here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 uffiċċju 是办公室，再用 doganali 锁定海关事务；联想拿着货物单证走进海关办事处。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A customs office that handles the discharge of a customs procedure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 办理海关程序核销手续，即确认有关程序已经完成的海关办事处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uffiċċju doganali li jittratta l-formalitajiet biex jiġi kkonfermat li proċedura doganali tkun intemmet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 办理海关程序核销、确认该程序已经完成的海关办事处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Uffiċċju doganali fejn jiġu ttrattati l-formalitajiet marbuta mal-għeluq ta' proċedura doganali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A customs office of discharge is an office that handles the formalities for confirming the completion of a customs procedure.

collocations.mt: jippreżenta d-dokumenti lill-uffiċċju doganali ta' verifika
collocations.en: submit the documents to the customs office of discharge
collocations.zh: 向海关程序核销办事处提交文件

collocations.en: confirmation from the customs office of discharge
collocations.zh: 海关程序核销办事处出具的确认

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija talbet konferma mill-uffiċċju doganali ta' verifika li l-proċedura doganali kienet intemmet.
formal.en: The company requested confirmation from the customs office of discharge that the customs procedure had been completed.
formal.zh: 公司向海关程序核销办事处申请确认该项海关程序已经完成。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif nista' nikkonferma li l-proċedura ntemmet? David: Ikkuntattja l-uffiċċju doganali ta' verifika u itlob konferma. Nina: Tajjeb, se nibgħatilhom messaġġ.
colloquial.en: Nina: How can I confirm that the procedure has been completed? David: Contact the customs office of discharge and ask for confirmation. Nina: All right, I'll send them a message.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我怎样才能确认这项程序已经完成？戴维：联系海关程序核销办事处，请他们确认。妮娜：好的，我给他们发条消息。

messages.speaker: Nina (进口商)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nista' nikkonferma li l-proċedura ntemmet?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nista' nikkonferma li l-proċedura ntemmet?
messages.zh: 我怎样才能确认这项程序已经完成？
messages.en: How can I confirm that the procedure has been completed?

messages.speaker: David (报关员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ikkuntattja l-uffiċċju doganali ta' verifika u itlob konferma.
messages.mt_standard: Ikkuntattja l-uffiċċju doganali ta' verifika u itlob konferma.
messages.zh: 联系海关程序核销办事处，请他们确认。
messages.en: Contact the customs office of discharge and ask for confirmation.

messages.speaker: Nina (进口商)
messages.zh: 好的，我给他们发条消息。
messages.en: All right, I'll send them a message.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本词条的指定义项，想象海关在程序文件上盖“已完成”章，把整个词组与“程序核销”配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The customs office designated to handle a consignment at its destination.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指定在货物目的地处理该批货物相关海关事务的海关办事处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-uffiċċju tad-dwana magħżul biex jittratta l-kwistjonijiet doganali ta' kunsinna fid-destinazzjoni tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在一批货物的目的地负责处理其相关海关事务的指定海关办事处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-uffiċċju doganali tad-destinazzjoni huwa l-uffiċċju tad-dwana magħżul biex jittratta l-kunsinna fil-post tad-destinazzjoni tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The customs office of destination is the designated customs office that handles a consignment at its destination.

collocations.en: the code of the customs office of destination
collocations.zh: 目的地海关办事处的代码

collocations.en: to contact the customs office of destination
collocations.zh: 联系目的地海关办事处

formal.mt: L-isem u l-indirizz tal-uffiċċju doganali tad-destinazzjoni jidhru fid-dokumenti tat-trasport.
formal.en: The name and address of the customs office of destination appear in the transport documents.
formal.zh: 运输单证上列有目的地海关办事处的名称和地址。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek l-indirizz tal-uffiċċju doganali tad-destinazzjoni? Mark: Iva, qiegħed fid-dokumenti tat-trasport; nurik fejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have the address of the customs office of destination? Mark: Yes, it is in the transport documents; I will show you where.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有目的地海关办事处的地址吗？马克：有，就在运输单证里，我指给你看。

messages.speaker: Maja (货主)
messages.zh: 你有目的地海关办事处的地址吗？
messages.en: Do you have the address of the customs office of destination?

messages.speaker: Mark (物流工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed fid-dokumenti tat-trasport; nurik fejn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed fid-dokumenti tat-trasport; nurik fejn.
messages.zh: 有，就在运输单证里，我指给你看。
messages.en: Yes, it is in the transport documents; I will show you where.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“办公室—海关—目的地”分段记忆整条短语，再想象货物抵达终点时对应的那一处海关办事处。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A customs office responsible for customs procedures when goods enter a customs territory.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责货物进入关税领土时相关海关手续的海关办事处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uffiċċju tad-dwana responsabbli għall-proċeduri doganali marbuta mad-dħul ta' merkanzija f'territorju doganali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 负责货物入境相关海关手续的海关办事处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Uffiċċju tad-dwana li jieħu ħsieb il-proċeduri doganali meta merkanzija tidħol f'territorju doganali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A customs office of entry is an office that handles customs procedures when goods enter a customs territory.

collocations.en: present the documents at the customs office of entry
collocations.zh: 在入境海关办事处提交文件

collocations.en: contact the customs office of entry

formal.mt: L-importatur ikkuntattja l-uffiċċju doganali tad-dħul biex jistaqsi liema dokumenti kienu meħtieġa għall-merkanzija.
formal.en: The importer contacted the customs office of entry to ask which documents were required for the goods.
formal.zh: 进口商联系了入境海关办事处，询问这批货物需要哪些文件。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn għandi nippreżenta dawn id-dokumenti? Lara: Fl-uffiċċju doganali tad-dħul. Nista' nurik fejn hu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where should I present these documents? Lara: At the customs office of entry. I can show you where it is.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这些文件应该交到哪里？拉拉：交到入境海关办事处。我可以指给你看它在哪里。

messages.speaker: Mark (进口商)
messages.zh: 这些文件应该交到哪里？
messages.en: Where should I present these documents?

messages.speaker: Lara (货运代理)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-uffiċċju doganali tad-dħul. Nista' nurik fejn hu.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-uffiċċju doganali tad-dħul. Nista' nurik fejn hu.
messages.zh: 交到入境海关办事处。我可以指给你看它在哪里。
messages.en: At the customs office of entry. I can show you where it is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把货物进入关税领土的画面与这个词组配对：看到 tad-dħul 就提醒自己关注“进入”，整组记作“入境海关办事处”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A customs office responsible for customs procedures for goods being exported.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责办理货物出口相关海关手续的海关办事处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uffiċċju tad-dwana responsabbli għall-proċeduri doganali relatati ma' merkanzija li tkun se tiġi esportata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 负责货物出口相关海关手续的海关办事处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Uffiċċju tad-dwana li jieħu ħsieb il-formalitajiet doganali għall-esportazzjoni ta' merkanzija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A customs office of export is an office that handles customs formalities for goods being exported.

collocations.en: submit a declaration at the customs office of export
collocations.zh: 在出口海关办事处提交申报单

collocations.mt: titlob informazzjoni mingħand l-uffiċċju doganali tal-esportazzjoni
collocations.en: request information from the customs office of export
collocations.zh: 向出口海关办事处咨询信息

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija talbet informazzjoni mingħand l-uffiċċju doganali tal-esportazzjoni dwar il-formalitajiet għall-esportazzjoni tal-prodotti tagħha.
formal.en: The company requested information from the customs office of export about the formalities for exporting its products.
formal.zh: 该公司向出口海关办事处咨询了出口其产品所需办理的手续。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Irrid nibgħat dawn il-prodotti barra l-pajjiż. Lil min nista' nistaqsi dwar il-formalitajiet? Pawlu: Ċempel lill-uffiċċju doganali tal-esportazzjoni. Hemmhekk jistgħu jgħinuk.
colloquial.en: Nina: I want to send these products abroad. Who can I ask about the formalities? Pawlu: Call the customs office of export. They can help you there.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我想把这些产品运到国外。办理手续的事可以问谁？保罗：给出口海关办事处打电话吧。那里的工作人员可以帮你。

messages.speaker: Nina (商家)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrid nibgħat dawn il-prodotti barra l-pajjiż. Lil min nista' nistaqsi dwar il-formalitajiet?
messages.mt_standard: Irrid nibgħat dawn il-prodotti barra l-pajjiż. Lil min nista' nistaqsi dwar il-formalitajiet?
messages.zh: 我想把这些产品运到国外。办理手续的事可以问谁？
messages.en: I want to send these products abroad. Who can I ask about the formalities?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċempel lill-uffiċċju doganali tal-esportazzjoni. Hemmhekk jistgħu jgħinuk.
messages.mt_standard: Ċempel lill-uffiċċju doganali tal-esportazzjoni. Hemmhekk jistgħu jgħinuk.
messages.zh: 给出口海关办事处打电话吧。那里的工作人员可以帮你。
messages.en: Call the customs office of export. They can help you there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“产品准备出口，先咨询出口手续”这一情景记忆：tal-esportazzjoni 对应“出口”，整个词组强调办理出口业务的海关办事处。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The customs office at the first point where goods enter a customs territory.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 货物进入某一关税领土时，在第一个入境地点负责相关手续的海关办事处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-uffiċċju tad-dwana fil-punt fejn merkanzija tidħol għall-ewwel darba f'territorju doganali matul il-vjaġġ tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 货物进入某一关税领土时，第一个入境地点的海关办事处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Uffiċċju tad-dwana fil-post fejn merkanzija tidħol għall-ewwel darba f'territorju doganali qabel ma tkompli lejn postijiet oħra fih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A customs office of first entry is the customs office at the first point where goods enter a customs territory during their journey.

collocations.en: identify the customs office of first entry
collocations.zh: 确定首次入境海关办事处

collocations.mt: tibgħat informazzjoni lill-uffiċċju doganali tal-ewwel dħul
collocations.en: send information to the customs office of first entry
collocations.zh: 向首次入境海关办事处发送信息

formal.mt: Il-pjan tat-trasport jidentifika l-uffiċċju doganali tal-ewwel dħul fit-territorju doganali u d-destinazzjoni finali tal-merkanzija.
formal.en: The transport plan identifies the customs office of first entry into the customs territory and the goods' final destination.
formal.zh: 运输计划列明了货物进入该关税领土时的首次入境海关办事处，以及货物的最终目的地。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-merkanzija se tidħol minn port u mbagħad tkompli lejn belt oħra. Liema uffiċċju hu tal-ewwel dħul? David: L-uffiċċju doganali tal-ewwel dħul hu dak fil-port fejn tidħol għall-ewwel darba fit-territorju doganali.
colloquial.en: Sara: The goods will enter through a port and then continue to another city. Which office is the office of first entry? David: The customs office of first entry is the one at the port where the goods first enter the customs territory.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：货物会从一个港口入境，然后继续运往另一座城市。哪个办事处是首次入境办事处？戴维：首次入境海关办事处就是货物第一次进入该关税领土的那个港口的海关办事处。

messages.speaker: Sara (物流助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-merkanzija se tidħol minn port u mbagħad tkompli lejn belt oħra. Liema uffiċċju hu tal-ewwel dħul?
messages.mt_standard: Il-merkanzija se tidħol minn port u mbagħad tkompli lejn belt oħra. Liema uffiċċju hu tal-ewwel dħul?
messages.zh: 货物会从一个港口入境，然后继续运往另一座城市。哪个办事处是首次入境办事处？
messages.en: The goods will enter through a port and then continue to another city. Which office is the office of first entry?

messages.speaker: David (物流主管)
messages.mt_spoken: L-uffiċċju doganali tal-ewwel dħul hu dak fil-port fejn tidħol għall-ewwel darba fit-territorju doganali.
messages.mt_standard: L-uffiċċju doganali tal-ewwel dħul hu dak fil-port fejn tidħol għall-ewwel darba fit-territorju doganali.
messages.zh: 首次入境海关办事处就是货物第一次进入该关税领土的那个港口的海关办事处。
messages.en: The customs office of first entry is the one at the port where the goods first enter the customs territory.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在运输路线的第一个入境点画一个数字“1”：ewwel 提醒“第一”，dħul 提醒“进入”，合起来记住“首次入境海关办事处”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A customs office responsible for monitoring customs-related activities or procedures.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责持续跟踪海关相关活动或程序情况的海关办公室。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uffiċċju tad-dwana responsabbli biex isegwi b'mod regolari attivitajiet jew proċeduri doganali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 负责跟踪和监测海关相关活动或程序的海关办公室。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Uffiċċju tad-dwana li jsegwi b'mod regolari kif ikunu għaddejjin attivitajiet jew proċeduri doganali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A monitoring customs office is a customs office that keeps track of customs-related activities or procedures.

collocations.en: a report to the monitoring customs office
collocations.zh: 提交给监测海关办公室的报告

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija bagħtet rapport lill-uffiċċju doganali tal-monitoraġġ dwar l-attivitajiet tagħha.
formal.en: The company sent the monitoring customs office a report on its activities.
formal.zh: 公司向监测海关办公室提交了一份有关其活动的报告。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Lil min se nibagħtu dan ir-rapport? Pawlu: Lill-uffiċċju doganali tal-monitoraġġ. Għandi l-indirizz elettroniku tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who are we sending this report to? Pawlu: To the monitoring customs office. I have its email address.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我们要把这份报告发给谁？Pawlu：发给监测海关办公室。我有该办公室的电子邮箱地址。

messages.speaker: Marija (物流职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil min se nibagħtu dan ir-rapport?
messages.mt_standard: Lil min se nibagħtu dan ir-rapport?
messages.zh: 我们要把这份报告发给谁？
messages.en: Who are we sending this report to?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (物流同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Lill-uffiċċju doganali tal-monitoraġġ. Għandi l-indirizz elettroniku tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Lill-uffiċċju doganali tal-monitoraġġ. Għandi l-indirizz elettroniku tiegħu.
messages.zh: 发给监测海关办公室。我有该办公室的电子邮箱地址。
messages.en: To the monitoring customs office. I have its email address.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语想成“海关办公室＋监测职责”，联想工作人员持续查看流程记录的画面，记住重点是跟踪情况。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A customs office at which goods are presented to the customs authorities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 货物向海关当局呈验时所对应的海关办公室。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uffiċċju tad-dwana fejn il-merkanzija tiġi ppreżentata lill-awtoritajiet doganali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向海关当局呈验货物的海关办公室，即货物呈验地海关。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Uffiċċju tad-dwana fejn issir il-preżentazzjoni tal-merkanzija lill-awtoritajiet doganali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The customs office of presentation is the customs office where goods are presented to the customs authorities.

collocations.en: present the goods at the customs office of presentation
collocations.zh: 在货物呈验地海关呈验货物

collocations.en: the address of the customs office of presentation
collocations.zh: 货物呈验地海关的地址

formal.mt: Id-dokument jindika l-uffiċċju doganali tal-preżentazzjoni fejn se tiġi ppreżentata l-merkanzija.
formal.en: The document identifies the customs office of presentation where the goods will be presented.
formal.zh: 文件注明了将向海关呈验货物的货物呈验地海关。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn se nippreżentaw il-merkanzija? Mark: Fl-uffiċċju doganali tal-preżentazzjoni. L-indirizz qiegħed f'dan id-dokument.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where are we going to present the goods? Mark: At the customs office of presentation. The address is in this document.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们要在哪里呈验货物？Mark：在货物呈验地海关。地址就在这份文件里。

messages.speaker: Sara (货运职员)
messages.zh: 我们要在哪里呈验货物？
messages.en: Where are we going to present the goods?

messages.speaker: Mark (货运同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-uffiċċju doganali tal-preżentazzjoni. L-indirizz qiegħed f'dan id-dokument.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-uffiċċju doganali tal-preżentazzjoni. L-indirizz qiegħed f'dan id-dokument.
messages.zh: 在货物呈验地海关。地址就在这份文件里。
messages.en: At the customs office of presentation. The address is in this document.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想“把货物呈到海关面前”的场景：这个短语回答“在哪里呈验货物”，用呈验地点来记住整个词条。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A customs office responsible for customs procedures where goods leave a customs territory.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在货物离开关税领土的地点负责相关海关手续的海关办事处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uffiċċju tad-dwana responsabbli għall-proċeduri doganali fil-post minn fejn merkanzija toħroġ minn territorju doganali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 货物离开关税领土时，在出境地点负责相关手续的海关办事处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Uffiċċju tad-dwana li jieħu ħsieb il-proċeduri doganali marbuta mal-ħruġ tal-merkanzija minn territorju doganali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A customs office of exit is an office that handles customs procedures at the point where goods leave a customs territory.

collocations.en: contact the customs office of exit

collocations.mt: tivverifika l-ħinijiet tal-ftuħ tal-uffiċċju doganali tal-ħruġ
collocations.en: check the opening hours of the customs office of exit
collocations.zh: 查询出境海关办事处的办公时间

formal.mt: Qabel it-tluq, it-trasportatur ikkuntattja l-uffiċċju doganali tal-ħruġ fil-port biex jivverifika l-ħinijiet tal-ftuħ.
formal.en: Before departure, the carrier contacted the customs office of exit at the port to check its opening hours.
formal.zh: 出发前，承运人联系了港口的出境海关办事处，查询其办公时间。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Il-merkanzija se toħroġ mit-territorju doganali minn dan il-port. Fejn hu l-uffiċċju doganali tal-ħruġ? Marija: Qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb prinċipali. Tista' tistaqsi hemm dwar il-proċeduri.
colloquial.en: Toni: The goods will leave the customs territory through this port. Where is the customs office of exit? Marija: It is next to the main gate. You can ask about the procedures there.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：货物将从这个港口离开该关税领土。出境海关办事处在哪里？玛丽亚：就在大门旁边。你可以到那里咨询手续。

messages.speaker: Toni (货车司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-merkanzija se toħroġ mit-territorju doganali minn dan il-port. Fejn hu l-uffiċċju doganali tal-ħruġ?
messages.mt_standard: Il-merkanzija se toħroġ mit-territorju doganali minn dan il-port. Fejn hu l-uffiċċju doganali tal-ħruġ?
messages.zh: 货物将从这个港口离开该关税领土。出境海关办事处在哪里？
messages.en: The goods will leave the customs territory through this port. Where is the customs office of exit?

messages.speaker: Marija (港口工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb prinċipali. Tista' tistaqsi hemm dwar il-proċeduri.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb prinċipali. Tista' tistaqsi hemm dwar il-proċeduri.
messages.zh: 就在大门旁边。你可以到那里咨询手续。
messages.en: It is next to the main gate. You can ask about the procedures there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象货物沿着向外的箭头离境：tal-ħruġ 提醒“离开、出境”。与“出口业务”搭配比较，记住本词组聚焦货物离境地点的海关办事处。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A customs office responsible for supervising customs-related activities or procedures.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责监督海关相关活动或程序执行情况的海关办公室。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uffiċċju tad-dwana responsabbli mis-superviżjoni ta' attivitajiet jew proċeduri doganali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对海关相关活动或程序承担监督职责的海关办公室。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Uffiċċju tad-dwana li jissorvelja t-twettiq ta' attivitajiet jew proċeduri doganali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A supervising customs office is a customs office that oversees the conduct of customs-related activities or procedures.

collocations.en: the instructions of the supervising customs office
collocations.zh: 监管海关办公室的指示

collocations.en: request clarification from the supervising customs office
collocations.zh: 请求监管海关办公室作出说明

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija talbet kjarifika mill-uffiċċju doganali tas-sorveljanza dwar il-proċedura li kellha ssegwi.
formal.en: The company requested clarification from the supervising customs office about the procedure it needed to follow.
formal.zh: 公司请求监管海关办公室说明其需要遵循的程序。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dawn l-istruzzjonijiet minn fejn ġew? Ġorġ: Mill-uffiċċju doganali tas-sorveljanza. Ejja naqrawhom flimkien.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where did these instructions come from? Ġorġ: From the supervising customs office. Let's read them together.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这些指示是哪里发来的？Ġorġ：监管海关办公室发来的。我们一起读一下吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (进出口职员)
messages.zh: 这些指示是哪里发来的？
messages.en: Where did these instructions come from?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (进出口同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mill-uffiċċju doganali tas-sorveljanza. Ejja naqrawhom flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Mill-uffiċċju doganali tas-sorveljanza. Ejja naqrawhom flimkien.
messages.zh: 监管海关办公室发来的。我们一起读一下吧。
messages.en: From the supervising customs office. Let's read them together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把短语放进“监管办公室发来程序指示”的小故事里，用“监督执行、提供指示”的场景记住这里的监管职责。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A customs office where a customs transit operation begins.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 海关转运程序开始时所对应的海关办公室，即启运地海关。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uffiċċju tad-dwana fejn tibda operazzjoni ta' tranżitu doganali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 办理海关转运程序起始环节的海关办公室，即启运地海关。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Uffiċċju tad-dwana li jkun il-punt tal-bidu ta' operazzjoni ta' tranżitu doganali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The customs office of departure is the customs office at which a customs transit operation starts.

collocations.en: the code of the customs office of departure
specify the customs office of departure

formal.mt: Id-dikjarazzjoni tindika l-uffiċċju doganali tat-tluq fejn se tibda l-operazzjoni ta' tranżitu.
formal.en: The declaration specifies the customs office of departure where the transit operation will begin.
formal.zh: 申报单注明了转运程序开始的启运地海关。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Liema kodiċi rrid nikteb hawn? David: Il-kodiċi tal-uffiċċju doganali tat-tluq. Issibu fid-dokument tat-tranżitu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Which code should I write here? David: The code of the customs office of departure. You'll find it in the transit document.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这里应该填哪个代码？David：填启运地海关的代码。你可以在转运文件里找到。

messages.speaker: Nina (报关职员)
messages.zh: 这里应该填哪个代码？
messages.en: Which code should I write here?

messages.speaker: David (报关同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kodiċi tal-uffiċċju doganali tat-tluq. Issibu fid-dokument tat-tranżitu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kodiċi tal-uffiċċju doganali tat-tluq. Issibu fid-dokument tat-tranżitu.
messages.zh: 填启运地海关的代码。你可以在转运文件里找到。
messages.en: The code of the customs office of departure. You'll find it in the transit document.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条货物转运路线，在起点画海关办公室并标上整个短语；用“转运从这里开始”的画面记住启运地海关。

gloss_zh: 办理货物纳入海关程序的海关办事处

teaching_sense.en_definition: A customs office where goods are placed under a customs procedure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 办理将货物纳入某项海关程序的手续的海关办事处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uffiċċju doganali fejn isiru l-formalitajiet biex il-merkanzija titqiegħed taħt proċedura doganali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 办理将货物纳入海关程序的手续的海关办事处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Uffiċċju doganali fejn jiġu ttrattati l-formalitajiet għat-tqegħid tal-merkanzija taħt proċedura doganali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A customs office of placement is an office where the formalities for placing goods under a customs procedure are handled.

collocations.en: submit the documents to the customs office of placement
collocations.zh: 向办理货物纳入海关程序的海关办事处提交文件

collocations.en: contact the customs office of placement
collocations.zh: 联系办理货物纳入海关程序的海关办事处

formal.mt: L-importatur ikkuntattja l-uffiċċju doganali tat-tqegħid biex jistaqsi liema dokumenti kellu jippreżenta.
formal.en: The importer contacted the customs office of placement to ask which documents he needed to submit.
formal.zh: 进口商联系了办理货物纳入海关程序的海关办事处，询问需要提交哪些文件。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Lil min nibgħat dawn id-dokumenti? Marija: Ibgħathom lill-uffiċċju doganali tat-tqegħid. Mark: Tajjeb, nibgħathom illum.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who should I send these documents to? Marija: Send them to the customs office of placement. Mark: All right, I'll send them today.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这些文件该发给谁？玛丽亚：发给办理货物纳入海关程序的海关办事处。马克：好的，我今天就发。

messages.speaker: Mark (进口商)
messages.zh: 这些文件该发给谁？
messages.en: Who should I send these documents to?

messages.speaker: Marija (报关员)
messages.zh: 发给办理货物纳入海关程序的海关办事处。
messages.en: Send them to the customs office of placement.

messages.speaker: Mark (进口商)
messages.zh: 好的，我今天就发。
messages.en: All right, I'll send them today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个长词组配上“货物进入海关程序”的画面：先记海关办事处，再记它办理的是纳入程序的手续。

gloss_zh: 办理货物纳入海关程序手续的海关办事处

teaching_sense.en_definition: A customs office responsible for the formalities of placing goods under a customs procedure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责办理将货物置于某项海关程序之下的相关手续的海关办事处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uffiċċju doganali responsabbli għall-formalitajiet meħtieġa biex il-merkanzija titqiegħed taħt proċedura doganali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 负责办理将货物纳入某项海关程序的手续的海关办事处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Uffiċċju doganali li jittratta l-formalitajiet tat-tqegħid tal-merkanzija taħt proċedura doganali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A customs office of placement handles the formalities through which goods are placed under a particular customs procedure.

collocations.mt: l-indirizz tal-uffiċċju doganali tat-tqegħid taħt proċedura
collocations.en: the address of the customs office of placement
collocations.zh: 办理货物纳入海关程序手续的海关办事处的地址

collocations.mt: jippreżenta dikjarazzjoni fl-uffiċċju doganali tat-tqegħid taħt proċedura
collocations.en: submit a declaration at the customs office of placement
collocations.zh: 在办理货物纳入海关程序手续的海关办事处提交申报单

formal.mt: Qabel ma ppreżentat id-dikjarazzjoni, il-kumpanija kkonfermat l-indirizz tal-uffiċċju doganali tat-tqegħid taħt proċedura.
formal.en: Before submitting the declaration, the company confirmed the address of the customs office of placement.
formal.zh: 提交申报单之前，公司确认了办理货物纳入海关程序手续的海关办事处的地址。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandek l-indirizz tal-uffiċċju doganali tat-tqegħid taħt proċedura? Pawlu: Iva, qiegħed fuq din l-ittra. Sara: Sewwa, se niċċekkjah qabel nitlaq.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you have the address of the customs office of placement? Pawlu: Yes, it's on this letter. Sara: Good, I'll check it before I leave.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你有办理货物纳入海关程序手续的海关办事处的地址吗？保罗：有，就在这封信上。萨拉：好，我出发前核对一下。

messages.speaker: Sara (进口商)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek l-indirizz tal-uffiċċju doganali tat-tqegħid taħt proċedura?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek l-indirizz tal-uffiċċju doganali tat-tqegħid taħt proċedura?
messages.zh: 你有办理货物纳入海关程序手续的海关办事处的地址吗？
messages.en: Do you have the address of the customs office of placement?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 有，就在这封信上。
messages.en: Yes, it's on this letter.

messages.speaker: Sara (进口商)
messages.zh: 好，我出发前核对一下。
messages.en: Good, I'll check it before I leave.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分成“海关办事处”和“纳入某项程序”两块记忆；把货物放进标有“海关程序”的文件夹，帮助记住整个词组的用途。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A customs office that handles customs formalities for goods in transit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 办理过境货物相关海关手续的海关办事处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uffiċċju doganali li jittratta l-formalitajiet doganali relatati ma' merkanzija fi tranżitu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 办理货物过境相关手续的海关办事处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Uffiċċju doganali fejn jiġu ttrattati formalitajiet marbuta mal-mogħdija ta' merkanzija fi tranżitu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A customs office of transit is an office that handles customs formalities relating to goods passing through in transit.

collocations.en: present the documents at the customs office of transit
collocations.zh: 在过境海关办事处出示文件

collocations.en: the opening hours of the customs office of transit
collocations.zh: 过境海关办事处的办公时间

formal.mt: Is-sewwieq ippreżenta d-dokumenti fl-uffiċċju doganali tat-tranżitu qabel kompla bil-vjaġġ.
formal.en: The driver presented the documents at the customs office of transit before continuing his journey.
formal.zh: 司机在过境海关办事处出示文件后，继续行程。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn se tieqaf issa? Ġużepp: Fl-uffiċċju doganali tat-tranżitu, biex nippreżenta d-dokumenti. Lara: Tajjeb, ċempilli meta tkun lest.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where are you stopping now? Ġużepp: At the customs office of transit, to present the documents. Lara: All right, call me when you're finished.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你现在要在哪里停一下？朱塞佩：去过境海关办事处，出示文件。拉拉：好的，办完给我打电话。

messages.speaker: Lara (运输调度员)
messages.zh: 你现在要在哪里停一下？
messages.en: Where are you stopping now?

messages.speaker: Ġużepp (货车司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-uffiċċju doganali tat-tranżitu, biex nippreżenta d-dokumenti.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-uffiċċju doganali tat-tranżitu, biex nippreżenta d-dokumenti.
messages.zh: 去过境海关办事处，出示文件。
messages.en: At the customs office of transit, to present the documents.

messages.speaker: Lara (运输调度员)
messages.zh: 好的，办完给我打电话。
messages.en: All right, call me when you're finished.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tranżitu 与英语 transit 配对记忆，再想象货车途中到海关递交文件，整组就记成“过境海关办事处”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An office where people buy tickets or obtain information about them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出售票券并提供相关咨询的办公或服务场所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uffiċċju fejn in-nies jixtru l-biljetti jew jiksbu informazzjoni dwarhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出售票券的办事处或服务窗口；售票处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Uffiċċju fejn jinbiegħu l-biljetti għat-trasport, għal avvenimenti jew għal dħul f'postijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A ticket office is a place where you can buy tickets for journeys, events, or admission.

collocations.en: the queue outside the ticket office

formal.mt: Il-passiġġieri jistgħu jixtru l-biljetti mill-uffiċċju tal-biljetti qabel il-vjaġġ.
formal.en: Passengers can buy their tickets from the ticket office before their journey.
formal.zh: 乘客可以在出发前到售票处购票。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-uffiċċju tal-biljetti? Pawlu: Ħdejn id-daħla. Ejja nixtru l-biljetti qabel jitwal il-kju.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the ticket office? Pawlu: Next to the entrance. Let's buy the tickets before the queue gets longer.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：售票处在哪里？保罗：在入口旁边。趁队伍还没变长，我们去买票吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (旅客)
messages.zh: 售票处在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the ticket office?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn id-daħla. Ejja nixtru l-biljetti qabel jitwal il-kju.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn id-daħla. Ejja nixtru l-biljetti qabel jitwal il-kju.
messages.zh: 在入口旁边。趁队伍还没变长，我们去买票吧。
messages.en: Next to the entrance. Let's buy the tickets before the queue gets longer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语和“排队买票的窗口”画面绑定：看到 biljetti 就联想到票，再把 uffiċċju tal-biljetti 整体记成售票处。

gloss_zh: 担保事务处；海关担保办事处

teaching_sense.en_definition: An office responsible for handling guarantees, including guarantees connected with customs procedures.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责办理担保事务的办事处，也可专指办理海关担保事务的机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uffiċċju responsabbli minn kwistjonijiet ta' garanzija, inklużi garanziji marbuta ma' proċeduri doganali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 负责办理海关程序中担保事务的海关办事处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Uffiċċju doganali responsabbli minn kwistjonijiet ta' garanzija marbuta ma' proċeduri doganali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A customs office of guarantee is a customs office that handles guarantees connected with customs procedures.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 负责办理或管理担保事务的办事处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Uffiċċju responsabbli mill-immaniġġjar ta' garanziji u mid-dokumenti relatati magħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An office of guarantee is an office responsible for dealing with guarantees and related administrative matters.

collocations.en: the documents for the office of guarantee
collocations.zh: 提交给担保事务处的文件

collocations.en: to contact the office of guarantee

formal.mt: Għal informazzjoni dwar il-garanzija marbuta mal-proċedura doganali, jekk jogħġbok ikkuntattja l-uffiċċju tal-garanzija.
formal.en: For information about the guarantee connected with the customs procedure, please contact the customs office of guarantee.
formal.zh: 如需了解与该海关程序有关的担保信息，请联系海关担保办事处。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Lil min nista' nistaqsi dwar din il-garanzija? Rita: Ikkuntattja l-uffiċċju tal-garanzija u staqsi liema dokumenti għandek bżonn.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who can I ask about this guarantee? Rita: Contact the office of guarantee and ask which documents you need.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这项担保的事可以问谁？丽塔：联系担保事务处，问问你需要哪些文件。

messages.speaker: Mark (申请人)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil min nista' nistaqsi dwar din il-garanzija?
messages.mt_standard: Lil min nista' nistaqsi dwar din il-garanzija?
messages.zh: 这项担保的事可以问谁？
messages.en: Who can I ask about this guarantee?

messages.speaker: Rita (办事人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ikkuntattja l-uffiċċju tal-garanzija u staqsi liema dokumenti għandek bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Ikkuntattja l-uffiċċju tal-garanzija u staqsi liema dokumenti għandek bżonn.
messages.zh: 联系担保事务处，问问你需要哪些文件。
messages.en: Contact the office of guarantee and ask which documents you need.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“拿着担保文件去办事处”的画面记整个短语；语境出现海关程序时，再把它具体理解为海关担保办事处。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An office that provides visitors with information about a place and its tourist attractions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向游客提供当地景点、游览及其他旅游信息的服务机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uffiċċju li jipprovdi lit-turisti informazzjoni dwar post, l-attrazzjonijiet tiegħu u s-servizzi għaż-żjarat tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为游客提供当地旅游信息和咨询服务的办事处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Uffiċċju fejn it-turisti jistgħu jiksbu informazzjoni dwar attrazzjonijiet, attivitajiet u servizzi fil-post li jkunu qed iżuru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tourist office is a place where visitors can obtain information about local attractions, activities, and services.

collocations.en: to ask the tourist office for information
collocations.zh: 向旅游咨询处询问信息

collocations.en: to get a map from the tourist office
collocations.zh: 到旅游咨询处领取地图

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi jistgħu jiksbu mapep u informazzjoni dwar il-mużewijiet mill-uffiċċju tat-turiżmu.
formal.en: Visitors can obtain maps and information about the museums from the tourist office.
formal.zh: 游客可以到旅游咨询处领取地图，并了解博物馆的相关信息。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Minn fejn nistgħu nieħdu mappa tal-belt? David: Mill-uffiċċju tat-turiżmu fil-pjazza. Nistgħu nistaqsu wkoll dwar il-mużewijiet.
colloquial.en: Lina: Where can we get a map of the city? David: From the tourist office in the square. We can also ask about the museums.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：我们可以去哪里领一张城市地图？戴维：去广场上的旅游咨询处。我们还可以问问博物馆的情况。

messages.speaker: Lina (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn nistgħu nieħdu mappa tal-belt?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn nistgħu nieħdu mappa tal-belt?
messages.zh: 我们可以去哪里领一张城市地图？
messages.en: Where can we get a map of the city?

messages.speaker: David (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mill-uffiċċju tat-turiżmu fil-pjazza. Nistgħu nistaqsu wkoll dwar il-mużewijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Mill-uffiċċju tat-turiżmu fil-pjazza. Nistgħu nistaqsu wkoll dwar il-mużewijiet.
messages.zh: 去广场上的旅游咨询处。我们还可以问问博物馆的情况。
messages.en: From the tourist office in the square. We can also ask about the museums.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 turiżmu 与旅游场景相连，再想象游客走进 uffiċċju tat-turiżmu，拿地图、问景点，整体记成旅游咨询处。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A designated office serving as a single contact point for communication and cooperation between organizations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为统一联系窗口，负责机构之间沟通与合作的指定办事处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uffiċċju magħżul biex iservi bħala punt uniku ta' kuntatt għall-komunikazzjoni u l-kooperazzjoni bejn organizzazzjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 统一负责有关各方沟通与协调的单一联络办事处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Uffiċċju li jservi bħala l-punt uniku ta' kuntatt biex jiffaċilita l-komunikazzjoni u l-kooperazzjoni bejn il-partijiet ikkonċernati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A single liaison office is a designated office through which the parties involved communicate and coordinate their cooperation.

collocations.en: to establish a single liaison office

collocations.mt: tgħaddi talba lill-uffiċċju uniku ta' kooperazzjoni
collocations.en: to forward a request to the single liaison office
collocations.zh: 向单一联络处转交请求

formal.mt: L-organizzazzjonijiet parteċipanti se jistabbilixxu uffiċċju uniku ta' kooperazzjoni biex jiffaċilitaw il-komunikazzjoni bejniethom.
formal.en: The participating organizations will establish a single liaison office to facilitate communication between them.
formal.zh: 参与机构将设立单一联络处，以促进彼此之间的沟通。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Lil min nibgħat din it-talba dwar il-kooperazzjoni? Daniel: Ibgħatha lill-uffiċċju uniku ta' kooperazzjoni. Huma jgħidulek x'għandek tagħmel wara.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who should I send this cooperation request to? Daniel: Send it to the single liaison office. They will tell you what to do next.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这份合作请求应该发给谁？丹尼尔：发给单一联络处。他们会告诉你下一步该怎么做。

messages.speaker: Sara (项目助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil min nibgħat din it-talba dwar il-kooperazzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Lil min nibgħat din it-talba dwar il-kooperazzjoni?
messages.zh: 这份合作请求应该发给谁？
messages.en: Who should I send this cooperation request to?

messages.speaker: Daniel (项目协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ibgħatha lill-uffiċċju uniku ta' kooperazzjoni. Huma jgħidulek x'għandek tagħmel wara.
messages.mt_standard: Ibgħatha lill-uffiċċju uniku ta' kooperazzjoni. Huma jgħidulek x'għandek tagħmel wara.
messages.zh: 发给单一联络处。他们会告诉你下一步该怎么做。
messages.en: Send it to the single liaison office. They will tell you what to do next.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“多家机构、一个联系窗口”的画面记忆：uniku 提醒你只有一个统一窗口，整个短语记成负责合作沟通的单一联络处。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The upper part of the leg, between the hip and the knee.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 腿部从髋部到膝盖之间的部分，即大腿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti ta' fuq tar-riġel, bejn il-ġenbejn u l-irkoppa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大腿；髋部与膝盖之间的腿部。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-parti tar-riġel li tinsab bejn il-ġenbejn u l-irkoppa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your thigh is the upper part of your leg, between your hip and your knee.

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni tal-anatomija, l-għalliem spjega fejn jinsab l-uirċ u kif il-muskoli tiegħu jgħinu fil-mixi.
formal.en: During the anatomy lesson, the teacher explained where the thigh is and how its muscles help with walking.
formal.zh: 在解剖课上，老师讲解了大腿的位置，以及大腿肌肉如何帮助行走。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn qed tħoss l-uġigħ? Mark: Fl-uirċ, eżatt fuq l-irkoppa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where do you feel the pain? Mark: In my thigh, just above the knee.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你哪里疼？马克：大腿，就在膝盖上方。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哪里疼？
messages.en: Where do you feel the pain?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 大腿，就在膝盖上方。
messages.en: In my thigh, just above the knee.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 uirċ 写在人体图的大腿处，沿髋部到膝盖画线，记住它指整段大腿。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The children of the male person being referred to.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所指男性的孩子们或子女；整个词表达“他的子女”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tfal tiegħu, jiġifieri t-tfal tal-persuna maskili li tkun qed tissemma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 子女；此词具体指“他的孩子们”，不限定子女的性别。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tfal tiegħu, kemm subien kif ukoll bniet, irrispettivament minn jekk ikunux għadhom żgħar jew diġà adulti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone's children are their sons or daughters, and this form refers specifically to his children.

formal.mt: Fl-intervista, il-missier spjega kif iqassam il-ħin tiegħu bejn ix-xogħol u l-kura ta' wliedu.
formal.en: In the interview, the father explained how he divides his time between work and caring for his children.
formal.zh: 在采访中，这位父亲解释了自己如何在工作和照顾子女之间分配时间。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ġużeppi ġej għall-piknik? Nina: Iva, u uliedu ġejjin miegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is Ġużeppi coming to the picnic? Nina: Yes, and his children are coming with him.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：朱塞佩来参加野餐吗？妮娜：来，他的孩子们也和他一起来。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 朱塞佩来参加野餐吗？
messages.en: Is Ġużeppi coming to the picnic?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 来，他的孩子们也和他一起来。
messages.en: Yes, and his children are coming with him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 uliedu 整体记作“他的子女”：想象一位父亲带着几个孩子，既记住复数，也记住所属关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A final demand that threatens a consequence if it is not obeyed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 附带不遵从便会承担某种后果的最终要求，即最后通牒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Talba finali li magħha jkun hemm theddida ta' konsegwenza jekk ma tiġix aċċettata jew imwettqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 最后通牒；要求对方接受或执行，否则将采取某种行动的最终要求。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Talba jew kundizzjoni finali li persuna jew grupp jippreżenta lil ħaddieħor, bi twissija dwar x'se jiġri jekk ma tiġix osservata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone gives you an ultimatum, they make a final demand and threaten a consequence if you refuse.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ta ultimatum lill-kuntrattur: ix-xogħol kellu jitlesta sa nhar il-Ġimgħa, inkella l-kuntratt kien se jiġi tterminat.
formal.en: The committee gave the contractor an ultimatum: the work had to be completed by Friday, or the contract would be terminated.
formal.zh: 委员会向承包商发出最后通牒：工程必须在星期五之前完成，否则将终止合同。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tajt lil ħija ultimatum: jew ibaxxi l-ħoss jew nitfi t-televixin. Maja: U baxxa l-ħoss?
colloquial.en: Mark: I gave my brother an ultimatum: either he turns the volume down or I turn the television off. Maja: And did he turn it down?
colloquial.zh: 马克：我给我兄弟下了最后通牒：要么把音量调低，要么我关电视。玛雅：那他调低了吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajt lil ħija ultimatum: jew ibaxxi l-ħoss jew nitfi t-televixin.
messages.mt_standard: Tajt lil ħija ultimatum: jew ibaxxi l-ħoss jew nitfi t-televixin.
messages.zh: 我给我兄弟下了最后通牒：要么把音量调低，要么我关电视。
messages.en: I gave my brother an ultimatum: either he turns the volume down or I turn the television off.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那他调低了吗？
messages.en: And did he turn it down?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“最终要求加拒绝后果”记 ultimatum，脑中配一句“要么照办，否则就采取行动”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An open sore on the skin or on a lining inside the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发生在皮肤或体内黏膜表面的开放性破损，即溃疡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ferita miftuħa fil-ġilda jew fil-membrana li tiksi parti minn ġewwa tal-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 溃疡；皮肤或黏膜表面形成的开放性病损。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ferita miftuħa li tifforma fuq il-ġilda jew fuq membrana ġewwa l-ġisem, bħal dik tal-istonku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An ulcer is an open sore that forms on your skin or on a lining inside your body.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport mediku jiddeskrivi d-daqs u l-post tal-ulċera li nstabet waqt l-eżami.
formal.en: The medical report describes the size and location of the ulcer found during the examination.
formal.zh: 医疗报告描述了检查中发现的溃疡的大小和位置。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tiekol bil-mod? Pawlu: Għandi ulċera fil-ħalq u tweġġagħni meta niekol.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you eating slowly? Pawlu: I have a mouth ulcer, and it hurts when I eat.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你怎么吃得这么慢？保罗：我有口腔溃疡，吃东西时会疼。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么吃得这么慢？
messages.en: Why are you eating slowly?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi ulċera fil-ħalq u tweġġagħni meta niekol.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi ulċera fil-ħalq u tweġġagħni meta niekol.
messages.zh: 我有口腔溃疡，吃东西时会疼。
messages.en: I have a mouth ulcer, and it hurts when I eat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ulċera 与“表面破损形成溃疡”配对，再用胃和口腔两个位置帮助记忆。

gloss_zh: 湿度；空气中的水汽含量

teaching_sense.en_definition: The amount of water vapour present in the air.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 空气中所含水蒸气的多少，即空气的潮湿程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwantità ta' fwar tal-ilma li jkun hemm fl-arja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 湿度，指空气中水蒸气的含量。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-umdità hija l-kwantità ta' fwar tal-ilma li jkun hemm fl-arja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Humidity is the amount of water vapour in the air, which affects how damp the air feels.

formal.mt: L-umdità għolja fil-kamra tista' tagħmel ħsara lill-kotba, għalhekk huwa importanti li jitkejjel il-livell ta' umdità regolarment.
formal.en: High humidity in the room can damage the books, so it is important to measure the humidity level regularly.
formal.zh: 房间内湿度过高可能损坏书籍，因此定期测量湿度很重要。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-ħwejjeġ għadhom imxarrbin? Karl: Illum l-umdità għolja ħafna, u għalhekk qed idumu biex jinxfu. Maja: Mela ndaħħalhom ġewwa u nixgħel id-dehumidifier.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are the clothes still wet? Karl: The humidity is very high today, so they are taking a long time to dry. Maja: Then I'll bring them inside and turn on the dehumidifier.
colloquial.zh: Maja：衣服怎么还湿着？Karl：今天湿度很高，所以干得慢。Maja：那我把衣服收进来，打开除湿机。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 衣服怎么还湿着？
messages.en: Why are the clothes still wet?

messages.speaker: Karl (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum l-umdità għolja ħafna, u għalhekk qed idumu biex jinxfu.
messages.mt_standard: Illum l-umdità għolja ħafna, u għalhekk qed idumu biex jinxfu.
messages.zh: 今天湿度很高，所以干得慢。
messages.en: The humidity is very high today, so they are taking a long time to dry.

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ndaħħalhom ġewwa u nixgħel id-dehumidifier.
messages.mt_standard: Mela ndaħħalhom ġewwa u nixgħel id-dehumidifier.
messages.zh: 那我把衣服收进来，打开除湿机。
messages.en: Then I'll bring them inside and turn on the dehumidifier.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 umdità 和“晾了一天还没干的衣服”联系起来记：空气中水汽多，就是湿度高。成对记忆 umdità għolja（高湿度）和 umdità baxxa（低湿度）。

gloss_zh: 令人受辱的；令人难堪的；可耻的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing someone to feel humiliated, embarrassed, or ashamed, or deserving shame because of unacceptable behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容使人感到受辱、难堪或羞愧的事情，也可形容因行为不当而可耻的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħossu umiljat, imbarazzat jew mistħi, jew li jġib mistħija minħabba mġiba ħażina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人受辱的；使人感到尊严受损或被贬低的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħossu mċekken jew li tilef id-dinjità tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An experience is humiliating if it makes someone feel degraded or causes them to lose their sense of dignity.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人尴尬或难堪的；使人在他人面前感到不自在的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħossu skomdu jew imbarazzat, speċjalment quddiem nies oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A situation is embarrassing if it makes someone feel awkward or uncomfortable, especially in front of other people.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可耻的；因行为错误或不可接受而应受到谴责的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jistħoqqlu kundanna u jġib mistħija għax jinvolvi mġiba ħażina jew inaċċettabbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Behaviour is shameful if it is so wrong or unacceptable that it deserves strong disapproval.

collocations.zh: 令人难堪或受辱的经历

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-trattament umlijanti li rċevew il-ħaddiema meta ġew insultati quddiem il-kollegi tagħhom.
formal.en: The report describes the humiliating treatment the workers received when they were insulted in front of their colleagues.
formal.zh: 报告描述了工人在同事面前遭到辱骂时所受到的有辱尊严的对待。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif marret il-laqgħa? Mark: Kienet esperjenza umlijanti. Il-kap daħak bija quddiem kulħadd għax għamilt żball. Lara: Ma kienx sew li jittrattak hekk. Żball jista' jagħmlu kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did the meeting go? Mark: It was a humiliating experience. The boss laughed at me in front of everyone because I made a mistake. Lara: It was wrong of him to treat you like that. Anyone can make a mistake.
colloquial.zh: Lara：会议开得怎么样？Mark：那是一次令人受辱的经历。因为我犯了个错，老板当着所有人的面嘲笑我。Lara：他那样对你是不对的。谁都会犯错。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 会议开得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the meeting go?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kienet esperjenza umlijanti. Il-kap daħak bija quddiem kulħadd għax għamilt żball.
messages.mt_standard: Kienet esperjenza umlijanti. Il-kap daħak bija quddiem kulħadd għax għamilt żball.
messages.zh: 那是一次令人受辱的经历。因为我犯了个错，老板当着所有人的面嘲笑我。
messages.en: It was a humiliating experience. The boss laughed at me in front of everyone because I made a mistake.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma kienx sew li jittrattak hekk. Żball jista' jagħmlu kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Ma kienx sew li jittrattak hekk. Żball jista' jagħmlu kulħadd.
messages.zh: 他那样对你是不对的。谁都会犯错。
messages.en: It was wrong of him to treat you like that. Anyone can make a mistake.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个画面记 umlijanti 的义项：被当众贬低对应“受辱”，说错话后不自在对应“难堪”，欺负弱者受到谴责对应“可耻”。判断时留意句子是在描述人的感受，还是评价行为。

gloss_zh: 幽默的；诙谐的；逗人发笑的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Humorous or amusing in a way that makes people laugh.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有幽默感或诙谐意味、能够逗人发笑的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ħjiel ta' umoriżmu u jqanqal it-tbissima jew id-daħk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 幽默有趣、令人发笑的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lin-nies jitbissmu jew jidħku minħabba l-umoriżmu tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is humorous makes people smile or laugh because it is amusing.

formal.mt: L-awtur juża stil umoristiku biex jiddeskrivi l-problemi tal-ħajja ta' kuljum.
formal.en: The author uses a humorous style to describe the problems of everyday life.
formal.zh: 作者以诙谐的风格描写日常生活中的问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tidħaq? Mark: Qrajt kumment umoristiku taħt ir-ritratt tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you laughing? Mark: I read a funny comment under your photo.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么在笑？马克：我读到了你照片下面的一条幽默评论。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么在笑？
messages.en: Why are you laughing?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qrajt kumment umoristiku taħt ir-ritratt tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Qrajt kumment umoristiku taħt ir-ritratt tiegħek.
messages.zh: 我读到了你照片下面的一条幽默评论。
messages.en: I read a funny comment under your photo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友读完一条评论后笑出声，把整个短语 kumment umoristiku 与“幽默评论”一起记住；这里强调逗人发笑。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a way that was not expected or anticipated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以事先没有预料到的方式；出乎意料地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li ħadd ma kien qed jistenna jew ibassar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出乎预料地；在事先没有预料到的情况下。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bla mistenni, jiġifieri b'mod li ma kienx previst jew mistenni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something happens unexpectedly, it happens when you did not think it would.

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa ntemmet bla mistenni minħabba qtugħ tad-dawl.
formal.en: The meeting ended unexpectedly because of a power cut.
formal.zh: 会议因停电而意外结束。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex wasalt daqshekk kmieni? Pawlu: Il-laqgħa spiċċat bla mistenni, u stajt nitlaq kmieni.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you arrive so early? Pawlu: The meeting ended unexpectedly, so I was able to leave early.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你怎么这么早就到了？保罗：会议意外提前结束了，所以我能早点离开。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么这么早就到了？
messages.en: Why did you arrive so early?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-laqgħa spiċċat bla mistenni, u stajt nitlaq kmieni.
messages.mt_standard: Il-laqgħa spiċċat bla mistenni, u stajt nitlaq kmieni.
messages.zh: 会议意外提前结束了，所以我能早点离开。
messages.en: The meeting ended unexpectedly, so I was able to leave early.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 unexpectedly 与马耳他语 bla mistenni 配对记忆：想象原定继续的会议忽然结束，大家都没料到；重点记住“出乎预料”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Combined or organized into one coherent system or whole.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 原本分开的部分经过整合，形成同一套体系或一个协调的整体的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih partijiet li qabel kienu separati nġabru jew ġew organizzati f'sistema waħda jew f'ħaġa waħda sħiħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 统一的；由分开的部分整合成同一体系或整体的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jgħaqqad partijiet differenti f'ħaġa waħda sħiħa jew jorganizzahom skont sistema waħda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is unified has had its separate parts brought together into one coherent whole.

formal.mt: L-istituzzjonijiet adottaw qafas unifikat biex japplikaw l-istess kriterji għall-applikazzjonijiet kollha.
formal.en: The institutions adopted a unified framework to apply the same criteria to all applications.
formal.zh: 各机构采用了统一的框架，以便对所有申请使用相同的标准。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad għandna tliet listi differenti? Mark: Le, issa għandna dokument unifikat bl-informazzjoni kollha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do we still have three different lists? Mark: No, we now have a unified document containing all the information.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们还有三份不同的清单吗？马克：没有了，现在我们有一份整合了全部信息的统一文档。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 我们还有三份不同的清单吗？
messages.en: Do we still have three different lists?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, issa għandna dokument unifikat bl-informazzjoni kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Le, issa għandna dokument unifikat bl-informazzjoni kollha.
messages.zh: 没有了，现在我们有一份整合了全部信息的统一文档。
messages.en: No, we now have a unified document containing all the information.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三份清单合成一份统一文档的画面记在脑中：unifikat 强调整合后成为同一个整体。搭配记忆：qafas unifikat，统一框架。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Joined together and acting in agreement or toward a shared purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 彼此团结、保持一致，并为共同目标采取行动的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun magħqud u jaġixxi bi qbil jew jaħdem flimkien għal għan komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 团结一致的；联合起来并共同采取行动的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun magħqud ma' oħrajn u jaqsam magħhom pożizzjoni jew għan komuni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: People who are united agree with one another and work together for a shared purpose.

formal.mt: Tim unit jista' jiffaċċja d-diffikultajiet b'aktar fiduċja u jkompli jaħdem lejn għan komuni.
formal.en: A united team can face difficulties with greater confidence and continue working toward a shared goal.
formal.zh: 团结一致的团队能够更有信心地面对困难，并继续为共同目标努力。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Wara dik it-telfa, it-tim għadu unit? Pawlu: Iva, kulħadd għadu jgħin lil xulxin fit-taħriġ.
colloquial.en: Lara: After that defeat, is the team still united? Pawlu: Yes, everyone is still helping one another in training.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：输掉那场比赛后，球队还团结吗？保罗：是的，训练时大家仍然互相帮助。

messages.speaker: Lara (球迷朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Wara dik it-telfa, it-tim għadu unit?
messages.mt_standard: Wara dik it-telfa, it-tim għadu unit?
messages.zh: 输掉那场比赛后，球队还团结吗？
messages.en: After that defeat, is the team still united?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (球队队员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kulħadd għadu jgħin lil xulxin fit-taħriġ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kulħadd għadu jgħin lil xulxin fit-taħriġ.
messages.zh: 是的，训练时大家仍然互相帮助。
messages.en: Yes, everyone is still helping one another in training.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象球队输球后仍互相帮助：tim unit 就是团结一致的团队。把 unit 与英文 united 对照记忆，注意此处是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An individual unit within a system that requires a supply of a resource or service.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 系统中需要获得某种资源或服务供应、作为一个独立需求实体看待的单元。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Unità f'sistema li teħtieġ provvista ta' riżorsa jew servizz u titqies bħala entità separata min-naħa tad-domanda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 需求单元；系统中产生资源或服务需求的独立单元。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Unità li tirrappreżenta parti mid-domanda għal riżorsa jew servizz f'sistema.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A demand unit is an individual entity whose requirements contribute to the demand within a system.

collocations.en: the consumption of a demand unit
collocations.zh: 一个需求单元的消耗量

collocations.en: the monitoring of a demand unit
collocations.zh: 对一个需求单元的监测

formal.mt: Ir-rapport janalizza l-konsum ta' kull unità tad-domanda biex jgħin fl-ippjanar tal-provvista.
formal.en: The report analyses the consumption of each demand unit to support supply planning.
formal.zh: 报告分析了每个需求单元的消耗量，以辅助供应规划。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din iċ-ċifra turi l-konsum tas-sistema kollha? David: Le, turi biss il-konsum ta' unità tad-domanda waħda.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does this figure show the consumption of the whole system? David: No, it only shows the consumption of one demand unit.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个数字表示整个系统的消耗量吗？戴维：不是，它只表示一个需求单元的消耗量。

messages.speaker: Sara (实习生)
messages.mt_spoken: Din iċ-ċifra turi l-konsum tas-sistema kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Din iċ-ċifra turi l-konsum tas-sistema kollha?
messages.zh: 这个数字表示整个系统的消耗量吗？
messages.en: Does this figure show the consumption of the whole system?

messages.speaker: David (分析员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, turi biss il-konsum ta' unità tad-domanda waħda.
messages.mt_standard: Le, turi biss il-konsum ta' unità tad-domanda waħda.
messages.zh: 不是，它只表示一个需求单元的消耗量。
messages.en: No, it only shows the consumption of one demand unit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在系统图中给一个需要供应的小方框贴上“需求单元”：unità 对应单元，tad-domanda 对应需求的，整组词一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A unit that makes reserve capacity available to a system when it is needed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向系统提供备用容量、在需要时可供调用的单元。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Unità li tagħmel kapaċità ta' riserva disponibbli għal sistema biex tintuża meta jkun hemm bżonnha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 备用容量提供单元；能够为系统提供所需备用容量的单元。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Unità li tista' tipprovdi kapaċità ta' riserva biex tgħin lis-sistema meta tkun meħtieġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A reserve providing unit makes reserve capacity available for a system to use when required.

collocations.en: the capacity of a reserve providing unit
collocations.zh: 一个备用容量提供单元的容量

collocations.en: the availability of a reserve providing unit
collocations.zh: 一个备用容量提供单元的可用性

formal.mt: Qabel ma jitlesta l-pjan, l-operatur għandu jivverifika l-kapaċità u d-disponibbiltà ta' kull unità tal-forniment tar-riservi.
formal.en: Before the plan is completed, the operator should verify the capacity and availability of each reserve providing unit.
formal.zh: 在完成计划之前，操作人员应核实每个备用容量提供单元的容量和可用性。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din l-unità tal-forniment tar-riservi tista' tgħinna llum? Mark: Iva, għadni kemm ikkonfermajt li hija disponibbli.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can this reserve providing unit help us today? Mark: Yes, I have just confirmed that it is available.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个备用容量提供单元今天能帮上忙吗？马克：能，我刚确认过它可以使用。

messages.speaker: Nina (值班协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Din l-unità tal-forniment tar-riservi tista' tgħinna llum?
messages.mt_standard: Din l-unità tal-forniment tar-riservi tista' tgħinna llum?
messages.zh: 这个备用容量提供单元今天能帮上忙吗？
messages.en: Can this reserve providing unit help us today?

messages.speaker: Mark (操作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadni kemm ikkonfermajt li hija disponibbli.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadni kemm ikkonfermajt li hija disponibbli.
messages.zh: 能，我刚确认过它可以使用。
messages.en: Yes, I have just confirmed that it is available.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把长词组分成三个意义块来记：unità 是单元，tal-forniment 表示提供，tar-riservi 表示备用容量；联想需要时提供支援的单元。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In this packet, 'Unknown' names a cranberry, a small red fruit with a tart taste.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本词包中指蔓越莓，一种体小、色红、味酸的水果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'dan il-pakkett, 'Unknown' tirreferi għal frotta żgħira ħamra b'togħma qarsa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蔓越莓，一种小而红、味道偏酸的水果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Frotta żgħira ħamra b'togħma qarsa li f'dan il-pakkett għandha t-tikketta 'Unknown'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cranberry is a small red fruit that has a tart taste.

collocations.en: juice made from the fruit labelled 'Unknown'
collocations.zh: 用标注为“Unknown”的蔓越莓制成的果汁

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, it-tikketta 'Unknown' tindika frotta żgħira ħamra b'togħma qarsa.
formal.en: In this exercise, the label 'Unknown' identifies a cranberry, a small red fruit with a tart taste.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，“Unknown”这一标签指蔓越莓，即一种小而红、味酸的水果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi l-frotta bit-tikketta 'Unknown'? Pawlu: Hija frotta żgħira ħamra u qarsa. Maja: Nista' nagħmel meraq minnha? Pawlu: Iva, tista'.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is the fruit labelled 'Unknown'? Pawlu: It is a cranberry, a small red fruit with a tart taste. Maja: Can I make juice from it? Pawlu: Yes, you can.
colloquial.zh: Maja：标注为“Unknown”的是什么水果？Pawlu：是蔓越莓，一种小而红、味酸的水果。Maja：可以用它榨汁吗？Pawlu：可以。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 标注为“Unknown”的是什么水果？
messages.en: What is the fruit labelled 'Unknown'?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija frotta żgħira ħamra u qarsa.
messages.mt_standard: Hija frotta żgħira ħamra u qarsa.
messages.zh: 是蔓越莓，一种小而红、味酸的水果。
messages.en: It is a cranberry, a small red fruit with a tart taste.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
