messages.zh: 可以用它榨汁吗？
messages.en: Can I make juice from it?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.zh: 可以。
messages.en: Yes, you can.

cognitive_memory_aid: 仅按本词包记忆：给一颗红色酸果贴上“Unknown”标签，看到标签就联想到蔓越莓，不据此推断词源。

gloss_zh: 未知项；身份不明的对象

teaching_sense.en_definition: In this packet, 'unkown' is a noun label for something whose identity or details are not known.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本词包中用作名词标签，指身份或具体信息尚不明确的对象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'dan il-pakkett, 'unkown' hija tikketta nominali għal xi ħaġa li l-identità jew id-dettalji tagħha mhumiex magħrufa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 未知的对象；身份或相关信息尚不明确的事物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li għadha mhix magħrufa jew li għad m'hemmx biżżejjed informazzjoni dwarha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An unknown is something whose identity or relevant details have not yet been established.

formal.mt: L-entrata għandha t-tikketta 'unkown' għax l-identità tal-oġġett għadha mhix magħrufa.
formal.en: The entry carries the label 'unkown' because the object's identity is not yet known.
formal.zh: 由于该对象的身份尚不明确，这一条目标注为“unkown”。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex dan l-oġġett huwa mmarkat 'unkown'? Mark: Għax għadna ma nafux x'inhu. Sara: Nistaqsu lill-għalliem? Mark: Iva, forsi jkun jaf.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is this object marked 'unkown'? Mark: Because we do not know what it is yet. Sara: Shall we ask the teacher? Mark: Yes, perhaps he knows.
colloquial.zh: Sara：为什么这个对象标着“unkown”？Mark：因为我们还不知道它是什么。Sara：我们问问老师好吗？Mark：好，也许他知道。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 为什么这个对象标着“unkown”？
messages.en: Why is this object marked 'unkown'?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 因为我们还不知道它是什么。
messages.en: Because we do not know what it is yet.

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 我们问问老师好吗？
messages.en: Shall we ask the teacher?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 好，也许他知道。
messages.en: Yes, perhaps he knows.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把本条“unkown”想成物品旁的一张问号卡：身份还没弄清，所以是未知项；按给定拼写单独记忆。

gloss_zh: 傅油；宗教仪式中的涂油

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of applying oil to a person as part of a religious ceremony.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在宗教仪式中将油涂抹在某人身上的行为，称为傅油。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li bih persuna tindilek biż-żejt bħala parti minn rit reliġjuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 傅油，即作为宗教仪式的一部分给人涂油的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att reliġjuż li fih jiġi applikat iż-żejt fuq persuna bħala parti minn ċerimonja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Unction is the act of anointing someone with oil as part of a religious ceremony.

formal.mt: Matul iċ-ċerimonja reliġjuża, is-saċerdot għamel l-unzjoni biż-żejt.
formal.en: During the religious ceremony, the priest performed the anointing with oil.
formal.zh: 在宗教仪式期间，神父用油施行了傅油礼。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jiġifieri 'unzjoni'? David: Meta jidilku persuna biż-żejt waqt rit reliġjuż. Lara: Allura ż-żejt huwa parti mir-rit? David: Iva, jintuża fl-unzjoni.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'unzjoni' mean? David: It means anointing a person with oil during a religious rite. Lara: So the oil is part of the rite? David: Yes, it is used in the anointing.
colloquial.zh: Lara：“unzjoni”是什么意思？David：就是在宗教仪式中给人涂油。Lara：所以油是仪式的一部分？David：对，傅油时会用到。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: “unzjoni”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'unzjoni' mean?

messages.speaker: David (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta jidilku persuna biż-żejt waqt rit reliġjuż.
messages.mt_standard: Meta jidilku persuna biż-żejt waqt rit reliġjuż.
messages.zh: 就是在宗教仪式中给人涂油。
messages.en: It means anointing a person with oil during a religious rite.

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 所以油是仪式的一部分？
messages.en: So the oil is part of the rite?

messages.speaker: David (老师)
messages.zh: 对，傅油时会用到。
messages.en: Yes, it is used in the anointing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“仪式、油、涂抹”三个画面：unzjoni 指宗教仪式中的傅油行为，用场景帮助记忆即可。

gloss_zh: 已上传内容；已上传项目

teaching_sense.en_definition: In this packet, 'uploaded' is a noun label for content that has been placed on an online platform.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本词包中用作名词标签，指已经上传到网络平台的内容，例如上传到 Facebook 的照片。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'dan il-pakkett, 'uploaded' hija tikketta nominali għal kontenut li ttella' fuq pjattaforma online, pereżempju Facebook.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已上传的内容，例如已上传到 Facebook 的文件或照片。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kontenut li diġà ttella' fuq pjattaforma online, bħal ritratt li ttella' fuq Facebook.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An item labelled 'uploaded' is content that has already been transferred to an online platform.

formal.mt: Ir-ritratt għandu t-tikketta 'uploaded', li tindika li diġà ttella' fuq Facebook.
formal.en: The photo carries the label 'uploaded', indicating that it has already been uploaded to Facebook.
formal.zh: 这张照片带有“uploaded”标签，表示它已经上传到 Facebook。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ir-ritratt huwa mmarkat 'uploaded'. Diġà ttella'? Adam: Iva, tellajtu fuq Facebook. Nina: Nista' narah hemm? Adam: Iva, qiegħed fuq il-paġna tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Nina: The photo is marked 'uploaded'. Has it already been uploaded? Adam: Yes, I uploaded it to Facebook. Nina: Can I see it there? Adam: Yes, it is on my page.
colloquial.zh: Nina：照片标着“uploaded”。已经上传了吗？Adam：对，我把它上传到 Facebook 了。Nina：我能在那里看到吗？Adam：能，就在我的页面上。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 照片标着“uploaded”。已经上传了吗？
messages.en: The photo is marked 'uploaded'. Has it already been uploaded?

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.zh: 对，我把它上传到 Facebook 了。
messages.en: Yes, I uploaded it to Facebook.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我能在那里看到吗？
messages.en: Can I see it there?

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.zh: 能，就在我的页面上。
messages.en: Yes, it is on my page.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象照片传送完成后出现“uploaded”标签；本词包把它作为名词标签，指已经上传的那份内容。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The direction or area of a river toward its source.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 河流中朝向源头的方向或区域，即上游。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-naħa jew iż-żona ta' xmara li tinsab lejn is-sors tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 上游；河流朝向源头的一侧或区域。
sense_translations.mt_definition: In-naħa ta' xmara lejn is-sors tagħha, kontra d-direzzjoni li fiha jiġri l-ilma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The upstream is the part of a river toward its source, relative to a particular place.

formal.mt: Fil-mappa tax-xmara, it-terminu 'upstream' jindika ż-żona lejn is-sors tagħha.
formal.en: On the river map, the term 'upstream' indicates the area toward its source.
formal.zh: 在这张河流地图上，“upstream”一词表示朝向河源的上游区域。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'upstream' fuq din il-mappa? Mark: Tfisser in-naħa tax-xmara lejn is-sors tagħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'upstream' mean on this map? Mark: It means the side of the river toward its source.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张地图上的“upstream”是什么意思？马克：指河流朝向源头的那一侧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这张地图上的“upstream”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'upstream' mean on this map?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser in-naħa tax-xmara lejn is-sors tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser in-naħa tax-xmara lejn is-sors tagħha.
messages.zh: 指河流朝向源头的那一侧。
messages.en: It means the side of the river toward its source.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条从源头流向河口的河，把 upstream 标在靠近源头的一端，记住“上游看河源”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A powerful tropical storm with very strong winds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 伴有极强风力的热带风暴，通常指飓风；所给义项还包括龙卷风和台风。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Maltempata tropikali b'irjieħ qawwija ħafna; skont is-sens, il-kelma tista' tirreferi wkoll għal tromba tal-arja jew tifun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 飓风，通常指发生在北大西洋或东北太平洋的强烈热带气旋。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ċiklun tropikali qawwi li jseħħ fl-Atlantiku tat-Tramuntana jew fil-parti tal-Grigal tal-Paċifiku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A hurricane is a powerful tropical cyclone occurring in the North Atlantic or northeastern Pacific.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 龙卷风，与云层相连并接触地面的猛烈旋转气柱。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kolonna ta' arja li ddur b'qawwa kbira, tinżel minn sħaba u tmiss l-art.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tornado is a violently rotating column of air that connects a cloud with the ground.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 台风，发生在西北太平洋的强烈热带气旋。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ċiklun tropikali qawwi li jseħħ fil-parti tal-Majjistral tal-Oċean Paċifiku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A typhoon is a powerful tropical cyclone that occurs in the northwestern Pacific Ocean.

formal.mt: L-uragan ikkawża ħsara kbira fil-bini u ħalla diversi toroq magħluqa.
formal.en: The hurricane caused extensive damage to buildings and left several roads closed.
formal.zh: 这场飓风使建筑物严重受损，并导致数条道路封闭。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt l-aħbarijiet dwar l-uragan? Mark: Iva, ir-riħ kien tant qawwi li waqgħu ħafna siġar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see the news about the hurricane? Mark: Yes, the wind was so strong that many trees fell.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看了关于飓风的新闻吗？马克：看了，风大得吹倒了很多树。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看了关于飓风的新闻吗？
messages.en: Did you see the news about the hurricane?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ir-riħ kien tant qawwi li waqgħu ħafna siġar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ir-riħ kien tant qawwi li waqgħu ħafna siġar.
messages.zh: 看了，风大得吹倒了很多树。
messages.en: Yes, the wind was so strong that many trees fell.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张风暴图卡记住 uragan 的三个义项：飓风、龙卷风、台风；读句子时结合地点与形态判断具体所指。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A young female cricket that has not yet reached adulthood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尚未长成成虫的雌性蟋蟀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Insett żgħir tas-sess femminili mill-grupp tal-grilli li għadu ma laħaqx l-istadju adult.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 幼小的雌性蟋蟀，强调其年龄小且为雌性。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Grillu żgħir tas-sess femminili li għadu qed jikber u għadu mhuwiex adult.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A young female cricket is a female cricket that is still growing and has not yet become an adult.

collocations.en: a young female cricket in the grass
to observe a young female cricket
collocations.zh: 观察一只幼小的雌蟋蟀

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni fil-ġnien, l-istudenta rreġistrat il-preżenza ta' urejżqa fost il-ħaxix.
formal.en: During the observation in the garden, the student recorded the presence of a young female cricket among the grass.
formal.zh: 在花园进行观察时，这名女学生记录了草丛中一只幼小雌蟋蟀的出现。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara, hemm urejżqa fil-ħaxix! Mark: Rajtha! Ejja nosservawha mingħajr ma mmissuha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look, there is a young female cricket in the grass! Mark: I see it! Let's watch it without touching it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看，草丛里有一只幼小的雌蟋蟀！马克：看到了！我们观察一下，别碰它。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 看，草丛里有一只幼小的雌蟋蟀！
messages.en: Look, there is a young female cricket in the grass!

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtha! Ejja nosservawha mingħajr ma mmissuha.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtha! Ejja nosservawha mingħajr ma mmissuha.
messages.zh: 看到了！我们观察一下，别碰它。
messages.en: I see it! Let's watch it without touching it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 urejżqa 配一张小蟋蟀图，并在旁边写上“幼小、雌性”两个标签，三个信息一起记。

gloss_zh: 他们／她们展示了；表明了

teaching_sense.en_definition: A past-tense verb form meaning that they showed, demonstrated, or made something evident.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示“他们／她们展示了、说明了或表明了”的过去时动词形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma tal-verb fil-passat li tfisser li huma ppreżentaw xi ħaġa, għamluha tidher jew taw prova tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他们／她们展示了、给人看了，或使某种情况显现出来了。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Huma għamlu xi ħaġa viżibbli jew magħrufa, ippreżentawha lil xi ħadd jew taw prova tagħha fil-passat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If people showed something, they made it visible, demonstrated it, or made a fact clear to someone.

collocations.zh: 他们／她们表现出了兴趣
他们／她们表现出了尊重

formal.mt: L-istudenti urew ir-riżultati tal-proġett tagħhom waqt il-laqgħa tal-iskola.
formal.en: The students showed the results of their project during the school meeting.
formal.zh: 学生们在学校会议上展示了他们的项目成果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Sħabek urewlek ir-ritratti tal-vjaġġ? Mark: Iva, urewli kollox ilbieraħ. Kien hemm ritratti sbieħ ħafna!
colloquial.en: Maja: Did your friends show you the photos from the trip? Mark: Yes, they showed me everything yesterday. There were some very beautiful photos!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的朋友们给你看旅行照片了吗？马克：看了，他们昨天全给我看了。有些照片特别漂亮！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的朋友们给你看旅行照片了吗？
messages.en: Did your friends show you the photos from the trip?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, urewli kollox ilbieraħ. Kien hemm ritratti sbieħ ħafna!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, urewli kollox ilbieraħ. Kien hemm ritratti sbieħ ħafna!
messages.zh: 看了，他们昨天全给我看了。有些照片特别漂亮！
messages.en: Yes, they showed me everything yesterday. There were some very beautiful photos!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 urew 放进“他们昨天展示了照片”的画面，连同“复数主语、过去动作”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large vase-shaped container, often with a lid, used for decoration or for holding cremated remains.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种通常呈大花瓶形、常带盖的容器，可作装饰或用于盛放骨灰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent forma ta' vażun kbir, spiss b'għatu, li jintuża bħala tiżjin jew biex jinżamm fih ir-rmied ta' persuna kkremata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 瓮状容器，通常呈大花瓶形，可用于装饰，也可用于存放火化后的骨灰。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reċipjent li jixbah vażun kbir u li jista' jintuża għat-tiżjin jew biex jinżamm fih ir-rmied wara kremazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An urn is a vase-shaped container that may be used as an ornament or to hold a person's ashes after cremation.

formal.mt: L-urna dekorattiva tqiegħdet fuq bażi tal-ġebel fid-daħla tal-ġnien.
formal.en: The decorative urn was placed on a stone base at the entrance to the garden.
formal.zh: 这只装饰瓮被安放在花园入口处的石座上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn inqiegħdu din l-urna dekorattiva? David: Ħdejn il-bieb tal-ġnien, fejn tidher sew.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where shall we put this decorative urn? David: By the garden gate, where it can be seen clearly.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这只装饰瓮放在哪里好？David：放在花园门旁边吧，那里看得清楚。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 这只装饰瓮放在哪里好？
messages.en: Where shall we put this decorative urn?

messages.speaker: David (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-bieb tal-ġnien, fejn tidher sew.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-bieb tal-ġnien, fejn tidher sew.
messages.zh: 放在花园门旁边吧，那里看得清楚。
messages.en: By the garden gate, where it can be seen clearly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 urna 想成一只瓮状大容器，再用搭配区分用途：dekorattiva 提示装饰，funerali 提示存放骨灰。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Requiring immediate attention or action because delay could cause problems.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 需要立即关注或采取行动、不能拖延的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jeħtieġ attenzjoni jew azzjoni minnufih għax id-dewmien jista' joħloq problemi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 紧急的；需要立即处理或回应的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu jiġi indirizzat minnufih u ma jistax jitħalla għal aktar tard.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is urgent needs to be dealt with immediately because waiting could cause difficulties.

formal.mt: Dan il-każ huwa urġenti u jeħtieġ tweġiba qabel tmiem il-ġurnata.
formal.en: This case is urgent and requires a response before the end of the day.
formal.zh: 这个情况十分紧急，需要在今天结束前作出回应。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nistgħu nitkellmu issa? Għandi bżonn urġenti tal-għajnuna tiegħek. Mark: Iva, għidli x'ġara.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can we talk now? I urgently need your help. Mark: Yes, tell me what happened.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们现在能聊聊吗？我急需你的帮助。Mark：可以，告诉我发生了什么。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nitkellmu issa? Għandi bżonn urġenti tal-għajnuna tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nitkellmu issa? Għandi bżonn urġenti tal-għajnuna tiegħek.
messages.zh: 我们现在能聊聊吗？我急需你的帮助。
messages.en: Can we talk now? I urgently need your help.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 可以，告诉我发生了什么。
messages.en: Yes, tell me what happened.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 urġenti 放在“需要现在处理”的情境里记：każ urġenti 就是不能拖到明天的紧急情况。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The need for something to receive immediate attention or action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事需要立即受到关注或得到处理的紧迫性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħtieġa li xi ħaġa tingħata attenzjoni jew tiġi indirizzata minnufih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 紧迫性；必须迅速采取行动、不能延误的程度或状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-fatt li sitwazzjoni teħtieġ azzjoni malajr u ma tistax tistenna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The urgency of a situation is the degree to which it requires immediate attention or action.

formal.mt: Minħabba l-urġenza tas-sitwazzjoni, il-kumitat iddeċieda li jiltaqa' llum.
formal.en: Because of the urgency of the situation, the committee decided to meet today.
formal.zh: 鉴于情况的紧迫性，委员会决定今天召开会议。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex trid tibgħat id-dokument issa? Pawlu: Hemm urġenza għax iridu jirċevuh qabel nofsinhar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do you want to send the document now? Pawlu: It is urgent because they need to receive it before noon.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么想现在就把文件发出去？Pawlu：事情比较紧急，因为他们必须在中午前收到。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么想现在就把文件发出去？
messages.en: Why do you want to send the document now?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm urġenza għax iridu jirċevuh qabel nofsinhar.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm urġenza għax iridu jirċevuh qabel nofsinhar.
messages.zh: 事情比较紧急，因为他们必须在中午前收到。
messages.en: It is urgent because they need to receive it before noon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“紧迫性”记 urġenza：urġenti 描述事情很急，urġenza 则把这种“急”的状态当作名词来谈。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who uses a product, service, device, or system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用某种产品、服务、设备或系统的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tuża prodott, servizz, apparat jew sistema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用户；某种产品、服务、设备或系统的使用者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel użu minn xi ħaġa, bħal servizz, kompjuter jew applikazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A user is a person who uses a particular product, service, device, or system.

formal.mt: Kull utent għandu jaqra l-istruzzjonijiet qabel juża s-sistema għall-ewwel darba.
formal.en: Each user should read the instructions before using the system for the first time.
formal.zh: 每位用户都应在首次使用该系统前阅读说明。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Jien utent ġdid. Kif noħloq kont? Nina: Agħfas fuq 'Irreġistra' u imla d-dettalji tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Mark: I am a new user. How do I create an account? Nina: Click 'Register' and fill in your details.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我是新用户。怎么创建账户？Nina：点击“注册”，然后填写你的资料。

messages.speaker: Mark (新用户)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien utent ġdid. Kif noħloq kont?
messages.mt_standard: Jien utent ġdid. Kif noħloq kont?
messages.zh: 我是新用户。怎么创建账户？
messages.en: I am a new user. How do I create an account?

messages.speaker: Nina (客服人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Agħfas fuq 'Irreġistra' u imla d-dettalji tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Agħfas fuq 'Irreġistra' u imla d-dettalji tiegħek.
messages.zh: 点击“注册”，然后填写你的资料。
messages.en: Click 'Register' and fill in your details.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象首次注册服务时介绍自己：Jien utent ġdid，意思是“我是新用户”；把 utent 与使用服务的人联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The person who ultimately uses a product or service.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 最终实际使用某项产品或服务的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-persuna li fl-aħħar mill-aħħar tuża prodott jew servizz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 最终实际使用产品或服务的用户。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Utent aħħari huwa l-persuna li tuża prodott jew servizz għall-ħtiġijiet tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An end-user is the person who actually uses a product or service.

formal.mt: Il-manwal għandu jkun ċar għall-utent aħħari u jispjega kull pass b'mod sempliċi.
formal.en: The manual should be clear to the end-user and explain each step simply.
formal.zh: 手册应让最终用户看得明白，并用简单的方式解释每个步骤。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għal min hi din il-gwida? Lara: Għall-utent aħħari, jiġifieri għall-persuna li se tuża l-prodott.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who is this guide for? Lara: For the end-user, meaning the person who will use the product.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这份指南是给谁看的？Lara：给最终用户，也就是将要使用这个产品的人。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这份指南是给谁看的？
messages.en: Who is this guide for?

messages.speaker: Lara (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għall-utent aħħari, jiġifieri għall-persuna li se tuża l-prodott.
messages.mt_standard: Għall-utent aħħari, jiġifieri għall-persuna li se tuża l-prodott.
messages.zh: 给最终用户，也就是将要使用这个产品的人。
messages.en: For the end-user, meaning the person who will use the product.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组和“产品最后到了谁手里使用”这个问题一起记，答案就是最终用户。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something useful helps someone do something or meet a need.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能帮助人完成事情或满足某种需要的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa utli tgħin lil xi ħadd jagħmel xi ħaġa jew jaqdi ħtieġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够发挥实际作用、提供帮助或满足需要的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa tkun utli meta tagħti għajnuna jew taqdi skop prattiku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is useful helps you achieve a purpose or do a task.

formal.mt: Dan il-fuljett fih informazzjoni utli għal min se jżur il-mużew għall-ewwel darba.
formal.en: This leaflet contains useful information for anyone visiting the museum for the first time.
formal.zh: 这份宣传册包含对初次参观博物馆的人有用的信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Inġib miegħi mappa tal-belt? Nina: Iva, tkun utli jekk tintilef.
colloquial.en: Maja: Should I bring a map of the city? Nina: Yes, it will be useful if you get lost.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我要带一张城市地图吗？Nina：要，迷路时会有用。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要带一张城市地图吗？
messages.en: Should I bring a map of the city?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 要，迷路时会有用。
messages.en: Yes, it will be useful if you get lost.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象迷路时打开地图，立刻想到 utli：能帮上忙，就是“有用的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An imagined ideal society where people live under perfect conditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 想象中人们在完善条件下生活的理想社会。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Soċjetà ideali immaġinata fejn in-nies jgħixu f'kundizzjonijiet perfetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 想象中的完美社会或理想世界。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Utopja hija soċjetà jew dinja immaġinata li titqies perfetta fil-mod kif jgħixu n-nies fiha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A utopia is an imagined society in which people's lives and social conditions are perfect.

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, l-awtriċi tiddeskrivi utopja fejn kulħadd għandu dar u ħadd ma jgħix fil-faqar.
formal.en: In the novel, the author describes a utopia where everyone has a home and nobody lives in poverty.
formal.zh: 在小说中，作者描绘了一个人人有家、无人生活在贫困中的乌托邦。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Immaġina post fejn kulħadd jgħin lil xulxin u ħadd ma jiġġieled. Mark: Dik tkun utopja!
colloquial.en: Lara: Imagine a place where everyone helps one another and nobody fights. Mark: That would be a utopia!
colloquial.zh: Lara：想象一个大家互相帮助、谁也不争斗的地方。Mark：那就是乌托邦了！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Immaġina post fejn kulħadd jgħin lil xulxin u ħadd ma jiġġieled.
messages.mt_standard: Immaġina post fejn kulħadd jgħin lil xulxin u ħadd ma jiġġieled.
messages.zh: 想象一个大家互相帮助、谁也不争斗的地方。
messages.en: Imagine a place where everyone helps one another and nobody fights.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 那就是乌托邦了！
messages.en: That would be a utopia!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 utopja 配上一幅“人人安居、彼此友善”的想象城市图，记住它表示乌托邦。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The reproductive organ in which a fetus develops during pregnancy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 怀孕期间胎儿在其中发育的生殖器官。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-organu tas-sistema riproduttiva li fih jiżviluppa l-fetu waqt it-tqala.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 女性生殖系统中供胚胎及胎儿在妊娠期间发育的器官，即子宫。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-utru huwa organu tas-sistema riproduttiva femminili li fih jiżviluppaw l-embrijun u mbagħad il-fetu waqt it-tqala.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The uterus is the organ in which an embryo and then a fetus develop during pregnancy.

formal.mt: Id-dijagramma turi l-utru u tispjega li l-fetu jiżviluppa fih waqt it-tqala.
formal.en: The diagram shows the uterus and explains that the fetus develops inside it during pregnancy.
formal.zh: 图示展示了子宫，并说明胎儿在怀孕期间于其中发育。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu l-utru f'din l-istampa? Rita: Huwa dan l-organu hawn; il-fetu jiżviluppa fih waqt it-tqala.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is the uterus in this picture? Rita: It is this organ here; the fetus develops inside it during pregnancy.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这张图里的子宫是什么？Rita：就是这里这个器官；怀孕期间胎儿在里面发育。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这张图里的子宫是什么？
messages.en: What is the uterus in this picture?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa dan l-organu hawn; il-fetu jiżviluppa fih waqt it-tqala.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa dan l-organu hawn; il-fetu jiżviluppa fih waqt it-tqala.
messages.zh: 就是这里这个器官；怀孕期间胎儿在里面发育。
messages.en: It is this organ here; the fetus develops inside it during pregnancy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在生殖系统示意图的子宫位置写上 utru，把词形、器官位置和胎儿发育的功能一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Solid waste passed out of a person's or animal's body through the anus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人或动物经肛门排出体外的固体废物，即粪便。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Skart solidu li joħroġ mill-ġisem ta' persuna jew annimal mill-anus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粪便，口语中也称“便便”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-materjal solidu li persuna jew annimal joħroġ mill-imsaren meta jagħmel il-bżonnijiet tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Poop is the solid waste that people or animals pass out of their bodies.

formal.mt: Is-sidien tal-klieb għandhom jiġbru l-uċuh tal-annimali tagħhom biex iżommu l-mogħdijiet nodfa.
formal.en: Dog owners should pick up their animals' poop to keep the paths clean.
formal.zh: 养狗的人应清理自家动物的粪便，以保持步道清洁。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Attent, hemm uċuh tal-kelb ħdejn il-bank! Toni: Rajtu. Se niġbru b'borża.
colloquial.en: Sara: Watch out, there's dog poop beside the bench! Toni: I saw it. I'll pick it up with a bag.
colloquial.zh: Sara：小心，长椅旁边有狗便便！Toni：我看见了，我会用袋子把它捡起来。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Attent, hemm uċuh tal-kelb ħdejn il-bank!
messages.mt_standard: Attent, hemm uċuh tal-kelb ħdejn il-bank!
messages.zh: 小心，长椅旁边有狗便便！
messages.en: Watch out, there's dog poop beside the bench!

messages.speaker: Toni (狗主人)
messages.zh: 我看见了，我会用袋子把它捡起来。
messages.en: I saw it. I'll pick it up with a bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本条给定的“便便”义，想象遛狗时拿出清洁袋的场景，把物品、动作和词义一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An unpleasant physical sensation or a feeling of emotional suffering.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体某处产生的疼痛感，或内心感受到的痛苦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni fiżika li tweġġa', jew tbatija li persuna tħoss f'qalbha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 身体上的疼痛，或情感上的痛苦。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni ta' tbatija fil-ġisem jew fil-ħajja emozzjonali ta' persuna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Pain is an unpleasant feeling that you experience when your body hurts or when you suffer emotionally.

formal.mt: Il-pazjent iddeskriva uġiegħ qawwi fl-irkoppa li beda wara li waqa'.
formal.en: The patient described severe pain in his knee that began after he fell.
formal.zh: 患者描述说，摔倒后膝盖开始剧烈疼痛。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad għandek l-uġiegħ f'idek? Mark: Iva, imma llum inħossu inqas.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you still have pain in your hand? Mark: Yes, but I feel it less today.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你的手还疼吗？Mark：还疼，不过今天感觉没那么疼了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的手还疼吗？
messages.en: Do you still have pain in your hand?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 还疼，不过今天感觉没那么疼了。
messages.en: Yes, but I feel it less today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 uġiegħ 和皱眉喊疼的画面联系起来，再用 uġiegħ qawwi 记住“剧烈疼痛”；这是记忆联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Pain in the head; in a drinking context, the unpleasant after-effects of alcohol.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 头部的疼痛；在饮酒后的语境中，也可表示宿醉所带来的不适。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uġigħ li jinħass fir-ras; f'kuntest ta' xorb alkoħoliku, jista' jirreferi wkoll għall-iskumdità li tinħass wara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 头部出现的疼痛感。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Uġigħ li persuna tħoss f'rasha, f'parti minnha jew fir-ras kollha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you have a headache, you feel pain in part or all of your head.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 饮酒过量后出现的宿醉不适，通常在次日表现为头痛、恶心或疲倦。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stat ta' skumdità wara li persuna tkun xorbot wisq alkoħol, ġeneralment l-għada, li jista' jinkludi uġigħ fir-ras, dardir u għeja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A hangover is the unpleasant condition you may experience after drinking too much alcohol, often with headache, nausea, and tiredness.

collocations.mt: uġigħ ta' ras wara lejl ta' xorb
collocations.en: a hangover after a night of drinking

formal.mt: L-istudenta kitbet lill-għalliema biex tispjega li kellha uġigħ ta' ras u ma setgħetx tattendi l-lezzjoni.
formal.en: The student wrote to her teacher to explain that she had a headache and could not attend the lesson.
formal.zh: 这名学生写信向老师说明，她因头痛无法来上课。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex għandek uġigħ ta' ras dalgħodu? Ben: Xrobt wisq ilbieraħ filgħaxija; illum għandi wkoll id-dardir. Sara: Mela għadek qed tħoss l-effett tax-xorb.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do you have a headache this morning? Ben: I drank too much last night; today I feel sick as well. Sara: So you're still feeling the effects of the alcohol.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你今天早上怎么头痛了？Ben：昨晚喝多了，今天还觉得恶心。Sara：看来你还在难受，是宿醉的影响。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għandek uġigħ ta' ras dalgħodu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għandek uġigħ ta' ras dalgħodu?
messages.zh: 你今天早上怎么头痛了？
messages.en: Why do you have a headache this morning?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xrobt wisq ilbieraħ filgħaxija; illum għandi wkoll id-dardir.
messages.mt_standard: Xrobt wisq ilbieraħ filgħaxija; illum għandi wkoll id-dardir.
messages.zh: 昨晚喝多了，今天还觉得恶心。
messages.en: I drank too much last night; today I feel sick as well.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela għadek qed tħoss l-effett tax-xorb.
messages.mt_standard: Mela għadek qed tħoss l-effett tax-xorb.
messages.zh: 看来你还在难受，是宿醉的影响。
messages.en: So you're still feeling the effects of the alcohol.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 ras 是“头”，uġigħ ta' ras 先联想揉太阳穴的“头痛”；若出现昨晚喝多了的语境，再联系“宿醉”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Pain felt in the back, especially in the lower back.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 背部感到的疼痛，尤其可指腰背部疼痛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uġigħ li jinħass fid-dahar, speċjalment fil-parti t'isfel tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 背部疼痛，常指腰背部的持续疼痛。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Uġigħ fid-dahar li jista' jdum għal xi żmien u jagħmel il-moviment skomdu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you have backache, you feel pain in your back, often in its lower part.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, l-impjegat semma li kellu uġigħ tad-dahar wara li ġarr kaxxi tqal.
formal.en: In his report, the employee mentioned that he had backache after carrying heavy boxes.
formal.zh: 该员工在报告中提到，他搬运重箱子后出现了背痛。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed timxi bil-mod? Pawlu: Għandi uġigħ tad-dahar minn meta ġarrejt dik il-kaxxa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you walking slowly? Pawlu: I've had backache since I carried that box.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你怎么走得这么慢？Pawlu：自从搬了那个箱子，我就一直背痛。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 你怎么走得这么慢？
messages.en: Why are you walking slowly?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi uġigħ tad-dahar minn meta ġarrejt dik il-kaxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi uġigħ tad-dahar minn meta ġarrejt dik il-kaxxa.
messages.zh: 自从搬了那个箱子，我就一直背痛。
messages.en: I've had backache since I carried that box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 dahar 是“背部”，把 uġigħ tad-dahar 想成搬箱子后扶着腰背的画面，整组对应“背痛”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Pain felt in a tooth or in several teeth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一颗或多颗牙齿出现的疼痛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uġigħ li jinħass f'sinna waħda jew f'aktar minn sinna waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 牙齿的疼痛，可发生于一颗或多颗牙齿。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni ta' uġigħ f'sinna jew fis-snien li tista' tkun kontinwa jew tinħass minn ħin għal ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you have toothache, you feel pain in one or more of your teeth.

formal.mt: Il-pazjenta talbet appuntament mad-dentist minħabba uġigħ tas-snien li kien ilu jumejn.
formal.en: The patient requested a dental appointment because of toothache that had lasted two days.
formal.zh: 这名患者因为牙痛持续了两天，申请预约看牙医。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex ma rqadtx sew? Toni: Kelli uġigħ tas-snien il-lejl kollu. Nina: Għandek appuntament mad-dentist? Toni: Iva, illum waranofsinhar.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why didn't you sleep well? Toni: I had toothache all night. Nina: Do you have a dentist's appointment? Toni: Yes, this afternoon.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你怎么没睡好？Toni：我牙疼了一整夜。Nina：你约了牙医吗？Toni：约了，今天下午。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么没睡好？
messages.en: Why didn't you sleep well?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 我牙疼了一整夜。
messages.en: I had toothache all night.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你约了牙医吗？
messages.en: Do you have a dentist's appointment?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 约了，今天下午。
messages.en: Yes, this afternoon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 snien“牙齿”和捂着腮帮子的画面联系起来，整组记住 uġigħ tas-snien“牙痛”；即使只疼一颗牙，也可使用这一表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Previously used, rather than new.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经被使用过的，而非全新的；形容商品时常指二手的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun diġà ntuża u ma jkunx ġdid; meta jingħad għal oġġett għall-bejgħ, jindika li jkun intuża qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已经使用过的；用来描述商品时，指二手的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun diġà ntuża minn xi ħadd, u għalhekk ma jkunx ġdid.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A used object has already been used by someone and is no longer new.

formal.mt: Il-kompjuter użat ġie ttestjat qabel ma tqiegħed għall-bejgħ.
formal.en: The used computer was tested before being offered for sale.
formal.zh: 这台二手电脑在出售前经过了测试。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-ktieb ġdid jew użat? Rita: Użat, imma jinsab f'kundizzjoni tajba.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this book new or used? Rita: Used, but it is in good condition.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这本书是新的还是二手的？丽塔：二手的，不过保存得很好。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这本书是新的还是二手的？
messages.en: Is this book new or used?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.zh: 二手的，不过保存得很好。
messages.en: Used, but it is in good condition.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 użat 和二手书的画面一起记：书已经有人用过，但仍然可以继续使用。

gloss_zh: 内部自用；限于自身需要的使用

teaching_sense.en_definition: Use of a resource or output solely for the needs of the entity that controls or produces it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 资源或产出仅供控制或生产它的单位满足自身需要，而不向外部出售或供应的使用方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-użu ta' riżorsa jew prodott għall-ħtiġijiet tal-entità li tikkontrollah jew tipproduċih biss, mingħajr bejgħ jew provvista lil oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仅供生产或控制该资源的单位内部自用，而不对外出售或供应。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-użu ta' dak li jiġi prodott jew ikkontrollat minn entità biex jaqdi l-ħtiġijiet tagħha stess biss, minflok jiġi offrut lil entitajiet oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Captive use occurs when an entity reserves a resource or its output for its own needs instead of supplying it to others.

formal.mt: L-elettriku ġġenerat minn dan l-impjant huwa għall-użu ristrett tal-fabbrika u ma jinbiegħx lil terzi.
formal.en: The electricity generated by this plant is for the factory's captive use and is not sold to third parties.
formal.zh: 该电站生产的电力仅供工厂内部自用，不向第三方出售。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-fabbrika tbigħ l-elettriku li tipproduċi? Mark: Le, huwa għall-użu ristrett tagħha; tużah kollu hi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does the factory sell the electricity it produces? Mark: No, it is for its captive use; the factory uses all of it itself.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：工厂会出售自己生产的电力吗？马克：不会，这些电力供它内部自用，全部由工厂自己使用。

messages.speaker: Sara (访客)
messages.zh: 工厂会出售自己生产的电力吗？
messages.en: Does the factory sell the electricity it produces?

messages.speaker: Mark (工厂员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa għall-użu ristrett tagħha; tużah kollu hi.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa għall-użu ristrett tagħha; tużah kollu hi.
messages.zh: 不会，这些电力供它内部自用，全部由工厂自己使用。
messages.en: No, it is for its captive use; the factory uses all of it itself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词组放进工厂自发自用电力的画面：电留在厂内满足自身需要，就能记住这里的内部自用义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Use of something for a particular, clearly identified purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将某物用于一个明确指定的目的；也指这种特定用途。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-użu ta' xi ħaġa għal għan partikolari u definit b'mod ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 针对某一明确目的的使用；特定用途。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-użu ta' oġġett, materjal jew riżorsa għal skop partikolari li jkun identifikat b'mod ċar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A specific use is a particular purpose for which something is intended or employed.

formal.mt: Dan il-materjal ġie żviluppat għal użu speċifiku: l-insulazzjoni tas-soqfa.
formal.en: This material was developed for a specific use: roof insulation.
formal.zh: 这种材料是为一个特定用途而开发的：屋顶隔热。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din l-għodda għandha użu speċifiku? Toni: Iva, nużawha biex naqtgħu l-ħġieġ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this tool have a specific use? Toni: Yes, we use it to cut glass.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个工具有什么特定用途吗？托尼：有，我们用它来切割玻璃。

messages.speaker: Lara (学徒)
messages.zh: 这个工具有什么特定用途吗？
messages.en: Does this tool have a specific use?

messages.speaker: Toni (师傅)
messages.zh: 有，我们用它来切割玻璃。
messages.en: Yes, we use it to cut glass.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 użu speċifiku 想成工具标签上的明确用途，例如用于切玻璃；每次记忆都补上具体用来做什么。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The practice of lending money at excessively high rates of interest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以过高利率借出金钱、收取高额利息的做法，即放高利贷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-prattika li wieħed isellef il-flus u jitlob imgħax għoli żżejjed fuqhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以过高利率放贷并收取高额利息的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-prattika tas-self tal-flus b'rata ta' imgħax għolja żżejjed.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Usury is the practice of lending money and charging excessively high interest on the loan.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif l-użura tista' żżid il-piż tad-dejn fuq min jissellef.
formal.en: The report describes how usury can increase the burden of debt on borrowers.
formal.zh: 报告说明了高利贷如何加重借款人的债务负担。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed jitolbuni nħallas lura d-doppju tas-somma wara xahar biss. Pawlu: Dak imgħax għoli wisq; dik tinstema' bħall-użura.
colloquial.en: Maja: They are asking me to repay twice the amount after just one month. Pawlu: That interest is far too high; that sounds like usury.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他们要求我仅一个月后就偿还两倍的金额。保罗：这利息也太高了，听起来就是高利贷。

messages.speaker: Maja (借款人)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed jitolbuni nħallas lura d-doppju tas-somma wara xahar biss.
messages.mt_standard: Qed jitolbuni nħallas lura d-doppju tas-somma wara xahar biss.
messages.zh: 他们要求我仅一个月后就偿还两倍的金额。
messages.en: They are asking me to repay twice the amount after just one month.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak imgħax għoli wisq; dik tinstema' bħall-użura.
messages.mt_standard: Dak imgħax għoli wisq; dik tinstema' bħall-użura.
messages.zh: 这利息也太高了，听起来就是高利贷。
messages.en: That interest is far too high; that sounds like usury.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 użura 时想象借款单上的利息高得吓人：关键词是过高的利息，而不只是借钱。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who wanders from place to place without a settled home; also a person who avoids work and spends time idly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有固定住所、四处漂泊的人；也可指逃避工作、游手好闲的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tiġġerra minn post għal ieħor mingħajr dar fissa; tista' wkoll tkun persuna li tevita x-xogħol u tqatta' l-ħin titgħażżen.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 居无定所、四处漂泊的流浪者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tiġġerra minn post għal ieħor mingħajr ma jkollha dar fissa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A vagabond is someone who wanders from place to place without a settled home.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不愿工作、终日闲混的人；游手好闲者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tevita x-xogħol u tqatta' ħafna mill-ħin tagħha titgħażżen.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A loafer is someone who avoids work and spends much of their time doing nothing useful.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 没有固定住所、辗转各地的流浪汉。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna mingħajr dar fissa li tivvjaġġa minn post għal ieħor u tgħix fit-triq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tramp is someone without a settled home who travels between places and lives on the streets.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 居无定所、没有稳定生活来源的流浪人员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li m'għandhiex dar fissa jew mezz stabbli ta' għajxien u tiġġerra minn post għal ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A vagrant is someone who has no settled home or regular means of support.

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-vagabond jgħaddi minn raħal għal ieħor u jfittex post fejn jorqod.
formal.en: In the novel, the vagabond goes from village to village looking for somewhere to sleep.
formal.zh: 小说中，这名流浪者从一个村庄走到另一个村庄，寻找可以过夜的地方。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak ir-raġel fl-istorja? Mark: Hu vagabond; m'għandux dar fissa u jmur minn post għal ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that man in the story? Mark: He is a vagabond; he has no settled home and goes from place to place.
colloquial.zh: Maja：故事里的那个男人是谁？Mark：他是个流浪者，没有固定住所，四处漂泊。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书伙伴)
messages.zh: 故事里的那个男人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that man in the story?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu vagabond; m'għandux dar fissa u jmur minn post għal ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Hu vagabond; m'għandux dar fissa u jmur minn post għal ieħor.
messages.zh: 他是个流浪者，没有固定住所，四处漂泊。
messages.en: He is a vagabond; he has no settled home and goes from place to place.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 vagabond 放进两个小画面：背着包四处漂泊的人，以及整天闲坐不工作的人；结合上下文区分“流浪者”和“游手好闲者”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Periods when people take a break from school or work to rest, travel, or enjoy leisure activities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 暂时不用上学或工作、可以休息、旅行或进行休闲活动的假期；此词为复数形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Perjodi ta' mistrieħ mill-iskola jew mix-xogħol, li fihom wieħed jista' jistrieħ, jivvjaġġa jew jagħmel attivitajiet ta' divertiment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 假期；暂时离开日常学习或工作、用于休息或度假的时段，词形为复数。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Perjodi li fihom wieħed jieqaf għal xi żmien mill-iskola jew mix-xogħol biex jistrieħ jew imur xi mkien għad-divertiment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Holidays are periods when people are free from their usual work or studies and can rest or travel.

collocations.en: to spend the holidays with the family

formal.mt: Matul il-vaganzi tas-sajf, il-librerija se torganizza attivitajiet ta' qari għat-tfal.
formal.en: During the summer holidays, the library will organise reading activities for children.
formal.zh: 暑假期间，图书馆将为儿童举办阅读活动。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'se tagħmel fil-vaganzi? Luca: Se nqatta' ġimgħa Għawdex mal-familja.
colloquial.en: Sara: What are you going to do during the holidays? Luca: I am going to spend a week in Gozo with my family.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你假期打算做什么？Luca：我打算和家人在戈佐岛住一周。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你假期打算做什么？
messages.en: What are you going to do during the holidays?

messages.speaker: Luca (朋友)
messages.zh: 我打算和家人在戈佐岛住一周。
messages.en: I am going to spend a week in Gozo with my family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 vaganzi 写在一整段假日日历上，联想连续多天不用上学或工作；连同 il-vaganzi tas-sajf“暑假”一起记，提醒自己这是复数形式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A railway vehicle used to carry goods or passengers as part of a train.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 组成列车、用于运载货物或乘客的铁路车辆；可指货车车厢或客车车厢。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vettura li timxi fuq il-binarji bħala parti minn ferrovija u li tintuża biex iġġorr merkanzija jew passiġġieri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铁路货车；用于装载、运输货物的车厢。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Vettura tal-ferrovija li tintuża biex iġġorr merkanzija minn post għal ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A wagon is a railway vehicle used for carrying goods as part of a train.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 火车客车车厢；列车中供乘客乘坐的部分。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Parti minn ferrovija li fiha jkun hemm spazju u siġġijiet għall-passiġġieri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A carriage is one of the sections of a train in which passengers sit and travel.

formal.mt: Il-merkanzija tqiegħdet f'vagun magħluq qabel ma l-ferrovija telqet mill-istazzjon.
formal.en: The goods were placed in an enclosed wagon before the train left the station.
formal.zh: 列车离开车站前，货物被装入了一节封闭式货车车厢。

colloquial.mt: Nina: F'liema vagun se noqogħdu? Pawlu: Ejja nidħlu fl-ewwel vagun; hemm żewġ siġġijiet vojta.
colloquial.en: Nina: Which carriage shall we sit in? Pawlu: Let's get into the first carriage; there are two empty seats.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我们坐哪节车厢？Pawlu：进第一节吧，那里有两个空座位。

messages.speaker: Nina (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 我们坐哪节车厢？
messages.en: Which carriage shall we sit in?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nidħlu fl-ewwel vagun; hemm żewġ siġġijiet vojta.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nidħlu fl-ewwel vagun; hemm żewġ siġġijiet vojta.
messages.zh: 进第一节吧，那里有两个空座位。
messages.en: Let's get into the first carriage; there are two empty seats.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一列火车中单独的一节 vagun：装箱子时是货车车厢，坐乘客时是客车车厢；用“列车的一节”这个共同画面串起两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large mass of snow and ice that suddenly slides down a mountain slope.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大量积雪和冰突然沿山坡向下滑落的现象，也指滑落的雪冰团块。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Massa kbira ta' borra u silġ li tinżel f'daqqa minn fuq xaqliba ta' muntanja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雪崩；大量积雪和冰突然从山坡上滑落。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Massa kbira ta' borra u silġ li tinqala' minn fuq muntanja u tiżżerżaq malajr 'l isfel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An avalanche is a large mass of snow and ice that suddenly slides down the side of a mountain.

formal.mt: Il-mogħdija ngħalqet wara li valanga niżlet mill-muntanja u għattiet parti minnha.
formal.en: The trail was closed after an avalanche came down the mountain and covered part of it.
formal.zh: 雪崩从山上滑落并掩埋了部分步道后，这条步道被关闭了。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex għalqu din il-mogħdija? David: Niżlet valanga dalgħodu u għattiet it-triq bil-borra.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why did they close this trail? David: An avalanche came down this morning and covered the route with snow.
colloquial.zh: Anna：他们为什么关闭这条步道？David：今天早上发生了雪崩，积雪把路盖住了。

messages.speaker: Anna (徒步伙伴)
messages.zh: 他们为什么关闭这条步道？
messages.en: Why did they close this trail?

messages.speaker: David (徒步伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Niżlet valanga dalgħodu u għattiet it-triq bil-borra.
messages.mt_standard: Niżlet valanga dalgħodu u għattiet it-triq bil-borra.
messages.zh: 今天早上发生了雪崩，积雪把路盖住了。
messages.en: An avalanche came down this morning and covered the route with snow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 valanga 对应到“大块积雪突然冲下山坡”的动态画面；再记 riskju ta' valanga“雪崩风险”，把具体景象和常用表达一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Valencia is a proper name used to identify a place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 瓦伦西亚，用于指称地方的专有名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Valencia huwa isem proprju li jintuża biex jidentifika post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 瓦伦西亚，地名。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Valencia huwa isem proprju ta' post.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Valencia is the proper name of a place.

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-vjaġġ jinkludi żjara f'Valencia.
formal.en: The travel itinerary includes a visit to Valencia.
formal.zh: 旅行行程包括到访瓦伦西亚。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn sejjer għall-vaganza? Pawlu: Sejjer Valencia, u diġà għandi l-mappa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where are you going on holiday? Pawlu: I'm going to Valencia, and I already have the map.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你要去哪里度假？保罗：我要去瓦伦西亚，而且已经准备好地图了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sejjer Valencia, u diġà għandi l-mappa.
messages.mt_standard: Sejjer Valencia, u diġà għandi l-mappa.
messages.zh: 我要去瓦伦西亚，而且已经准备好地图了。
messages.en: I'm going to Valencia, and I already have the map.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Valencia 写在想象中的旅行地图上，配合 lejn Valencia（前往瓦伦西亚）一起记，看到大写首字母便联想到地名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A briefcase is a case used for carrying documents and other items needed for work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于携带文件和其他工作用品的公文包。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Valiġetta hija baskett li jintuża biex jinġarru dokumenti u affarijiet oħra meħtieġa għax-xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公文包，用于装载文件及工作用品的包。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Valiġetta hija baskett għad-dokumenti u għal affarijiet oħra li persuna ġġorr magħha għax-xogħol.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A briefcase is a bag or case in which you carry documents and other things for work.

formal.mt: Qabel il-laqgħa, is-segretarja poġġiet id-dokumenti kollha fil-valiġetta.
formal.en: Before the meeting, the secretary placed all the documents in the briefcase.
formal.zh: 会议开始前，秘书把所有文件都放进了公文包。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Rajt il-valiġetta tiegħi? Mark: Iva, qiegħda ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Marta: Have you seen my briefcase? Mark: Yes, it's next to the door.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你看见我的公文包了吗？马克：看见了，就在门旁边。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.zh: 你看见我的公文包了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen my briefcase?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 看见了，就在门旁边。
messages.en: Yes, it's next to the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象上班前把文件放进 valiġetta，再练习 il-valiġetta tiegħi（我的公文包）；用装文件的动作帮助记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Valletta is the name of the capital city of Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 瓦莱塔，马耳他首都的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Valletta huwa l-isem tal-belt kapitali ta' Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: Valletta, the capital city of Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 瓦莱塔，马耳他的首都。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Valletta hija l-belt kapitali ta' Malta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Valletta is the city that serves as the capital of Malta.

formal.mt: Il-lezzjoni tal-ġeografija tispjega li Valletta hija l-belt kapitali ta' Malta.
formal.en: The geography lesson explains that Valletta is the capital city of Malta.
formal.zh: 地理课讲解了瓦莱塔是马耳他的首都。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għada sejrin Valletta? David: Iva, niltaqgħu hemm fid-disgħa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are we going to Valletta tomorrow? David: Yes, let's meet there at nine.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们明天去瓦莱塔吗？戴维：去，我们九点在那里见吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们明天去瓦莱塔吗？
messages.en: Are we going to Valletta tomorrow?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 去，我们九点在那里见吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's meet there at nine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在记忆卡上把 Valletta 与 Malta 配成“城市—国家”一组，再写上“首都”；注意 Valletta 中连续的 ll 和 tt。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A value established by deduction from known information, or a method used to establish such a value.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据已知信息推导确定的数值，或用这种推导方式确定数值的方法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Valur deduttiv huwa valur li jiġi stabbilit permezz ta' deduzzjoni minn informazzjoni magħrufa; l-espressjoni tista' tindika wkoll il-metodu użat biex jiġi stabbilit dak il-valur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 推导值，即根据已知信息通过推导确定的数值。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Valur deduttiv huwa valur li jinkiseb permezz ta' deduzzjoni minn informazzjoni magħrufa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A deductive value is a value established by drawing conclusions from information that is already known.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 推导估值法，即依据已知信息通过推导来确定数值的方法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-metodu tal-valur deduttiv huwa mod kif jiġi stabbilit valur permezz ta' deduzzjoni minn informazzjoni magħrufa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The deductive value method is a procedure for establishing a value by deduction from known information.

collocations.en: the calculation of the deductive value

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega l-metodu tal-valur deduttiv u juri kif inkiseb il-valur mill-informazzjoni disponibbli.
formal.en: The report explains the deductive value method and shows how the value was obtained from the available information.
formal.zh: 报告解释了推导估值法，并展示了如何根据现有信息得出该数值。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif wasalt għal dan il-valur deduttiv? Toni: Bdejt mill-informazzjoni li kellna u ktibt kull pass tal-kalkolu.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did you arrive at this deductive value? Toni: I started with the information we had and wrote down every step of the calculation.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你是怎样得出这个推导值的？托尼：我从我们掌握的信息入手，写下了计算的每一步。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif wasalt għal dan il-valur deduttiv?
messages.mt_standard: Kif wasalt għal dan il-valur deduttiv?
messages.zh: 你是怎样得出这个推导值的？
messages.en: How did you arrive at this deductive value?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Bdejt mill-informazzjoni li kellna u ktibt kull pass tal-kalkolu.
messages.mt_standard: Bdejt mill-informazzjoni li kellna u ktibt kull pass tal-kalkolu.
messages.zh: 我从我们掌握的信息入手，写下了计算的每一步。
messages.en: I started with the information we had and wrote down every step of the calculation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画出“已知信息→逐步推导→数值”的箭头链，把末端结果记作 valur deduttiv，把整套求值步骤记作 il-metodu tal-valur deduttiv。

gloss_zh: 海关估价；货物完税价格

teaching_sense.en_definition: The value assigned to goods for customs purposes, including the calculation of applicable duties.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为办理海关手续而确定的货物价值，可用作计算适用关税的依据。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-valur attribwit lill-merkanzija għal skopijiet doganali, inkluż il-kalkolu tad-dazji applikabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为海关管理和计税等目的确定的价值。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-valur stabbilit għal skopijiet doganali, bħall-ipproċessar tad-dikjarazzjoni u l-kalkolu tad-dazji.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The customs value is the value assigned to goods when they are assessed for customs purposes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海关对货物进行估价后确定的货物价值。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-valur tal-merkanzija kif jiġi stabbilit għall-finijiet tal-proċeduri doganali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The customs value of goods is their assessed value for use in customs procedures.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 计算应征关税时采用的计税价值，即完税价格。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-valur li jintuża bħala bażi għall-kalkolu tad-dazju dovut fuq il-merkanzija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The dutiable value is the amount on which a customs duty is calculated.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika l-valur doganali tal-oġġetti u jispjega kif ġie kkalkulat.
formal.en: The report states the customs value of the items and explains how it was calculated.
formal.zh: 报告列明了这些物品的海关估价，并解释了计算方法。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'valur doganali niżżel hawn? Lara: Iċċekkja d-dokument tal-valutazzjoni; il-valur doganali għandu jkun hemm.
colloquial.en: Mark: What customs value should I enter here? Lara: Check the valuation document; the customs value should be there.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这里该填多少海关估价？Lara：查一下估价文件，里面应该有海关估价。

messages.speaker: Mark (进口商)
messages.zh: 这里该填多少海关估价？
messages.en: What customs value should I enter here?

messages.speaker: Lara (报关代理)
messages.mt_spoken: Iċċekkja d-dokument tal-valutazzjoni; il-valur doganali għandu jkun hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Iċċekkja d-dokument tal-valutazzjoni; il-valur doganali għandu jkun hemm.
messages.zh: 查一下估价文件，里面应该有海关估价。
messages.en: Check the valuation document; the customs value should be there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语放进“货物过海关，先确定价值”的画面中记忆；遇到计税语境时，再联想到“完税价格”。

gloss_zh: 货物的海关估价；货物完税价格

teaching_sense.en_definition: The value of the goods established for customs purposes, including use as a basis for calculating duties.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为海关手续而确定的货物价值，可作为计算关税的依据；该短语明确指出估价对象是货物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-valur tal-merkanzija stabbilit għal skopijiet doganali, li jista' jintuża bħala bażi għall-kalkolu tad-dazji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为海关事务而确定的货物价值。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-valur attribwit lill-merkanzija għall-finijiet tal-proċeduri doganali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The customs value is the assessed value of the goods for customs purposes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 货物在海关估价中被确定的价值。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-valur tal-merkanzija kif jiġi ddeterminat matul il-valutazzjoni għal skopijiet doganali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The customs value of goods is the value established for those goods in a customs assessment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于计算货物应征关税的计税价值。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-valur tal-merkanzija li fuqu jiġi kkalkulat id-dazju dovut.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The dutiable value is the assessed amount used to calculate the duty payable on the goods.

collocations.en: the calculation of the customs value of the goods
verify the customs value of the goods

formal.mt: Il-valur doganali tal-merkanzija huwa indikat fid-dikjarazzjoni, flimkien mad-dettalji tal-kunsinna.
formal.en: The customs value of the goods is stated in the declaration, together with the shipment details.
formal.zh: 申报单列明了货物的海关估价及该批货物的运输详情。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn insib il-valur doganali tal-merkanzija? Pawlu: Fid-dikjarazzjoni; ejja niċċekkjawh flimkien.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where can I find the customs value of the goods? Pawlu: In the declaration; let's check it together.
colloquial.zh: Nina：在哪里能找到这批货物的海关估价？Pawlu：在申报单里，我们一起核对一下。

messages.speaker: Nina (物流助理)
messages.zh: 在哪里能找到这批货物的海关估价？
messages.en: Where can I find the customs value of the goods?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (报关代理)
messages.zh: 在申报单里，我们一起核对一下。
messages.en: In the declaration; let's check it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“海关估价＋货物的”分组记忆：先认出 valur doganali，再用 tal-merkanzija 提醒自己，估价对象是货物。

gloss_zh: 定额进口价值；固定标准进口价值

teaching_sense.en_definition: An import value set at a fixed standard rate for the goods concerned.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按固定标准为有关进口货物确定的价值。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Valur għall-merkanzija importata li jiġi stabbilit skont rata standard fissa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 按照固定标准确定的进口货物价值。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Valur ta' merkanzija importata kkalkulat abbażi ta' rata fissa standard.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A flat-rate import value is a value assigned to imported goods using a fixed standard rate.

formal.mt: Għal dan l-eżempju, il-kalkolu juża l-valur fiss ta' importazzjoni indikat fit-tabella.
formal.en: For this example, the calculation uses the flat-rate import value shown in the table.
formal.zh: 在本例中，计算采用表中列出的定额进口价值。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema valur nuża f'dan l-eżerċizzju? David: Uża l-valur fiss ta' importazzjoni li hemm fit-tabella.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which value should I use in this exercise? David: Use the flat-rate import value in the table.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这道练习该用哪个数值？David：用表中的定额进口价值。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这道练习该用哪个数值？
messages.en: Which value should I use in this exercise?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Uża l-valur fiss ta' importazzjoni li hemm fit-tabella.
messages.mt_standard: Uża l-valur fiss ta' importazzjoni li hemm fit-tabella.
messages.zh: 用表中的定额进口价值。
messages.en: Use the flat-rate import value in the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“进口货物查固定标准表”的画面记忆：valur 是价值，fiss 提醒固定，ta' importazzjoni 标明进口用途。

gloss_zh: 初始价值；购买价格；购买者价格；购买者价值

teaching_sense.en_definition: The value associated with goods from the purchasers' perspective, referring in context to an initial value or a purchase price.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从购买者角度表述的货物价值，依上下文可指初始价值、购买价格或购买者价值。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-valur marbut mal-oġġetti mill-perspettiva tax-xerrejja, li skont il-kuntest jista' jirreferi għall-valur inizjali jew għall-prezz tax-xiri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在相关计算或记录开始时采用的初始价值。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-valur li jintuża fil-bidu ta' kalkolu jew li jitniżżel meta jinbeda rekord.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An initial value is the value recorded or used at the beginning of a calculation or process.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 购买商品时支付或约定支付的价格。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-prezz li jitħallas jew li jkun miftiehem għax-xiri ta' oġġett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The purchase price is the amount paid or agreed to be paid when something is bought.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从购买者一方表述的商品购入价格。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-prezz tal-oġġetti kif jitqies mill-perspettiva ta' dawk li jixtruhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The purchasers' price is the price of goods considered from the perspective of those buying them.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从购买者角度表述的商品价值或估值。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-valur tal-oġġetti kif jitqies jew jiġi espress mill-perspettiva tax-xerrejja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The purchasers' value is the value of goods expressed from the perspective of the people buying them.

formal.mt: F'din it-tabella, il-valur għax-xerrejja jirreferi għall-prezz tax-xiri tal-oġġetti.
formal.en: In this table, the value for purchasers refers to the purchase price of the goods.
formal.zh: 在本表中，购买者价值指货物的购买价格。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawn, il-valur għax-xerrejja jfisser il-prezz tax-xiri? Toni: Iva, f'dan l-eżempju niżżlu l-ammont li ħallsu x-xerrejja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does the value for purchasers mean the purchase price here? Toni: Yes, in this example we enter the amount the purchasers paid.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里的购买者价值是指购买价格吗？Toni：是的，这个例子里填购买者支付的金额。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn, il-valur għax-xerrejja jfisser il-prezz tax-xiri?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn, il-valur għax-xerrejja jfisser il-prezz tax-xiri?
messages.zh: 这里的购买者价值是指购买价格吗？
messages.en: Does the value for purchasers mean the purchase price here?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, f'dan l-eżempju niżżlu l-ammont li ħallsu x-xerrejja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, f'dan l-eżempju niżżlu l-ammont li ħallsu x-xerrejja.
messages.zh: 是的，这个例子里填购买者支付的金额。
messages.en: Yes, in this example we enter the amount the purchasers paid.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“站在购买者一边看价值”记住短语，再看表头和定义，判断具体指初始价值、购买价格还是购买者价值。

gloss_zh: 计算值；经计算得出的数值

teaching_sense.en_definition: A numerical result obtained by applying a calculation to given data.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对给定数据进行计算后得到的数值。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Riżultat numeriku miksub billi jsir kalkolu fuq data mogħtija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 依据给定数据，通过计算得出的数值。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Valur numeriku li jinkiseb permezz ta' kalkolu abbażi ta' data mogħtija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A computed value is a numerical result obtained by performing a calculation on given data.

collocations.en: compare the computed value with the measured value
collocations.zh: 将计算值与测量值比较

formal.mt: Ir-rapport għandu jinkludi l-valur komputat u l-metodu użat biex jinkiseb.
formal.en: The report must include the computed value and the method used to obtain it.
formal.zh: 报告须列明计算值及其计算方法。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'valur komputat sibt? Mark: Sibt 24, imma għad irrid niċċekkja l-kalkolu.
colloquial.en: Sara: What computed value did you get? Mark: I got 24, but I still need to check the calculation.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你算出的数值是多少？马克：我算出24，不过还得检查一下计算过程。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你算出的数值是多少？
messages.en: What computed value did you get?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Sibt 24, imma għad irrid niċċekkja l-kalkolu.
messages.mt_standard: Sibt 24, imma għad irrid niċċekkja l-kalkolu.
messages.zh: 我算出24，不过还得检查一下计算过程。
messages.en: I got 24, but I still need to check the calculation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个短语和“输入数据→进行计算→得到数值”连起来记；箭头终点就是计算值。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A normal value calculated as an average in which individual values contribute according to assigned weights.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将各项正常值按照指定权重求平均后得到的数值。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Valur normali miksub billi tittieħed medja ta' diversi valuri normali, fejn kull valur jikkontribwixxi skont il-piż assenjat lilu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 各项正常值按各自权重计算得出的平均正常值。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Medja ta' valuri normali kkalkulata billi kull valur jingħata piż li jiddetermina kemm jikkontribwixxi għar-riżultat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A weighted average normal value combines normal values into an average according to the weight assigned to each.

collocations.en: the calculation of the weighted average normal value
collocations.zh: 加权平均正常值的计算

collocations.mt: qabbel il-prezz mal-valur normali medju peżat
collocations.en: compare the price with the weighted average normal value
collocations.zh: 将价格与加权平均正常值比较

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jippreżenta l-valur normali medju peżat u jispeċifika l-piż mogħti lil kull valur inkluż fil-kalkolu.
formal.en: The report presents the weighted average normal value and specifies the weight assigned to each value included in the calculation.
formal.zh: 报告列出了加权平均正常值，并说明了参与计算的各项数值所占的权重。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-valur normali medju peżat huwa eqreb lejn 12 milli lejn 20? Pawlu: Għax il-valur ta' 12 għandu piż akbar fil-kalkolu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is the weighted average normal value closer to 12 than to 20? Pawlu: Because the value of 12 has a greater weight in the calculation.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么加权平均正常值更接近12，而不是20？保罗：因为数值12在计算中所占的权重更大。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-valur normali medju peżat huwa eqreb lejn 12 milli lejn 20?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-valur normali medju peżat huwa eqreb lejn 12 milli lejn 20?
messages.zh: 为什么加权平均正常值更接近12，而不是20？
messages.en: Why is the weighted average normal value closer to 12 than to 20?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-valur ta' 12 għandu piż akbar fil-kalkolu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-valur ta' 12 għandu piż akbar fil-kalkolu.
messages.zh: 因为数值12在计算中所占的权重更大。
messages.en: Because the value of 12 has a greater weight in the calculation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象各项正常值在拉动平均值：权重越大，拉力越强；把“正常值、平均、权重”三个意思一起记。

gloss_zh: 合约名义规模；合约名义价值

teaching_sense.en_definition: The reference amount or value used to express a contract's underlying scale and calculate amounts due under it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于表示合约标的规模并计算合约项下相关款项的参考金额或价值，不一定等于实际支付或交换的金额。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ammont jew valur ta' referenza li jintuża biex jesprimi d-daqs sottostanti ta' kuntratt u biex jiġu kkalkulati ħlasijiet marbuta miegħu, mingħajr ma jkun neċessarjament l-ammont li jitħallas jew jiġi skambjat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 合约所代表的名义规模，即用于表示其标的规模的参考金额，不一定是实际投入或交付的金额。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-daqs ta' kuntratt espress bħala ammont ta' referenza li jirrappreżenta l-iskala sottostanti tiegħu, u li mhux neċessarjament ikun l-ammont investit jew imħallas.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The notional contract size is the reference amount that expresses the underlying scale represented by a contract.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 合约标的所对应的名义货币价值，用作计算相关付款等的参考，不一定等于合约本身的市场价值。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-valur monetarju ta' referenza tal-ammont sottostanti rappreżentat minn kuntratt, li jintuża għal kalkoli bħall-ħlasijiet u mhux neċessarjament ikun il-valur tas-suq tal-kuntratt innifsu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The notional contract value is the monetary reference value of a contract's underlying amount, which may differ from the contract's market value.

collocations.mt: ħlas ibbażat fuq il-valur nozzjonali tal-kuntratt
collocations.en: a payment based on the notional contract value
collocations.zh: 以合约名义价值为基础计算的付款

formal.mt: Id-dokument jispeċifika li l-valur nozzjonali tal-kuntratt huwa miljun ewro u li l-ħlasijiet jiġu kkalkulati fuq din il-bażi.
formal.en: The document specifies that the notional contract value is one million euros and that payments are calculated on this basis.
formal.zh: 文件规定，合约名义价值为一百万欧元，相关付款以此为基础计算。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-valur nozzjonali tal-kuntratt huwa miljun ewro. Irrid inħallas dak kollu? David: Mhux bilfors; dak huwa l-ammont ta' referenza. Il-kuntratt jgħid kemm trid tħallas.
colloquial.en: Nina: The notional contract value is one million euros. Do I have to pay all of that? David: Not necessarily; that is the reference amount. The contract states how much you have to pay.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：合约名义价值是一百万欧元。我得付这么多吗？戴维：不一定；那是参考金额。具体要付多少，合约里有规定。

messages.speaker: Nina (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-valur nozzjonali tal-kuntratt huwa miljun ewro. Irrid inħallas dak kollu?
messages.mt_standard: Il-valur nozzjonali tal-kuntratt huwa miljun ewro. Irrid inħallas dak kollu?
messages.zh: 合约名义价值是一百万欧元。我得付这么多吗？
messages.en: The notional contract value is one million euros. Do I have to pay all of that?

messages.speaker: David (培训讲师)
messages.mt_spoken: Mhux bilfors; dak huwa l-ammont ta' referenza. Il-kuntratt jgħid kemm trid tħallas.
messages.mt_standard: Mhux bilfors; dak huwa l-ammont ta' referenza. Il-kuntratt jgħid kemm trid tħallas.
messages.zh: 不一定；那是参考金额。具体要付多少，合约里有规定。
messages.en: Not necessarily; that is the reference amount. The contract states how much you have to pay.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把名义价值想成合约计算时使用的“大尺子”：它表示参考规模，实际付款还要看合约规定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The target frequency entered into a device or control system for it to reach or maintain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在设备或控制系统中设定的、要求设备达到或维持的目标频率。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-frekwenza mixtieqa li tiġi ssettjata f'apparat jew f'sistema ta' kontroll sabiex l-apparat jilħaqha jew iżommha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 输入控制设备或系统、作为调节目标的频率数值。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Valur tal-frekwenza ssettjat f'apparat jew f'sistema ta' kontroll li jservi bħala mira għar-regolazzjoni tal-frekwenza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A frequency setpoint is the target frequency that a device or control system is instructed to reach or maintain.

collocations.mt: issettja l-valur programmat tal-frekwenza għal 50 Hz
collocations.en: set the frequency setpoint to 50 Hz
collocations.zh: 将频率设定值设为50赫兹

formal.mt: Matul it-test, il-valur programmat tal-frekwenza ġie ssettjat għal 50 Hz, u l-frekwenza attwali ġiet irreġistrata kull sekonda.
formal.en: During the test, the frequency setpoint was set to 50 Hz, and the actual frequency was recorded every second.
formal.zh: 测试期间，频率设定值被设为50赫兹，并且每秒记录一次实际频率。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'inhu l-valur programmat tal-frekwenza bħalissa? Ġużeppi: Huwa 50 Hz, imma l-apparat għadu qed juri 48 Hz.
colloquial.en: Marija: What is the frequency setpoint right now? Ġużeppi: It is 50 Hz, but the device is still showing 48 Hz.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：现在的频率设定值是多少？朱塞佩：是50赫兹，不过设备上显示的还是48赫兹。

messages.speaker: Marija (技术员)
messages.zh: 现在的频率设定值是多少？
messages.en: What is the frequency setpoint right now?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (操作员)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa 50 Hz, imma l-apparat għadu qed juri 48 Hz.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa 50 Hz, imma l-apparat għadu qed juri 48 Hz.
messages.zh: 是50赫兹，不过设备上显示的还是48赫兹。
messages.en: It is 50 Hz, but the device is still showing 48 Hz.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象控制面板上“目标50赫兹、当前48赫兹”两栏：目标栏帮助你记住频率设定值的意思。

gloss_zh: 预定值；按计划列明的数值

teaching_sense.en_definition: A value specified in advance in a schedule or plan.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在时间表、计划或明细表中预先列明的数值。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Valur stabbilit minn qabel u indikat fi skeda jew fi pjan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在计划或明细表中预先规定的数值。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Valur li jkun ġie stabbilit minn qabel u mniżżel fi skeda jew fi pjan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A scheduled value is a figure specified in advance in a schedule or plan.

collocations.en: the scheduled value for the period
to compare the actual value with the scheduled value
collocations.zh: 将实际值与预定值进行比较

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iqabbel il-valur attwali mal-valur skedat għal kull xahar u jispjega kull differenza.
formal.en: The report compares the actual value with the scheduled value for each month and explains every difference.
formal.zh: 报告逐月比较实际值与预定值，并解释各项差异。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu l-valur skedat għal dan ix-xahar? Mark: Mitejn ewro. Il-valur attwali għadu ma ġiex ikkonfermat.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is the scheduled value for this month? Mark: Two hundred euros. The actual value has not been confirmed yet.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个月的预定值是多少？马克：二百欧元。实际值还没有确认。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu l-valur skedat għal dan ix-xahar?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu l-valur skedat għal dan ix-xahar?
messages.zh: 这个月的预定值是多少？
messages.en: What is the scheduled value for this month?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mitejn ewro. Il-valur attwali għadu ma ġiex ikkonfermat.
messages.mt_standard: Mitejn ewro. Il-valur attwali għadu ma ġiex ikkonfermat.
messages.zh: 二百欧元。实际值还没有确认。
messages.en: Two hundred euros. The actual value has not been confirmed yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词组记成“计划表里先填好的数”：看到 valur skedat，就联想左栏是预定值，右栏是实际值，方便成对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The monetary value of a particular transaction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某笔交易以货币表示的价值或金额。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-valur fi flus ta' tranżazzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某笔交易所涉及的货币价值或金额。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-ammont ta' flus li jirrappreżenta l-valur ta' tranżazzjoni partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The transaction value is the monetary amount associated with a particular transaction.

formal.mt: Il-fattura għandha tindika l-valur tat-tranżazzjoni u l-munita użata għall-ħlas.
formal.en: The invoice should indicate the transaction value and the currency used for payment.
formal.zh: 发票应注明交易金额以及付款所用的货币。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm hu l-valur tat-tranżazzjoni? Mark: Ħames mitt ewro. L-istess ammont jidher fuq il-fattura.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is the transaction value? Mark: Five hundred euros. The same amount appears on the invoice.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这笔交易的金额是多少？马克：五百欧元。发票上也是这个金额。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这笔交易的金额是多少？
messages.en: What is the transaction value?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħames mitt ewro. L-istess ammont jidher fuq il-fattura.
messages.mt_standard: Ħames mitt ewro. L-istess ammont jidher fuq il-fattura.
messages.zh: 五百欧元。发票上也是这个金额。
messages.en: Five hundred euros. The same amount appears on the invoice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张发票，把“这笔交易值多少钱”圈出来，旁边写上 valur tat-tranżazzjoni，用具体交易金额帮助记住整个词组。

gloss_zh: 因果关系评估；因果关系评估方法

teaching_sense.en_definition: An evaluation of whether one event caused another, or a method used to make that evaluation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 评估某一事件是否导致另一事件的过程，也可指进行这种评估所采用的方法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Eżami biex jiġi stabbilit jekk avveniment ikkawżax ieħor, jew metodu użat biex isir dan l-eżami.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某一事件与另一事件之间是否存在因果关系所作的评估。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Evalwazzjoni tal-evidenza biex jiġi stabbilit jekk avveniment wieħed ikkawżax avveniment ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A causality assessment examines evidence to determine whether one event caused another.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于评估两个事件之间是否存在因果关系的一套程序或方法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sett ta' passi jew kriterji użati biex jiġi evalwat jekk hemmx rabta ta' kawża u effett bejn żewġ avvenimenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A causality assessment method provides a structured procedure for evaluating whether one event caused another.

collocations.en: to carry out a causality assessment
the results of the causality assessment

formal.mt: It-tim wettaq valutazzjoni tal-kawżalità biex jeżamina jekk il-bidla fil-proċess kinitx ikkawżat iż-żieda fl-iżbalji. Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-metodu użat u r-riżultati.
formal.en: The team carried out a causality assessment to examine whether the change in the process had caused the increase in errors. The report describes the method used and the results.
formal.zh: 团队开展了因果关系评估，以考察流程变更是否导致错误增加。报告说明了所用方法及评估结果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: L-iżbalji żdiedu wara l-bidla. Dan ifisser li l-bidla kkawżathom? Mark: Mhux bilfors. Irridu nagħmlu valutazzjoni tal-kawżalità u nħarsu wkoll lejn spjegazzjonijiet oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Errors increased after the change. Does that mean the change caused them? Mark: Not necessarily. We need to carry out a causality assessment and consider other explanations too.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：变更之后错误增加了。这就说明错误是变更造成的吗？马克：不一定。我们需要做因果关系评估，也要考虑其他解释。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: L-iżbalji żdiedu wara l-bidla. Dan ifisser li l-bidla kkawżathom?
messages.mt_standard: L-iżbalji żdiedu wara l-bidla. Dan ifisser li l-bidla kkawżathom?
messages.zh: 变更之后错误增加了。这就说明错误是变更造成的吗？
messages.en: Errors increased after the change. Does that mean the change caused them?

messages.speaker: Mark (研究员)
messages.mt_spoken: Mhux bilfors. Irridu nagħmlu valutazzjoni tal-kawżalità u nħarsu wkoll lejn spjegazzjonijiet oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Mhux bilfors. Irridu nagħmlu valutazzjoni tal-kawżalità u nħarsu wkoll lejn spjegazzjonijiet oħra.
messages.zh: 不一定。我们需要做因果关系评估，也要考虑其他解释。
messages.en: Not necessarily. We need to carry out a causality assessment and consider other explanations too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“先后发生，还要查因果”来记这个词组：把两个事件之间的箭头画成问号，再用评估证据填上答案；也记住它可指所用的评估方法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A valve that controls the release of liquid as a spray.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 控制液体以喷雾形式释放的阀门。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Valv li jikkontrolla l-ħruġ ta' likwidu f'għamla ta' sprej.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于控制喷雾释放的阀门。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Valv li jiftaħ jew jagħlaq il-passaġġ ta' likwidu li joħroġ bħala sprej.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A spray valve is a device that controls when liquid is released as a spray.

formal.mt: Qabel l-użu, iċċekkja li l-valv ta' l-isprej ikun nadif u jaħdem sew.
formal.en: Before use, check that the spray valve is clean and working properly.
formal.zh: 使用前，请检查喷雾阀是否清洁且运作正常。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex mhu ħiereġ xejn mill-flixkun? Toni: Jista' jkun li l-valv ta' l-isprej huwa mblukkat. Ejja niċċekkjawh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is nothing coming out of the bottle? Toni: The spray valve might be blocked. Let's check it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：为什么瓶子里什么也喷不出来？Toni：可能是喷雾阀堵住了。我们检查一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 为什么瓶子里什么也喷不出来？
messages.en: Why is nothing coming out of the bottle?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jista' jkun li l-valv ta' l-isprej huwa mblukkat. Ejja niċċekkjawh.
messages.mt_standard: Jista' jkun li l-valv ta' l-isprej huwa mblukkat. Ejja niċċekkjawh.
messages.zh: 可能是喷雾阀堵住了。我们检查一下。
messages.en: The spray valve might be blocked. Let's check it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象按下喷瓶时，阀门打开才有细雾喷出，把整个词组与这个动作一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A valve that regulates the amount of fluid passing through it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于调节通过的流体量、使其符合所需用量的阀门。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Valv li jirregola l-kwantità ta' fluwidu li tgħaddi minnu biex joħroġ l-ammont meħtieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 控制流体通过量，以实现定量供给或精确调节的阀门。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Valv li jikkontrolla b'mod preċiż l-ammont ta' fluwidu li jgħaddi minn sistema.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A metering valve regulates fluid flow so that the required amount passes through a system.

formal.mt: It-tekniku aġġusta l-valv tal-kejl biex jirregola l-ammont ta' likwidu li jidħol fis-sistema.
formal.en: The technician adjusted the metering valve to regulate the amount of liquid entering the system.
formal.zh: 技术人员调节了计量阀，以控制进入系统的液体量。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qiegħed taġġusta dak il-valv? Mark: Dan hu l-valv tal-kejl. Qiegħed nirregola kemm likwidu jgħaddi minnu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you adjusting that valve? Mark: This is the metering valve. I'm regulating how much liquid passes through it.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么在调那个阀门？Mark：这是计量阀。我在调节通过它的液体量。

messages.speaker: Sara (学徒)
messages.zh: 你为什么在调那个阀门？
messages.en: Why are you adjusting that valve?

messages.speaker: Mark (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu l-valv tal-kejl. Qiegħed nirregola kemm likwidu jgħaddi minnu.
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu l-valv tal-kejl. Qiegħed nirregola kemm likwidu jgħaddi minnu.
messages.zh: 这是计量阀。我在调节通过它的液体量。
messages.en: This is the metering valve. I'm regulating how much liquid passes through it.
