cognitive_memory_aid: 把计量阀想成控制每次放出多少液体的小关口，用“定量放行”的画面记住词组。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A valve that regulates the flow of steam to a machine or engine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过调节蒸汽流量来控制机器或发动机运行的阀门。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Valvola li tirregola l-fluss tal-istim lejn magna jew mutur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于调节进入机器或发动机的蒸汽流量的节流阀。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Valvola li tikkontrolla l-ammont ta' fwar li jgħaddi lejn magna jew mutur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A throttle in this context is a valve that controls how much steam reaches a machine or engine.

formal.mt: Id-dijagramma turi kif il-valvola tal-istim tirregola l-fluss tal-fwar lejn il-magna.
formal.en: The diagram shows how the steam throttle regulates the flow of steam to the engine.
formal.zh: 图示说明蒸汽节流阀如何调节进入发动机的蒸汽流量。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-valvola tal-istim x'tagħmel? Mark: Tirregola kemm fwar jidħol fil-magna. Ara, tidher ukoll fid-dijagramma.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does this steam throttle do? Mark: It regulates how much steam enters the engine. Look, it is shown in the diagram too.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个蒸汽节流阀有什么作用？马克：它调节进入发动机的蒸汽量。你看，图里也画出来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (学员)
messages.zh: 这个蒸汽节流阀有什么作用？
messages.en: What does this steam throttle do?

messages.speaker: Mark (技术讲师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tirregola kemm fwar jidħol fil-magna. Ara, tidher ukoll fid-dijagramma.
messages.mt_standard: Tirregola kemm fwar jidħol fil-magna. Ara, tidher ukoll fid-dijagramma.
messages.zh: 它调节进入发动机的蒸汽量。你看，图里也画出来了。
messages.en: It regulates how much steam enters the engine. Look, it is shown in the diagram too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象蒸汽管道上有一扇可调大小的小门：门开大，蒸汽通过更多；门关小，通过更少。用这个画面记住蒸汽节流阀的作用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An upward adjustment in the assessed or recorded value of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将某物的评估价值或账面价值向上调整的行为或结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Aġġustament li bih jiżdied il-valur stmat jew irreġistrat ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将价格或估定价值向上调整的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jiżdied il-prezz jew il-valur mogħti lil xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Marking up is the process of increasing an item's price or assigned value.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在原价格或成本基础上增加的金额或比例。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-ammont jew il-perċentwal li jiżdied mal-prezz oriġinali jew mal-ispiża ta' oġġett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A markup is an amount added to an item's original price or cost.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 会计上将资产账面价值调高的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Aġġustament fil-kontijiet li bih jiżdied il-valur irreġistrat ta' assi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A write up is an accounting adjustment that raises the recorded value of an asset.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 资产账面价值的向上调整，或由此产生的账面增值额。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żieda fil-valur ta' assi rreġistrata fil-kontijiet, jew l-ammont ta' dik iż-żieda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A write-up records an increase in an asset's book value, or denotes the increase itself.

collocations.en: an upward valuation of the property

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega r-raġunijiet għall-valwazzjoni pożittiva tal-proprjetà u jindika l-valur il-ġdid tagħha.
formal.en: The report explains the reasons for the upward valuation of the property and states its new value.
formal.zh: 报告解释了该房产估值调增的原因，并列明其新估值。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-valur tal-bini żdied fil-kontijiet? Pawlu: Saret valwazzjoni pożittiva wara stima ġdida.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why has the building's value increased in the accounts? Pawlu: An upward adjustment was made following a new valuation.
colloquial.zh: Lara：为什么账上这栋楼的价值增加了？Pawlu：重新估价后，账面价值作了向上调整。

messages.speaker: Lara (企业主)
messages.zh: 为什么账上这栋楼的价值增加了？
messages.en: Why has the building's value increased in the accounts?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (会计师)
messages.mt_spoken: Saret valwazzjoni pożittiva wara stima ġdida.
messages.mt_standard: Saret valwazzjoni pożittiva wara stima ġdida.
messages.zh: 重新估价后，账面价值作了向上调整。
messages.en: An upward adjustment was made following a new valuation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象估值表上的数字旁画着向上箭头：这里要记的是价值调高，结合价格或账面价值语境理解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dance in triple time, or a piece of music for this dance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种三拍子的双人舞，也指伴奏这种舞蹈的乐曲。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żifna għal koppja b'ritmu ta' tliet taħbitiet f'kull battuta, jew biċċa mużika għal din iż-żifna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 华尔兹，一种三拍子的双人舞；也指华尔兹舞曲。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żifna li fiha koppja ddur b'ritmu ta' tliet taħbitiet f'kull battuta, jew il-mużika li takkumpanjaha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A waltz is a dance for two people in triple time, or music written for that dance.

formal.mt: Waqt il-kunċert, l-orkestra daqqet valz b'ritmu ċar ta' tliet taħbitiet f'kull battuta.
formal.en: During the concert, the orchestra played a waltz with a clear rhythm of three beats per bar.
formal.zh: 音乐会上，管弦乐团演奏了一首每小节三拍、节奏清晰的华尔兹舞曲。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Taf tiżfen il-valz? David: Ftit biss. Tista' turini l-passi?
colloquial.en: Nina: Can you dance the waltz? David: Only a little. Can you show me the steps?
colloquial.zh: Nina：你会跳华尔兹吗？David：只会一点点。你能教我舞步吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你会跳华尔兹吗？
messages.en: Can you dance the waltz?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 只会一点点。你能教我舞步吗？
messages.en: Only a little. Can you show me the steps?

cognitive_memory_aid: 默念“一二三、一二三”，想象两人随着三拍子旋转，把 valz 同舞蹈和舞曲一起记住。

gloss_zh: 蓄意破坏公物或他人财物的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who deliberately damages or destroys public property or other people's belongings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 故意损坏或毁坏公共设施或他人财物的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li apposta tagħmel ħsara lil proprjetà pubblika jew lil affarijiet ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蓄意损坏或毁坏公共财产或他人财物的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li apposta tkisser jew tagħmel ħsara lil proprjetà pubblika jew privata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A vandal is someone who deliberately damages or destroys property belonging to other people or the public.

collocations.zh: 抓住一名蓄意破坏财物的人

formal.mt: Il-vandalu kisser żewġ bankijiet fil-ġnien pubbliku u għamel ħsara lill-ilqugħ.
formal.en: The vandal broke two benches in the public garden and damaged the fence.
formal.zh: 那名破坏者砸坏了公共花园里的两张长椅，还损坏了围栏。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt x'għamel dak il-vandalu mal-bank? Mark: Iva, kissru. Issa m'għandniex fejn noqogħdu bilqiegħda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see what that vandal did to the bench? Mark: Yes, he broke it. Now we have nowhere to sit.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看到那个破坏者把长椅怎么了吗？马克：看到了，他把它弄坏了。现在我们都没地方坐了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到那个破坏者把长椅怎么了吗？
messages.en: Did you see what that vandal did to the bench?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kissru. Issa m'għandniex fejn noqogħdu bilqiegħda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kissru. Issa m'għandniex fejn noqogħdu bilqiegħda.
messages.zh: 看到了，他把它弄坏了。现在我们都没地方坐了。
messages.en: Yes, he broke it. Now we have nowhere to sit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 vandalu 和“长椅被故意砸坏”的画面联记：这个词指实施破坏的人，不是破坏行为本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flavouring obtained from vanilla pods and used especially in sweet foods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由香草荚取得的调味料，常用于甜食，带有特有的香气和味道。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza li tinkiseb mill-imżiewed tal-pjanta tal-vanilla u tintuża biex tagħti togħma u riħa, speċjalment lill-ħelu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 香草调味料；从香草荚取得、常用来给蛋糕和冰淇淋等甜食增香的材料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sustanza aromatika mill-imżiewed tal-pjanta tal-vanilla, użata biex tagħti togħma lil ikel bħal kejkijiet u ġelat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Vanilla is a flavouring made from vanilla pods that gives cakes, ice cream, and other foods a sweet, distinctive flavour.

formal.mt: Żid kuċċarina estratt tal-vanilla mat-taħlita tal-kejk u ħawwad sew.
formal.en: Add a teaspoon of vanilla extract to the cake mixture and stir well.
formal.zh: 在蛋糕糊中加入一茶匙香草精，然后充分搅拌。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi ġelat trid, tal-vanilla jew taċ-ċikkulata? Luka: Tal-vanilla, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which ice cream would you like, vanilla or chocolate? Luka: Vanilla, please.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你想吃哪种冰淇淋，香草的还是巧克力的？卢卡：香草的，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Sara (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ġelat trid, tal-vanilla jew taċ-ċikkulata?
messages.mt_standard: Xi ġelat trid, tal-vanilla jew taċ-ċikkulata?
messages.zh: 你想吃哪种冰淇淋，香草的还是巧克力的？
messages.en: Which ice cream would you like, vanilla or chocolate?

messages.speaker: Luka (顾客)
messages.zh: 香草的，谢谢。
messages.en: Vanilla, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 vanilla 放进“香草冰淇淋”的点餐画面中记忆，再用 estratt tal-vanilla 联记烘焙用的香草精。

gloss_zh: 厢式货车；客货两用厢式车

teaching_sense.en_definition: An enclosed road vehicle used to carry goods or a small group of passengers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有封闭车厢、用于运送货物或少量乘客的机动车。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vettura b'kompartiment magħluq li tintuża biex iġġorr merkanzija jew grupp żgħir ta' passiġġieri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 厢式车；具有封闭车厢、用于载货或载送少量乘客的车辆。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Vettura li għandha spazju magħluq fuq wara għall-ġarr ta' oġġetti jew ta' numru żgħir ta' nies.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A van is an enclosed road vehicle used for transporting goods or carrying a small number of passengers.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija tuża vann biex twassal il-pakketti lill-klijenti kull filgħodu.
formal.en: The company uses a van to deliver parcels to customers every morning.
formal.zh: 这家公司每天早上用一辆厢式车给客户送包裹。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-mejda ma tidħolx fil-karozza. Pawlu: Nistgħu nikru vann għal għada.
colloquial.en: Nina: The table won't fit in the car. Pawlu: We can rent a van for tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这张桌子放不进小汽车。保罗：我们可以租辆厢式车，明天用。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这张桌子放不进小汽车。
messages.en: The table won't fit in the car.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们可以租辆厢式车，明天用。
messages.en: We can rent a van for tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 vann 就想象打开后门、把桌子搬进封闭车厢的场景，用“搬家租厢式车”帮助记住词义。

gloss_zh: 有益的；有利的；有优势的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Bringing a benefit or giving someone a favourable position or opportunity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够带来益处，或使人在条件、处境或机会方面占有优势的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġib benefiċċju jew jagħti lil xi ħadd kundizzjonijiet jew opportunitajiet aħjar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有益的；能够产生良好作用或带来实际益处的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jagħmel il-ġid jew iġib riżultat tajjeb għal persuna jew għal xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is beneficial has a good effect or brings a useful improvement to someone or something.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有利的；能够提供较好条件、机会或相对优势的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jagħti vantaġġ lil xi ħadd jew ipoġġih f'qagħda aħjar biex jilħaq dak li jrid.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is advantageous gives you better conditions or a stronger position for achieving what you want.

formal.mt: Il-ftehim il-ġdid huwa vantaġġjuż għall-kumpanija għax inaqqas l-ispejjeż tat-trasport.
formal.en: The new agreement is advantageous to the company because it reduces transport costs.
formal.zh: 这项新协议对公司有利，因为它降低了运输成本。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taħseb li dan l-abbonament huwa vantaġġjuż għalija? Mark: Iva, jekk tuża l-karozza tal-linja kuljum, tiffranka l-flus.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you think this pass would be good value for me? Mark: Yes, if you take the bus every day, you'll save money.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得这张乘车通票对我来说划算吗？马克：划算，如果你每天坐公交车，就能省钱。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li dan l-abbonament huwa vantaġġjuż għalija?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li dan l-abbonament huwa vantaġġjuż għalija?
messages.zh: 你觉得这张乘车通票对我来说划算吗？
messages.en: Do you think this pass would be good value for me?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk tuża l-karozza tal-linja kuljum, tiffranka l-flus.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk tuża l-karozza tal-linja kuljum, tiffranka l-flus.
messages.zh: 划算，如果你每天坐公交车，就能省钱。
messages.en: Yes, if you take the bus every day, you'll save money.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 vantaġġjuż 记成评价方案时的“能带来好处”：强调良好作用时译“有益”，强调条件或机会更好时译“有利”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A powerful boat used to tow or push other vessels, especially in a harbour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于拖曳或推动其他船只的动力强劲的船，常在港口协助大型船舶移动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bastiment b'magna qawwija li jirmonka jew jimbotta bastimenti oħra, speċjalment fil-port.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于拖曳、推动或协助其他船舶移动的拖船。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bastiment qawwi li jintuża biex jiġbed jew jimbotta bastimenti oħra u jgħinhom jiċċaqalqu fil-port jew fuq il-baħar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tugboat is a powerful boat that helps other vessels move by towing or pushing them.

formal.mt: Il-vapur tal-irmonk għen lill-bastiment il-kbir jidħol fil-port mingħajr periklu.
formal.en: The tugboat helped the large vessel enter the harbour safely.
formal.zh: 拖船协助大型船舶安全驶入港口。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex hemm vapur tal-irmonk ħdejn dak il-bastiment? Mark: Qed jgħinu jdur biex jidħol fil-port.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is there a tugboat beside that ship? Mark: It is helping the ship turn so it can enter the harbour.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那艘大船旁边为什么有一艘拖船？马克：它正在帮大船转向，好驶入港口。

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm vapur tal-irmonk ħdejn dak il-bastiment?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm vapur tal-irmonk ħdejn dak il-bastiment?
messages.zh: 那艘大船旁边为什么有一艘拖船？
messages.en: Why is there a tugboat beside that ship?

messages.speaker: Mark (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed jgħinu jdur biex jidħol fil-port.
messages.mt_standard: Qed jgħinu jdur biex jidħol fil-port.
messages.zh: 它正在帮大船转向，好驶入港口。
messages.en: It is helping the ship turn so it can enter the harbour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“小船帮大船转弯进港”的场景，把 vapur tal-irmonk 整组对应为拖船或拖轮。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large passenger ship used for holiday voyages, usually with accommodation, entertainment, and visits to several ports.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于度假航行的大型客船，通常提供住宿和娱乐设施，并停靠多个港口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vapur kbir tal-passiġġieri li jintuża għal vjaġġi ta' btala u normalment joffri akkomodazzjoni, divertiment u żjarat f'diversi portijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供旅客乘坐并在船上住宿、娱乐和度假的大型客船，通常沿途停靠不同港口。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bastiment kbir li fuqu l-passiġġieri jqattgħu btala, b'kabini fejn jorqdu u faċilitajiet ta' divertiment, u li normalment jieqaf f'portijiet differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cruise ship is a large passenger ship on which people take holidays, often visiting several ports during the voyage.

collocations.en: a cabin on a cruise ship

formal.mt: Il-vapur tal-kruċieri wasal fil-Port il-Kbir, fejn il-passiġġieri niżlu għal żjara fil-Belt Valletta.
formal.en: The cruise ship arrived in the Grand Harbour, where the passengers disembarked for a visit to Valletta.
formal.zh: 邮轮抵达大港，旅客在那里下船，前往瓦莱塔游览。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Se torqdu fuq il-vapur tal-kruċieri llejla? David: Iva, għandna kabina b'tieqa li tagħti għal fuq il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Nina: Are you sleeping on the cruise ship tonight? David: Yes, we have a cabin with a window overlooking the sea.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你们今晚睡在邮轮上吗？戴维：是啊，我们的客舱有一扇能看海的窗户。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se torqdu fuq il-vapur tal-kruċieri llejla?
messages.mt_standard: Se torqdu fuq il-vapur tal-kruċieri llejla?
messages.zh: 你们今晚睡在邮轮上吗？
messages.en: Are you sleeping on the cruise ship tonight?

messages.speaker: David (旅客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandna kabina b'tieqa li tagħti għal fuq il-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandna kabina b'tieqa li tagħti għal fuq il-baħar.
messages.zh: 是啊，我们的客舱有一扇能看海的窗户。
messages.en: Yes, we have a cabin with a window overlooking the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一座带客舱、餐厅和娱乐设施的海上度假酒店，把 vapur tal-kruċieri 与邮轮旅行一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fishing vessel that catches fish by towing a large net through the water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过在水中拖曳大型渔网来捕鱼的渔船。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bastiment tas-sajd li jaqbad il-ħut billi jiġbed xibka kbira fl-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拖曳大型渔网进行捕捞的渔船。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bastiment tas-sajd li juża xibka kbira miġbuda fl-ilma biex jaqbad il-ħut.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A trawler is a fishing boat that catches fish by pulling a large net through the water.

formal.mt: Il-vapurett telaq mill-port kmieni filgħodu u reġa' lura b'qabda tajba ta' ħut.
formal.en: The trawler left the harbour early in the morning and returned with a good catch of fish.
formal.zh: 拖网渔船清晨驶离港口，满载捕获的鱼返回。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dak il-vapurett sejjer jistad? Pawlu: Iva, ara x-xibka kbira fuq wara.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is that trawler going fishing? Pawlu: Yes, look at the large net at the back.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：那艘拖网渔船要去捕鱼吗？保罗：是啊，看船尾那张大渔网。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 那艘拖网渔船要去捕鱼吗？
messages.en: Is that trawler going fishing?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara x-xibka kbira fuq wara.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara x-xibka kbira fuq wara.
messages.zh: 是啊，看船尾那张大渔网。
messages.en: Yes, look at the large net at the back.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 vapurett 与“船尾拖着大渔网”的画面绑定，看到这个词就想起拖网捕鱼的渔船。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small body of still water, or a large container used to hold liquids or other materials.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指一处小型静水池塘，也可指盛放液体或其他物料的大槽或大缸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għadira żgħira ta' ilma wieqaf, jew reċipjent kbir li jintuża biex jinżammu fih likwidi jew materjali oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 面积较小、通常没有明显水流的水体，即池塘或水池。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għadira żgħira ta' ilma wieqaf, li tista' tkun naturali jew magħmula mill-bniedem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pond is a small area of still water, either natural or made by people.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于储存、混合或加工液体等物料的大型容器，如大槽或大缸。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reċipjent kbir li jintuża biex jinżammu, jitħalltu jew jiġu pproċessati likwidi jew materjali oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A vat is a large container used for holding, mixing, or processing liquids and other materials.

formal.mt: Il-pjan jinkludi vaska żgħira fil-ġnien u vaska kbira tal-fermentazzjoni fil-bini fejn isir l-inbid.
formal.en: The plan includes a small pond in the garden and a large fermentation vat in the building where wine is made.
formal.zh: 规划包括花园里的一处小池塘，以及酿酒建筑内的一座大型发酵槽。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Meta tgħid vaska, qed tfisser dik bil-ħut fil-ġnien? Toni: Le, qed ngħid il-vaska kbira fejn inħalltu l-meraq.
colloquial.en: Sara: When you say vaska, do you mean the pond with fish in the garden? Toni: No, I mean the large vat where we mix the juice.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你说 vaska，是指花园里养鱼的那个池塘吗？托尼：不是，我说的是我们混合果汁用的那个大槽。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tgħid vaska, qed tfisser dik bil-ħut fil-ġnien?
messages.mt_standard: Meta tgħid vaska, qed tfisser dik bil-ħut fil-ġnien?
messages.zh: 你说 vaska，是指花园里养鱼的那个池塘吗？
messages.en: When you say vaska, do you mean the pond with fish in the garden?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, qed ngħid il-vaska kbira fejn inħalltu l-meraq.
messages.mt_standard: Le, qed ngħid il-vaska kbira fejn inħalltu l-meraq.
messages.zh: 不是，我说的是我们混合果汁用的那个大槽。
messages.en: No, I mean the large vat where we mix the juice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 vaska 配两张记忆图：花园里有鱼的池塘、车间里盛液体的大槽；用场景区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Extremely large in area, extent, or scope.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面积、规模或涉及范围非常大的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kbir ħafna fl-erja, fl-estensjoni jew fil-firxa tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 广阔的；面积、规模或范围极大的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu erja, estensjoni jew firxa kbira ħafna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is vast is extremely large in area, extent, or scope.

formal.mt: L-istudju jkopri territorju vast u janalizza d-differenzi bejn ir-reġjuni.
formal.en: The study covers a vast territory and analyses the differences between the regions.
formal.zh: 这项研究涵盖广阔的地域，并分析各地区之间的差异。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-park huwa vast; minn fejn nibdew? Mark: Nibdew minn hawn u naraw il-bqija għada.
colloquial.en: Maja: This park is vast; where do we start? Mark: Let's start here and see the rest tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个公园真大；我们从哪里开始逛？Mark：从这里开始吧，剩下的明天再看。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-park huwa vast; minn fejn nibdew?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-park huwa vast; minn fejn nibdew?
messages.zh: 这个公园真大；我们从哪里开始逛？
messages.en: This park is vast; where do we start?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nibdew minn hawn u naraw il-bqija għada.
messages.mt_standard: Nibdew minn hawn u naraw il-bqija għada.
messages.zh: 从这里开始吧，剩下的明天再看。
messages.en: Let's start here and see the rest tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 vast 放进 territorju vast“广阔的领土”中记忆，想象地图上延伸到视野之外的一大片土地；也可把这个“大范围”画面迁移到知识领域。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A covering worn around a baby's neck to protect clothing from food or saliva.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围在婴儿颈部、遮住胸前衣服，以防食物或口水弄脏衣服的用品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa drapp jew materjal ieħor li titqiegħed madwar għonq tarbija u tgħatti sidirha biex tipproteġi l-ħwejjeġ mill-ikel jew mill-bżieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 婴儿围嘴；围在婴儿颈部、保护胸前衣服免受食物和口水沾污的用品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għata żgħira li tintlibes madwar għonq tarbija biex iżżomm il-ħwejjeġ tagħha nodfa waqt l-ikel jew meta joħroġilha l-bżieq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A baby bib is a protective covering placed around a baby's neck to keep food and saliva off their clothes.

collocations.en: put a bib on the baby

formal.mt: Qabel l-ikla, il-persuna li tieħu ħsieb it-tarbija għandha tlibbisha vavalor nadif biex tipproteġi l-ħwejjeġ tagħha.
formal.en: Before the meal, the baby's caregiver should put a clean bib on the baby to protect their clothes.
formal.zh: 用餐前，照护者应给婴儿戴上干净的围嘴，以保护婴儿的衣服。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hu l-vavalor tat-tarbija? Mark: Fil-kexxun; ilbishulha qabel tagħtiha l-ikel.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the baby's bib? Mark: In the drawer; put it on her before you feed her.
colloquial.zh: Lara：宝宝的围嘴在哪里？Mark：在抽屉里；喂她吃东西前先给她戴上。

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.zh: 宝宝的围嘴在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the baby's bib?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.zh: 在抽屉里；喂她吃东西前先给她戴上。
messages.en: In the drawer; put it on her before you feed her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 vavalor 与“宝宝吃饭前，胸前先围好”这个动作连起来记忆；脑中固定一幅围嘴接住食物、衣服保持干净的画面。

gloss_zh: 幼稚的人；天真而缺乏经验的年轻女子；轻信的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who behaves childishly or shows innocence and little experience of the world.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 行为幼稚，或天真而缺乏处世经验的人；也可指天真无经验的年轻女子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ġġib ruħha b'mod infantili jew li hija innoċenti u għandha ftit esperjenza tad-dinja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 言行幼稚、表现得不成熟的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li ġġib ruħha b'mod infantili u turi nuqqas ta' maturità fl-imġiba tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A childish person behaves in an immature way that is more typical of a child.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天真单纯、缺乏社会经验的年轻女子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mara żagħżugħa li hija innoċenti u għadha ma għandhiex wisq esperjenza tad-dinja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An ingenue is an innocent young woman who has little experience of the world.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因缺乏经验或判断力而容易相信别人的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li temmen lil ħaddieħor malajr wisq minħabba nuqqas ta' esperjenza jew ta' ġudizzju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A naive person trusts others too readily because they lack experience or sound judgement.

collocations.en: a naive person who believes everything

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-protagonist jidher bħala vavu li jemmen kull wegħda mingħajr ma jistaqsi.
formal.en: In the novel, the protagonist appears as a naive person who believes every promise without asking questions.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，主人公显得十分天真，对每一个承诺都不加追问地相信。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qaluli li rbħajt premju, imma jridu l-flus l-ewwel. Mark: Tkunx vavu; iċċekkja sew qabel tibgħat il-flus.
colloquial.en: Maja: They told me I won a prize, but they want money first. Mark: Don't be naive; check carefully before you send any money.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他们说我中奖了，但要我先付钱。Mark：别这么轻信；汇钱之前先仔细核实。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qaluli li rbħajt premju, imma jridu l-flus l-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Qaluli li rbħajt premju, imma jridu l-flus l-ewwel.
messages.zh: 他们说我中奖了，但要我先付钱。
messages.en: They told me I won a prize, but they want money first.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tkunx vavu; iċċekkja sew qabel tibgħat il-flus.
messages.mt_standard: Tkunx vavu; iċċekkja sew qabel tibgħat il-flus.
messages.zh: 别这么轻信；汇钱之前先仔细核实。
messages.en: Don't be naive; check carefully before you send any money.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“行为幼稚、少女初涉世事、轻信别人”三个场景分别记住 vavu 的三个义项；遇到它时先看语境是在说不成熟、单纯还是容易受骗。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A container, usually made of glass, with a wide opening and often a lid, used for storing food or other substances.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常由玻璃制成、开口较宽且常配有盖子，用于储存食物或其他物品的容器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kontenitur, ġeneralment tal-ħġieġ, b'fetħa wiesgħa u spiss b'għatu, li jintuża biex jinżamm fih ikel jew sustanzi oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 罐子；通常有宽口和盖子、用于储存食物等物品的玻璃容器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reċipjent li normalment ikun tal-ħġieġ u jkollu fetħa wiesgħa, u li jista' jingħalaq b'għatu biex jinżammu fih ikel jew affarijiet oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A jar is a container with a wide opening, usually made of glass, in which food or other substances are stored.

formal.mt: Il-ġamm għandu jinżamm f'vażett nadif u magħluq sew.
formal.en: The jam should be kept in a clean, tightly closed jar.
formal.zh: 果酱应存放在干净且盖紧的罐子里。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tista' tiftaħli dan il-vażett? Mark: Iva, agħtihuli; l-għatu jidher issikkat ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you open this jar for me? Mark: Yes, pass it to me; the lid looks very tight.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你能帮我打开这个罐子吗？Mark：可以，递给我吧；盖子看起来拧得很紧。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 你能帮我打开这个罐子吗？
messages.en: Can you open this jar for me?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, agħtihuli; l-għatu jidher issikkat ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, agħtihuli; l-għatu jidher issikkat ħafna.
messages.zh: 可以，递给我吧；盖子看起来拧得很紧。
messages.en: Yes, pass it to me; the lid looks very tight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 vażett 与“宽口、玻璃、拧盖”三个视觉特征绑定，想象打开果酱罐再伸入小勺的动作，用具体容器画面帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A container used to hold flowers, often also displayed as a decoration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来插放花朵，也可单独作为装饰品摆放的容器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent li jintuża biex jitqiegħdu fih il-fjuri u li jista' jservi wkoll bħala tiżjin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 花瓶；用于插花或装饰的容器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reċipjent li fih jitqiegħdu l-fjuri, jew li jitqiegħed waħdu bħala tiżjin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A vase is a container in which you put flowers or which you display as a decorative object.

formal.mt: Fuq il-mejda tqiegħed vażun tal-ħġieġ bil-fjuri friski.
formal.en: A glass vase containing fresh flowers was placed on the table.
formal.zh: 桌上摆放了一个插着鲜花的玻璃花瓶。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn inpoġġi dawn il-fjuri? Mark: Poġġihom fil-vażun fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall I put these flowers? Mark: Put them in the vase on the table.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些花放在哪里？马克：放进桌上的花瓶里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这些花放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall I put these flowers?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 放进桌上的花瓶里。
messages.en: Put them in the vase on the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌上的花瓶里插着鲜花，把 vażun 与“花瓶装花”的画面一起记住。

gloss_zh: 景象；景色；视野中的景观

teaching_sense.en_definition: A visible scene, especially the scenery seen from a particular place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 眼前可见的景象，尤其指从某个位置望见的景色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xena li wieħed jista' jara, speċjalment il-pajsaġġ li jidher minn post partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 景象；映入眼帘的场景或景物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xena jew dehra li wieħed jista' jara quddiemu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sight is a scene or something visible that you notice when you look around.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 景色；从某个特定位置望见的景观。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-pajsaġġ jew ix-xena li wieħed jara minn post partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The view from a place is the scenery that you can see when you look out from it.

formal.mt: Mit-terrazzin tal-lukanda, il-viżitaturi jistgħu jgawdu veduta sabiħa tal-baħar.
formal.en: From the hotel terrace, visitors can enjoy a beautiful view of the sea.
formal.zh: 游客可以从酒店露台欣赏美丽的海景。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ejja ħdejn it-tieqa! Hemm veduta sabiħa. Pawlu: Iva, minn hawn nista' nara l-baħar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Come over to the window! There is a beautiful view. Pawlu: Yes, I can see the sea from here.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：到窗边来！这里的景色很美。保罗：是啊，从这里能看见大海。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja ħdejn it-tieqa! Hemm veduta sabiħa.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja ħdejn it-tieqa! Hemm veduta sabiħa.
messages.zh: 到窗边来！这里的景色很美。
messages.en: Come over to the window! There is a beautiful view.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, minn hawn nista' nara l-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, minn hawn nista' nara l-baħar.
messages.zh: 是啊，从这里能看见大海。
messages.en: Yes, I can see the sea from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 veduta 配上“站在窗边看海景”的画面：既能记眼前景象，也能记从某处望见的景色。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small lodge situated at or beside an entrance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于门口或入口旁的小屋，即门房。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kamra jew binja żgħira li tinsab ħdejn bieb jew daħla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 门房；设在门口或入口旁的小屋。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Binja żgħira jew kamra li tinsab maġenb bieb jew daħla.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A door lodge is a small building or room situated beside a door or entrance.

collocations.en: the door of the entrance lodge

formal.mt: Il-pjanta turi velestrun ħdejn id-daħla prinċipali.
formal.en: The plan shows a small entrance lodge beside the main entrance.
formal.zh: 平面图显示主入口旁设有一间门房。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn se nistennew? Toni: Fil-velestrun ħdejn id-daħla. Il-bieb miftuħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where are we going to wait? Toni: In the lodge beside the entrance. The door is open.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们在哪里等？托尼：在入口旁的门房里。门开着。

messages.speaker: Lara (访客)
messages.zh: 我们在哪里等？
messages.en: Where are we going to wait?

messages.speaker: Toni (同行者)
messages.zh: 在入口旁的门房里。门开着。
messages.en: In the lodge beside the entrance. The door is open.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 velestrun 时画一扇大门，再在门旁画一间小屋，用“入口旁的门房”固定词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A station where bus routes begin or end and passengers board or leave buses.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 公共汽车线路的起点站或终点站，供乘客候车、上车和下车。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn jibdew jew jispiċċaw ir-rotot tal-karozzi tal-linja u fejn il-passiġġieri jistennew, jitilgħu jew jinżlu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公共汽车总站；公共汽车线路的起点站或终点站。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stazzjon fejn jibdew jew jispiċċaw ir-rotot tal-karozzi tal-linja u fejn il-passiġġieri jistgħu jitilgħu jew jinżlu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bus terminus is a station where bus routes begin or end and passengers can board or leave buses.

formal.mt: Il-passiġġieri għandhom jaslu fil-venda tal-karozzi għaxar minuti qabel il-ħin tat-tluq.
formal.en: Passengers should arrive at the bus terminus ten minutes before departure.
formal.zh: 乘客应在发车时间前十分钟到达公共汽车总站。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn se niltaqgħu għada? Pawlu: Ħdejn il-venda tal-karozzi, fid-disgħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where shall we meet tomorrow? Pawlu: Near the bus terminus, at nine.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们明天在哪里碰面？保罗：九点，在公共汽车总站附近。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们明天在哪里碰面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 九点，在公共汽车总站附近。
messages.en: Near the bus terminus, at nine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语和公交线路首尾站的画面绑定：乘客在总站等车、上车或下车，整体记作“公共汽车总站”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or desire of hurting or punishing someone because of a wrong they have done.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因别人曾经伤害或得罪自己而加以惩罚、伤害的行为，或想这样做的愿望。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil jew ix-xewqa li tagħmel ħsara lil xi ħadd jew tikkastigah minħabba ħsara jew offiża li jkun għamillek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 报复；为了回应自己受到的伤害或冒犯而伤害对方的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Azzjoni li biha xi ħadd jagħmel ħsara lil persuna oħra għax din tkun weġġgħetu jew offendietu qabel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Revenge is harm that someone does to another person in return for an injury or offence they have suffered.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 复仇；因遭受伤害或不公而对相关的人施加惩罚。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kastig jew ħsara li xi ħadd jagħmel lil persuna oħra bi tpattija għal ħsara jew inġustizzja li jkun sofra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Vengeance is punishment or harm inflicted on someone in response to a wrong that has been suffered.

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, ix-xewqa għall-vendetta twassal lill-karattru prinċipali biex jitlef il-fiduċja ta' sħabu.
formal.en: In the novel, the desire for revenge causes the main character to lose the trust of his companions.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，复仇的欲望使主人公失去了同伴的信任。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Wara dak li qallek, trid tieħu vendetta? Luqa: Le, irrid biss nispjegalu kif ħassejtni.
colloquial.en: Marija: After what he said to you, do you want revenge? Luqa: No, I just want to explain to him how I felt.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：他说了那些话之后，你想报复吗？卢卡：不，我只是想向他说明我的感受。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Wara dak li qallek, trid tieħu vendetta?
messages.mt_standard: Wara dak li qallek, trid tieħu vendetta?
messages.zh: 他说了那些话之后，你想报复吗？
messages.en: After what he said to you, do you want revenge?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, irrid biss nispjegalu kif ħassejtni.
messages.mt_standard: Le, irrid biss nispjegalu kif ħassejtni.
messages.zh: 不，我只是想向他说明我的感受。
messages.en: No, I just want to explain to him how I felt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“受了伤害，想让对方也付出代价”的情境记住 vendetta；它是名词，可对应中文的“报复”或“复仇”。

gloss_zh: 爱报复的；怀有报复心的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Wanting to hurt or punish someone because they have hurt or offended you.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因受到伤害或冒犯而想伤害、惩罚对方的；怀有报复心的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun irid jagħmel ħsara lil xi ħadd jew jikkastigah għax ikun weġġgħu jew offendieh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 怀有报复心的；因别人伤害或得罪自己而想加以报复的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkollu x-xewqa li jagħmel ħsara lil ħaddieħor jew jikkastigah bi tpattija għal xi ħsara jew offiża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is vindictive wants to hurt or punish people who have hurt or offended them.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat sostna li kull ilment għandu jiġi eżaminat b'mod ġust u mingħajr atteġġjament vendikattiv.
formal.en: The committee maintained that every complaint should be examined fairly and without a vindictive attitude.
formal.zh: 委员会强调，应公正审查每一项投诉，处理时不应怀有报复心理。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ma tridx tistiednu? Għax ikkritikak? Mark: Ma rridx inkun vendikattiv. Għandek raġun, se nistiednu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why don't you want to invite him? Because he criticised you? Mark: I don't want to be vindictive. You're right, I'll invite him.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么不想邀请他？因为他批评了你吗？马克：我不想怀着报复心做事。你说得对，我会邀请他。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tridx tistiednu? Għax ikkritikak?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tridx tistiednu? Għax ikkritikak?
messages.zh: 你为什么不想邀请他？因为他批评了你吗？
messages.en: Why don't you want to invite him? Because he criticised you?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma rridx inkun vendikattiv. Għandek raġun, se nistiednu.
messages.mt_standard: Ma rridx inkun vendikattiv. Għandek raġun, se nistiednu.
messages.zh: 我不想怀着报复心做事。你说得对，我会邀请他。
messages.en: I don't want to be vindictive. You're right, I'll invite him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给故事中总想报复别人的人物贴上 vendikattiv 标签，记住它描述人的性格或态度，意思是“怀有报复心的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Maltese name for the city called Venice in English.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 城市名“威尼斯”的马耳他语名称，书写时首字母大写为 Venezja。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem bil-Malti tal-belt magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala Venice.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 威尼斯；马耳他语写作 Venezja 的城市名称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isem proprju li jirreferi għall-belt li bl-Ingliż tissejjaħ Venice.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Venezja is the Maltese proper name for the city known in English as Venice.

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-vjaġġ jinkludi żjara f'Venezja u ħin liberu biex il-parteċipanti jesploraw il-belt.
formal.en: The travel programme includes a visit to Venice and free time for participants to explore the city.
formal.zh: 旅行安排包括游览威尼斯，并为参加者留出自由探索这座城市的时间。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn tixtieq tmur għall-vaganza li jmiss? David: Nixtieq immur Venezja. Int tiġi miegħi?
colloquial.en: Nina: Where would you like to go for your next holiday? David: I'd like to go to Venice. Would you come with me?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：下次度假你想去哪里？戴维：我想去威尼斯。你愿意和我一起去吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn tixtieq tmur għall-vaganza li jmiss?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn tixtieq tmur għall-vaganza li jmiss?
messages.zh: 下次度假你想去哪里？
messages.en: Where would you like to go for your next holiday?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq immur Venezja. Int tiġi miegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq immur Venezja. Int tiġi miegħi?
messages.zh: 我想去威尼斯。你愿意和我一起去吗？
messages.en: I'd like to go to Venice. Would you come with me?

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作三语旅行卡片，把 Venezja、Venice、威尼斯并排记忆；写马耳他语句子时，提醒自己城市名首字母要大写。

gloss_zh: 威尼斯的；威尼斯风格的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Connected with Venice, its people, or its characteristic styles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与威尼斯、当地居民或当地特色风格有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' Venezja, man-nies tagħha jew mal-istili karatteristiċi tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 威尼斯的；与威尼斯居民、文化或风格有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ġej minn Venezja jew li għandu x'jaqsam ma' din il-belt, man-nies jew mal-kultura tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something Venetian comes from Venice or is associated with its people, culture, or styles.

formal.mt: Il-mużew jesebixxi vażun tal-ħġieġ venezjan bħala eżempju ta' sengħa artistika.
formal.en: The museum displays a Venetian glass vase as an example of artistic craftsmanship.
formal.zh: 博物馆展出一只威尼斯玻璃花瓶，作为艺术工艺的范例。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-vażun tal-ħġieġ venezjan? Mark: Iva, xtrajtu waqt żjara f'Venezja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this vase made of Venetian glass? Mark: Yes, I bought it during a visit to Venice.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个花瓶是威尼斯玻璃做的吗？马克：是的，我去威尼斯游玩时买的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个花瓶是威尼斯玻璃做的吗？
messages.en: Is this vase made of Venetian glass?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，我去威尼斯游玩时买的。
messages.en: Yes, I bought it during a visit to Venice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把威尼斯玻璃花瓶作为记忆画面，见到 venezjan 就想到“威尼斯的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describes a fault or sin that is relatively minor and can be forgiven.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容过失或罪过程度较轻，可以得到宽恕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi żball jew dnub li mhuwiex gravi u li jista' jinħafer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可宽恕的；指过失或罪过情节较轻、不属严重性质的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jingħad għal nuqqas jew dnub li ma jitqiesx gravi u li jista' jinħafer.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A venial fault or sin is relatively minor and is considered capable of being forgiven.

formal.mt: Fit-test, il-kelma venjal tiddeskrivi nuqqas ħafif li jista' jinħafer.
formal.en: In the text, the word venjal describes a minor fault that can be forgiven.
formal.zh: 在这篇文本中，venjal 一词描述可以宽恕的轻微过失。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser dnub venjal? Pawlu: Ifisser dnub li mhuwiex gravi u li jista' jinħafer.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does a venial sin mean? Pawlu: It means a sin that is not grave and can be forgiven.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：“轻罪”是什么意思？保罗：指不严重、可以得到宽恕的罪过。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: “轻罪”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does a venial sin mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser dnub li mhuwiex gravi u li jista' jinħafer.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser dnub li mhuwiex gravi u li jista' jinħafer.
messages.zh: 指不严重、可以得到宽恕的罪过。
messages.en: It means a sin that is not grave and can be forgiven.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“轻微过失，可以原谅”八个字串联含义，把 venjal 与严重过错作程度对照。

gloss_zh: 真是表现绝了；做得太棒了

teaching_sense.en_definition: An informal expression praising someone for doing something exceptionally well.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于口语中，热情称赞某人某件事做得非常出色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni informali li tintuża biex tfaħħar lil xi ħadd talli għamel xi ħaġa tajjeb ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表现绝了；把某件事完成得非常出色，用于热情赞扬。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni ta' tifħir għal xi ħadd li rnexxielu jagħmel xi ħaġa b'mod eċċellenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you say someone slayed that, you mean they performed a particular task exceptionally well.

collocations.mt: Vera faqa u tajjeb fuq il-palk!
collocations.zh: 他在舞台上的表现太棒了！

formal.mt: F'djalogu informali, l-espressjoni 'Vera faqa u tajjeb' tintuża biex turi ammirazzjoni għal prestazzjoni eċċellenti.
formal.en: In an informal dialogue, the expression 'Vera faqa u tajjeb' is used to express admiration for an excellent performance.
formal.zh: 在非正式对话中，表达式“Vera faqa u tajjeb”用于赞叹出色的表现。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif mar Mark fuq il-palk? Lara: Vera faqa u tajjeb! Kulħadd beda jċapċap.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Mark do on stage? Lara: He absolutely slayed! Everyone started clapping.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克在舞台上表现怎么样？拉拉：真是绝了！大家都鼓起掌来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克在舞台上表现怎么样？
messages.en: How did Mark do on stage?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Vera faqa u tajjeb! Kulħadd beda jċapċap.
messages.mt_standard: Vera faqa u tajjeb! Kulħadd beda jċapċap.
messages.zh: 真是绝了！大家都鼓起掌来。
messages.en: He absolutely slayed! Everyone started clapping.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友表演结束、全场鼓掌的场景，把整句作为“表现绝了”的口语赞叹来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A word that expresses an action, an event, or a state.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示动作、事件或状态的一类词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tesprimi azzjoni, ġrajja jew stat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 动词：语法中表示动作、事件或状态的词。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fil-grammatika, kelma li tesprimi azzjoni, ġrajja jew stat u li tista' tieħu forom differenti skont il-kuntest grammatikali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A verb is a word used to express an action, an event, or a state.

formal.mt: Fis-sentenza 'Marija taqra ktieb', il-kelma 'taqra' hija verb li jesprimi azzjoni.
formal.en: In the sentence 'Marija reads a book', the word 'reads' is a verb expressing an action.
formal.zh: 在“玛丽亚读一本书”这句话中，“读”是表示动作的动词。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Liema kelma hija verb f''Pawlu jikteb ittra'? Mark: 'Jikteb' hija verb, għax tgħid x'qed jagħmel Pawlu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Which word is a verb in 'Pawlu writes a letter'? Mark: 'Writes' is a verb because it tells us what Pawlu is doing.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：“保罗写一封信”里哪个词是动词？马克：“写”是动词，因为它说明保罗在做什么。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema kelma hija verb f''Pawlu jikteb ittra'?
messages.mt_standard: Liema kelma hija verb f''Pawlu jikteb ittra'?
messages.zh: “保罗写一封信”里哪个词是动词？
messages.en: Which word is a verb in 'Pawlu writes a letter'?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: 'Jikteb' hija verb, għax tgħid x'qed jagħmel Pawlu.
messages.mt_standard: 'Jikteb' hija verb, għax tgħid x'qed jagħmel Pawlu.
messages.zh: “写”是动词，因为它说明保罗在做什么。
messages.en: 'Writes' is a verb because it tells us what Pawlu is doing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 verb 放进“谁在做什么”的句子里定位，再补记动词也可以表达状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Expressed in words, especially through speech.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用言语表达的，尤其指通过口头表达的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiġi espress bil-kliem, speċjalment permezz tat-taħdit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 言语的；用语言表达的，尤指口头表达的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-kliem jew li jiġi espress bit-taħdit.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is verbal involves words, especially words that are spoken.

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti għandhom jagħtu tweġiba verbali qabel ma jimlew il-formola.
formal.en: Participants should give a verbal response before completing the form.
formal.zh: 参与者应先作出口头回答，再填写表格。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ftehim kien bil-miktub? Mark: Le, kellna biss ftehim verbali. Maja: Mela ejja niktbu dak li qbilna fuqu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was the agreement in writing? Mark: No, we only had a verbal agreement. Maja: Then let's write down what we agreed on.
colloquial.zh: Maja：协议是书面的吗？Mark：不是，我们只有口头协议。Maja：那我们把商定的内容写下来吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 协议是书面的吗？
messages.en: Was the agreement in writing?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 不是，我们只有口头协议。
messages.en: No, we only had a verbal agreement.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ejja niktbu dak li qbilna fuqu.
messages.mt_standard: Mela ejja niktbu dak li qbilna fuqu.
messages.zh: 那我们把商定的内容写下来吧。
messages.en: Then let's write down what we agreed on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 verbali 和“开口说出来”联系起来，连着记 ftehim verbali“口头协议”，用说话与写字的画面对比帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A formal decision about a case, especially whether an accused person is guilty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对案件作出的正式裁决，尤指认定被告是否有罪的结论。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Deċiżjoni formali dwar każ, speċjalment dwar jekk persuna akkużata tkunx ħatja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对案件作出的正式裁决，尤指有关被告是否有罪的认定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Deċiżjoni li tingħata fi tmiem il-kunsiderazzjoni ta' każ, speċjalment dwar il-ħtija ta' persuna akkużata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A verdict is a formal decision in a case, especially a decision about whether someone is guilty.

formal.mt: Il-verdett tħabbar wara li nstemgħet l-evidenza kollha.
formal.en: The verdict was announced after all the evidence had been heard.
formal.zh: 在听取全部证据后，裁决结果得到宣布。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Smajt jekk ħariġx il-verdett? Pawlu: Għadu ma ħariġx. Sara: Sewwa, ngħidlek jekk nisma' xi aħbar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you heard whether the verdict is out? Pawlu: It isn't out yet. Sara: Okay, I'll let you know if I hear any news.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你听说裁决结果出来了吗？Pawlu：还没出来。Sara：好，我听到消息就告诉你。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听说裁决结果出来了吗？
messages.en: Have you heard whether the verdict is out?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 还没出来。
messages.en: It isn't out yet.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, ngħidlek jekk nisma' xi aħbar.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, ngħidlek jekk nisma' xi aħbar.
messages.zh: 好，我听到消息就告诉你。
messages.en: Okay, I'll let you know if I hear any news.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 verdett，就想象法庭宣布案件结论的时刻；把它记成“裁决结果”，并用 verdett ta' ħtija 巩固“有罪裁决”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small bird with greenish and yellow feathers, called a greenfinch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种羽毛带绿色和黄色的小型鸟，称为绿雀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur żgħir li għandu rix fl-aħdar u fl-isfar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绿雀，一种羽毛带绿色和黄色的小型鸟。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għasfur żgħir b'rix fl-aħdar u fl-isfar u b'munqar qasir u b'saħħtu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A greenfinch is a small bird with greenish and yellow feathers and a short, strong beak.

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, l-istudenti raw verdun fuq fergħa u ddeskrivew il-kuluri tar-rix tiegħu.
formal.en: During the observation, the students saw a greenfinch on a branch and described the colours of its feathers.
formal.zh: 观察时，学生们看见树枝上有一只绿雀，并描述了它羽毛的颜色。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara dak l-għasfur fuq il-fergħa! Ninu: Dak verdun. Lara: Kemm għandu kuluri sbieħ!
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at that bird on the branch! Ninu: That's a greenfinch. Lara: What beautiful colours it has!
colloquial.zh: Lara：快看树枝上的那只鸟！Ninu：那是一只绿雀。Lara：它的颜色真漂亮！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 快看树枝上的那只鸟！
messages.en: Look at that bird on the branch!

messages.speaker: Ninu (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是一只绿雀。
messages.en: That's a greenfinch.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 它的颜色真漂亮！
messages.en: What beautiful colours it has!

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 verdun 配一幅记忆画面：一只带绿黄羽毛的小鸟停在树枝上；看到这幅画面，就说 verdun“绿雀”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Checked and confirmed to be correct, true, or genuine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经检查并确认正确、属实或真实的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġie ċċekkjat u kkonfermat li huwa korrett, veru jew awtentiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经过核查并确认正确、属实或真实的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun għadda minn kontroll sabiex jiġi kkonfermat li huwa korrett, veru jew awtentiku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is verified has been checked and confirmed to be correct, true, or genuine.

formal.mt: Id-dokument verifikat għandu jintbagħat flimkien mal-applikazzjoni.
formal.en: The verified document should be sent with the application.
formal.zh: 经核验的文件应随申请一并提交。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-kont huwa verifikat? Mark: Iva, ħdejn l-isem hemm il-marka tal-verifika. Maja: Tajjeb, issa nista' nagħrfu aktar faċilment.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this account verified? Mark: Yes, there's a verification mark next to the name. Maja: Good, now I can recognise it more easily.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个账号已认证了吗？Mark：是的，名字旁边有认证标记。Maja：好，这样我就更容易认出它了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个账号已认证了吗？
messages.en: Is this account verified?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħdejn l-isem hemm il-marka tal-verifika.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħdejn l-isem hemm il-marka tal-verifika.
messages.zh: 是的，名字旁边有认证标记。
messages.en: Yes, there's a verification mark next to the name.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, issa nista' nagħrfu aktar faċilment.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, issa nista' nagħrfu aktar faċilment.
messages.zh: 好，这样我就更容易认出它了。
messages.en: Good, now I can recognise it more easily.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 verifikat 想成文件旁打上的核验勾：已经检查并确认，才叫“已核实的”；连着记 dokument verifikat“经核验的文件”。

gloss_zh: 味美思酒；苦艾配制葡萄酒

teaching_sense.en_definition: A wine flavoured with herbs and spices, often served before a meal or used in cocktails.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用芳香植物和香料调味的葡萄酒，常作为餐前酒饮用，也用于调制鸡尾酒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inbid aromatizzat b'ħxejjex aromatiċi u ħwawar, li spiss jinxtorob qabel l-ikel jew jintuża fil-cocktails.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 味美思酒，一种用芳香植物和香料调味的葡萄酒。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip ta' nbid aromatizzat b'ħxejjex aromatiċi u ħwawar, li jista' jiġi servut waħdu jew jitħallat f'cocktail.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Vermouth is a wine flavoured with herbs and spices that people drink on its own or mix into cocktails.

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta tispeċifika li għandhom jiżdiedu tletin millilitru vermut niexef mat-taħlita.
formal.en: The recipe specifies that thirty millilitres of dry vermouth should be added to the mixture.
formal.zh: 配方规定，应在混合液中加入三十毫升干味美思酒。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'tirrakkomanda qabel l-ikel? Pawlu: Tazza vermut bis-silġ. Trid tipprovaha?
colloquial.en: Lara: What do you recommend before the meal? Pawlu: A glass of vermouth with ice. Would you like to try it?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：餐前你推荐喝什么？保罗：一杯加冰的味美思酒。你想尝尝吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 餐前你推荐喝什么？
messages.en: What do you recommend before the meal?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (酒保)
messages.zh: 一杯加冰的味美思酒。你想尝尝吗？
messages.en: A glass of vermouth with ice. Would you like to try it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 vermut 和餐前的一小杯香草风味葡萄酒联系起来，再用 tazza vermut（一杯味美思酒）整组记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A liquid coating that dries to form a hard protective or decorative layer on a surface, especially wood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涂在木材等表面、干燥后形成坚硬保护层或装饰层的液体涂料，通常为透明或半透明的清漆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza likwida li titqiegħed fuq wiċċ, speċjalment tal-injam, u tinxef biex tifforma saff iebes li jipproteġih jew iżejnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 清漆，涂覆后干燥成膜、用于保护或装饰木材等表面的涂料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kisja likwida, ġeneralment trasparenti jew semitrasparenti, li wara li tinxef tifforma saff protettiv jew dekorattiv fuq wiċċ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Varnish is a liquid that you apply to a surface, especially wood, to give it a hard protective or decorative coating.

formal.mt: Wara li l-wiċċ tal-injam jitnaddaf, għandu jingħata saff verniċ trasparenti biex jiġi protett mill-umdità.
formal.en: After the wooden surface is cleaned, a coat of clear varnish should be applied to protect it from moisture.
formal.zh: 木质表面清洁后，应涂上一层透明清漆，以防受潮。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' noqgħod fuq dan il-bank? Toni: Għadu ma jistax jintuża; għadna kemm tajnieh saff verniċ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I sit on this bench? Toni: It cannot be used yet; we have just given it a coat of varnish.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我能坐这张长椅吗？托尼：现在还不能用，我们刚给它涂了一层清漆。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 我能坐这张长椅吗？
messages.en: Can I sit on this bench?

messages.speaker: Toni (木匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu ma jistax jintuża; għadna kemm tajnieh saff verniċ.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu ma jistax jintuża; għadna kemm tajnieh saff verniċ.
messages.zh: 现在还不能用，我们刚给它涂了一层清漆。
messages.en: It cannot be used yet; we have just given it a coat of varnish.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象木桌刷上 verniċ 后多了一层保护膜；把 saff verniċ（一层清漆）与刷漆动作一起记住。

gloss_zh: 多才多艺的；用途广泛的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to do many different things well, or suitable for many different uses.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人能胜任多种不同工作，也形容工具、材料等能够适用于多种用途。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ħila jagħmel ħafna affarijiet differenti tajjeb, jew li jista' jintuża għal ħafna skopijiet differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 多才多艺的，能胜任多种任务的；用途广泛、能适应不同需要的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li kapaċi jwettaq kompiti differenti b'suċċess, jew li huwa adattat għal diversi użi u sitwazzjonijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something that is versatile can perform many different tasks or be used successfully for a variety of purposes.

collocations.zh: 能驾驭多种角色的演员

formal.mt: Il-kumitat għażel attriċi versatili li setgħet tinterpreta kemm rwoli komiċi kif ukoll rwoli drammatiċi.
formal.en: The committee selected a versatile actress who could perform both comic and dramatic roles.
formal.zh: 委员会选中了一位戏路宽广的女演员，她既能演喜剧角色，也能演正剧角色。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Din l-għodda taqta' biss? Sara: Le, taqta', tħaffer u tillixxa. Hija versatili ħafna.
colloquial.en: Mark: Does this tool only cut? Sara: No, it cuts, drills, and smooths surfaces. It is very versatile.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这件工具只能切割吗？萨拉：不是，它能切割、钻孔，还能磨平表面。它的用途很多。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这件工具只能切割吗？
messages.en: Does this tool only cut?

messages.speaker: Sara (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, taqta', tħaffer u tillixxa. Hija versatili ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Le, taqta', tħaffer u tillixxa. Hija versatili ħafna.
messages.zh: 不是，它能切割、钻孔，还能磨平表面。它的用途很多。
messages.en: No, it cuts, drills, and smooths surfaces. It is very versatile.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 versatili 配两幅图：一位能演多种角色的演员，一件能完成多种工作的工具；人和物都突出“本领多、用途广”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Going straight up and down, at a right angle to a horizontal line or surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 沿上下方向直立延伸的，与水平线或水平面成直角的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jimxi dritt minn fuq għal isfel jew minn isfel għal fuq, u jagħmel angolu rett ma' linja jew wiċċ orizzontali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 竖直的，沿上下方向延伸并与水平方向成直角的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu direzzjoni dritta minn fuq għal isfel u jkun f'angolu ta' disgħin grad mal-orizzontali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A line, surface, or object that is vertical extends straight up and down at a right angle to the horizontal.

formal.mt: Fuq il-graff, l-assi vertikali juri t-temperatura, filwaqt li l-assi orizzontali juri l-ħin.
formal.en: On the graph, the vertical axis shows temperature, while the horizontal axis shows time.
formal.zh: 图中，纵轴表示温度，横轴表示时间。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-linja għandha tmur minn naħa għall-oħra? David: Le, pinġi linja vertikali, minn fuq għal isfel.
colloquial.en: Nina: Should the line go from side to side? David: No, draw a vertical line, from top to bottom.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这条线要从一边画到另一边吗？戴维：不是，画一条竖直线，从上往下画。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-linja għandha tmur minn naħa għall-oħra?
messages.mt_standard: Il-linja għandha tmur minn naħa għall-oħra?
messages.zh: 这条线要从一边画到另一边吗？
messages.en: Should the line go from side to side?

messages.speaker: David (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, pinġi linja vertikali, minn fuq għal isfel.
messages.mt_standard: Le, pinġi linja vertikali, minn fuq għal isfel.
messages.zh: 不是，画一条竖直线，从上往下画。
messages.en: No, draw a vertical line, from top to bottom.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 vertikali 时，用手从上往下划一条直线，并默念 linja vertikali（竖直线），让方向动作帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large flying insect that has a sting and belongs to the wasp family.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 胡蜂类的一种大型飞行昆虫，能够用尾部的螫针蜇人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Insett kbir mill-familja taż-żnażan li jtir u jista' jniggeż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胡蜂；一种体形较大、具有螫针的蜂类昆虫。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Insett kbir mill-familja taż-żnażan li għandu ġwienaħ u jista' jniggeż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A hornet is a large type of wasp that can give a painful sting.

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni fil-ġnien, l-istudenti raw vespa kbira ħdejn is-siġra u żammew distanza minnha.
formal.en: During their observation in the garden, the students saw a large hornet near the tree and kept their distance from it.
formal.zh: 在花园里进行观察时，学生们看到树旁有一只大胡蜂，便与它保持距离。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm vespa ħdejn it-tieqa! Pawlu: Rajtha. Ejja nitbiegħdu ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: There's a hornet by the window! Pawlu: I saw it. Let's move away a little.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：窗边有一只胡蜂！保罗：我看到了。我们离远一点吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 窗边有一只胡蜂！
messages.en: There's a hornet by the window!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我看到了。我们离远一点吧。
messages.en: I saw it. Let's move away a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 vespa 和“窗边飞来一只大胡蜂”的画面绑定，再连读 vespa kbira“大胡蜂”；这是场景联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A professional who examines animals and treats their illnesses and injuries.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为动物检查身体、诊断疾病并治疗疾病或伤害的专业人员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna mħarrġa biex teżamina l-annimali u tittratta l-mard u l-ġrieħi tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 兽医；专门检查动物健康并治疗动物疾病和伤害的专业人员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Professjonist li jeżamina l-annimali, jagħmel dijanjożi tal-mard tagħhom u jagħtihom il-kura meħtieġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A veterinarian is a trained professional who provides medical care for animals.

collocations.en: to take the dog to the veterinarian

formal.mt: Il-veterinarju eżamina l-kelb u spjega lis-sid kif għandu jagħtih il-mediċina.
formal.en: The veterinarian examined the dog and explained to the owner how to give it the medicine.
formal.zh: 兽医检查了这只狗，并向主人说明应该怎样给它喂药。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-qattus ma jridx jiekol illum. Mark: Ċempel lill-veterinarju u staqsih jekk għandniex nieħduh għandu.
colloquial.en: Sara: The cat doesn't want to eat today. Mark: Call the veterinarian and ask him whether we should bring the cat in.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：猫今天不肯吃东西。马克：给兽医打个电话，问问是否应该带猫过去。

messages.speaker: Sara (猫主人)
messages.zh: 猫今天不肯吃东西。
messages.en: The cat doesn't want to eat today.

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċempel lill-veterinarju u staqsih jekk għandniex nieħduh għandu.
messages.mt_standard: Ċempel lill-veterinarju u staqsih jekk għandniex nieħduh għandu.
messages.zh: 给兽医打个电话，问问是否应该带猫过去。
messages.en: Call the veterinarian and ask him whether we should bring the cat in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“宠物生病，要找兽医”的场景记 veterinarju，并把整个短语 għand il-veterinarju“去兽医那里”一起练熟。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shop window in which goods are displayed for people outside to see.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 商店用来陈列商品、供外面行人观看的玻璃橱窗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tieqa tal-ħġieġ ta' ħanut fejn jintwerew prodotti biex jarawhom in-nies minn barra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 陈列橱窗；商店面向街道、用来展示商品的玻璃窗。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tieqa ta' ħanut li fiha jitqiegħdu oġġetti għall-wiri sabiex jiġbdu l-attenzjoni tan-nies li jgħaddu minn barra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A show-window is a shop window where goods are arranged for passers-by to see.

formal.mt: Il-ħanut poġġa l-prodotti l-ġodda fil-vetrina sabiex il-klijenti jkunu jistgħu jarawhom minn barra.
formal.en: The shop placed the new products in the display window so that customers could see them from outside.
formal.zh: 商店把新商品摆进橱窗，让顾客能够从外面看到。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara dik il-libsa fil-vetrina! Nina: Togħġobni ħafna. Nidħlu nistaqsu kemm tiswa?
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at that dress in the window! Nina: I really like it. Shall we go in and ask how much it costs?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看橱窗里的那条连衣裙！妮娜：我很喜欢。我们进去问问多少钱，好吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (购物的朋友)
messages.zh: 看橱窗里的那条连衣裙！
messages.en: Look at that dress in the window!

messages.speaker: Nina (购物的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Togħġobni ħafna. Nidħlu nistaqsu kemm tiswa?
messages.mt_standard: Togħġobni ħafna. Nidħlu nistaqsu kemm tiswa?
messages.zh: 我很喜欢。我们进去问问多少钱，好吗？
messages.en: I really like it. Shall we go in and ask how much it costs?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象逛街时隔着玻璃看连衣裙，把 vetrina 记成“展示商品的商店橱窗”，再用 fil-vetrina“在橱窗里”巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A means of transport, such as a car, bus, or truck, used to carry people or goods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于运送人员或货物的交通工具，例如汽车、公共汽车或卡车。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mezz ta' trasport, bħal karozza, xarabank jew trakk, li jintuża biex iġorr nies jew merkanzija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 车辆；用于运送人或货物的交通工具，如汽车、公共汽车或卡车。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mezz li bih jiġu ttrasportati nies jew oġġetti minn post għal ieħor, bħal karozza, xarabank jew trakk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A vehicle is a means of transport used to carry people or goods from one place to another.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija xtrat vettura elettrika biex tittrasporta tagħmir bejn iż-żewġ uffiċċji tagħha.
formal.en: The company bought an electric vehicle to transport equipment between its two offices.
formal.zh: 公司购买了一辆电动车，用来在两个办公室之间运送设备。

colloquial.mt: Daniel: Liema vettura se nużaw biex inġorru l-kaxxi? Rita: Nużaw il-vann tal-kumpanija. Fih aktar spazju.
colloquial.en: Daniel: Which vehicle are we going to use to carry the boxes? Rita: Let's use the company van. It has more space.
colloquial.zh: 丹尼尔：我们用哪辆车搬箱子？丽塔：用公司的厢式货车吧。它的空间更大。

messages.speaker: Daniel (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema vettura se nużaw biex inġorru l-kaxxi?
messages.mt_standard: Liema vettura se nużaw biex inġorru l-kaxxi?
messages.zh: 我们用哪辆车搬箱子？
messages.en: Which vehicle are we going to use to carry the boxes?

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Nużaw il-vann tal-kumpanija. Fih aktar spazju.
messages.mt_standard: Nużaw il-vann tal-kumpanija. Fih aktar spazju.
messages.zh: 用公司的厢式货车吧。它的空间更大。
messages.en: Let's use the company van. It has more space.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中把汽车、公交车和卡车排成一列，统一贴上 vettura“车辆”的标签，再用 vettura elettrika“电动车辆”练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who does not eat meat or fish, or a description of food suitable for such a person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指不吃肉和鱼的素食者，也用于描述适合素食者食用的食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ma tikolx laħam jew ħut, jew deskrizzjoni ta' ikel adattat għal persuna bħal din.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 素食者；也指不含肉和鱼、适合素食者食用的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li ma tikolx laħam jew ħut; il-kelma tintuża wkoll għal ikel li ma fihx laħam jew ħut.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A vegetarian does not eat meat or fish, and vegetarian food contains neither meat nor fish.

formal.mt: Ir-restorant joffri menu veġetarjan li ma jinkludi la laħam u lanqas ħut.
formal.en: The restaurant offers a vegetarian menu that includes neither meat nor fish.
formal.zh: 这家餐厅提供不含肉和鱼的素食菜单。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Jien veġetarjan. Għandkom xi ħaġa bla laħam u bla ħut? Rita: Iva, għandna għaġin bil-ħaxix.
colloquial.en: Mark: I am vegetarian. Do you have anything without meat or fish? Rita: Yes, we have pasta with vegetables.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我是素食者。有不含肉和鱼的菜吗？丽塔：有，我们有蔬菜意面。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien veġetarjan. Għandkom xi ħaġa bla laħam u bla ħut?
messages.mt_standard: Jien veġetarjan. Għandkom xi ħaġa bla laħam u bla ħut?
messages.zh: 我是素食者。有不含肉和鱼的菜吗？
messages.en: I am vegetarian. Do you have anything without meat or fish?

messages.speaker: Rita (服务员)
messages.zh: 有，我们有蔬菜意面。
messages.en: Yes, we have pasta with vegetables.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 veġetarjan 和点餐情境一起记：说自己是素食者，再找不含肉和鱼的食物。

gloss_zh: 祖母或外祖母；曾祖母或曾外祖母（本练习中的标签）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A label in this exercise referring to grandmothers or great-grandmothers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本练习中指祖母、外祖母或曾祖辈女性的标签。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tikketta f'dan l-eżerċizzju li tirreferi għan-nanniet nisa jew għall-bużnanniet nisa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 祖母、外祖母，或曾祖母、曾外祖母等曾祖辈女性。
sense_translations.mt_definition: In-nanniet nisa jew il-bużnanniet nisa, jiġifieri l-ommijiet tal-ġenituri jew tal-ġenituri tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This label refers to grandmothers or great-grandmothers within the exercise.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju dwar il-familja, it-tikketta 'vghhhhhhhhhhhhh' tirreferi għan-nanniet nisa jew għall-bużnanniet nisa.
formal.en: In this exercise about the family, the label 'vghhhhhhhhhhhhh' refers to grandmothers or great-grandmothers.
formal.zh: 在这项家庭主题练习中，标签“vghhhhhhhhhhhhh”指祖母、外祖母或曾祖辈女性。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Xi tfisser it-tikketta 'vghhhhhhhhhhhhh' hawn? Pawlu: Hawn tfisser nanniet nisa jew bużnanniet nisa.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does the label 'vghhhhhhhhhhhhh' mean here? Pawlu: Here it means grandmothers or great-grandmothers.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这里的标签“vghhhhhhhhhhhhh”是什么意思？保罗：这里指祖母、外祖母或曾祖辈女性。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的标签“vghhhhhhhhhhhhh”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the label 'vghhhhhhhhhhhhh' mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser nanniet nisa jew bużnanniet nisa.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser nanniet nisa jew bużnanniet nisa.
messages.zh: 这里指祖母、外祖母或曾祖辈女性。
messages.en: Here it means grandmothers or great-grandmothers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把此练习标签放在家庭树的祖母辈和曾祖母辈旁边，通过两层长辈关系记住含义，不从重复字母推测词根或读音。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A label in this exercise referring to vegetables, such as carrots, cabbages, and other edible plant foods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本练习中表示蔬菜的标签，所指包括胡萝卜、卷心菜等供人食用的植物性食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tikketta f'dan l-eżerċizzju li tirreferi għall-ħaxix tal-ikel, bħal karrotti, kaboċċi u pjanti oħra li jittieklu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蔬菜；供人食用、通常用于烹调或制作沙拉的植物或其部分。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjanti jew partijiet minn pjanti li jittieklu bħala ħaxix, nejjin jew imsajrin, bħal karrotti u kaboċċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This label refers to plants or plant parts eaten as vegetables.

collocations.en: the 'vhg' category on the shopping list

formal.mt: Fil-lista ta' dan l-eżerċizzju, il-kategorija 'vhg' tinkludi ħaxix tal-ikel bħall-karrotti u l-kaboċċi.
formal.en: In this exercise's list, the category 'vhg' includes vegetables such as carrots and cabbages.
formal.zh: 在本练习的清单中，“vhg”类别包括胡萝卜和卷心菜等蔬菜。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi npoġġi taħt 'vhg' f'din il-lista? Mark: Poġġi l-karrotti u l-kaboċċi; hawn 'vhg' tfisser ħaxix tal-ikel.
colloquial.en: Sara: What should I put under 'vhg' on this list? Mark: Put carrots and cabbages; here 'vhg' means vegetables.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这张清单的“vhg”下面该填什么？马克：填胡萝卜和卷心菜；这里“vhg”表示蔬菜。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 这张清单的“vhg”下面该填什么？
messages.en: What should I put under 'vhg' on this list?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġi l-karrotti u l-kaboċċi; hawn 'vhg' tfisser ħaxix tal-ikel.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġi l-karrotti u l-kaboċċi; hawn 'vhg' tfisser ħaxix tal-ikel.
messages.zh: 填胡萝卜和卷心菜；这里“vhg”表示蔬菜。
messages.en: Put carrots and cabbages; here 'vhg' means vegetables.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把此练习标签贴在装有胡萝卜和卷心菜的菜篮图片旁，靠具体蔬菜画面记忆，不把字母组合解释为词根。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cassette containing magnetic tape on which moving images and sound can be recorded and played back.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 内装磁带、可用录像设备录制和播放影像与声音的盒式录像带。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kasett b'tejp manjetiku li fuqu jistgħu jiġu rrekordjati u jintwerew stampi li jiċċaqilqu flimkien mal-ħoss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于录制和播放影像及声音的盒式磁带，即录像带。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kasett li fih tejp manjetiku u li jintuża biex jiġu rrekordjati jew jintwerew filmati bil-ħoss.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A video cassette is a case containing magnetic tape that stores moving images and sound for playback on suitable equipment.

formal.mt: Il-librerija żammet il-vidjow kasett fl-arkivju biex il-film ikun jista' jiġi studjat fil-futur.
formal.en: The library kept the video cassette in its archive so that the film could be studied in the future.
formal.zh: 图书馆将这盒录像带保存在档案库中，以便将来研究其中的影片。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Sibt vidjow kasett fil-kaxxa. Taf x'hemm fuqu? Mark: Iva, hemm il-filmat tat-tieġ tan-nanniet.
colloquial.en: Maja: I found a video cassette in the box. Do you know what's on it? Mark: Yes, it has the recording of our grandparents' wedding.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我在箱子里找到了一盒录像带。你知道里面录了什么吗？马克：知道，里面是爷爷奶奶的婚礼录像。

messages.speaker: Maja (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: Sibt vidjow kasett fil-kaxxa. Taf x'hemm fuqu?
messages.mt_standard: Sibt vidjow kasett fil-kaxxa. Taf x'hemm fuqu?
messages.zh: 我在箱子里找到了一盒录像带。你知道里面录了什么吗？
messages.en: I found a video cassette in the box. Do you know what's on it?

messages.speaker: Mark (孙子)
messages.zh: 知道，里面是爷爷奶奶的婚礼录像。
messages.en: Yes, it has the recording of our grandparents' wedding.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与一盒装着家庭婚礼影像的旧录像带联系起来，记住它指实体录像带，而不是任意视频文件。

gloss_zh: 代牧；代理神父；先行到达的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A priest who carries out religious duties on behalf of another church official.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 代表另一位教会负责人履行宗教职务的神父，即代牧或代理神父。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Saċerdot li jwettaq dmirijiet reliġjużi f'isem uffiċjal ieħor tal-Knisja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 代牧；代理神父，指代表另一位教会负责人履行宗教职务的神职人员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Saċerdot li jaqdi dmirijiet reliġjużi f'isem persuna oħra li għandha kariga fil-Knisja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A vicar is a priest who performs religious duties on behalf of another church official.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who precedes the arrival of another
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在另一人到来之前先行到达的人；先遣者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tasal qabel persuna oħra li tkun għadha mistennija tasal.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person described this way arrives before another person whose arrival is still expected.

formal.mt: Il-vigarju mexxa ċ-ċerimonja u wara ltaqa' mal-familji li kienu preżenti.
formal.en: The vicar led the ceremony and afterwards met the families who were present.
formal.zh: 代牧主持了仪式，随后会见了在场的各个家庭。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min se jmexxi ċ-ċerimonja nhar il-Ħadd? Ġużeppi: Il-vigarju. Nistgħu nkellmuh wara l-quddiesa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who will lead the ceremony on Sunday? Ġużeppi: The vicar. We can speak to him after Mass.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：星期天谁来主持仪式？朱塞佩：代牧。我们可以在弥撒后和他谈谈。

messages.speaker: Marija (教友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jmexxi ċ-ċerimonja nhar il-Ħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jmexxi ċ-ċerimonja nhar il-Ħadd?
messages.zh: 星期天谁来主持仪式？
messages.en: Who will lead the ceremony on Sunday?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (教友)
messages.zh: 代牧。我们可以在弥撒后和他谈谈。
messages.en: The vicar. We can speak to him after Mass.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分成两个场景记忆：教堂里代表他人履职的是“代牧”，到达顺序中走在另一人前面的是“先行者”；依语境区分两个义项。

gloss_zh: 卑鄙的；恶劣的；令人厌恶的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Morally very bad or deeply unpleasant in a way that causes strong disgust.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容道德上十分卑劣，或恶劣到令人强烈厌恶的人、行为或事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li hu ħażin ħafna moralment jew tant spjaċevoli li jqajjem stmerrija qawwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卑鄙的；极其恶劣或令人作呕的，表达强烈的道德谴责或厌恶。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jistħoqqlu kundanna minħabba l-ħażen tiegħu, jew li jqajjem stmerrija kbira.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you describe someone or something as vile, you mean that they are morally very bad or extremely disgusting.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tagħha, il-kumitat iddeskriva l-abbuż tal-fiduċja tal-anzjani bħala att vili.
formal.en: In its report, the committee described the abuse of elderly people's trust as a vile act.
formal.zh: 委员会在报告中将利用老年人信任的行为描述为卑鄙之举。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Smajt li seraq il-flus li nġabru għall-familja? Toni: Iva, dak kien att vili. In-nies tawhom biex jgħinu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you hear that he stole the money collected for the family? Toni: Yes, that was a vile act. People donated it to help.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你听说他偷走了为那个家庭募集的钱吗？托尼：听说了，那种行为太卑鄙了。大家捐钱是为了帮忙。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt li seraq il-flus li nġabru għall-familja?
messages.mt_standard: Smajt li seraq il-flus li nġabru għall-familja?
messages.zh: 你听说他偷走了为那个家庭募集的钱吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that he stole the money collected for the family?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dak kien att vili. In-nies tawhom biex jgħinu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dak kien att vili. In-nies tawhom biex jgħinu.
messages.zh: 听说了，那种行为太卑鄙了。大家捐钱是为了帮忙。
messages.en: Yes, that was a vile act. People donated it to help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它和“偷走救助捐款的卑鄙行为”联系起来，记住这个词带有强烈谴责或厌恶，语气比普通的“坏”更重。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A house, usually spacious and detached, often with a garden.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常较宽敞、独立建造且常带花园的住宅。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dar li normalment tkun spazjuża, mibnija għaliha u ħafna drabi jkollha ġnien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 别墅；通常独立建造、较宽敞且常带花园的住宅。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dar spazjuża li normalment tkun mibnija għaliha u jista' jkollha ġnien madwarha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A villa is a house that is usually spacious and detached, often with its own garden.

formal.mt: Il-villa għandha tliet kmamar tas-sodda u ġnien kbir fuq wara.
formal.en: The villa has three bedrooms and a large garden at the back.
formal.zh: 这栋别墅有三间卧室，后面还有一个大花园。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt il-villa li hemm ħdejn il-baħar? Mark: Iva, għandha ġnien sabiħ ħafna!
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you seen the villa by the sea? Mark: Yes, it has a really beautiful garden!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看到海边那栋别墅了吗？马克：看到了，它的花园真漂亮！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt il-villa li hemm ħdejn il-baħar?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt il-villa li hemm ħdejn il-baħar?
messages.zh: 你看到海边那栋别墅了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen the villa by the sea?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了，它的花园真漂亮！
messages.en: Yes, it has a really beautiful garden!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 villa 和英语 villa 对照记忆，脑中画出一栋带花园的独立别墅，再读 villa bil-ġnien 加深印象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A wicked person, especially a character who does harmful things in a story.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做坏事的恶人，尤指故事中伤害他人或制造冲突的反派人物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna ħażina, speċjalment karattru fi storja li jagħmel il-ħsara lil ħaddieħor jew joħloq il-kunflitti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恶人；尤指故事、戏剧或电影中作恶的反派人物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel affarijiet ħżiena, jew karattru fi storja, dramm jew film li jagħmel il-ħsara lil oħrajn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A villain is a wicked person, especially a character whose harmful actions create conflict in a story.

formal.mt: F'dan ir-rumanz, il-villan iqarraq bin-nies biex jikseb il-poter.
formal.en: In this novel, the villain deceives people to gain power.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，反派通过欺骗人们来获取权力。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu l-villan f'dan il-film? Pawlu: Dak ir-raġel bil-kowt iswed.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is the villain in this film? Pawlu: That man in the black coat.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这部电影里的反派是谁？保罗：那个穿黑色外套的男人。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这部电影里的反派是谁？
messages.en: Who is the villain in this film?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个穿黑色外套的男人。
messages.en: That man in the black coat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用拼写对照记忆：villa 是别墅，villan 多一个 n，换成故事里的反派；这是辨词提示，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area of land where grapevines are grown to produce grapes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 种植葡萄藤、生产葡萄的一片土地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa art fejn jitkabbru d-dwieli biex jipproduċu l-għeneb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 葡萄园；成片种植葡萄藤以收获葡萄的土地。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għalqa jew biċċa art imħawla bid-dwieli li jitkabbru għall-għeneb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A vineyard is an area of land where grapevines are cultivated for their grapes.

collocations.zh: 一片种满葡萄藤的葡萄园

formal.mt: Il-bidwi jieħu ħsieb il-vinja matul is-sena kollha biex id-dwieli jibqgħu b'saħħithom.
formal.en: The farmer tends the vineyard throughout the year to keep the grapevines healthy.
formal.zh: 农民全年照料葡萄园，使葡萄藤保持健康。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn sejjer dalgħodu? Toni: Sejjer fil-vinja biex niġbor l-għeneb.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where are you going this morning? Toni: I'm going to the vineyard to pick grapes.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你今天早上去哪里？托尼：我去葡萄园摘葡萄。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 你今天早上去哪里？
messages.en: Where are you going this morning?

messages.speaker: Toni (果农)
messages.zh: 我去葡萄园摘葡萄。
messages.en: I'm going to the vineyard to pick grapes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 vinja 想成一整片整齐排列的葡萄藤：vinja 是种植的园地，għeneb 是收获的葡萄，用场景区分两词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A primate that typically climbs trees and uses its hands to grasp food and objects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 猴子，一类通常善于攀树、能用手抓取食物和物体的灵长类动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal primat li normalment jitla' mas-siġar u juża idejh biex jaqbad l-ikel u oġġetti oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 猴子；通常善于攀爬、能用手抓取东西的灵长类动物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Annimal primat li jista' jitla' mas-siġar u jaqbad l-ikel jew oġġetti oħra b'idejh.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A monkey is a primate that typically climbs trees and uses its hands to grasp food and other objects.

collocations.en: a monkey eating a piece of fruit
collocations.zh: 一只正在吃水果的猴子

formal.mt: Fl-istampa jidher vinkulari fuq fergħa, bi frotta f'idu.
formal.en: The picture shows a monkey on a branch, holding a piece of fruit.
formal.zh: 图中有一只猴子站在树枝上，手里拿着一个水果。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn hu l-vinkulari fl-istampa? Adam: Hemm fuq is-siġra, qed jiekol frotta!
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is the monkey in the picture? Adam: There in the tree, eating a piece of fruit!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：图里的猴子在哪里？亚当：在那棵树上，正在吃水果！

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 图里的猴子在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the monkey in the picture?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm fuq is-siġra, qed jiekol frotta!
messages.mt_standard: Hemm fuq is-siġra, qed jiekol frotta!
messages.zh: 在那棵树上，正在吃水果！
messages.en: There in the tree, eating a piece of fruit!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 vinkulari 写在猴子图片旁，配上“树上拿着水果”的画面；每次遮住中文，看图说词，建立直接联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A long, thin, rigid object used for support, measurement, or another practical purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 细长而坚硬的杆状物，可用于支撑、测量或其他实际用途。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett twil, irqiq u riġidu li jintuża bħala appoġġ, għall-kejl jew għal xi skop prattiku ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于盛装或保存食品、饮料等物品的金属罐。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reċipjent tal-metall li jintuża biex iżomm jew jippreserva ikel, xorb jew prodotti oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A can is a metal container used for holding food, drinks, or other products.
