sense_translations.en_explanation: A double-phase short-circuit occurs when two electrical phases become connected through an unintended path of low resistance.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tekniku jiddeskrivi xort fiċ-ċirkwit bifażi u jidentifika ż-żewġ fażijiet involuti.
formal.en: The technical report describes a double-phase short-circuit and identifies the two phases involved.
formal.zh: 技术报告描述了一次两相短路，并指出了所涉及的两相。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fir-rapport hemm miktub 'xort fiċ-ċirkwit bifażi'. Xi jfisser? Rita: Ifisser li kien hemm short circuit bejn żewġ fażijiet.
colloquial.en: Mark: The report says 'double-phase short-circuit'. What does that mean? Rita: It means there was a short circuit between two phases.
colloquial.zh: 马克：报告里写着“两相短路”。这是什么意思？丽塔：意思是两相之间发生了短路。

messages.speaker: Mark (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fir-rapport hemm miktub 'xort fiċ-ċirkwit bifażi'. Xi jfisser?
messages.mt_standard: Fir-rapport hemm miktub 'xort fiċ-ċirkwit bifażi'. Xi jfisser?
messages.zh: 报告里写着“两相短路”。这是什么意思？
messages.en: The report says 'double-phase short-circuit'. What does that mean?

messages.speaker: Rita (电工教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li kien hemm short circuit bejn żewġ fażijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li kien hemm short circuit bejn żewġ fażijiet.
messages.zh: 意思是两相之间发生了短路。
messages.en: It means there was a short circuit between two phases.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整条术语配上“两条相线发生短路”的示意图，看到 bifażi 就回想图中的两相；这是场景记忆，不是词源分析。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An electrical short-circuit fault involving one phase and an unintended low-resistance current path.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涉及一个相的短路故障，其中电流形成非预期的低电阻通路，可能引起过大的电流。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħsara elettrika li tinvolvi fażi waħda u mogħdija mhux intenzjonata b'reżistenza baxxa għall-kurrent, u li tista' twassal għal kurrent għoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 单相短路：涉及一个相并形成非预期低电阻电流通路的电气故障。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħsara f'sistema elettrika li tinvolvi fażi waħda u sseħħ meta tinħoloq mogħdija mhux intenzjonata b'reżistenza baxxa għall-kurrent.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A single-phase short-circuit is an electrical fault involving one phase in which current follows an unintended low-resistance path.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tekniku jiddeskrivi xort fiċ-ċirkwit monofażi u jidentifika l-fażi involuta.
formal.en: The technical report describes a single-phase short-circuit and identifies the phase involved.
formal.zh: 技术报告描述了一次单相短路，并指出了所涉及的相。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fir-rapport hemm miktub 'xort fiċ-ċirkwit monofażi'. Kemm-il fażi tinvolvi din il-ħsara? Pawlu: Tinvolvi fażi waħda.
colloquial.en: Lara: The report says 'single-phase short-circuit'. How many phases does this fault involve? Pawlu: It involves one phase.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：报告里写着“单相短路”。这种故障涉及几个相？保罗：涉及一个相。

messages.speaker: Lara (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fir-rapport hemm miktub 'xort fiċ-ċirkwit monofażi'. Kemm-il fażi tinvolvi din il-ħsara?
messages.mt_standard: Fir-rapport hemm miktub 'xort fiċ-ċirkwit monofażi'. Kemm-il fażi tinvolvi din il-ħsara?
messages.zh: 报告里写着“单相短路”。这种故障涉及几个相？
messages.en: The report says 'single-phase short-circuit'. How many phases does this fault involve?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (电工教师)
messages.zh: 涉及一个相。
messages.en: It involves one phase.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整条术语写在“一相发生短路”的学习卡上，并圈出数字一；看到 monofażi 时回想“单相短路”的完整概念。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An electrical fault in which all three phases become connected through unintended low-resistance paths.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 三相电气系统中三个相之间形成非预期的低电阻连接的短路故障，可能引起过大的电流。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħsara elettrika li fiha t-tliet fażijiet jingħaqdu permezz ta' mogħdijiet mhux intenzjonati b'reżistenza baxxa, u dan jista' jwassal għal kurrent għoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 三相短路：三个相之间出现非预期低电阻连接的电气故障。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħsara f'sistema elettrika bi tliet fażijiet li sseħħ meta jkun hemm konnessjonijiet mhux intenzjonati b'reżistenza baxxa bejn it-tliet fażijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A triple-phase short-circuit occurs when all three electrical phases become connected through unintended paths of low resistance.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tekniku jiddeskrivi xort fiċ-ċirkwit trifażi u jikkonferma li l-ħsara kienet tinvolvi t-tliet fażijiet.
formal.en: The technical report describes a triple-phase short-circuit and confirms that the fault involved all three phases.
formal.zh: 技术报告描述了一次三相短路，并确认该故障涉及全部三个相。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fir-rapport hemm miktub 'xort fiċ-ċirkwit trifażi'. Jiġifieri kienu involuti t-tliet fażijiet? Karl: Iva, din il-ħsara kienet tinvolvihom kollha.
colloquial.en: Nina: The report says 'triple-phase short-circuit'. Does that mean all three phases were involved? Karl: Yes, this fault involved all of them.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：报告里写着“三相短路”。意思是三个相都涉及其中吗？卡尔：是的，这次故障涉及全部三个相。

messages.speaker: Nina (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fir-rapport hemm miktub 'xort fiċ-ċirkwit trifażi'. Jiġifieri kienu involuti t-tliet fażijiet?
messages.mt_standard: Fir-rapport hemm miktub 'xort fiċ-ċirkwit trifażi'. Jiġifieri kienu involuti t-tliet fażijiet?
messages.zh: 报告里写着“三相短路”。意思是三个相都涉及其中吗？
messages.en: The report says 'triple-phase short-circuit'. Does that mean all three phases were involved?

messages.speaker: Karl (电工教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, din il-ħsara kienet tinvolvihom kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, din il-ħsara kienet tinvolvihom kollha.
messages.zh: 是的，这次故障涉及全部三个相。
messages.en: Yes, this fault involved all of them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在学习卡上画出三条相线，并把三个相一起圈入故障范围；看到 trifażi 就回想“三个相全部涉及”的三相短路场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Different from something else, especially in kind or type.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与另一事物不同的，尤其指属于另一种类或类型的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Din l-espressjoni tindika li xi ħaġa hija differenti minn oħra, speċjalment fit-tip jew fil-għamla tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不同的；与所比较的事物不一样的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Din l-espressjoni tiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li mhijiex l-istess bħal dik li tkun qed titqabbel magħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is different is not the same as the thing being compared with it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 另一种类的；在类别或性质上有所不同的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Din l-espressjoni tindika li xi ħaġa tappartjeni għal tip ieħor jew għandha natura differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something of a different kind belongs to another type or has a different nature.

formal.mt: Għat-tieni prova ntuża materjal xort'oħra sabiex jitqabblu r-riżultati.
formal.en: A different kind of material was used for the second test so that the results could be compared.
formal.zh: 第二次试验使用了另一种材料，以便比较结果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid l-istess kejk bħal dejjem? Mark: Le, illum nixtieq xi ħaġa xort'oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want the same cake as usual? Mark: No, today I'd like something different.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你要和平时一样的蛋糕吗？马克：不要，今天我想换一种。

messages.speaker: Maja (店员)
messages.zh: 你要和平时一样的蛋糕吗？
messages.en: Do you want the same cake as usual?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, illum nixtieq xi ħaġa xort'oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Le, illum nixtieq xi ħaġa xort'oħra.
messages.zh: 不要，今天我想换一种。
messages.en: No, today I'd like something different.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象每天买同一种蛋糕，今天指向另一款说这个表达，把它记作“换一种、来点不同的”。

gloss_zh: 一种阴道用海绵施用器

teaching_sense.en_definition: A type of applicator that includes a sponge and is intended for vaginal use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种带有海绵、供阴道使用的施用器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' applikatur li għandu sponża u huwa maħsub għall-użu fil-vaġina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阴道用海绵施用器，即带有海绵、供阴道使用的器具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Applikatur li jinkludi sponża u li huwa maħsub biex jintuża fil-vaġina.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A vaginal sponge applicator is a device that includes a sponge and is intended for vaginal use.

collocations.mt: deskrizzjoni ta' xorta ta' applikatur bl-isponża għall-vaġina
collocations.en: a description of a type of vaginal sponge applicator
collocations.zh: 对一种阴道用海绵施用器的描述

collocations.mt: informazzjoni dwar xorta ta' applikatur bl-isponża għall-vaġina
collocations.en: information about a type of vaginal sponge applicator
collocations.zh: 关于一种阴道用海绵施用器的信息

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jiddeskrivi xorta ta' applikatur bl-isponża għall-vaġina u jagħti d-dimensjonijiet tagħha.
formal.en: The catalogue describes a type of vaginal sponge applicator and gives its dimensions.
formal.zh: 目录描述了一种阴道用海绵施用器，并列出了其尺寸。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'xorta ta' applikatur bl-isponża għall-vaġina'? Lara: Ifisser tip ta' applikatur li għandu sponża u huwa maħsub għall-użu fil-vaġina.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'a type of vaginal sponge applicator' mean? Lara: It means a type of applicator with a sponge that is intended for vaginal use.
colloquial.zh: Maja：“一种阴道用海绵施用器”是什么意思？Lara：意思是一种带有海绵、供阴道使用的施用器。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser 'xorta ta' applikatur bl-isponża għall-vaġina'?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser 'xorta ta' applikatur bl-isponża għall-vaġina'?
messages.zh: “一种阴道用海绵施用器”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'a type of vaginal sponge applicator' mean?

messages.speaker: Lara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser tip ta' applikatur li għandu sponża u huwa maħsub għall-użu fil-vaġina.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser tip ta' applikatur li għandu sponża u huwa maħsub għall-użu fil-vaġina.
messages.zh: 意思是一种带有海绵、供阴道使用的施用器。
messages.en: It means a type of applicator with a sponge that is intended for vaginal use.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“一种—施用器—带海绵—供阴道使用”四段理解长短语，先记器具名称，再记材料和用途限定。

gloss_zh: 仍然；无论如何；以同样方式

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression meaning that something happens despite a difficulty, or that people or things are treated in the same way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某事尽管有困难仍然发生，或表示对人或事物采取同样的方式；具体意义由上下文决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li turi li xi ħaġa ssir minkejja diffikultà jew ċirkustanza oħra, jew li persuni jew affarijiet jiġu ttrattati bl-istess mod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仍然，尽管如此；无论如何；以同样的方式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tfisser minkejja dak li jkun intqal jew ġara, ikun xi jkun il-każ, jew bl-istess mod, skont il-kuntest.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression when something happens despite other circumstances, regardless of them, or in the same way as something else.

formal.mt: Għalkemm kien hemm dewmien fit-trasport, il-laqgħa saret xorta waħda.
formal.en: Although there were transport delays, the meeting took place anyway.
formal.zh: 尽管交通出现延误，会议仍然举行了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tagħmel ix-xita. Se tmur xorta waħda? Lara: Iva, se nieħu umbrella u mmur.
colloquial.en: Maja: It's raining. Are you going anyway? Lara: Yes, I'll take an umbrella and go.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：正在下雨。你还是要去吗？拉拉：是的，我带把伞就去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tagħmel ix-xita. Se tmur xorta waħda?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tagħmel ix-xita. Se tmur xorta waħda?
messages.zh: 正在下雨。你还是要去吗？
messages.en: It's raining. Are you going anyway?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se nieħu umbrella u mmur.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se nieħu umbrella u mmur.
messages.zh: 是的，我带把伞就去。
messages.en: Yes, I'll take an umbrella and go.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景记忆：下雨也照样去，对大家也照样对待；根据语境把“照样”理解为“仍然”或“同样地”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unfortunate or unlucky, with bad luck affecting what happens to him.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某人遭遇不幸或运气不好；这一表达具体涉及男性的运气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Din l-espressjoni tindika li raġel għandu xorti ħażina jew li ġratlu xi ħaġa sfortunata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不幸的；遭遇令人遗憾或不利情况的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Din l-espressjoni tiddeskrivi raġel li ġarrab ġrajja sfortunata jew sab ruħu f'qagħda ħażina.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is unfortunate experiences an event or situation that brings difficulty or disappointment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 运气不好的；因坏运气而遭遇不利结果的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Din l-espressjoni tindika li l-affarijiet ma marrux tajjeb għal raġel minħabba xorti ħażina.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is unlucky has things go badly because chance does not favour him.

collocations.en: his bad luck in the game

formal.mt: Minħabba xortih ħażina, il-parteċipant tilef il-premju minkejja t-tħejjija tajba tiegħu.
formal.en: Because of his bad luck, the participant missed out on the prize despite his thorough preparation.
formal.zh: 由于运气不好，这位参赛者尽管准备充分，仍与奖项失之交臂。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark reġa' tilef il-karozza tal-linja. Lara: Minħabba xortih ħażina, wasal fil-waqfa eżatt wara li telqet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark missed the bus again. Lara: With his bad luck, he reached the stop just after it left.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克又没赶上公交车。拉拉：他运气真不好，刚到车站，车就开走了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克又没赶上公交车。
messages.en: Mark missed the bus again.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba xortih ħażina, wasal fil-waqfa eżatt wara li telqet.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba xortih ħażina, wasal fil-waqfa eżatt wara li telqet.
messages.zh: 他运气真不好，刚到车站，车就开走了。
messages.en: With his bad luck, he reached the stop just after it left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整句和“他刚到车站，车就开走”的画面绑定，记住它表达他不幸或运气不好。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Erupted, releasing material suddenly and forcefully.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 喷发了；指物质突然猛烈地喷出，可用于描述火山喷发。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dan il-verb jiddeskrivi ħruġ f'daqqa u b'qawwa, bħal meta vulkan joħroġ lava u rmied.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喷发了；突然猛烈地向外喷出物质。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dan il-verb ifisser li seħħ ħruġ qawwi u f'daqqa ta' materjal, bħall-lava minn vulkan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a volcano erupted, it suddenly released lava, ash, or gases with great force.

formal.mt: Il-vulkan xpakka matul il-lejl, u l-awtoritajiet għalqu t-toroq fil-qrib.
formal.en: The volcano erupted during the night, and the authorities closed nearby roads.
formal.zh: 火山在夜间喷发，当局关闭了附近的道路。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt l-aħbarijiet? Il-vulkan xpakka dalgħodu. Mark: Iva, rajt ir-ritratti tal-irmied.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you see the news? The volcano erupted this morning. Mark: Yes, I saw the pictures of the ash.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看新闻了吗？火山今天早上喷发了。马克：看了，我看到了火山灰的照片。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看新闻了吗？火山今天早上喷发了。
messages.en: Did you see the news? The volcano erupted this morning.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 看了，我看到了火山灰的照片。
messages.en: Yes, I saw the pictures of the ash.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上一段火山突然喷出熔岩的短片，并用“喷发了”提醒自己这里描述已发生的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An absorbent cloth used to soak up liquids.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够吸收液体的布，可用来吸干洒出的水或擦拭湿处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xraba hija drapp li jassorbi l-likwidi u li jista' jintuża biex jiġbor ilma mxerred jew biex jimsaħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吸水布；用来吸收水或其他液体的布。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xraba hija biċċa drapp li tassorbi l-ilma jew likwidi oħra u tintuża biex timsaħ jew tiġbor likwidu mxerred.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An absorbent cloth is a piece of fabric that takes in liquid when placed against it.

formal.mt: Wara li nxtered l-ilma fuq il-mejda, il-ħaddiem uża xraba biex jassorbih.
formal.en: After water spilled onto the table, the worker used an absorbent cloth to soak it up.
formal.zh: 水洒到桌面后，工作人员用吸水布将水吸干。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xerridt l-ilma fuq il-mejda! Mark: Hawn biċċa xraba. Użaha biex timsaħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: I spilled water on the table! Mark: Here's a piece of absorbent cloth. Use it to wipe it up.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我把水洒到桌上了！马克：这里有块吸水布，用它擦干吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 我把水洒到桌上了！
messages.en: I spilled water on the table!

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn biċċa xraba. Użaha biex timsaħ.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn biċċa xraba. Użaha biex timsaħ.
messages.zh: 这里有块吸水布，用它擦干吧。
messages.en: Here's a piece of absorbent cloth. Use it to wipe it up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌上的一小摊水被布迅速吸进去，把词和“吸收液体的布”这个用途一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small glowing particle produced by fire or friction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 燃烧或摩擦时产生的细小发光颗粒，即火花。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frak żgħir li jixgħel u jtir min-nar jew minħabba l-frizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 火花；从燃烧物或摩擦处迸出的细小发光颗粒。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Frak żgħir u jaħraq li jixgħel għal ftit ħin meta jtir min-nar jew jinħoloq bil-frizzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A spark is a tiny glowing particle that comes from a fire or is produced by friction.

formal.mt: Waqt il-qtugħ tal-metall, ix-xrar jista' jikkawża ħruq.
formal.en: During metal cutting, sparks can cause burns.
formal.zh: 切割金属时，火花可能造成灼伤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tara x-xrar ħiereġ min-nar? Mark: Iva, ejja noqogħdu ftit aktar 'il bogħod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you see the sparks coming from the fire? Mark: Yes, let's stand a little farther away.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看到火里迸出的火花了吗？马克：看到了，我们站远一点吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到火里迸出的火花了吗？
messages.en: Can you see the sparks coming from the fire?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja noqogħdu ftit aktar 'il bogħod.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja noqogħdu ftit aktar 'il bogħod.
messages.zh: 看到了，我们站远一点吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's stand a little farther away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xrar 配上篝火迸出亮点的画面，连同“火花”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Materials used to take up and retain liquids.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于吸入并留住液体的材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjali li jintużaw biex jassorbu u jżommu fihom likwidi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吸收材料；能够吸入并留住液体的物质或用品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Materjali jew oġġetti li jiġbdu likwidi għal ġo fihom u jżommuhom hemm.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Absorbents are materials that take liquids into themselves and hold them.

formal.mt: Il-likwidu mxerred għandu jinġabar bix-xrejjeb.
formal.en: The spilled liquid should be collected using absorbents.
formal.zh: 应使用吸收材料清理洒出的液体。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn huma x-xrejjeb? Xerridt ftit ilma. Mark: Fil-kaxxa ħdejn il-bieb. Ħu kemm għandek bżonn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are the absorbents? I've spilled some water. Mark: In the box beside the door. Take as many as you need.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：吸收材料在哪里？我洒了些水。马克：在门旁边的箱子里。需要多少就拿多少。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn huma x-xrejjeb? Xerridt ftit ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn huma x-xrejjeb? Xerridt ftit ilma.
messages.zh: 吸收材料在哪里？我洒了些水。
messages.en: Where are the absorbents? I've spilled some water.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-kaxxa ħdejn il-bieb. Ħu kemm għandek bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-kaxxa ħdejn il-bieb. Ħu kemm għandek bżonn.
messages.zh: 在门旁边的箱子里。需要多少就拿多少。
messages.en: In the box beside the door. Take as many as you need.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xrejjeb 放进“洒水后拿材料吸干”的场景，记住它指吸收材料。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A broad, flat piece of stone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一块宽而平的石料，即石板。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa ġebel wiesgħa u ċatta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 石板；具有宽阔平面的板状石料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa ġebel b'wiċċ wiesa' u ċatt, magħmula f'għamla ta' ċangatura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A stone slab is a broad, flat piece of stone.

collocations.en: the surface of the stone slab

formal.mt: Qabel l-installazzjoni, għandu jitnaddaf il-wiċċ tax-xriek.
formal.en: Before installation, the surface of the stone slab should be cleaned.
formal.zh: 安装前，应清洁石板的表面。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn inpoġġi l-vażun? Mark: Poġġih fuq ix-xriek ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall I put the vase? Mark: Put it on the stone slab beside the door.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我把花瓶放在哪里？马克：放在门旁边的石板上吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 我把花瓶放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall I put the vase?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 放在门旁边的石板上吧。
messages.en: Put it on the stone slab beside the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一块平整石板上摆着花瓶，把 xriek 与“石板”及其平面联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose meaning is not established in the supplied packet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给资料将此词标为名词，但未提供可确定的具体词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li t-tifsira tiegħu mhijiex stabbilita fl-informazzjoni mogħtija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具体词义未明；问号表示所给资料未确定该名词的含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira ta' dan in-nom mhijiex magħrufa mill-informazzjoni mogħtija, fejn tidher biss marka ta' mistoqsija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied entry identifies a noun but does not establish its meaning.

formal.mt: F'din il-lista, il-kelma 'xrobb' hija mmarkata bħala nom, iżda t-tifsira tagħha mhijiex mogħtija.
formal.en: In this list, the word 'xrobb' is marked as a noun, but its meaning is not provided.
formal.zh: 在这份词表中，“xrobb”被标为名词，但没有给出其含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'xrobb'? Mark: Ma nafx. Hawn hemm biss marka ta' mistoqsija.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word 'xrobb' mean? Mark: I don't know. There's only a question mark here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：“xrobb”这个词是什么意思？马克：我不知道。这里只有一个问号。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: “xrobb”这个词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word 'xrobb' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx. Hawn hemm biss marka ta' mistoqsija.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx. Hawn hemm biss marka ta' mistoqsija.
messages.zh: 我不知道。这里只有一个问号。
messages.en: I don't know. There's only a question mark here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xrobb 写在带问号的词卡上，暂记“名词，词义待定”，不要凭字形猜义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small beach beside the sea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 海边面积较小的一片海滩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bajja żgħira max-xatt tal-baħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一片面积较小的海滩。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bajja żgħira fejn l-art tiltaqa' mal-baħar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A small beach is a limited stretch of shore beside the sea.

formal.mt: Il-mixja tispiċċa ħdejn xtajta ramlija fejn il-viżitaturi jistgħu jistrieħu.
formal.en: The walk ends beside a small sandy beach where visitors can rest.
formal.zh: 步行路线终点旁有一小片沙滩，游客可以在那里休息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se mmorru ngħumu? Toni: Hemm xtajta kwieta wara dawk il-blat. Maja: Mela ejja mmorru hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we go swimming? Toni: There is a quiet little beach behind those rocks. Maja: Then let's go there.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们去哪里游泳？Toni：那些岩石后面有一片宁静的小海滩。Maja：那我们就去那里吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们去哪里游泳？
messages.en: Where shall we go swimming?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm xtajta kwieta wara dawk il-blat.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm xtajta kwieta wara dawk il-blat.
messages.zh: 那些岩石后面有一片宁静的小海滩。
messages.en: There is a quiet little beach behind those rocks.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们就去那里吧。
messages.en: Then let's go there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xtajta 联想成岩石后藏着的一小片海滩，用“小而安静的海边”这一画面记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rack used to hold or arrange objects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于放置、支撑或整齐收纳物品的架子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Struttura li fuqha jitqiegħdu jew jinżammu oġġetti b'mod organizzat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用来放置、支撑或收纳物品的架子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Qafas jew struttura magħmula biex iżżomm oġġetti mqiegħda fuqha jew fiha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A rack is a frame used for holding or arranging particular objects.

formal.mt: Wara l-ħasil, il-platti għandhom jitqiegħdu fuq l-xtilliera biex jinxfu.
formal.en: After washing, the plates should be placed on the rack to dry.
formal.zh: 清洗后，应将盘子放在架子上晾干。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn inpoġġi dawn iż-żraben? Mark: Fuq l-xtilliera ħdejn il-bieb. Sara: Tajjeb, hemm post għalihom.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where should I put these shoes? Mark: On the rack beside the door. Sara: Good, there is room for them.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这些鞋放在哪里？Mark：放在门旁的架子上。Sara：好，那里有地方放。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 这些鞋放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put these shoes?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 放在门旁的架子上。
messages.en: On the rack beside the door.

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 好，那里有地方放。
messages.en: Good, there is room for them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 xtilliera 时想象门边鞋子整齐排在架上，再用“碗碟架、鞋架”两个场景巩固词义。

gloss_zh: 建筑上剥落的碎石；指（趾）甲周围的疼痛肿胀；极小或极窄之物

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small pieces of masonry chipped off a building.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从建筑物上敲落或剥落的细小砖石碎片。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frak jew biċċiet żgħar tal-ġebel li jinqalgħu minn bini.

sense_translations.en_definition: shards of masonry chipped off a building
sense_translations.zh_definition: 从建筑物上敲落或剥落的砖石碎片。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċiet żgħar u frak tal-ġebel li jinqalgħu minn bini meta dan jitqaxxar jew jintlaqat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: These are small fragments of masonry that have been chipped away from a building.

sense_translations.en_definition: agnail (a painful swelling around a fingernail or toenail)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 手指甲或脚趾甲周围出现的疼痛性肿胀。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nefħa li tweġġa' fil-ġilda ta' madwar difer ta' sebgħa tal-id jew tas-sieq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An agnail is a painful swelling affecting the skin around a fingernail or toenail.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常小或非常狭窄的东西。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħaġa li tkun żgħira ħafna jew dejqa ħafna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this word for something that is exceptionally small or narrow.

collocations.en: a painful swelling around the nail

formal.mt: Matul ix-xogħol fuq il-faċċata nġabret ix-xulliefa tal-ġebel biex il-bankina tibqa' nadifa.
formal.en: During work on the facade, the masonry chips were collected to keep the pavement clean.
formal.zh: 施工人员在处理建筑立面时收集了剥落的砖石碎片，以保持人行道清洁。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed iżżomm subgħajk hekk? Pawlu: Għandi xulliefa madwar id-difer u tweġġagħni. Lara: Mela oqgħod attent meta taqbad l-affarijiet.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you holding your finger like that? Pawlu: I have a swelling around the nail, and it hurts. Lara: Then be careful when you pick things up.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么那样抬着手指？Pawlu：我的指甲周围肿了，很疼。Lara：那你拿东西时小心些。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么那样抬着手指？
messages.en: Why are you holding your finger like that?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi xulliefa madwar id-difer u tweġġagħni.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi xulliefa madwar id-difer u tweġġagħni.
messages.zh: 我的指甲周围肿了，很疼。
messages.en: I have a swelling around the nail, and it hurts.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela oqgħod attent meta taqbad l-affarijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Mela oqgħod attent meta taqbad l-affarijiet.
messages.zh: 那你拿东西时小心些。
messages.en: Then be careful when you pick things up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张独立词义卡记 xulliefa：墙边碎石、甲边疼肿、极小窄物；这是分类记忆，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person from Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自马耳他的人，即马耳他人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna minn Malta; persuna Maltija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他人；来自马耳他的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li hija minn Malta, jiġifieri persuna Maltija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A Maltese person is someone who comes from Malta.

collocations.zh: 来自马耳他的马耳他人
居住在国外的马耳他人

formal.mt: Fit-test, il-kelma Xumakka tirreferi għal persuna minn Malta.
formal.en: In the text, the word Xumakka refers to a person from Malta.
formal.zh: 在这篇文字中，Xumakka 一词指来自马耳他的人。

colloquial.mt: Mei: Xi tfisser Xumakka f'din is-sentenza? Toni: Hawnhekk tfisser persuna Maltija. Mei: Issa fhimt min qed isemmi t-test.
colloquial.en: Mei: What does Xumakka mean in this sentence? Toni: Here it means a Maltese person. Mei: Now I understand who the text is referring to.
colloquial.zh: Mei：这句话里的 Xumakka 是什么意思？Toni：这里指一个马耳他人。Mei：现在我明白文章说的是谁了。

messages.speaker: Mei (马耳他语学习者)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 Xumakka 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does Xumakka mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Toni (语言教师)
messages.zh: 这里指一个马耳他人。
messages.en: Here it means a Maltese person.

messages.speaker: Mei (马耳他语学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa fhimt min qed isemmi t-test.
messages.mt_standard: Issa fhimt min qed isemmi t-test.
messages.zh: 现在我明白文章说的是谁了。
messages.en: Now I understand who the text is referring to.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 Xumakka 配一张人物站在马耳他地图旁的词卡，用“来自马耳他的人”这一完整短语记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A kick, especially an attempt to send a ball into a goal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用脚踢的动作，尤指把球踢向球门的射门。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daqqa bis-sieq, speċjalment meta plejer jagħtiha lil ballun biex jipprova jiskorja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 球类运动中把球踢向球门、试图得分的一次射门。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tentattiv biex plejer jiskorja billi jagħti daqqa lill-ballun u jibagħtu lejn il-lasta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A shot is an attempt to score by sending the ball towards the goal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用脚踢某物的一下或一次动作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Daqqa li persuna tagħti lil xi ħaġa b'sieqha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A kick is a movement in which someone strikes something with their foot.

collocations.zh: 有力的一脚踢球或射门

formal.mt: Il-plejer skorja b'xutt qawwi minn barra l-kaxxa.
formal.en: The player scored with a powerful shot from outside the penalty area.
formal.zh: 这名球员在禁区外大力射门得分。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Rajt dak ix-xutt? Pawlu: Iva, imma l-gowler salva l-ballun!
colloquial.en: Mark: Did you see that shot? Pawlu: Yes, but the goalkeeper saved it!
colloquial.zh: Mark：你看到那脚射门了吗？Pawlu：看到了，不过守门员把球扑住了！

messages.speaker: Mark (队友)
messages.zh: 你看到那脚射门了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that shot?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (队友)
messages.zh: 看到了，不过守门员把球扑住了！
messages.en: Yes, but the goalkeeper saved it!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象球员抬脚踢球的画面：普通的一脚是“踢”，瞄准球门的一脚就是“射门”，用同一动作串起两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having long hair.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人留着长头发的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu xagħru twil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长着或留着长头发的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li għandha xagħar twil.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is long-haired has hair that is long.

collocations.zh: 一个留长发的年轻男子

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt jidher żagħżugħ xuxan bilwieqfa ħdejn siġra.
formal.en: The photograph shows a long-haired young man standing beside a tree.
formal.zh: 照片中可以看到一名留着长发的年轻男子站在树旁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak ir-raġel xuxan? Lara: Dak ħija; għandu xagħru twil ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that long-haired man? Lara: That's my brother; his hair is very long.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那个长头发的男人是谁？Lara：那是我哥哥，他的头发很长。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个长头发的男人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that long-haired man?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ħija; għandu xagħru twil ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ħija; għandu xagħru twil ħafna.
messages.zh: 那是我哥哥，他的头发很长。
messages.en: That's my brother; his hair is very long.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个形容词贴在一张长发人物画像旁，看到头发垂下来的样子就回想“长头发的”，并整组记住 raġel xuxan。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The hair that grows above the upper lip.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长在上唇上方的胡须，即髭。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xagħar li jikber fuq ix-xoffa ta' fuq, taħt l-imnieħer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 上唇上方、鼻子下方的胡须。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ix-xagħar li jikber bejn l-imnieħer u x-xoffa ta' fuq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A moustache is the hair that grows above someone's upper lip.

collocations.zh: 一个留着上唇胡须的男人

formal.mt: Ir-raġel fir-ritratt jingħaraf mix-xwarib tiegħu.
formal.en: The man in the photograph can be recognized by his moustache.
formal.zh: 凭着上唇的胡须，可以认出照片中的这名男子。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Se żżomm ix-xwarib? Mark: Iva, u se mmur għand il-barbier għada.
colloquial.en: Nina: Are you going to keep your moustache? Mark: Yes, and I'm going to the barber tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你打算保留上唇的胡须吗？Mark：是的，我明天还要去理发师那里。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你打算保留上唇的胡须吗？
messages.en: Are you going to keep your moustache?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u se mmur għand il-barbier għada.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u se mmur għand il-barbier għada.
messages.zh: 是的，我明天还要去理发师那里。
messages.en: Yes, and I'm going to the barber tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在人物鼻子下面、上唇上面画一小条胡须，再标上 xwarib；用这个明确位置记住它指上唇胡须。

gloss_zh: 放松自在的；有宽裕活动空间的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relaxed and comfortable, or having plenty of room to move and sit comfortably.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人放松自在，或有充足空间活动、舒展身体和舒适就坐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħossu rilassat u komdu, jew li għandu biżżejjed spazju biex jiċċaqlaq u joqgħod kif jixtieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 身心放松、舒适自在而不拘束的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jħossu rilassat u komdu, mingħajr tensjoni jew skumdità.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is relaxed and at ease, they feel comfortable and free from tension.

sense_translations.en_definition: having ample room (e.g. to move around or make oneself comfortable)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 有充裕空间可以活动、舒展身体或让自己待得舒服的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu spazju biżżejjed madwaru biex jiċċaqlaq jew joqgħod komdu mingħajr ma jkun magħfus.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone with ample room has enough space around them to move or settle comfortably.

collocations.en: to feel relaxed and at ease
to sit comfortably on the sofa with plenty of room
collocations.zh: 在沙发上宽宽松松地舒适就坐

formal.mt: Is-siġġijiet tqiegħdu 'l bogħod minn xulxin sabiex kull parteċipant ikun jista' joqgħod xxamplat.
formal.en: The chairs were placed far apart so that each participant could sit comfortably with plenty of room.
formal.zh: 椅子之间留出了较大的距离，让每位参与者都有充裕空间舒适就坐。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandek biżżejjed spazju hemm? Pawlu: Iva, hawn nista' noqgħod xxamplat u nirrilassa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you got enough room there? Pawlu: Yes, I can sit comfortably here and relax.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你那里空间够吗？Pawlu：够，我在这里可以舒舒服服地坐着，放松一下。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你那里空间够吗？
messages.en: Have you got enough room there?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn nista' noqgħod xxamplat u nirrilassa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn nista' noqgħod xxamplat u nirrilassa.
messages.zh: 够，我在这里可以舒舒服服地坐着，放松一下。
messages.en: Yes, I can sit comfortably here and relax.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己独坐宽长沙发，手脚可以舒展，心情也放松；用“空间宽裕”和“感觉自在”两个画面连接这两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A greeting used when meeting or addressing someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 见到别人或开始与别人交谈时使用的问候语，相当于“你好”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tislima li tintuża meta tiltaqa' ma' xi ħadd jew tibda tkellmu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 见面或开始交谈时使用的问候语“你好”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma ta' tislima li tgħid lil xi ħadd meta tiltaqa' miegħu jew tibda konverżazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A hello is a greeting that you give someone when you meet them or begin speaking to them.

collocations.zh: 用“你好”这个词表达的问候
用“你好”这个词作出的回应

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, il-kelma 'xxcadddflrirddfgdsgg' tintuża bħala tislima fil-bidu ta' konverżazzjoni.
formal.en: In this exercise, the word 'xxcadddflrirddfgdsgg' is used as a greeting at the beginning of a conversation.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，“xxcadddflrirddfgdsgg”用作交谈开始时的问候语。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'xxcadddflrirddfgdsgg'? Lara: Hija tislima li tuża meta tiltaqa' ma' xi ħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'xxcadddflrirddfgdsgg' mean? Lara: It is a greeting you use when you meet someone.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：‘xxcadddflrirddfgdsgg’是什么意思？拉拉：这是见到别人时使用的问候语。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: ‘xxcadddflrirddfgdsgg’是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'xxcadddflrirddfgdsgg' mean?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija tislima li tuża meta tiltaqa' ma' xi ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Hija tislima li tuża meta tiltaqa' ma' xi ħadd.
messages.zh: 这是见到别人时使用的问候语。
messages.en: It is a greeting you use when you meet someone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词形放在“见面挥手说你好”的画面旁记忆；先对应问候功能，不把字母串拆成词根。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To strike a ball or another object with the foot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用脚踢球或其他物体，使其移动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tolqot ballun jew oġġett ieħor b'sieqek biex iċċaqalqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用脚踢某物，例如踢球。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħti daqqa b'sieqek lil xi ħaġa, bħal ballun, biex iċċaqlaqha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you kick something, such as a ball, you strike it with your foot.

formal.mt: Il-plejer xxutja l-ballun lejn il-lasta, iżda l-gowler waqqfu.
formal.en: The player kicked the ball towards the goal, but the goalkeeper stopped it.
formal.zh: 球员把球踢向球门，但守门员将球挡住了。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min xxutja l-ballun fil-ġnien? Lara: Pawlu xxutja l-ballun hemm waqt il-logħba.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who kicked the ball into the garden? Lara: Pawlu kicked it there during the game.
colloquial.zh: 马克：谁把球踢进花园了？拉拉：保罗在比赛时把球踢到那儿了。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁把球踢进花园了？
messages.en: Who kicked the ball into the garden?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu xxutja l-ballun hemm waqt il-logħba.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu xxutja l-ballun hemm waqt il-logħba.
messages.zh: 保罗在比赛时把球踢到那儿了。
messages.en: Pawlu kicked the ball there during the game.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象脚尖碰球、球向球门飞去的连续动作，把 xxutja 与“用脚踢”的动作整体配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of shock and worry caused by something unexpected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因意外且令人担忧的事情而产生的惊愕和不安。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' ħasda u tħassib li jinħoloq minħabba xi ħaġa mhux mistennija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 面对突发或令人不安的情况时产生的惊愕、惶惑和担忧。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni ta' ħasda, konfużjoni u tħassib quddiem ġrajja mhux mistennija jew aħbar inkwetanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Consternation is a feeling of shock and worry that arises when something unexpected or troubling happens.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, 'xxxx' tiddeskrivi l-ħasda u t-tħassib tal-istudenti meta saru jafu li l-eżami kien se jsir dakinhar stess.
formal.en: In this exercise, 'xxxx' describes the students' shock and worry when they learned that the examination would take place that very day.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，“xxxx”描述学生们得知考试就在当天举行时的惊愕与不安。

colloquial.mt: Maja: 'xxxx' tfisser biss sorpriża? Lara: Le, tfisser ħasda flimkien ma' tħassib, bħal meta tasallek aħbar ħażina bla mistenni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does 'xxxx' just mean surprise? Lara: No, it means shock together with worry, as when you unexpectedly receive bad news.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：‘xxxx’只是表示惊讶吗？拉拉：不是，它表示惊愕中带着担忧，比如突然收到坏消息时的感受。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: ‘xxxx’只是表示惊讶吗？
messages.en: Does 'xxxx' just mean surprise?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tfisser ħasda flimkien ma' tħassib, bħal meta tasallek aħbar ħażina bla mistenni.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tfisser ħasda flimkien ma' tħassib, bħal meta tasallek aħbar ħażina bla mistenni.
messages.zh: 不是，它表示惊愕中带着担忧，比如突然收到坏消息时的感受。
messages.en: No, it means shock together with worry, as when you unexpectedly receive bad news.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“突然听到坏消息，先愣住，再担心”的两步画面记住 xxxx：既有惊愕，也有不安。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to connect an action with another action happening during the same period.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来连接在同一段时间内发生的动作，表示“在……的时候”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li torbot azzjoni ma' azzjoni oħra li tkun qed isseħħ fl-istess ħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在另一动作或情况持续的同时；在……期间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Matul iż-żmien li fih tkun qed isseħħ azzjoni jew tkun għaddejja sitwazzjoni oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this word to connect something happening with another action occurring during the same period.

formal.mt: Xħin l-istudenti kienu qed jaqraw it-test, l-għalliema kitbet tliet mistoqsijiet fuq il-bord.
formal.en: While the students were reading the text, the teacher wrote three questions on the board.
formal.zh: 学生们阅读课文时，老师在黑板上写了三个问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xħin int issajjar, jien naħsel il-platti. Pawlu: Tajjeb, hekk nispiċċaw aktar malajr.
colloquial.en: Maja: While you cook, I'll wash the dishes. Pawlu: Good, that way we'll finish sooner.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你做饭的时候，我来洗碗。保罗：好，这样我们能更快做完。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xħin int issajjar, jien naħsel il-platti.
messages.mt_standard: Xħin int issajjar, jien naħsel il-platti.
messages.zh: 你做饭的时候，我来洗碗。
messages.en: While you cook, I'll wash the dishes.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 好，这样我们能更快做完。
messages.en: Good, that way we'll finish sooner.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个同时进行的动作画成并排的时间线，用 xħin 连接，记住“你做这件事的时候，我做另一件事”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A proper name used to identify a place called York.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 地名“约克”，用于指称名为 York 的地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem proprju ta' post li jissejjaħ York.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 约克，一个用来指称特定地方的专有名称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isem proprju li jintuża biex jirreferi għal post imsejjaħ York.
sense_translations.en_explanation: York is a proper name used to refer to a place bearing that name.

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-vjaġġ jinkludi żjara f'York u ħin liberu għall-parteċipanti.
formal.en: The travel programme includes a visit to York and free time for the participants.
formal.zh: 旅行安排包括参观约克，以及供参加者自由活动的时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn sejjer għada? Mark: Sejjer York biex niltaqa' ma' ħabib.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are you going tomorrow? Mark: I am going to York to meet a friend.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你明天去哪儿？马克：我去约克见一位朋友。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你明天去哪儿？
messages.en: Where are you going tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sejjer York biex niltaqa' ma' ħabib.
messages.mt_standard: Sejjer York biex niltaqa' ma' ħabib.
messages.zh: 我去约克见一位朋友。
messages.en: I am going to York to meet a friend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 York 与中文地名“约克”并排写在旅行卡片上，再用“去约克、在约克”两个场景记忆；书写时保留大写 Y。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An informal expression referring to the mother of the person being addressed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指听话人的母亲的非正式表达，即“你妈妈”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni informali li tirreferi għal omm il-persuna li tkun qed tkellem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 你妈妈；指所交谈对象的母亲。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tfisser ommok, jiġifieri omm il-persuna li tkun qed tkellem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you say 'your mom', you are referring informally to the mother of the person you are addressing.

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tat-traduzzjoni, l-espressjoni Ingliża 'your mom' tingħata bil-Malti bħala 'ommok'.

colloquial.en: Maja: How do I say 'your mom' in Maltese? Mark: You can say 'ommok', as in the sentence 'How is your mom?'
colloquial.zh: Maja：马耳他语怎么说“你妈妈”？Mark：可以说“ommok”，例如“Kif inhi ommok?”，意思是“你妈妈好吗？”

cognitive_memory_aid: 把zigarella和礼盒上的红色蝴蝶结一起记：想到用窄窄的丝带系礼物，就回想这个词。

gloss_zh: 叔伯舅姑姨父辈的男性亲属；叔叔、伯伯、舅舅、姑父或姨父

teaching_sense.en_definition: A brother of your mother or father, or the husband of your aunt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 父亲或母亲的兄弟，或父母姐妹的丈夫；对应中文的叔叔、伯伯、舅舅、姑父、姨父等称谓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħu l-omm jew il-missier, jew ir-raġel taz-zija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 叔伯舅姑姨父辈的男性亲属，包括父母的兄弟以及父母姐妹的丈夫。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Raġel li jkun ħu wieħed mill-ġenituri tiegħek jew ir-raġel ta' zija tiegħek.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your uncle is a brother of either of your parents or the husband of your aunt.

collocations.zh: 我的叔叔、伯伯或舅舅等男性长辈亲属
探望叔伯舅等男性长辈亲属

formal.mt: Iz-zijju tiegħi, ħu ommi, attenda ċ-ċerimonja tal-gradwazzjoni tiegħi.
formal.en: My uncle, my mother's brother, attended my graduation ceremony.
formal.zh: 我的舅舅，也就是我母亲的兄弟，出席了我的毕业典礼。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ġie jżurek ilbieraħ? Mark: Iz-zijju tiegħi, ħu ommi. Ġab kejk miegħu. Maja: Kemm hu ħelu!
colloquial.en: Maja: Who came to visit you yesterday? Mark: My uncle, my mother's brother. He brought a cake with him. Maja: How sweet of him!
colloquial.zh: Maja：昨天谁来看你了？Mark：我舅舅，就是我妈妈的兄弟。他还带了蛋糕。Maja：他真贴心！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天谁来看你了？
messages.en: Who came to visit you yesterday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iz-zijju tiegħi, ħu ommi. Ġab kejk miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iz-zijju tiegħi, ħu ommi. Ġab kejk miegħu.
messages.zh: 我舅舅，就是我妈妈的兄弟。他还带了蛋糕。
messages.en: My uncle, my mother's brother. He brought a cake with him.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他真贴心！
messages.en: How sweet of him!

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一张亲属图，把父母的兄弟和姐妹的丈夫圈在一起标zijju；中文称谓要按具体亲属关系区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Failing to remain faithful to a person, group, or commitment that deserves loyalty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有对某人、某个团体或应当信守的承诺保持忠诚的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jurix lealtà lejn persuna jew grupp, jew li ma jibqax fidil għal impenn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不忠诚的；背弃对某人或某团体应有的忠诚与信任的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jonqos mil-lealtà lejn persuna jew grupp li jkun jafda fih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is disloyal fails to support or remain faithful to a person or group that trusts them.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat qies lill-membru zleali lejn l-għaqda għax għadda informazzjoni kunfidenzjali lill-avversarji tagħha.
formal.en: The committee considered the member disloyal to the association because he passed confidential information to its opponents.
formal.zh: 委员会认为该成员对协会不忠诚，因为他把机密信息透露给了协会的对手。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex m'għadekx tafda lil Pawlu? Mark: Kien zleali lejja. Għidtlu sigriet u mar jgħidu lil kulħadd. Maja: Issa nifhem għaliex int imweġġa'.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why don't you trust Pawlu anymore? Mark: He was disloyal to me. I told him a secret, and he went and told everyone. Maja: Now I understand why you're hurt.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么不再信任Pawlu了？Mark：他背弃了我的信任。我告诉了他一个秘密，他转头就告诉了所有人。Maja：现在我明白你为什么难过了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么不再信任Pawlu了？
messages.en: Why don't you trust Pawlu anymore?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien zleali lejja. Għidtlu sigriet u mar jgħidu lil kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Kien zleali lejja. Għidtlu sigriet u mar jgħidu lil kulħadd.
messages.zh: 他背弃了我的信任。我告诉了他一个秘密，他转头就告诉了所有人。
messages.en: He was disloyal to me. I told him a secret, and he went and told everyone.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 现在我明白你为什么难过了。
messages.en: Now I understand why you're hurt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把zleali放进“朋友泄露秘密、辜负信任”的场景中记，抓住不忠诚这一核心意思。

gloss_zh: 阴茎；我的阴茎（粗俗用语）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A vulgar term for the penis, referring in this form to the speaker's own penis.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指阴茎的粗俗说法；这一形式具体指说话者自己的阴茎。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma vulgari għall-pene li, f'din il-forma, tirreferi għall-pene ta' min qed jitkellem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阴茎，即男性的外生殖器；本词属于粗俗表达，这一形式表示“我的阴茎”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-pene huwa l-organu ġenitali estern maskili; din il-kelma ssemmih b'mod vulgari u tirreferi għall-pene ta' min jitkellem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone uses this vulgar term, they are referring to their own penis.

collocations.zh: 我的阴茎顶端（粗俗说法）
我的阴茎疼痛（粗俗说法）

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'zobbi' hija vulgari; f'test mediku, il-kelma 'pene' hija aktar xierqa.
formal.en: The word 'zobbi' is vulgar; in a medical text, the word 'pene' is more appropriate.
formal.zh: “zobbi”是粗俗用语；在医学文本中，使用“pene”更合适。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Qed iweġġagħni zobbi u ninsab inkwetat. Pawlu: Jekk l-uġigħ jibqa', kellem tabib.
colloquial.en: Mark: My dick hurts, and I'm worried. Pawlu: If the pain continues, speak to a doctor.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我的屌疼，我有点担心。Pawlu：如果一直疼，就找医生看看。

messages.speaker: Mark（成年朋友）
messages.mt_spoken: Qed iweġġagħni zobbi u ninsab inkwetat.
messages.mt_standard: Qed iweġġagħni zobbi u ninsab inkwetat.
messages.zh: 我的屌疼，我有点担心。
messages.en: My dick hurts, and I'm worried.

messages.speaker: Pawlu（成年朋友）
messages.zh: 如果一直疼，就找医生看看。
messages.en: If the pain continues, speak to a doctor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和“我的阴茎”一起记，并贴上“粗俗”标签；正式表达可联想例句中的 pene。

gloss_zh: 室内墙壁下部的护墙部分；墙裙

teaching_sense.en_definition: The lower section of an interior wall, often covered or decorated differently from the section above it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 室内墙壁的下部区域，通常采用与上部不同的饰面或装饰，称为墙裙。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti t'isfel ta' ħajt ta' ġewwa, li spiss tkun miksija jew imżejna b'mod differenti mill-parti ta' fuq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 墙裙，即室内墙面下部采用不同饰面或装饰处理的部分。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-parti t'isfel ta' ħajt f'kamra, spiss b'kisja jew dekorazzjoni differenti minn dik tal-parti ta' fuq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dado is the lower section of an interior wall that has a different covering or decoration from the section above.

formal.mt: Il-proġett ta' restawr jinkludi t-tiswija taz-zokklu tal-injam fil-kuritur.
formal.en: The restoration project includes repairing the wooden dado in the corridor.
formal.zh: 修复项目包括修缮走廊内的木质墙裙。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'kulur se nagħmlu z-zokklu? Mark: Nagħmluh blu ċar, u l-parti ta' fuq inħalluha bajda.
colloquial.en: Maja: What colour shall we paint the dado? Mark: Let's paint it light blue and leave the upper section white.
colloquial.zh: Maja：墙裙刷什么颜色？Mark：刷浅蓝色吧，上面的部分留白。

messages.speaker: Maja（屋主）
messages.zh: 墙裙刷什么颜色？
messages.en: What colour shall we paint the dado?

messages.speaker: Mark（油漆工）
messages.mt_spoken: Nagħmluh blu ċar, u l-parti ta' fuq inħalluha bajda.
messages.mt_standard: Nagħmluh blu ċar, u l-parti ta' fuq inħalluha bajda.
messages.zh: 刷浅蓝色吧，上面的部分留白。
messages.en: Let's paint it light blue and leave the upper section white.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象房间墙面下蓝上白：下半部那片独立装饰的墙裙，就是这里要记的 zokklu。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An incident in which people fight, especially by using physical force against one another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人们彼此争斗的一次事件，尤其指使用身体力量的打斗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġrajja li fiha nies jiġġieldu ma' xulxin, speċjalment billi jużaw il-forza fiżika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次打斗或争斗，尤其指双方发生肢体冲突。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġrajja li fiha żewġ persuni jew aktar jiġġieldu kontra xulxin, ħafna drabi billi jużaw il-forza fiżika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fight is an incident in which people act violently towards one another.

formal.mt: Il-pulizija intervjenew biex iwaqqfu ġlieda quddiem l-istazzjon.
formal.en: The police intervened to stop a fight outside the station.
formal.zh: 警方介入，制止了车站前的一场打斗。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex hemm daqshekk nies barra? Pawlu: Kien hemm ġlieda, imma issa kulħadd ikkalma.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are there so many people outside? Pawlu: There was a fight, but everyone has calmed down now.
colloquial.zh: Sara：外面怎么有这么多人？Pawlu：刚才有人打架，不过现在大家都平静下来了。

messages.speaker: Sara（邻居）
messages.zh: 外面怎么有这么多人？
messages.en: Why are there so many people outside?

messages.speaker: Pawlu（邻居）
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm ġlieda, imma issa kulħadd ikkalma.
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm ġlieda, imma issa kulħadd ikkalma.
messages.zh: 刚才有人打架，不过现在大家都平静下来了。
messages.en: There was a fight, but everyone has calmed down now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“街头发生打斗，警方上前制止”的画面记忆，把 ġlieda 和“一场打斗”连在一起。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A precious stone known in English as a sapphire.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种宝石，英语称为 sapphire，中文称为蓝宝石。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaġra prezzjuża magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala sapphire.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蓝宝石，一种可用于首饰的宝石。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħaġra prezzjuża li tista' tintuża f'ġojjellerija, bħal ċrieki jew ġiżirajjen.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sapphire is a precious stone that can be used in jewellery such as rings and necklaces.

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni tal-ġojjell tgħid li ċ-ċurkett huwa mżejjen b'żafir.
formal.en: The jewellery description states that the ring is adorned with a sapphire.
formal.zh: 首饰说明写明，这枚戒指镶有一颗蓝宝石。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'ħaġra hemm f'dan iċ-ċurkett? David: Hemm żafir. Trid tara ġiżirana biż-żafir ukoll?
colloquial.en: Anna: What stone is in this ring? David: There is a sapphire. Would you like to see a necklace with a sapphire too?
colloquial.zh: Anna：这枚戒指上是什么宝石？David：是蓝宝石。你也想看看镶有蓝宝石的项链吗？

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.zh: 这枚戒指上是什么宝石？
messages.en: What stone is in this ring?

messages.speaker: David (珠宝店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm żafir. Trid tara ġiżirana biż-żafir ukoll?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm żafir. Trid tara ġiżirana biż-żafir ukoll?
messages.zh: 是蓝宝石。你也想看看镶有蓝宝石的项链吗？
messages.en: There is a sapphire. Would you like to see a necklace with a sapphire too?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象珠宝店里一枚镶着蓝宝石的戒指，在宝石旁标上“żafir”，再用“ċurkett biż-żafir”连同场景一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tree resin that bees use as a material for building their hives.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蜜蜂用作蜂巢建造材料的树脂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Raża mis-siġar li n-naħal juża bħala materjal biex jibni l-ġarer tiegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: resin from trees used by bees as material in the construction of their hives
sense_translations.zh_definition: 蜜蜂采来用作筑巢材料的树脂。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Raża li tiġi mis-siġar u li n-naħal juża bħala materjal fil-bini tal-ġarer tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Żaftura is resin from trees that bees use as a building material in their hives.

collocations.zh: 蜜蜂采集筑巢用的树脂

collocations.en: use tree resin in hive construction

formal.mt: In-naħal jiġbor iż-żaftura mis-siġar u jużaha bħala materjal fil-bini tal-ġarer.
formal.en: Bees collect resin from trees and use it as a material in the construction of their hives.
formal.zh: 蜜蜂从树上采集树脂，并将其用作建造蜂巢的材料。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qed jiġbor in-naħal minn dik is-siġra? Pawlu: Qed jiġbor iż-żaftura biex jużaha fil-ġarer.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are the bees collecting from that tree? Pawlu: They are collecting resin to use in their hives.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：蜜蜂正在从那棵树上采集什么？保罗：它们正在采集树脂，用在蜂巢里。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qed jiġbor in-naħal minn dik is-siġra?
messages.mt_standard: X'qed jiġbor in-naħal minn dik is-siġra?
messages.zh: 蜜蜂正在从那棵树上采集什么？
messages.en: What are the bees collecting from that tree?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (养蜂人)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed jiġbor iż-żaftura biex jużaha fil-ġarer.
messages.mt_standard: Qed jiġbor iż-żaftura biex jużaha fil-ġarer.
messages.zh: 它们正在采集树脂，用在蜂巢里。
messages.en: They are collecting resin to use in their hives.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żaftura 配上“树上取材，蜂巢施工”的画面，记住它是蜜蜂筑巢用的树脂。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A yellow spice made from the underground stem of the turmeric plant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由姜黄植物的根茎制成的黄色香料，可用于调味和给食物上色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħwawar ta' lewn isfar magħmul mir-riżoma tal-pjanta tal-kurkuma, użat biex jagħti togħma u kulur lill-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姜黄，尤指由其根茎制成、用于烹饪的黄色香料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħwawar isfar magħmul mir-riżoma tal-kurkuma, li jintuża fit-tisjir biex jagħti kulur u togħma lill-ikel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Turmeric is a yellow spice made from a plant's underground stem and used to flavour and colour food.

formal.mt: Żid nofs kuċċarina żagħfran tal-Indja mar-ross biex tagħtih lewn isfar.
formal.en: Add half a teaspoon of turmeric to the rice to give it a yellow colour.
formal.zh: 往米饭里加入半茶匙姜黄，使其呈现黄色。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif ġie daqshekk isfar ir-ross? Ninu: Żidt ftit żagħfran tal-Indja waqt li kien qed jissajjar.
colloquial.en: Marta: How did the rice get so yellow? Ninu: I added a little turmeric while it was cooking.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：米饭怎么变得这么黄？尼努：煮的时候我加了一点姜黄。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 米饭怎么变得这么黄？
messages.en: How did the rice get so yellow?

messages.speaker: Ninu (做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żidt ftit żagħfran tal-Indja waqt li kien qed jissajjar.
messages.mt_standard: Żidt ftit żagħfran tal-Indja waqt li kien qed jissajjar.
messages.zh: 煮的时候我加了一点姜黄。
messages.en: I added a little turmeric while it was cooking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żagħfran tal-Indja 整组记成“让米饭变金黄的姜黄”，用黄色米饭的画面固定词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To resist pressure or opposition by remaining firm and refusing to give in.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面对压力或反对时坚持立场，不屈服或不让步。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirreżisti pressjoni jew oppożizzjoni billi jibqa' sod u ma jċedix.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抵抗或顶住压力，坚持立场而不屈服。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ma jċedix quddiem pressjoni jew oppożizzjoni u jibqa' sod fil-pożizzjoni tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone holds firm, they resist pressure or opposition and refuse to give in.

collocations.zh: 顶住了各项要求，坚持不让步

formal.mt: Matul in-negozjati, ir-rappreżentant żamm iebes u ma aċċettax it-tnaqqis fil-pagi.
formal.en: During the negotiations, the representative stood firm and did not accept the pay cut.
formal.zh: 谈判期间，代表坚持不让步，没有接受减薪。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Mark aċċetta jagħmel ix-xogħol kollu waħdu? Luqa: Le, żamm iebes u qal li kellu bżonn l-għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did Mark agree to do all the work on his own? Luqa: No, he stood firm and said he needed help.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克答应独自做完所有工作了吗？卢卡：没有，他坚持不让步，说自己需要帮助。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark aċċetta jagħmel ix-xogħol kollu waħdu?
messages.mt_standard: Mark aċċetta jagħmel ix-xogħol kollu waħdu?
messages.zh: 马克答应独自做完所有工作了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark agree to do all the work on his own?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, żamm iebes u qal li kellu bżonn l-għajnuna.
messages.mt_standard: Le, żamm iebes u qal li kellu bżonn l-għajnuna.
messages.zh: 没有，他坚持不让步，说自己需要帮助。
messages.en: No, he stood firm and said he needed help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人面对压力仍稳稳站住，用“顶住、不让步”记住 żamm iebes；例句中的形式描述已经发生的坚持。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A thistle-like plant grown for its thick leaf stalks, which are cooked and eaten.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种外形似蓟的植物，其粗厚叶柄可烹煮后作为蔬菜食用，称为刺苞菜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta li tixbah lix-xewk u titkabbar għaż-żkuk ħoxnin tal-weraq tagħha, li jissajru u jittieklu bħala ħaxix.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刺苞菜，一种似蓟的植物，其粗厚叶柄可作蔬菜食用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjanta li tixbah lix-xewk u li ż-zkuk ħoxnin tal-weraq tagħha jintużaw bħala ħaxix wara li jissajru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cardoon is a thistle-like plant whose thick leaf stalks are cooked and eaten as a vegetable.

formal.mt: Naddaf iz-zkuk taż-żannur, aqtagħhom f'biċċiet u għollihom sakemm jirtabu.
formal.en: Clean the cardoon stalks, cut them into pieces, and boil them until tender.
formal.zh: 将刺苞菜的叶柄清理干净，切成小段，再用水煮至软嫩。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Kif se ssajjar iż-żannur illum? Marija: Se ngħollih u nservih bi ftit żejt u lumi.
colloquial.en: Elena: How are you going to cook the cardoon today? Marija: I will boil it and serve it with a little oil and lemon.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：今天你打算怎么做刺苞菜？玛丽亚：我会把它煮熟，配一点油和柠檬。

messages.speaker: Elena (女儿)
messages.zh: 今天你打算怎么做刺苞菜？
messages.en: How are you going to cook the cardoon today?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Se ngħollih u nservih bi ftit żejt u lumi.
messages.mt_standard: Se ngħollih u nservih bi ftit żejt u lumi.
messages.zh: 我会把它煮熟，配一点油和柠檬。
messages.en: I will boil it and serve it with a little oil and lemon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 żannur 时，画一株像蓟的蔬菜，再把粗厚叶柄画进汤锅，用“叶柄煮着吃”联想刺苞菜。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pull something apart or damage it by tearing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过拉扯使纸张、布料等裂开、破损或分离。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iċarrat xi ħaġa, bħal karta jew drapp, billi jiġbidha sakemm tinqasam jew issirilha ħsara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 撕开或撕破纸张、布料等物品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iġiegħel karta, drapp jew materjal simili jinqasam billi jiġbdu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone tears something, they pull it apart or make a split in it.

formal.mt: Waqt li kien jiftaħ il-pakkett, żarrat il-karta bi żball.
formal.en: While opening the package, he accidentally tore the paper.
formal.zh: 他打开包裹时，不小心撕破了纸。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min żarrat din il-paġna? Pawlu: Ħija żarrat il-paġna bi żball waqt li kien iqalleb il-ktieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who tore this page? Pawlu: My brother accidentally tore the page while leafing through the book.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁把这一页撕破了？保罗：我弟弟翻书时不小心把这一页撕破了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁把这一页撕破了？
messages.en: Who tore this page?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija żarrat il-paġna bi żball waqt li kien iqalleb il-ktieb.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija żarrat il-paġna bi żball waqt li kien iqalleb il-ktieb.
messages.zh: 我弟弟翻书时不小心把这一页撕破了。
messages.en: My brother accidentally tore the page while leafing through the book.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żarrat 配上双手拉纸、纸张裂开的画面，连读 żarrat il-karta，记住“撕破纸”的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not correct or accurate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不符合事实、正确答案或应有情况的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li mhuwiex korrett jew li ma jaqbilx mal-fatti jew mat-tweġiba t-tajba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 错误的；与事实或正确结果不符的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li fih żball jew li ma jkunx jaqbel ma' dak li hu korrett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is incorrect contains a mistake or does not agree with the facts.

formal.mt: Il-kalkolu żbaljat fir-rapport wassal għal total li ma jaqbilx mal-ispejjeż reali.
formal.en: The incorrect calculation in the report produced a total that does not match the actual costs.
formal.zh: 报告中的错误计算导致总额与实际费用不符。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma weġibx Mark meta ċempiltlu? Nina: Għandek in-numru żbaljat; dan huwa n-numru l-qadim tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why didn't Mark answer when I called him? Nina: You have the wrong number; this is his old number.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：我给马克打电话，他为什么没接？妮娜：你用的号码不对，这是他的旧号码。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma weġibx Mark meta ċempiltlu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma weġibx Mark meta ċempiltlu?
messages.zh: 我给马克打电话，他为什么没接？
messages.en: Why didn't Mark answer when I called him?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek in-numru żbaljat; dan huwa n-numru l-qadim tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek in-numru żbaljat; dan huwa n-numru l-qadim tiegħu.
messages.zh: 你用的号码不对，这是他的旧号码。
messages.en: You have the wrong number; this is his old number.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拨错电话号码后，在号码旁画一个红叉；把 numru żbaljat 整组记成“错误的号码”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A serious or obvious mistake.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 程度严重或十分明显的错误，常使人难堪或造成不良结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żball serju jew ċar ħafna li jista' jikkawża mistħija jew konsegwenzi ħżiena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 严重或明显的大错；常令人难堪的重大失误。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żball kbir u evidenti li jista' jwassal għal problema jew għal sitwazzjoni imbarazzanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A blunder is a serious or obvious mistake that can cause embarrassment or other problems.

collocations.zh: 他纠正了一个严重错误

formal.mt: Fir-rapport instab żball oħxon fil-kalkolu tal-ispejjeż, u għalhekk it-total kellu jiġi kkoreġut.
formal.en: A serious mistake was found in the calculation of costs in the report, so the total had to be corrected.
formal.zh: 报告的费用计算中发现了一处严重错误，因此必须更正总额。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'ġara bl-istediniet? Mark: Għamilt żball oħxon: ktibt id-data ħażina fuqhom kollha!
colloquial.en: Sara: What happened with the invitations? Mark: I made a blunder: I put the wrong date on every one of them!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：请柬怎么了？马克：我犯了个大错：所有请柬上的日期都写错了！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 请柬怎么了？
messages.en: What happened with the invitations?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għamilt żball oħxon: ktibt id-data ħażina fuqhom kollha!
messages.mt_standard: Għamilt żball oħxon: ktibt id-data ħażina fuqhom kollha!
messages.zh: 我犯了个大错：所有请柬上的日期都写错了！
messages.en: I made a blunder: I put the wrong date on every one of them!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żball oħxon 整组联想成请柬全部印错日期的场景：不是小疏漏，而是醒目的“大失误”。

gloss_zh: 惊呆的人；目瞪口呆的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who is so surprised that they are left speechless.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在本词条的名词用法中，指因极度惊讶而一时说不出话的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'dan l-użu bħala nom, persuna tant sorpriża li tibqa' bla kliem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 惊呆、愕然或惊讶得目瞪口呆的人；此处按名词用法理解。
sense_translations.mt_definition: F'dan l-użu bħala nom, persuna maħsuda b'sorpriża kbira, tant li ma tkunx taf x'se tgħid.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this noun use, the word refers to someone who is so astonished that they cannot immediately speak.

collocations.en: the face of someone who is dumbfounded
the look of someone who is astounded

formal.mt: Meta sema' r-riżultat mhux mistenni, Mark kellu wiċċ ta' żbalordit u baqa' sieket għal ftit.
formal.en: When he heard the unexpected result, Mark had the face of someone who was dumbfounded and remained silent for a while.
formal.zh: 听到出乎意料的结果时，马克一脸惊愕，沉默了片刻。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt wiċċ Mark meta fetaħ ir-rigal? Lara: Iva, kellu ħarsa ta' żbalordit! Lanqas kelma ma qal.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see Mark's face when he opened the present? Lara: Yes, he had the look of someone who was astounded! He didn't say a word.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看到马克拆开礼物时的表情了吗？劳拉：看到了，他一副目瞪口呆的样子！一句话也没说。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt wiċċ Mark meta fetaħ ir-rigal?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt wiċċ Mark meta fetaħ ir-rigal?
messages.zh: 你看到马克拆开礼物时的表情了吗？
messages.en: Did you see Mark's face when he opened the present?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kellu ħarsa ta' żbalordit! Lanqas kelma ma qal.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kellu ħarsa ta' żbalordit! Lanqas kelma ma qal.
messages.zh: 看到了，他一副目瞪口呆的样子！一句话也没说。
messages.en: Yes, he had the look of someone who was astounded! He didn't say a word.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人打开意外的礼物后睁大眼睛、半天说不出话；用 ħarsa ta' żbalordit 记住“惊呆之人的眼神”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device with straps and a small pouch, used to throw stones.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由带子和盛放石块的小兜组成、用来把石块甩出去的投掷工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda biċ-ċineg u b'borża żgħira fin-nofs, li tintuża biex jitwaddbu l-ġebel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 投石索；利用带子和小兜将石块甩出的工具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żbandola hija għodda biċ-ċineg u b'borża żgħira li żżomm ġebla qabel ma titwaddab.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sling is a device that holds a stone in a small pouch so that it can be swung and released.

collocations.en: to throw a stone with a sling
collocations.zh: 用投石索甩出一块石头

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-ragħaj poġġa ġebla fiż-żbandola u waddabha lejn siġra niexfa.
formal.en: In the story, the shepherd placed a stone in the sling and threw it towards a dry tree.
formal.zh: 在故事中，牧羊人把一块石头放入投石索，朝一棵枯树甩了出去。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi dik fil-ktieb? Mark: Dik żbandola. Tintuża biex twaddab il-ġebel.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that in the book? Mark: That's a sling. It's used to throw stones.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：书里的那个是什么？马克：那是投石索，用来甩石头。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 书里的那个是什么？
messages.en: What's that in the book?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik żbandola. Tintuża biex twaddab il-ġebel.
messages.mt_standard: Dik żbandola. Tintuża biex twaddab il-ġebel.
messages.zh: 那是投石索，用来甩石头。
messages.en: That's a sling. It's used to throw stones.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把żbandola配上一幅“小兜装石、长带旋转、松手飞出”的画面，连着记住“投石索”和biż-żbandola“用投石索”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who lives outside the law and avoids the authorities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不遵守法律、逃避当局追捕的亡命之徒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tgħix barra mil-liġi u taħrab mill-awtoritajiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 法外之徒；因违法而逃避当局的亡命之徒。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żbandut huwa bniedem li jikser il-liġi u jgħix maħrub mill-awtoritajiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An outlaw is someone who breaks the law and lives beyond the control of the authorities.

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, iż-żbandut imfittex sab kenn f'dar abbandunata 'l bogħod mir-raħal.
formal.en: In the novel, the wanted outlaw found shelter in an abandoned house far from the village.
formal.zh: 在小说中，被通缉的亡命之徒躲进了一座远离村庄的废弃房屋。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu dak ir-raġel fil-film? Pawlu: Hu żbandut. Il-pulizija qed ifittxuh.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who's that man in the film? Pawlu: He's an outlaw. The police are looking for him.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：电影里的那个男人是谁？保罗：他是个亡命之徒，警察正在找他。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影里的那个男人是谁？
messages.en: Who's that man in the film?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 他是个亡命之徒，警察正在找他。
messages.en: He's an outlaw. The police are looking for him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象电影里一个被通缉的人躲在村外，把żbandut与“亡命之徒”绑定；再用żbandut imfittex记住“被通缉的亡命之徒”。

gloss_zh: 下船；离开交通工具；登陆

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of leaving a ship or another means of transport after arrival.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 到达目的地后从船舶或其他交通工具上下来的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jinżel minn vapur jew minn mezz ieħor ta' trasport wara l-wasla.

sense_translations.en_definition: landing (from a ship or other transportation)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 下船、登陆或从其他交通工具上下来的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żbark huwa l-proċess li fih in-nies jinżlu minn vapur jew minn mezz ieħor ta' trasport meta jaslu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A landing is the act of getting off a ship or another means of transport when it reaches its destination.

collocations.zh: 乘客下船或离开交通工具

formal.mt: Iż-żbark tal-passiġġieri beda wara li l-vapur intrabat mal-moll.
formal.en: Passenger disembarkation began after the ship was secured to the quay.
formal.zh: 船舶在码头系泊后，乘客开始下船。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Meta jibda ż-żbark? David: Fi ftit minuti. Stenna sakemm jiftħu l-bieb.
colloquial.en: Anna: When does disembarkation begin? David: In a few minutes. Wait until they open the door.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：什么时候开始下船？戴维：再过几分钟，等他们把门打开。

messages.speaker: Anna (乘客)
messages.zh: 什么时候开始下船？
messages.en: When does disembarkation begin?

messages.speaker: David (船员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fi ftit minuti. Stenna sakemm jiftħu l-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Fi ftit minuti. Stenna sakemm jiftħu l-bieb.
messages.zh: 再过几分钟，等他们把门打开。
messages.en: In a few minutes. Wait until they open the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把żbark想成“船到码头，乘客走下舷梯”的整个过程；用iż-żbark tal-passiġġieri连记“乘客下船”，也可指离开其他交通工具。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lack of balance or suitable proportion between different parts or amounts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不同部分、数量或力量之间缺乏平衡或适当比例的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' bilanċ jew ta' proporzjon xieraq bejn partijiet, ammonti jew forzi differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 失衡；相关部分、数量或力量之间比例不协调的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żbilanċ huwa stat li fih partijiet, ammonti jew forzi relatati ma jkunux fi proporzjon xieraq bejniethom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An imbalance exists when related parts, amounts, or forces are not in a suitable proportion to one another.

collocations.en: an imbalance between income and expenditure
collocations.zh: 收入与支出之间的失衡

formal.mt: Ir-rapport identifika żbilanċ fit-tqassim tar-riżorsi bejn iż-żewġ dipartimenti.
formal.en: The report identified an imbalance in the allocation of resources between the two departments.
formal.zh: 报告指出，两个部门之间的资源分配存在失衡。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Jien għandi sitt kompiti u int għandek tnejn biss. Hemm żbilanċ. Mark: Għandek raġun. Nagħmel tnejn minn tiegħek biex ikollna erbgħa kull wieħed.
colloquial.en: Sara: I have six tasks and you only have two. There's an imbalance. Mark: You're right. I'll do two of yours so we have four each.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我有六项任务，你却只有两项，分配不平衡。马克：你说得对。我来做你那边的两项，这样我们就各有四项了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien għandi sitt kompiti u int għandek tnejn biss. Hemm żbilanċ.
messages.mt_standard: Jien għandi sitt kompiti u int għandek tnejn biss. Hemm żbilanċ.
messages.zh: 我有六项任务，你却只有两项，分配不平衡。
messages.en: I have six tasks and you only have two. There's an imbalance.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun. Nagħmel tnejn minn tiegħek biex ikollna erbgħa kull wieħed.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun. Nagħmel tnejn minn tiegħek biex ikollna erbgħa kull wieħed.
messages.zh: 你说得对。我来做你那边的两项，这样我们就各有四项了。
messages.en: You're right. I'll do two of yours so we have four each.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象天平一边放六项任务、另一边只放两项，用倾斜画面记żbilanċ“失衡”；重新分配任务就是jikkoreġi żbilanċ“纠正失衡”。

gloss_zh: 直言不讳的；坦率表达意见的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Someone described as żbozz expresses their opinions openly and directly, even when others may disagree.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人公开、直接地表达自己的意见，即使这些意见可能引起他人反对。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jesprimi l-opinjonijiet tiegħu fil-miftuħ u b'mod dirett, anki meta oħrajn jistgħu ma jaqblux miegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 直言不讳的；公开而直接地表达自己意见的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li tgħid dak li taħseb b'mod ċar u dirett, anki dwar affarijiet li jistgħu jqanqlu nuqqas ta' qbil.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is outspoken, they express their opinions openly and directly, including opinions that other people may dislike.

formal.mt: L-awtur hu żbozz u jesprimi b'mod ċar in-nuqqas ta' qbil tiegħu mal-proposta.
formal.en: The author is outspoken and clearly expresses his disagreement with the proposal.
formal.zh: 这位作者直言不讳，明确表达了自己对该提案的反对意见。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark dejjem jgħid dak li jaħseb. Lara: Iva, hu żbozz, anki meta l-oħrajn ma jaqblux miegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark always says what he thinks. Lara: Yes, he's outspoken, even when the others disagree with him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克总是想到什么就说什么。拉拉：是啊，他直言不讳，即使别人不同意也一样。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark dejjem jgħid dak li jaħseb.
messages.mt_standard: Mark dejjem jgħid dak li jaħseb.
messages.zh: 马克总是想到什么就说什么。
messages.en: Mark always says what he thinks.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu żbozz, anki meta l-oħrajn ma jaqblux miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu żbozz, anki meta l-oħrajn ma jaqblux miegħu.
messages.zh: 是啊，他直言不讳，即使别人不同意也一样。
messages.en: Yes, he's outspoken, even when the others disagree with him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żbozz 和讨论会上直接举手说出不同意见的人联系起来，用“心里有意见，嘴上直说”记住其义。

gloss_zh: 词义未明；所给释义仅标注“No idea”

teaching_sense.en_definition: Żbul is listed as a noun, but the supplied information does not establish its meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给材料将 Żbul 标为名词，但仅提供“No idea”这一不确定性说明，无法据此确定其词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żbul huwa mniżżel bħala nom, iżda l-informazzjoni mogħtija ma tiċċarax it-tifsira tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词义不详：原释义为“No idea”，不足以确定该名词的具体含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira ta' dan in-nom mhijiex stabbilita mill-informazzjoni mogħtija, li tindika biss li t-tifsira mhijiex magħrufa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss indicates uncertainty and does not establish a usable meaning for this noun.

collocations.zh: Żbul 的含义（讨论该词时使用）
Żbul 这个词（讨论该词时使用）

formal.mt: Żbul huwa mniżżel bħala nom fil-materjal mogħti, iżda t-tifsira tiegħu mhijiex iċċarata.
formal.en: Żbul is listed as a noun in the supplied material, but its meaning is not clarified.
formal.zh: 所给材料将 Żbul 列为名词，但没有说明其确切含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser il-kelma Żbul? Mark: Hawn miktub biss 'No idea', allura minn din in-nota ma nistgħux inkunu nafu t-tifsira tagħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word Żbul mean? Mark: It only says 'No idea' here, so we cannot determine its meaning from this note.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：Żbul 这个词是什么意思？马克：这里仅写着“No idea”，所以我们无法凭这条说明确定它的意思。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: Żbul 这个词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word Żbul mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
