messages.mt_standard: Hawn miktub biss 'No idea', allura minn din in-nota ma nistgħux inkunu nafu t-tifsira tagħha.
messages.zh: 这里仅写着“No idea”，所以我们无法凭这条说明确定它的意思。
messages.en: It only says 'No idea' here, so we cannot determine its meaning from this note.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Żbul 暂记在“待查词义”卡片上：已知是名词，含义尚未确定；不要把资料中的“No idea”直接背成这个词的意思。

gloss_zh: 破旧邋遢的；破旧场所；邋遢的人；流浪汉或逃学者

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something or someone described as żdingat looks shabby, untidy, or poorly cared for.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容物品、场所或人的外表破旧、邋遢，显得缺乏整理或照料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi ħaġa, post jew persuna li tidher mitluqa, traskurata jew mhux miżmuma tajjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 破旧的；邋遢的；外表显得缺乏维护或整理的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa jew lil xi ħadd b'dehra mitluqa jew traskurata, minħabba nuqqas ta' kura jew manutenzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something or someone looks shabby, their appearance is worn, untidy, or poorly cared for.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 破旧、凌乱或缺乏维护的地方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Huwa post mitluq jew traskurat li ma jinżammx tajjeb u li d-dehra tiegħu turi nuqqas ta' kura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A shabby place is somewhere that looks neglected, worn, or poorly maintained.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 衣着破旧、仪容邋遢的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Huwa bniedem li jidher mitluq jew traskurat fl-ilbies jew fid-dehra personali tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A shabby person is someone whose clothes or personal appearance look untidy or poorly cared for.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 流浪汉；或逃学、不按规定上学的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Huwa persuna li tgħix tiġġerra mingħajr dar stabbli, jew persuna li tonqos mill-iskola mingħajr permess.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this sense, the noun refers either to a person who wanders without a settled home or to someone who stays away from school without permission.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-bini bħala żdingat u jirrakkomanda xogħol ta' manutenzjoni.
formal.en: The report describes the building as shabby and recommends maintenance work.
formal.zh: 报告形容这栋建筑破旧失修，并建议开展维护工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se tilbes dak il-kowt għall-ikla? Mark: Le, jidher żdingat wisq. Se nilbes ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you wearing that coat to dinner? Mark: No, it looks too shabby. I'll wear another one.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你要穿那件大衣去吃饭吗？马克：不，那件看着太破旧了。我会换一件。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要穿那件大衣去吃饭吗？
messages.en: Are you wearing that coat to dinner?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, jidher żdingat wisq. Se nilbes ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Le, jidher żdingat wisq. Se nilbes ieħor.
messages.zh: 不，那件看着太破旧了。我会换一件。
messages.en: No, it looks too shabby. I'll wear another one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“旧外套、破房间、邋遢人”三幅画面记住破旧邋遢这一组义；另将名词的“流浪汉”和“逃学者”分别记卡，避免混为一义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of completing customs procedures so that goods can be officially released.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 办理货物所需的海关手续，使货物获准放行的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jitlestew il-formalitajiet doganali meħtieġa biex il-merkanzija tkun tista' tiġi rilaxxata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为货物办理海关手续，使其通过海关的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jiġu ppreżentati d-dokumenti u jitwettqu l-proċeduri meħtieġa biex il-merkanzija tgħaddi mid-dwana.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This is the process of completing the formalities needed for goods to pass through customs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 货物清关，即完成海关规定的手续，使货物获准放行。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tlestija tal-formalitajiet doganali meħtieġa biex id-dwana tippermetti r-rilaxx tal-merkanzija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Customs clearance involves completing the required customs procedures so that goods can be officially released.

collocations.en: documents for customs clearance of goods
delays in customs clearance of goods
customs clearance of the goods is completed

formal.mt: L-importatur għandu jippreżenta d-dokumenti kollha meħtieġa għaż-żdoganar tal-merkanzija.
formal.en: The importer must submit all the documents required for customs clearance of the goods.
formal.zh: 进口商必须提交货物清关所需的全部文件。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tlesta ż-żdoganar tal-merkanzija? Sara: Iva, tista' tiġbor il-merkanzija llum.
colloquial.en: Mark: Has customs clearance of the goods been completed? Sara: Yes, you can collect the goods today.
colloquial.zh: Mark：货物清关完成了吗？Sara：完成了，你今天可以提货。

messages.speaker: Mark (进口商)
messages.zh: 货物清关完成了吗？
messages.en: Has customs clearance of the goods been completed?

messages.speaker: Sara (货运代理)
messages.zh: 完成了，你今天可以提货。
messages.en: Yes, you can collect the goods today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语联想成“货物在海关办完手续后放行”的画面；搭配“文件”和“延误”一起记，分别对应清关文件、清关延误。

gloss_zh: 集中清关；集中办理海关通关手续

teaching_sense.en_definition: Centralised customs clearance is the coordinated handling of customs clearance procedures through a central point.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指通过一个集中办理点，统一协调处理货物的海关清关手续。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Huwa l-ipproċessar koordinat tal-formalitajiet doganali tal-merkanzija permezz ta' punt ċentrali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 集中清关：将货物的清关手续集中处理。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Huwa arranġament li fih il-proċeduri biex il-merkanzija tgħaddi mid-dwana jiġu pproċessati b'mod ċentralizzat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Centralised clearance is an arrangement in which procedures for clearing goods are handled through a central point.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 集中办理海关通关手续：由集中办理点统一协调货物的海关清关程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Huwa mod ta' kif jiġu organizzati l-formalitajiet doganali, sabiex l-ipproċessar tagħhom ikun ikkoordinat permezz ta' punt ċentrali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Centralised customs clearance is a system in which customs formalities for goods are coordinated and processed through a central point.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija tipproponi sistema ta' żdoganar ċentralizzat biex tikkoordina l-ipproċessar tad-dokumenti doganali.
formal.en: The company proposes a centralised customs clearance system to coordinate the processing of customs documents.
formal.zh: 该公司提议采用集中清关系统，以协调海关文件的处理工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed niġbru d-dokumenti kollha hawn? Mark: Għax qed nużaw sistema ta' żdoganar ċentralizzat; dan hu l-punt fejn nikkoordinaw ix-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are we collecting all the documents here? Mark: Because we're using a centralised customs clearance system; this is where we coordinate the work.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么我们要把所有文件都集中到这里？马克：因为我们采用集中清关系统，这里就是协调工作的办理点。

messages.speaker: Maja (物流助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed niġbru d-dokumenti kollha hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed niġbru d-dokumenti kollha hawn?
messages.zh: 为什么我们要把所有文件都集中到这里？
messages.en: Why are we collecting all the documents here?

messages.speaker: Mark (物流主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax qed nużaw sistema ta' żdoganar ċentralizzat; dan hu l-punt fejn nikkoordinaw ix-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Għax qed nużaw sistema ta' żdoganar ċentralizzat; dan hu l-punt fejn nikkoordinaw ix-xogħol.
messages.zh: 因为我们采用集中清关系统，这里就是协调工作的办理点。
messages.en: Because we're using a centralised customs clearance system; this is where we coordinate the work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象多份报关文件汇到同一个办理点：用“清关手续集中处理”的画面，整体记住 żdoganar ċentralizzat。

gloss_zh: 躺下休息一会儿；一次躺卧休息

teaching_sense.en_definition: A period of rest spent lying down, without necessarily sleeping.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 躺下来休息的一段时间，不一定睡着。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Perjodu ta' mistrieħ li wieħed iqatta' mimdud, mingħajr ma bilfors jorqod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次躺下休息，指以躺卧姿势休息一会儿，不一定入睡。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żmien ta' mistrieħ li matulu wieħed jimtedd biex jistrieħ, iżda mhux bilfors biex jorqod.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you have a lie down, you rest in a lying position for a while, whether or not you fall asleep.

collocations.en: a lie down on the sofa

formal.mt: Wara li lestiet ix-xogħol, Marija ħadet żdrajjata qasira fuq is-sufan biex tistrieħ.
formal.en: After finishing her work, Marija had a short lie down on the sofa to rest.
formal.zh: 完成工作后，Marija 在沙发上躺了一会儿，休息一下。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Jien għajjiena. Se nieħu żdrajjata. Pawlu: Ħu żdrajjata qasira, imbagħad nieħdu kafè.
colloquial.en: Maja: I'm tired. I'm going to have a lie down. Pawlu: Have a short lie down, then we'll have a coffee.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我累了，打算躺一会儿。Pawlu：躺着休息一会儿吧，然后我们喝杯咖啡。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我累了，打算躺一会儿。
messages.en: I'm tired. I'm going to have a lie down.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħu żdrajjata qasira, imbagħad nieħdu kafè.
messages.mt_standard: Ħu żdrajjata qasira, imbagħad nieħdu kafè.
messages.zh: 躺着休息一会儿吧，然后我们喝杯咖啡。
messages.en: Have a short lie down, then we'll have a coffee.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象忙完后在沙发上伸直身体休息的画面，把 żdrajjata 记成“一次躺着休息”；连同 nieħu żdrajjata 整体记忆，不必联想到睡着。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An African mammal related to the horse, with black and white stripes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种原产于非洲、与马近缘、身上有黑白条纹的哺乳动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iż-żebra hija annimal mammiferu tal-Afrika, qarib taż-żiemel, li għandu strixxi suwed u bojod fuq ġismu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 斑马，一种与马近缘、身上有黑白条纹的非洲哺乳动物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iż-żebra hija annimal mammiferu li jgħix fl-Afrika, jixbah liż-żiemel u għandu ġismu miksi bi strixxi suwed u bojod.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A zebra is an African animal related to the horse that has black and white stripes.

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw żebra u ddeskrivew l-istrixxi suwed u bojod fuq ġisimha.
formal.en: The students observed a zebra and described the black and white stripes on its body.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了一匹斑马，并描述了它身上的黑白条纹。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dik iż-żebra ħdejn is-siġra! Pawlu: Rajtha! Għandha strixxi suwed u bojod sbieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that zebra near the tree! Pawlu: I see it! It has beautiful black and white stripes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看树旁边的那匹斑马！保罗：我看见了！它身上的黑白条纹真漂亮。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看树旁边的那匹斑马！
messages.en: Look at that zebra near the tree!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtha! Għandha strixxi suwed u bojod sbieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtha! Għandha strixxi suwed u bojod sbieħ.
messages.zh: 我看见了！它身上的黑白条纹真漂亮。
messages.en: I see it! It has beautiful black and white stripes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żebra 与英语 zebra 并排记忆，再想象一匹穿着黑白条纹衣服的马；这个画面帮助你记住“斑马”的词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Mercury, a silvery metallic element that is liquid at room temperature.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 汞，俗称水银，是一种在室温下呈液态的银白色金属元素。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iż-żejbaq huwa element kimiku metalliku ta' lewn il-fidda li jkun likwidu fit-temperatura tal-kamra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 水银，即汞，一种在室温下呈液态的银白色金属元素。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iż-żejbaq huwa metall ta' lewn il-fidda li jkun likwidu fit-temperatura tal-kamra u li jintuża f'ċerti strumenti tal-kejl.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Quicksilver is another name for mercury, a silvery metal that is liquid at room temperature.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi ż-żejbaq bħala metall ta' lewn il-fidda li jkun likwidu fit-temperatura tal-kamra.
formal.en: The report describes mercury as a silvery metal that is liquid at room temperature.
formal.zh: 报告将汞描述为一种在室温下呈液态的银白色金属。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu ż-żejbaq? Mark: Huwa metall likwidu ta' lewn il-fidda. Ara r-ritratt fil-ktieb.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is mercury? Mark: It is a silvery liquid metal. Look at the photo in the book.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：水银是什么？马克：它是一种银白色的液态金属。看看书里的照片。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 水银是什么？
messages.en: What is mercury?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa metall likwidu ta' lewn il-fidda. Ara r-ritratt fil-ktieb.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa metall likwidu ta' lewn il-fidda. Ara r-ritratt fil-ktieb.
messages.zh: 它是一种银白色的液态金属。看看书里的照片。
messages.en: It is a silvery liquid metal. Look at the photo in the book.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆 żejbaq 时，想象书中一滴银亮的液态金属，并把“水银”和“汞”写在同一张词卡上，提醒自己两者指同一种元素。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Additional to what is usual, required, or already available.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在通常数量、所需数量或已有数量之外增加的；用于修饰阴性单数名词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tiżdied ma' dak li hemm diġà jew ma' dak li hu meħtieġ jew tas-soltu; tintuża ma' nom femminili singular.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 额外的；在已有或所需数量之外多出来的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tkun aktar minn dak li hu meħtieġ jew li tiżdied ma' dak li hemm diġà.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is extra is additional to what is needed, usual, or already available.

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok, ehmeż kopja żejda tad-dokument mal-applikazzjoni.
formal.en: Please attach an extra copy of the document to the application.
formal.zh: 请随申请附上该文件的一份额外副本。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għandek pinna żejda? Tlift tiegħi. Lara: Iva, ħu din.
colloquial.en: Marija: Do you have an extra pen? I lost mine. Lara: Yes, take this one.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你有多余的笔吗？我的丢了。Lara：有，拿这支吧。

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.zh: 你有多余的笔吗？我的丢了。
messages.en: Do you have an extra pen? I lost mine.

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 有，拿这支吧。
messages.en: Yes, take this one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌上多出一支备用笔，用 pinna żejda 记住“额外的”；同时把 żejda 与阴性单数名词一起练习。

gloss_zh: 粗制橄榄果渣油；未经精炼的橄榄果渣油

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unrefined oil obtained from the material remaining after olive oil extraction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从提取橄榄油后留下的橄榄果渣中取得、尚未经过精炼处理的油。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żejt miksub mir-residwi li jibqgħu wara l-estrazzjoni taż-żejt taż-żebbuġ u li jkun għadu ma għaddiex mir-raffinar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粗制橄榄果渣油，即从橄榄榨油后的残渣中取得而尚未精炼的油。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żejt li jiġi estratt mir-residwi taż-żebbuġ wara li jkun ittieħed iż-żejt minnu u li jkun għadu mhux raffinat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Crude olive-pomace oil is unrefined oil extracted from the material left after olive oil has been obtained.

collocations.mt: kampjun ta' żejt mhux raffinat mir-residwi taż-żebbuġ
collocations.en: a sample of crude olive-pomace oil
collocations.zh: 一份粗制橄榄果渣油样品

collocations.mt: ir-raffinar taż-żejt mhux raffinat mir-residwi taż-żebbuġ
collocations.en: the refining of crude olive-pomace oil
collocations.zh: 粗制橄榄果渣油的精炼

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika l-kampjun bħala żejt mhux raffinat mir-residwi taż-żebbuġ.
formal.en: The report identifies the sample as crude olive-pomace oil.
formal.zh: 报告将该样品鉴定为粗制橄榄果渣油。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'hemm f'dan il-kontenitur? Rita: Żejt mhux raffinat mir-residwi taż-żebbuġ. Għad irid jiġi raffinat.
colloquial.en: Mark: What is in this container? Rita: Crude olive-pomace oil. It still needs to be refined.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这个容器里装的是什么？Rita：粗制橄榄果渣油，还需要精炼。

messages.speaker: Mark (新员工)
messages.zh: 这个容器里装的是什么？
messages.en: What is in this container?

messages.speaker: Rita (生产主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Żejt mhux raffinat mir-residwi taż-żebbuġ. Għad irid jiġi raffinat.
messages.mt_standard: Żejt mhux raffinat mir-residwi taż-żebbuġ. Għad irid jiġi raffinat.
messages.zh: 粗制橄榄果渣油，还需要精炼。
messages.en: Crude olive-pomace oil. It still needs to be refined.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把长词组分成三个意义块记忆：żejt 是油，mhux raffinat 是未经精炼，mir-residwi taż-żebbuġ 是来自橄榄残渣；合起来就是粗制橄榄果渣油。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Oil obtained from olives and used in cooking or food preparation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从橄榄果实中取得的油，常用于烹饪或调制食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żejt miksub mill-frott taż-żebbuġ, li jintuża fit-tisjir jew fit-tħejjija tal-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 橄榄油，即从橄榄果实中取得、可用于烹饪和调味的油。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żejt li jinkiseb miż-żebbuġ u li jintuża biex jissajjar jew jitħawwar l-ikel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Olive oil is oil obtained from olives and commonly used for cooking or dressing food.

formal.mt: Żid żewġ imgħaref żejt taż-żebbuġ mal-insalata u ħawwad sew.
formal.en: Add two tablespoons of olive oil to the salad and mix well.
formal.zh: 向沙拉中加入两汤匙橄榄油，充分拌匀。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Trid ftit żejt taż-żebbuġ mal-ħobż? Pawlu: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Agħtini ftit melħ ukoll.
colloquial.en: Anna: Would you like some olive oil with the bread? Pawlu: Yes, please. Pass me some salt too.
colloquial.zh: Anna：面包要配点橄榄油吗？Pawlu：要，谢谢。也递给我一点盐。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 面包要配点橄榄油吗？
messages.en: Would you like some olive oil with the bread?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Agħtini ftit melħ ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Agħtini ftit melħ ukoll.
messages.zh: 要，谢谢。也递给我一点盐。
messages.en: Yes, please. Pass me some salt too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把橄榄油淋在面包上：żejt 记“油”，taż-żebbuġ 记“橄榄的”；把整个词组与餐桌上的橄榄油瓶联系起来。

gloss_zh: 灯用级橄榄油；需精炼后方可食用的橄榄油

teaching_sense.en_definition: Virgin olive oil of a quality unsuitable for direct consumption that requires refining for food use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 品质不适合直接食用的初榨橄榄油，须经过精炼处理后才能用于食用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żejt verġni taż-żebbuġ li l-kwalità tiegħu ma tagħmlux adattat għall-konsum dirett u li jeħtieġ raffinar biex jintuża għall-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灯用级橄榄油，指不适合直接食用、须经精炼才能用于食用的初榨橄榄油。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żejt verġni taż-żebbuġ li ma jkunx adattat biex jiġi kkunsmat direttament minħabba l-kwalità tiegħu u li jkun jeħtieġ raffinar għall-użu fl-ikel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Lampante olive oil is virgin olive oil whose quality makes it unsuitable for direct consumption without refining.

collocations.en: a sample of lampante olive oil
collocations.zh: 一份灯用级橄榄油样品

collocations.en: the refining of lampante olive oil

formal.mt: Il-lott ġie kklassifikat bħala żejt taż-żebbuġa lampante u jeħtieġ raffinar qabel ma jkun jista' jintuża għall-ikel.
formal.en: The batch was classified as lampante olive oil and requires refining before it can be used for food.
formal.zh: 该批次被归类为灯用级橄榄油，需要经过精炼后才能用于食用。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nista' nuża dan iż-żejt mal-insalata? Toni: Le, dan hu żejt taż-żebbuġa lampante. Irid jiġi raffinat qabel jintuża għall-ikel.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can I use this oil on the salad? Toni: No, this is lampante olive oil. It must be refined before being used for food.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这种油可以拌沙拉吗？Toni：不行，这是灯用级橄榄油，必须经过精炼后才能用于食用。

messages.speaker: Lara (食品技术实习生)
messages.zh: 这种油可以拌沙拉吗？
messages.en: Can I use this oil on the salad?

messages.speaker: Toni (食品技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dan hu żejt taż-żebbuġa lampante. Irid jiġi raffinat qabel jintuża għall-ikel.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dan hu żejt taż-żebbuġa lampante. Irid jiġi raffinat qabel jintuża għall-ikel.
messages.zh: 不行，这是灯用级橄榄油，必须经过精炼后才能用于食用。
messages.en: No, this is lampante olive oil. It must be refined before being used for food.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个名称贴在想象中的“待精炼”油桶上，看到 lampante 就提醒自己“先精炼，再供食用”；这是用途提示的学习联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing great enthusiasm and dedication in pursuing a task, belief, or cause.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某项工作、信念或事业充满热情，并积极、认真地投入其中的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri ħeġġa kbira u dedikazzjoni fit-twettiq ta' xogħol jew fl-appoġġ ta' twemmin jew kawża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对工作、信念或事业抱有强烈热情并积极投入的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jaħdem jew jappoġġa xi ħaġa b'ħeġġa kbira, b'impenn u b'dedikazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is zealous shows great enthusiasm and dedication towards a particular activity, belief, or cause.

collocations.en: a zealous defender of the environment

formal.mt: Bħala voluntier żelanti, Pawlu ddedika ħafna ħin għall-organizzazzjoni ta' attivitajiet għall-komunità.
formal.en: As a zealous volunteer, Pawlu devoted much time to organising activities for the community.
formal.zh: 作为一名热忱的志愿者，保罗投入了大量时间为社区组织活动。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Pawlu reġa' offra li jgħin fil-festa? Rita: Iva, hu żelanti ħafna u dejjem lest biex jagħti daqqa t'id.
colloquial.en: Marta: Has Pawlu offered to help with the village feast again? Rita: Yes, he's very enthusiastic and always ready to lend a hand.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：保罗又主动提出帮忙筹办村里的节庆了吗？丽塔：是啊，他特别热心，总是愿意搭把手。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu reġa' offra li jgħin fil-festa?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu reġa' offra li jgħin fil-festa?
messages.zh: 保罗又主动提出帮忙筹办村里的节庆了吗？
messages.en: Has Pawlu offered to help with the village feast again?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu żelanti ħafna u dejjem lest biex jagħti daqqa t'id.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu żelanti ħafna u dejjem lest biex jagħti daqqa t'id.
messages.zh: 是啊，他特别热心，总是愿意搭把手。
messages.en: Yes, he's very enthusiastic and always ready to lend a hand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żelanti 和“主动举手帮忙的热心志愿者”画面绑定，记住它强调热情与投入。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The point in the sky directly above an observer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于观察者头顶正上方的天空位置，称为天顶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-punt fis-sema li jinsab eżatt fuq ras l-osservatur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天顶，即观察者所在位置垂直向上所对应的天空点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-punt fis-sema direttament fuq ras l-osservatur, fid-direzzjoni vertikali 'l fuq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The zenith is the point in the sky directly above a person observing it.

formal.mt: Fid-dijagramma, iż-żenit huwa mmarkat direttament fuq ras l-osservatur.
formal.en: In the diagram, the zenith is marked directly above the observer's head.
formal.zh: 图中把天顶标在观察者头顶的正上方。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hu ż-żenit? Mark: Ħares dritt 'il fuq, eżatt fuq rasek.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the zenith? Mark: Look straight up, directly above your head.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：天顶在哪里？马克：垂直向上看，就在你的头顶正上方。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 天顶在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the zenith?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħares dritt 'il fuq, eżatt fuq rasek.
messages.mt_standard: Ħares dritt 'il fuq, eżatt fuq rasek.
messages.zh: 垂直向上看，就在你的头顶正上方。
messages.en: Look straight up, directly above your head.

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习 żenit 时，想象从自己头顶竖直画一支箭指向天空；箭头指向的就是天顶。

teaching_sense.en_definition: She arranged for him to marry another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示她安排了他与另一个人的婚事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tfisser li hija rranġat biex hu jiżżewweġ lil persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 她安排他与某人结婚。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Hija rranġat iż-żwieġ tiegħu ma' persuna oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If she arranged his marriage to another person, she brought about that marriage.

collocations.zh: 他母亲安排了他的婚事

collocations.en: she arranged for him to marry Marija
collocations.zh: 她安排他与玛丽亚结婚

formal.mt: Skont ir-rakkont, ommu żewwġitu lil mara minn raħal fil-qrib.
formal.en: According to the story, his mother arranged for him to marry a woman from a nearby village.
formal.zh: 据故事所述，他母亲安排他与邻村的一名女子结婚。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min irranġa ż-żwieġ ta' Pawlu? Rita: Ommu żewwġitu lil Marija.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who arranged Pawlu's marriage? Rita: His mother arranged for him to marry Marija.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：谁安排了保罗的婚事？丽塔：他母亲安排他娶了玛丽亚。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁安排了保罗的婚事？
messages.en: Who arranged Pawlu's marriage?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 他母亲安排他娶了玛丽亚。
messages.en: His mother arranged for him to marry Marija.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把场景记成母亲安排婚事：她把他婚配给某人。重点分清“她安排”和“他结婚”这两个角色。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A man married to someone's mother who is not that person's biological father.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与某人的母亲结婚、但并非此人亲生父亲的男子，即继父。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-raġel miżżewweġ lil omm persuna, li mhuwiex il-missier bijoloġiku ta' dik il-persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 继父，即母亲的丈夫，但不是子女的亲生父亲。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ir-raġel li jkun miżżewweġ lill-omm iżda li ma jkunx il-missier bijoloġiku tat-tifel jew tat-tifla tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone's stepfather is the man married to their mother who is not their biological father.

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina kif ir-relazzjoni ma' żewġ l-omm tista' tiżviluppa matul iż-żmien.
formal.en: The study examines how the relationship with a stepfather can develop over time.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察了与继父的关系如何随时间发展。

colloquial.mt: Lara: F'din l-istorja, Mark hu missier it-tifla? Rita: Le, hu żewġ l-omm; mhuwiex il-missier bijoloġiku tagħha.
colloquial.en: Lara: In this story, is Mark the girl's father? Rita: No, he's her stepfather; he isn't her biological father.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：在这个故事里，马克是女孩的父亲吗？丽塔：不是，他是她的继父，不是她的亲生父亲。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: F'din l-istorja, Mark hu missier it-tifla?
messages.mt_standard: F'din l-istorja, Mark hu missier it-tifla?
messages.zh: 在这个故事里，马克是女孩的父亲吗？
messages.en: In this story, is Mark the girl's father?

messages.speaker: Rita (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hu żewġ l-omm; mhuwiex il-missier bijoloġiku tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hu żewġ l-omm; mhuwiex il-missier bijoloġiku tagħha.
messages.zh: 不是，他是她的继父，不是她的亲生父亲。
messages.en: No, he's her stepfather; he isn't her biological father.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用家庭关系图记 żewġ l-omm：把男子与母亲用婚姻线相连，再给孩子标注“继父”，明确亲属关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The man to whom the woman being referred to is married.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所谈及的那名女性的丈夫，即与她结婚的男子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-raġel li miegħu hija miżżewġa l-mara li qed issir referenza għaliha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 她的丈夫，指与所谈及的女性结婚的男子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ir-raġel miżżewweġ lill-mara li dwarha jkun qed isir id-diskors.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Her husband is the man to whom the woman being discussed is married.

formal.mt: Is-Sinjura Borg attendiet iċ-ċerimonja flimkien ma' żewġha.
formal.en: Mrs Borg attended the ceremony together with her husband.
formal.zh: 博尔格夫人与丈夫一同出席了典礼。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Maria ġejja waħedha għall-ikel? Pawlu: Le, ġejja ma' żewġha.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is Maria coming to the meal on her own? Pawlu: No, she's coming with her husband.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：玛丽亚一个人来吃饭吗？保罗：不是，她和丈夫一起来。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 玛丽亚一个人来吃饭吗？
messages.en: Is Maria coming to the meal on her own?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 不是，她和丈夫一起来。
messages.en: No, she's coming with her husband.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żewġha 当作“她的丈夫”整体记忆：想象谈到玛丽亚时，旁边标出与她结婚的男子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To slip away or move past quietly without attracting attention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了不引起别人注意而悄悄离开或溜过。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlaq jew jgħaddi minn post bil-moħbi biex ħadd ma jinduna bih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偷偷移动、溜过或离开，避免被别人察觉。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiċċaqlaq, jgħaddi jew jitlaq bil-moħbi, mingħajr ma jiġbed l-attenzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone sneaks away or past others, they move quietly so that nobody notices them.

collocations.en: he sneaked out of the room
he slipped stealthily through the crowd

formal.mt: Waqt id-diskussjoni, wieħed mill-mistednin żgiċċa bis-serqa mill-kamra mingħajr ma ġibed l-attenzjoni.
formal.en: During the discussion, one of the guests sneaked out of the room without attracting attention.
formal.zh: 讨论期间，一位客人悄悄溜出了房间，没有引起注意。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar Karl? Mark: Żgiċċa bis-serqa mill-kamra waqt li konna nitkellmu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did Karl go? Mark: He sneaked out of the room while we were talking.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：卡尔去哪儿了？马克：我们说话的时候，他偷偷溜出了房间。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 卡尔去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did Karl go?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgiċċa bis-serqa mill-kamra waqt li konna nitkellmu.
messages.mt_standard: Żgiċċa bis-serqa mill-kamra waqt li konna nitkellmu.
messages.zh: 我们说话的时候，他偷偷溜出了房间。
messages.en: He sneaked out of the room while we were talking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象大家正在聊天，一个人轻手轻脚溜出房间；把整个短语与“偷偷溜走”的画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of making a hole in a material with a drill.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用钻具在材料上打出孔洞的操作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil ta' toqba f'materjal bl-użu ta' trapan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钻孔，即用钻具在材料上打孔的操作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol li fih issir toqba f'materjal permezz ta' trapan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Drilling is the process of making a hole in a material by using a drill.

formal.mt: Qabel ix-xogħol ta' żgorbja, il-ħaddiem immarka fejn kellha ssir it-toqba fl-injam.
formal.en: Before the drilling work, the worker marked where the hole was to be made in the wood.
formal.zh: 钻孔作业开始前，工人在木材上标出了需要打孔的位置。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xadal xi jsir fuq din il-biċċa injam? Toni: Fadal ix-xogħol ta' żgorbja biex nagħmlu toqba għall-kamin.
colloquial.en: Sara: What still needs doing on this piece of wood? Toni: The drilling work remains so we can make a hole for the screw.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这块木头还有什么活儿没做？托尼：还要钻孔，给螺丝打一个孔。

messages.speaker: Sara (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Xadal xi jsir fuq din il-biċċa injam?
messages.mt_standard: Xadal xi jsir fuq din il-biċċa injam?
messages.zh: 这块木头还有什么活儿没做？
messages.en: What still needs doing on this piece of wood?

messages.speaker: Toni (木工)
messages.mt_spoken: Fadal ix-xogħol ta' żgorbja biex nagħmlu toqba għall-kamin.
messages.mt_standard: Fadal ix-xogħol ta' żgorbja biex nagħmlu toqba għall-kamin.
messages.zh: 还要钻孔，给螺丝打一个孔。
messages.en: The drilling work remains so we can make a hole for the screw.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“先标位置，再钻出孔”的工序记住钻孔概念；本条按名词学习，把注意力放在这项操作上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Young people considered together as a group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为一个群体来谈论的年轻人或青年。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuni ta' età żgħira, meqjusa flimkien bħala grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 年轻人；青年，指多名处于年轻阶段的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuni li jinsabu fil-perjodu taż-żgħożija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Youths are young people, especially when they are being discussed as a group.

formal.mt: Il-proġett joffri liż-żgħażagħ opportunitajiet ta' taħriġ u parteċipazzjoni fil-komunità.
formal.en: The project offers young people opportunities for training and participation in the community.
formal.zh: 该项目为年轻人提供培训和参与社区活动的机会。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min se jgħin fit-tindif tal-bajja? David: Grupp ta' żgħażagħ mill-iskola tagħna.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who is going to help clean the beach? David: A group of young people from our school.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：谁会来帮忙清理海滩？戴维：我们学校的一群年轻人。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 谁会来帮忙清理海滩？
messages.en: Who is going to help clean the beach?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.zh: 我们学校的一群年轻人。
messages.en: A group of young people from our school.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一群青年一起参加社区活动；把 żgħażagħ 与“一群年轻人”绑定，记住这里指人群。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An increase in tariff rates or officially imposed charges.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 关税税率或规定收费标准的提高。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żieda fir-rati tat-taxxi fuq l-importazzjoni jew fil-ħlasijiet stabbiliti għal servizzi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 关税税率或规定费率的上调。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jiżdiedu r-rati tat-taxxi fuq prodotti importati jew il-ħlasijiet stabbiliti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Tariff escalation occurs when tariff rates or officially established charges are increased.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport janalizza kif żieda fit-tariffi tal-importazzjoni tista' tgħolli l-prezzijiet għall-konsumaturi.
formal.en: The report analyses how an increase in import tariffs can raise prices for consumers.
formal.zh: 报告分析了进口关税上调可能如何推高消费者支付的价格。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Smajt biż-żieda fit-tariffi tal-karozzi tal-linja? Pawlu: Iva, issa se nonfoq aktar biex immur għax-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Marta: Have you heard about the increase in bus fares? Pawlu: Yes, now I'll spend more getting to work.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你听说公交票价上调了吗？保罗：听说了，现在我上班要多花钱了。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.zh: 你听说公交票价上调了吗？
messages.en: Have you heard about the increase in bus fares?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa se nonfoq aktar biex immur għax-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa se nonfoq aktar biex immur għax-xogħol.
messages.zh: 听说了，现在我上班要多花钱了。
messages.en: Yes, now I'll spend more getting to work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象收费表旁画着向上箭头：把整个短语与“费率提高、需要多付钱”的场景一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A light wind that blows from the sea towards the land.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从海面吹向陆地的轻柔微风。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Riħ ħafif li jonfoħ mill-baħar lejn l-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从海面吹向岸边的微风。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Riħ ħafif li jiġi mill-baħar u jinħass fuq ix-xatt jew fuq l-art fil-qrib.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sea breeze is a gentle wind that blows inland from the sea.

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi jistgħu joqogħdu fuq it-terrazzin u jgawdu ż-żiffa tal-baħar.
formal.en: Visitors can sit on the terrace and enjoy the sea breeze.
formal.zh: 游客可以坐在露台上，享受轻柔的海风。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Inpoġġu ħdejn it-tieqa? Hemm żiffa tal-baħar sabiħa. Ninu: Iva, hawn ħafna aktar frisk.
colloquial.en: Lara: Shall we sit by the window? There's a lovely sea breeze. Ninu: Yes, it's much cooler here.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们坐窗边好吗？有很舒服的海风。尼努：好，这里凉快多了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Inpoġġu ħdejn it-tieqa? Hemm żiffa tal-baħar sabiħa.
messages.mt_standard: Inpoġġu ħdejn it-tieqa? Hemm żiffa tal-baħar sabiħa.
messages.zh: 我们坐窗边好吗？有很舒服的海风。
messages.en: Shall we sit by the window? There's a lovely sea breeze.

messages.speaker: Ninu (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，这里凉快多了。
messages.en: Yes, it's much cooler here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象坐在海边，微风轻轻吹动衣角；把整个短语与“轻柔清凉的海风”画面联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A narrow strip of fabric used for tying or decorating things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于捆扎或装饰物品的细长布带。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strixxa twila u dejqa ta' drapp li tintuża biex torbot jew iżżejjen xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用来系结、包装或装饰的细长布带，如丝带或缎带。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa drapp twila u dejqa, spiss ikkulurita, li tintuża biex jintrabtu jew jiżżejnu affarijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A ribbon is a narrow strip of fabric used to tie or decorate something.

collocations.en: tie a ribbon around a gift

formal.mt: Kull kaxxa għandha tkun imżejna b'żigarella blu qabel titqiegħed fuq il-mejda.
formal.en: Each box should be decorated with a blue ribbon before it is placed on the table.
formal.zh: 每个盒子放到桌上之前，都应装饰一条蓝丝带。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għandek żigarella għal dan ir-rigal? Toni: Iva, trid il-ħamra jew il-blu?
colloquial.en: Marija: Do you have a ribbon for this gift? Toni: Yes, would you like the red one or the blue one?
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你有给这份礼物用的丝带吗？托尼：有，你要红色的还是蓝色的？

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.zh: 你有给这份礼物用的丝带吗？
messages.en: Do you have a ribbon for this gift?

messages.speaker: Toni (店员)
messages.zh: 有，你要红色的还是蓝色的？
messages.en: Yes, would you like the red one or the blue one?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给礼盒绕上一条红丝带，再打一个蝴蝶结；读 żigarella 时同步回想这条细长的装饰带。

gloss_zh: 之字形；锯齿形路线或图案

teaching_sense.en_definition: A line, pattern, or route with repeated sharp turns in alternating directions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反复向左右交替急转，形成连续折角的线条、图案或路线。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Linja, disinn jew mogħdija b'sensiela ta' dawriet qawwija li jalternaw bejn naħa u oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由方向交替的连续折角构成的之字形线条、图案或路线。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Forma jew rotta magħmula minn linji qosra li jibdlu d-direzzjoni f'angoli, darba lejn naħa u darba lejn l-oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A zigzag is a line or route that repeatedly turns sharply in alternating directions.

formal.mt: Fuq il-mappa, linja ħamra f'żigżag turi l-mogħdija li titla' mal-għolja.
formal.en: On the map, a red zigzag line shows the path climbing the hill.
formal.zh: 地图上的一条红色之字形线标示了上山的小路。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tiġbed linja f'żigżag? Ben: Qed niġbed it-triq tal-muntanja; iddur darba lejn il-lemin u darba lejn ix-xellug.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you drawing a zigzag line? Ben: I'm drawing the mountain road; it turns right and left in alternation.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么在画一条之字形线？本：我在画那条山路；它一会儿向右转，一会儿向左转。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么在画一条之字形线？
messages.en: Why are you drawing a zigzag line?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed niġbed it-triq tal-muntanja; iddur darba lejn il-lemin u darba lejn ix-xellug.
messages.mt_standard: Qed niġbed it-triq tal-muntanja; iddur darba lejn il-lemin u darba lejn ix-xellug.
messages.zh: 我在画那条山路；它一会儿向右转，一会儿向左转。
messages.en: I'm drawing the mountain road; it turns right and left in alternation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用手指连续画几个相连的字母 Z，每换一次方向就读一遍 żigżag，记住左右交替的之字形。

gloss_zh: 吉卜赛人（这一称呼可能带冒犯意味）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A term for a Roma person that may be considered offensive.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指罗姆人的一种称呼，常译为“吉卜赛人”；使用时需注意它可能带有冒犯意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tintuża għal persuna Rom u li tista' titqies bħala offensiva.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吉卜赛人，指罗姆人；这一称呼可能被认为不尊重或带有冒犯意味。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna Rom li għaliha tintuża din il-kelma, għalkemm il-kelma tista' titqies bħala offensiva.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person called a żingaru is being referred to as a Gypsy, a term that may cause offence.

formal.mt: Fit-traduzzjoni, il-kelma 'żingaru' teħtieġ attenzjoni, għax tista' titqies bħala offensiva.
formal.en: In translation, the word 'żingaru' requires care because it may be considered offensive.
formal.zh: 翻译时，需谨慎处理 żingaru 一词，因为它可能带有冒犯意味。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'żingaru' f'din is-sentenza? Mark: Tirreferi għal persuna Rom, imma l-kelma tista' toffendi. Lara: Mela se noqgħod attenta kif nużaha.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'żingaru' mean in this sentence? Mark: It refers to a Roma person, but the word can cause offence. Lara: Then I'll be careful how I use it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这句话里的 żingaru 是什么意思？Mark：它指罗姆人，但这个词可能冒犯别人。Lara：那我会注意怎么使用它。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 żingaru 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'żingaru' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tirreferi għal persuna Rom, imma l-kelma tista' toffendi.
messages.mt_standard: Tirreferi għal persuna Rom, imma l-kelma tista' toffendi.
messages.zh: 它指罗姆人，但这个词可能冒犯别人。
messages.en: It refers to a Roma person, but the word can cause offence.

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela se noqgħod attenta kif nużaha.
messages.mt_standard: Mela se noqgħod attenta kif nużaha.
messages.zh: 那我会注意怎么使用它。
messages.en: Then I'll be careful how I use it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żingaru 放在“阅读时辨认族群称呼”的词卡上，同时记住“吉卜赛人”和“称呼需谨慎”，不要用外貌或生活方式刻板联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large copper basin used to hold water or other contents.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来盛水或其他物品的大型铜盆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent kbir tar-ram, f'għamla ta' palangana, li jintuża biex iżomm l-ilma jew affarijiet oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 体积较大、用铜制成的盆。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Palangana kbira magħmula mir-ram li tista' tintuża biex jinżamm fiha l-ilma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A żinġla is a large basin made of copper.

collocations.en: to fill a large copper basin with water
to clean the large copper basin

formal.mt: Qabel l-użu, iż-żinġla tar-ram għandha titnaddaf u titqiegħed fuq wiċċ stabbli.
formal.en: Before use, the large copper basin should be cleaned and placed on a stable surface.
formal.zh: 使用前，应清洗大铜盆，并将其放在稳固的平面上。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Fejn se npoġġi l-ilma? Pawlu: Poġġih fiż-żinġla tar-ram. Marta: Se nimlieha sa nofsha.
colloquial.en: Marta: Where shall I put the water? Pawlu: Put it in the large copper basin. Marta: I'll fill it halfway.
colloquial.zh: Marta：我把水放在哪里？Pawlu：放进那个大铜盆里。Marta：我会把它装到一半。

messages.speaker: Marta (家人)
messages.zh: 我把水放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall I put the water?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 放进那个大铜盆里。
messages.en: Put it in the large copper basin.

messages.speaker: Marta (家人)
messages.zh: 我会把它装到一半。
messages.en: I'll fill it halfway.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żinġla 和“大铜盆装半盆水”的画面一起记，再用 tar-ram 提醒自己材质是铜；这是场景记忆法，不是词源拆解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fastening whose two toothed edges are joined or separated by moving a slider.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过移动拉头，使两侧链齿咬合或分开的扣合装置，即拉链。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qafla b'żewġ naħat bis-snien li jingħaqdu jew jinfirdu meta tiċċaqlaq il-biċċa li tiżżerżaq fuqhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拉链，用拉头连接或分开两侧链齿，常用于衣服、包等物品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Qafla li tintuża fil-ħwejjeġ jew fil-basktijiet u li tinfetaħ jew tingħalaq billi tiċċaqlaq biċċa żgħira tul żewġ naħat bis-snien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A żipp is a fastening that opens or closes when a slider moves along two rows of teeth.

formal.mt: Qabel ma taħsel il-ġakketta, agħlaq iż-żipp u segwi l-istruzzjonijiet fuq it-tikketta.
formal.en: Before washing the jacket, close the zipper and follow the instructions on the label.
formal.zh: 清洗夹克前，请拉上拉链，并按照标签上的说明操作。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Iż-żipp tal-basket ma jingħalaqx. Toni: Hemm biċċa drapp maqbuda fih. Sara: Issa ħriġtha. Iż-żipp qed jaħdem!
colloquial.en: Sara: The zipper on the bag won't close. Toni: There's a piece of fabric caught in it. Sara: I've freed it now. The zipper is working!
colloquial.zh: Sara：包上的拉链拉不上。Toni：有一块布卡在里面了。Sara：我现在把布弄出来了。拉链能用了！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 包上的拉链拉不上。
messages.en: The zipper on the bag won't close.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 有一块布卡在里面了。
messages.en: There's a piece of fabric caught in it.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我现在把布弄出来了。拉链能用了！
messages.en: I've freed it now. The zipper is working!

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 żipp 时想象手指把拉链一拉到顶，再配对记忆 tiftaħ“打开”和 tagħlaq“关上”，让词义和动作一起留在脑中。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Failing to show loyalty to someone or something that deserves or expects it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对本应忠于或被期待支持的人、团体或事业缺乏忠诚，表现出背信。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jurix lealtà lejn persuna, grupp jew kawża li għandhom jistennew l-appoġġ tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不忠诚的；背弃应有的信任、支持或忠诚的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jonqos milli jibqa' leali lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa u ma jagħtix l-appoġġ li jkun mistenni minnu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is żleali fails to give the loyalty or support that another person or group expects.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iddeskriva l-iżvelar tas-sigriet tal-grupp bħala att żleali.
formal.en: The report described the disclosure of the group's secret as a disloyal act.
formal.zh: 报告将泄露团体秘密的行为描述为背信之举。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex taħseb li kien żleali? Adam: Għax qal lil kulħadd is-sigriet li fdajtlu. Nina: Nifhem għaliex tlift il-fiduċja fih.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why do you think he was disloyal? Adam: Because he told everyone the secret I entrusted to him. Nina: I understand why you lost trust in him.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你为什么觉得他背信？Adam：因为他把我托付给他的秘密告诉了所有人。Nina：我明白你为什么不再信任他了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么觉得他背信？
messages.en: Why do you think he was disloyal?

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax qal lil kulħadd is-sigriet li fdajtlu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax qal lil kulħadd is-sigriet li fdajtlu.
messages.zh: 因为他把我托付给他的秘密告诉了所有人。
messages.en: Because he told everyone the secret I entrusted to him.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我明白你为什么不再信任他了。
messages.en: I understand why you lost trust in him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“朋友托付秘密，却被转告所有人”的情境记住 żleali，并整块练习 żleali lejn ħabib，突出它与忠诚和信任的关系。

gloss_zh: 损坏的；功能失常的；年老糊涂或头脑昏沉的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Damaged or unable to function properly; also mentally weakened by old age or light-headed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指东西受损或不能正常运作，也可形容人因年老而糊涂，或头脑昏沉、思路不清。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ħsara jew ma jaħdimx sew; jista' wkoll jiddeskrivi persuna li tħawdet bix-xjuħija jew li tħoss rasha ħafifa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受损的；遭到破坏而不再完好的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ġarrab ħsara u m'għadux fi stat tajjeb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is damaged has been harmed and is no longer in good condition.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 功能失常的；无法按应有方式正常运作的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jaħdimx jew ma jwettaqx il-funzjoni tiegħu kif suppost.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is dysfunctional does not work in the way it is supposed to.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因年老而心智衰退、糊涂的，或头脑昏沉、难以清晰思考的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ħsieb imdgħajjef bix-xjuħija, jew li jħoss rasu ħafifa u ma jaħsibx b'ċarezza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person described this way may be mentally confused through old age or feel light-headed and unable to think clearly.

collocations.en: equipment that does not function properly

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni nstab siġġu żmagat li kellu jitneħħa mill-klassi.
formal.en: During the inspection, a damaged chair was found and had to be removed from the classroom.
formal.zh: 检查时发现了一把损坏的椅子，必须将它搬出教室。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan is-siġġu żmagat; toqgħodx fuqu. Mark: Sewwa, se nġib ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: This chair is damaged; don't sit on it. Mark: All right, I'll get another one.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这把椅子坏了，别坐。Mark：好，我去拿另一把。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这把椅子坏了，别坐。
messages.en: This chair is damaged; don't sit on it.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我去拿另一把。
messages.en: All right, I'll get another one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“状态出了问题”串联记忆：椅子是受损，设备是失灵，描述人时则联系年老糊涂或头脑昏沉；具体含义由所修饰的对象决定。

gloss_zh: 衣着不整的；衣服凌乱、仪容不整的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Untidy in appearance because one's clothes are out of place or not properly arranged.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人的衣服没有穿戴整齐，衣领、衣摆等凌乱，整体显得仪容不整。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jidher traskurat għax ħwejġu mhumiex f'posthom jew mhumiex irranġati sew.

sense_translations.en_definition: when a person clothes are out of place, unkempt
sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容人衣服错位、没有整理好，因而衣着凌乱、仪容不整。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li għandha ħwejjiġha mċaqalqa minn posthom jew mhux irranġati, u għalhekk tidher traskurata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is described this way looks untidy because their clothes are out of place or poorly arranged.

collocations.en: to look untidy in one's clothing
to arrive with one's clothes in disarray

formal.mt: L-istudent wasal żmatat għall-intervista, bil-qmis barra mill-qalziet u bl-għonq tal-ġakketta mgħawweġ.
formal.en: The student arrived at the interview looking untidy, with his shirt untucked and his jacket collar twisted.
formal.zh: 这名学生来面试时衣着不整，衬衫没有塞进裤子，外套领子也歪了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tidher żmatat; irranġa l-qmis qabel nidħlu. Pawlu: Għandek raġun, ħriġt ngħaġġel.
colloquial.en: Sara: Your clothes look untidy; straighten your shirt before we go in. Pawlu: You're right, I rushed out.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你衣服有点乱，进去前把衬衫整理一下。Pawlu：你说得对，我出门太匆忙了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tidher żmatat; irranġa l-qmis qabel nidħlu.
messages.mt_standard: Tidher żmatat; irranġa l-qmis qabel nidħlu.
messages.zh: 你衣服有点乱，进去前把衬衫整理一下。
messages.en: Your clothes look untidy; straighten your shirt before we go in.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 你说得对，我出门太匆忙了。
messages.en: You're right, I rushed out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住一个出门太急的画面：领子歪、衬衫没塞好，整个人衣着不整。把 żmatat 直接与这个画面配对，并留意它只有一个 t 接在 a 前。

gloss_zh: 不修边幅的；破旧寒酸的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Untidy or neglected in appearance, or shabby and worn in condition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容外表缺乏整理、不修边幅，或衣物等因陈旧、磨损而显得破旧寒酸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jidher mhux irranġat jew traskurat, jew li hu qadim u mikul u jagħti dehra fqira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不修边幅的；因没有梳理或整理而显得凌乱的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma ġiex irranġat jew imħares sew u għalhekk jidher imħawwad u traskurat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is unkempt has an untidy appearance because they have not taken care of their grooming or clothing.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 破旧的；因磨损或缺乏照料而显得寒酸的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jidher qadim, mikul jew fi stat ħażin minħabba l-użu jew in-nuqqas ta' kura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is shabby looks worn and in poor condition after use or neglect.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel jilbes kowt żmattat, bil-kmiem mikulin u b'but imqatta'.
formal.en: In the story, the man wears a shabby coat with worn sleeves and a torn pocket.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个男人穿着一件破旧的大衣，袖子磨损了，口袋也破了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-kowt sar żmattat; ara kemm intlibsu l-kmiem. Toni: Naf, imma għadu jżommni sħun.
colloquial.en: Lara: This coat has become shabby; look how worn the sleeves are. Toni: I know, but it still keeps me warm.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这件大衣都穿旧了，看看袖子磨成什么样了。Toni：我知道，可它穿着还是很暖和。

messages.speaker: Lara (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-kowt sar żmattat; ara kemm intlibsu l-kmiem.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-kowt sar żmattat; ara kemm intlibsu l-kmiem.
messages.zh: 这件大衣都穿旧了，看看袖子磨成什么样了。
messages.en: This coat has become shabby; look how worn the sleeves are.

messages.speaker: Toni (弟弟)
messages.zh: 我知道，可它穿着还是很暖和。
messages.en: I know, but it still keeps me warm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żmattat 的双写 tt 当作两个记忆挂钩：一个挂“人没整理”，一个挂“衣物破旧”。这只是拼写助记，用来同时记住不修边幅和破旧两义。

gloss_zh: 出错地；斜着；倾斜地；沿对角线

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a mistaken or unsuccessful way, or obliquely rather than straight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示事情出了差错、没有按预期发展，也可表示动作或位置呈斜向、倾斜或对角方向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod żbaljat jew b'riżultat ħażin; jista' wkoll ifisser b'mod inklinat jew djagonali, minflok dritt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出错地；表示走错一步、判断失误，或事情没有顺利进行。
sense_translations.mt_definition: B'mod ħażin jew żbaljat, meta tittieħed deċiżjoni ħażina jew xi ħaġa ma tmurx kif suppost.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something goes this way, a mistake occurs or events fail to develop as intended.

sense_translations.en_definition: obliquely, slantwise, diagonally, at an angle
sense_translations.zh_definition: 斜着；倾斜地；沿斜线或对角线方向。
sense_translations.mt_definition: F'direzzjoni inklinata jew djagonali, jew f'pożizzjoni li mhijiex dritta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is placed or moves this way, it lies or travels at an angle rather than straight.

collocations.en: to attach something at a slant

formal.mt: Il-pannell twaħħal żmerċ, b'naħa ogħla mill-oħra, u għalhekk kellu jerġa' jiġi aġġustat.
formal.en: The panel was attached at a slant, with one side higher than the other, so it had to be adjusted again.
formal.zh: 面板被装斜了，一边高、一边低，因此必须重新调整。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-kwadru waħħaltu żmerċ; in-naħa tal-lemin ogħla. Ben: Veru, se niddrittah issa.
colloquial.en: Nina: You hung the picture at a slant; the right side is higher. Ben: True, I'll straighten it now.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你把画挂斜了，右边比较高。Ben：确实，我现在把它摆正。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kwadru waħħaltu żmerċ; in-naħa tal-lemin ogħla.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kwadru waħħaltu żmerċ; in-naħa tal-lemin ogħla.
messages.zh: 你把画挂斜了，右边比较高。
messages.en: You hung the picture at a slant; the right side is higher.

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.zh: 确实，我现在把它摆正。
messages.en: True, I'll straighten it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“歪了”作双义联想：画挂歪了对应空间上的倾斜，事情办歪了对应出了差错。这是中文学习联想，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 暂停时间；暂时中止的时段

teaching_sense.en_definition: A temporary break during which an activity stops before continuing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 活动暂时停止、随后可继续进行的一段时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Perjodu qasir li fih attività tieqaf għal xi ħin qabel ma tkompli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 暂停；从正在进行的活动中暂时停下来的一段时间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Waqfa temporanja minn attività li tkun għaddejja, biex wieħed jistrieħ jew jaħseb qabel ikompli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Time out is a temporary break from an activity that allows someone to rest or reconsider what to do.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 暂停时段；活动或比赛暂时中断、供休息或商议的一段时间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Perjodu qasir li fih attività jew logħba titwaqqaf temporanjament biex ikun hemm mistrieħ jew diskussjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A time-out is a short interruption in an activity or game during which participants can rest or discuss their next steps.

formal.mt: Matul iż-żmien ta' waqfien, il-kowċ spjega lill-plejers kif kellhom ikomplu l-logħba.
formal.en: During the time-out, the coach explained to the players how they should continue the game.
formal.zh: 暂停期间，教练向球员说明了接下来应该如何比赛。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nistgħu nieħdu żmien ta' waqfien qasir? Pawlu: Żgur, nistrieħu ħames minuti u mbagħad inkomplu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can we take a short time-out? Pawlu: Sure, let's rest for five minutes and then carry on.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们能暂停一小会儿吗？保罗：当然，休息五分钟再继续。

messages.speaker: Lara (学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nieħdu żmien ta' waqfien qasir?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nieħdu żmien ta' waqfien qasir?
messages.zh: 我们能暂停一小会儿吗？
messages.en: Can we take a short time-out?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur, nistrieħu ħames minuti u mbagħad inkomplu.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur, nistrieħu ħames minuti u mbagħad inkomplu.
messages.zh: 当然，休息五分钟再继续。
messages.en: Sure, let's rest for five minutes and then carry on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żmien ta' waqfien 和播放器的暂停键一起记：活动先停一段时间，之后还会继续。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The period for which a product remains usable or retains its required quality while stored under suitable conditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 产品在适当储存条件下仍可使用或保持所需品质的期限。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-perjodu li matulu prodott jibqa' tajjeb għall-użu jew iżomm il-kwalità meħtieġa meta jinħażen f'kundizzjonijiet xierqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 保质期：产品在规定储存条件下保持可接受品质的期限。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-perjodu li matulu prodott iżomm kwalità aċċettabbli meta jinħażen skont il-kundizzjonijiet speċifikati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A product's shelf life is the length of time it keeps an acceptable quality under specified storage conditions.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 储存寿命：物品在储存期间仍能保持适用状态或正常功能的期限。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-perjodu li matulu oġġett jista' jinżamm maħżun u jibqa' f'kundizzjoni tajba jew kapaċi jaqdi l-funzjoni tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An item's storage life is the period it can remain in storage while retaining its usefulness or function.

formal.mt: Il-manwal jindika ż-żmien tal-ħżin tal-prodott u l-kundizzjonijiet meħtieġa biex tinżamm il-kwalità tiegħu.
formal.en: The manual specifies the product's storage life and the conditions needed to maintain its quality.
formal.zh: 手册注明了该产品的储存寿命，以及保持其品质所需的条件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-prodott għandu żmien tal-ħżin twil? Mark: Iva, jekk iżżommu magħluq f'post frisk u niexef.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this product have a long shelf life? Mark: Yes, if you keep it sealed in a cool, dry place.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个产品的保质期长吗？马克：长，前提是密封放在阴凉干燥的地方。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-prodott għandu żmien tal-ħżin twil?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-prodott għandu żmien tal-ħżin twil?
messages.zh: 这个产品的保质期长吗？
messages.en: Does this product have a long shelf life?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk iżżommu magħluq f'post frisk u niexef.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk iżżommu magħluq f'post frisk u niexef.
messages.zh: 长，前提是密封放在阴凉干燥的地方。
messages.en: Yes, if you keep it sealed in a cool, dry place.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给储物架上的产品画一条时间线：从入库到品质不再达标，这一段就是 żmien tal-ħżin。

gloss_zh: 当时；在那个时候（按本条给定义项）

teaching_sense.en_definition: In this entry, relating to the particular time indicated by the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本条按给定形容词义项理解为与上下文所指的那个时候有关，释义为“当时”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'din l-entrata, bħala aġġettiv, tirreferi għal dak iż-żmien partikolari li jkun indikat mill-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 当时；指上下文所说的那个特定时候。本条保留给定的形容词标注。
sense_translations.mt_definition: F'dan is-sens mogħti, tindika dak iż-żmien partikolari li jkun qed jissemma jew jiġi deskritt fil-kuntest.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this entry, the expression identifies the particular time being referred to in the surrounding context.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, 'żminijietna' għandha tinftiehem skont is-sens mogħti, b'referenza għaż-żmien indikat fil-kuntest.
formal.en: In this exercise, 'żminijietna' should be understood according to the supplied sense, with reference to the time indicated by the context.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，应按给定的义项理解“żminijietna”，将其与上下文所指的那个时候联系起来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif nifhem 'żminijietna' f'din il-lista? Rita: Skont is-sens mogħti hawn, aħseb f'dak iż-żmien li qed jissemma.
colloquial.en: Maja: How should I understand 'żminijietna' in this list? Rita: According to the sense given here, think of the particular time being mentioned.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这份词表里的“żminijietna”该怎么理解？丽塔：按这里给出的义项，想着上下文提到的那个时候就可以。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这份词表里的“żminijietna”该怎么理解？
messages.en: How should I understand 'żminijietna' in this list?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Skont is-sens mogħti hawn, aħseb f'dak iż-żmien li qed jissemma.
messages.mt_standard: Skont is-sens mogħti hawn, aħseb f'dak iż-żmien li qed jissemma.
messages.zh: 按这里给出的义项，想着上下文提到的那个时候就可以。
messages.en: According to the sense given here, think of the particular time being mentioned.

cognitive_memory_aid: 本条可用时间轴定位法记忆：先找上下文指向的时间点，再把 żminijietna 与给定释义“当时”配对。

gloss_zh: 苗条；纤细的体态（按本条名词义项）

teaching_sense.en_definition: In this entry, the concept of a slim or slender bodily appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本条按给定名词义项理解为苗条、纤细的体态这一概念。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'din l-entrata, bħala nom, tindika l-kunċett ta' dehra tal-ġisem rqiqa u mhux goffa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 苗条；纤细的体态。本条以名词义项表达这一外形概念。
sense_translations.mt_definition: F'dan is-sens mogħti bħala nom, tirreferi għall-kunċett ta' figura rqiqa u mhux goffa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this noun entry, the sense concerns the concept of a slim or slender physical appearance.

collocations.en: the use of 'żnella' as a noun

formal.mt: F'din il-lista, 'żnella' hija ppreżentata bħala nom li jirreferi għall-kunċett ta' figura rqiqa.
formal.en: In this list, 'żnella' is presented as a noun referring to the concept of a slender figure.
formal.zh: 在这份词表中，“żnella”被列为名词，表示纤细体态这一概念。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'tindika 'żnella' f'din l-entrata? Mark: Hawn tindika l-kunċett ta' figura rqiqa, u hija mniżżla bħala nom.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'żnella' mean in this entry? Mark: Here it indicates the concept of a slender figure, and it is listed as a noun.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个词条里的“żnella”表示什么？马克：这里表示纤细体态这一概念，词表把它列为名词。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这个词条里的“żnella”表示什么？
messages.en: What does 'żnella' mean in this entry?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tindika l-kunċett ta' figura rqiqa, u hija mniżżla bħala nom.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tindika l-kunċett ta' figura rqiqa, u hija mniżżla bħala nom.
messages.zh: 这里表示纤细体态这一概念，词表把它列为名词。
messages.en: Here it indicates the concept of a slender figure, and it is listed as a noun.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在词卡上画一个纤细的人物轮廓，把 żnella 与“苗条体态”配对，并单独记住本条给定的名词标注。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person trained in medicine who examines patients and treats illnesses.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 接受医学训练、检查患者并诊治疾病的人；本词条按所给义项理解为医师。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna mħarrġa fil-mediċina li teżamina lill-pazjenti u tikkura l-mard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 医师；受过医学训练、负责检查患者和诊治疾病的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tabib li jkun imħarreġ biex jeżamina lill-pazjenti, jagħraf il-mard u jagħti l-kura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A physician is a person trained in medicine who examines patients and treats illnesses.

collocations.en: the meaning of the expression 'żobb go bott'
the translation of the expression 'żobb go bott'

formal.mt: F'din il-lista, l-espressjoni 'żobb go bott' tingħata bit-tifsira ta' tabib, jiġifieri persuna li teżamina lill-pazjenti u tikkura l-mard.
formal.en: In this list, the expression 'żobb go bott' is given the meaning of physician, a person who examines patients and treats illnesses.
formal.zh: 在这份词表中，表达“żobb go bott”所给的含义是医师，即检查患者并诊治疾病的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'żobb go bott' f'din il-lista? Mark: Hawnhekk ifisser tabib, persuna li teżamina lill-pazjenti u tikkura l-mard.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'żobb go bott' mean in this list? Mark: Here it means a physician, a person who examines patients and treats illnesses.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这份词表里的“żobb go bott”是什么意思？Mark：这里指医师，也就是检查患者并诊治疾病的人。

messages.en: Here it means a physician, a person who examines patients and treats illnesses.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本词条所给义项，把整个表达与“医生检查患者”的画面配对记忆；整体识记，不拆分猜测词源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The belt of the sky divided into twelve signs through which the Sun appears to move during the year.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 太阳在一年中看似运行所经过的天区带，在占星术中分为十二个星宫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iċ-ċinturin tas-sema li fih ix-xemx tidher timxi matul is-sena u li fl-astroloġija jinqasam fi tnax-il sinjal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黄道带；占星术中划分为十二个星宫的天区带，也指黄道十二宫体系。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Medda tas-sema li fiha tidher tgħaddi x-xemx matul is-sena, maqsuma fi tnax-il sinjal fl-astroloġija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The zodiac is a belt of the sky that is divided into twelve signs in astrology.

formal.mt: Il-ktieb jippreżenta t-tnax-il sinjal taż-żodjaku f'dijagramma ċirkolari, bl-isem ta' kull sinjal ħdejn is-simbolu tiegħu.
formal.en: The book presents the twelve signs of the zodiac in a circular diagram, with the name of each sign beside its symbol.
formal.zh: 这本书用圆形图展示黄道十二宫，并在每个星宫的符号旁标出其名称。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dawn is-simboli kollha huma tas-sinjali taż-żodjaku? Mark: Iva, hemm tnax-il sinjal; ejja naqraw l-ismijiet tagħhom flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are all these symbols for the signs of the zodiac? Mark: Yes, there are twelve signs; let's read their names together.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这些符号都是黄道十二宫的星宫符号吗？Mark：是的，一共有十二个星宫；我们一起读读它们的名称吧。

messages.mt_standard: Dawn is-simboli kollha huma tas-sinjali taż-żodjaku?
messages.zh: 这些符号都是黄道十二宫的星宫符号吗？
messages.en: Are all these symbols for the signs of the zodiac?
