messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm tnax-il sinjal; ejja naqraw l-ismijiet tagħhom flimkien.
messages.zh: 是的，一共有十二个星宫；我们一起读读它们的名称吧。
messages.en: Yes, there are twelve signs; let's read their names together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żodjaku 想象成分成十二格的天空圆环，每格放一个星宫符号，帮助记住“黄道十二宫”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area distinguished by its location, characteristics, purpose, or rules.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因位置、特征、用途或适用规则而与周围地方区分开的区域或地带。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti minn post jew territorju li tingħaraf mill-bqija minħabba l-pożizzjoni, il-karatteristiċi, l-użu jew ir-regoli tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 区域；地带，指具有某种共同特征、特定用途或特定管理规则的一片地方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Medda ta' art jew parti minn post b'karatteristiċi, skop jew regoli li jiddistingwuha mill-inħawi ta' madwarha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A zone is an area that has particular features, serves a particular purpose, or follows particular rules.

formal.mt: Il-pjan il-ġdid jinkludi żona residenzjali qrib l-iskola u żona industrijali aktar 'il bogħod miċ-ċentru.
formal.en: The new plan includes a residential zone near the school and an industrial zone farther from the centre.
formal.zh: 新规划包括学校附近的一片住宅区，以及距离中心更远的一片工业区。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din iż-żona hi kwieta filgħaxija? Mark: Iva, hi żona residenzjali u ma tantx jgħaddu karozzi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this area quiet in the evening? Mark: Yes, it's a residential zone, and there isn't much passing traffic.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这一带晚上安静吗？Mark：安静，这里是住宅区，经过的车不多。

messages.speaker: Maja (租客)
messages.zh: 这一带晚上安静吗？
messages.en: Is this area quiet in the evening?

messages.speaker: Mark (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hi żona residenzjali u ma tantx jgħaddu karozzi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hi żona residenzjali u ma tantx jgħaddu karozzi.
messages.zh: 安静，这里是住宅区，经过的车不多。
messages.en: Yes, it's a residential zone, and there isn't much passing traffic.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中给地图涂出一块颜色，再贴上“住宅”或“工业”标签，用这片有共同用途的地方记住 żona。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A designated area where goods may be stored or handled under special customs arrangements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 实行特殊海关管理安排、可用于储存或处理货物的指定区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żona magħżula fejn il-merkanzija tista' tinħażen jew tiġi ttrattata skont arranġamenti doganali speċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 实行特殊海关管理安排的指定区域，通常用于货物储存、处理或贸易。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żona magħżula fejn japplikaw arranġamenti doganali speċjali għall-ħażna, għat-trattament jew għall-kummerċ tal-merkanzija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A free zone is a designated area where special customs arrangements apply to goods stored, handled, or traded there.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-proċeduri għall-ħażna tal-merkanzija fiż-żona libera.
formal.en: The report describes the procedures for storing goods in the free zone.
formal.zh: 该报告说明了在自由区内储存货物的程序。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn se nħażnu l-merkanzija? Rita: Fiż-żona libera, wara li niċċekkjaw il-proċeduri doganali.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where are we going to store the goods? Rita: In the free zone, after we check the customs procedures.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们准备把货物存在哪里？丽塔：存到自由区，先核查一下海关程序。

messages.speaker: Mark (仓库职员)
messages.zh: 我们准备把货物存在哪里？
messages.en: Where are we going to store the goods?

messages.speaker: Rita (物流主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Fiż-żona libera, wara li niċċekkjaw il-proċeduri doganali.
messages.mt_standard: Fiż-żona libera, wara li niċċekkjaw il-proċeduri doganali.
messages.zh: 存到自由区，先核查一下海关程序。
messages.en: In the free zone, after we check the customs procedures.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语想成地图上圈出的货物专区：记住这里的“自由”联系特殊海关安排，不能理解成完全没有规则。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A geographically distant area designated for refund-related activities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 地理位置较远、被指定用于退款相关事务的区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żona li tinsab 'il bogħod u li hija magħżula għal attivitajiet relatati mal-għoti lura tal-flus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 位于较远地点、用于退款相关事务的指定区域。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żona f'post imbiegħed li tkun magħżula għal ħidma marbuta mal-għoti lura tal-flus.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A remote refund zone is a geographically distant area designated for activities connected with returning money.

collocations.en: access to the remote refund zone
collocations.zh: 前往远程退款区的通道或途径

collocations.en: services in the remote refund zone

formal.mt: Il-pjan juri fejn tinsab iż-żona mbiegħda ta' rifużjoni u kif wieħed jista' jasal għaliha.
formal.en: The plan shows where the remote refund zone is located and how to reach it.
formal.zh: 该平面图标明了远程退款区的位置及前往路线。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Iż-żona mbiegħda ta' rifużjoni tinsab f'dan il-bini? Pawlu: Le, tinsab aktar 'il bogħod; ejja naraw il-mappa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the remote refund zone in this building? Pawlu: No, it is farther away; let's look at the map.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：远程退款区在这栋楼里吗？保罗：不，在更远的地方；我们看看地图吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iż-żona mbiegħda ta' rifużjoni tinsab f'dan il-bini?
messages.mt_standard: Iż-żona mbiegħda ta' rifużjoni tinsab f'dan il-bini?
messages.zh: 远程退款区在这栋楼里吗？
messages.en: Is the remote refund zone in this building?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (服务人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tinsab aktar 'il bogħod; ejja naraw il-mappa.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tinsab aktar 'il bogħod; ejja naraw il-mappa.
messages.zh: 不，在更远的地方；我们看看地图吧。
messages.en: No, it is farther away; let's look at the map.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“区域—距离远—办理退款”三个画面串起来，想象地图远端的退款服务区，帮助记住整个长短语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area whose interconnected electricity systems operate at a common frequency in synchronism.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 互相连接的电力系统以共同频率保持同步运行的区域，也可指构成该区域的同步电网。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żona fejn sistemi tal-elettriku konnessi ma' xulxin jaħdmu b'mod sinkronizzat bi frekwenza komuni; it-terminu jista' jirreferi wkoll għan-netwerk innifsu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由以共同频率保持同步运行的互联电力系统所覆盖的区域。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żona koperta minn sistemi tal-elettriku konnessi ma' xulxin li jaħdmu b'mod sinkronizzat bi frekwenza komuni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A synchronous area is a region in which interconnected electricity systems operate together at a common frequency.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 各组成部分以共同频率保持同步运行的互联电网。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Netwerk tal-elettriku magħmul minn partijiet konnessi ma' xulxin li jaħdmu b'mod sinkronizzat bi frekwenza komuni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A synchronous grid is an interconnected electricity network whose constituent systems operate together at a common frequency.

collocations.en: the frequency of the synchronous grid
the boundaries of the synchronous area
the stability of the synchronous grid

formal.mt: L-istudju jidentifika l-konfini taż-żona sinkronika u janalizza l-istabbiltà tal-frekwenza tan-netwerk tagħha.
formal.en: The study identifies the boundaries of the synchronous area and analyses the frequency stability of its grid.
formal.zh: 该研究确定了同步区域的边界，并分析了其电网的频率稳定性。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dawn iż-żewġ sistemi huma fl-istess żona sinkronika? David: Iva, huma konnessi u jaħdmu b'mod sinkronizzat bi frekwenza komuni.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are these two systems in the same synchronous area? David: Yes, they are interconnected and operate in synchronism at a common frequency.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这两个系统属于同一个同步区域吗？戴维：是的，它们相互连接，并以共同频率保持同步运行。

messages.speaker: Sara (实习工程师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn iż-żewġ sistemi huma fl-istess żona sinkronika?
messages.mt_standard: Dawn iż-żewġ sistemi huma fl-istess żona sinkronika?
messages.zh: 这两个系统属于同一个同步区域吗？
messages.en: Are these two systems in the same synchronous area?

messages.speaker: David (电网工程师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huma konnessi u jaħdmu b'mod sinkronizzat bi frekwenza komuni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huma konnessi u jaħdmu b'mod sinkronizzat bi frekwenza komuni.
messages.zh: 是的，它们相互连接，并以共同频率保持同步运行。
messages.en: Yes, they are interconnected and operate in synchronism at a common frequency.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上的多座电站跟着同一个节拍运行：看覆盖范围时记“同步区域”，看连接的网络时记“同步电网”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area in which electricity supply and demand are balanced through coordinated operational actions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过相互协调的运行操作来维持电力供需平衡的区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żona fejn il-provvista u d-domanda tal-elettriku jinżammu f'bilanċ permezz ta' azzjonijiet operattivi kkoordinati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过协调电力运行措施来维持供需平衡的指定区域。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żona magħżula fejn jiġu kkoordinati azzjonijiet operattivi biex jinżamm il-bilanċ bejn il-provvista u d-domanda tal-elettriku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A coordinated balancing area is an area where operational actions are coordinated to maintain the balance between electricity supply and demand.

collocations.en: management of the coordinated balancing area
operators in the coordinated balancing area
collocations.zh: 协调平衡区域内的运营方

collocations.en: the boundaries of the coordinated balancing area

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif l-operaturi fiż-żona ta' bbilanċjar koordinat jaħdmu flimkien biex iżommu l-provvista u d-domanda tal-elettriku f'bilanċ.
formal.en: The report explains how operators in the coordinated balancing area work together to keep electricity supply and demand in balance.
formal.zh: 该报告解释了协调平衡区域内的运营方如何共同维持电力供需平衡。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'jiġri jekk id-domanda tiżdied fiż-żona ta' bbilanċjar koordinat? Mark: L-operaturi jikkoordinaw l-azzjonijiet tagħhom biex iżommu l-provvista u d-domanda f'bilanċ.
colloquial.en: Nina: What happens if demand rises in the coordinated balancing area? Mark: The operators coordinate their actions to keep supply and demand in balance.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：如果协调平衡区域内的需求上升，会怎样？马克：运营方会协调各自的操作，以维持供需平衡。

messages.speaker: Nina (实习调度员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jiġri jekk id-domanda tiżdied fiż-żona ta' bbilanċjar koordinat?
messages.mt_standard: X'jiġri jekk id-domanda tiżdied fiż-żona ta' bbilanċjar koordinat?
messages.zh: 如果协调平衡区域内的需求上升，会怎样？
messages.en: What happens if demand rises in the coordinated balancing area?

messages.speaker: Mark (调度主管)
messages.mt_spoken: L-operaturi jikkoordinaw l-azzjonijiet tagħhom biex iżommu l-provvista u d-domanda f'bilanċ.
messages.mt_standard: L-operaturi jikkoordinaw l-azzjonijiet tagħhom biex iżommu l-provvista u d-domanda f'bilanċ.
messages.zh: 运营方会协调各自的操作，以维持供需平衡。
messages.en: The operators coordinate their actions to keep supply and demand in balance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个区域里的调度员共同扶稳一架天平，两端分别是电力供应和需求；用“区域—平衡—协调”记住短语结构。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area assigned to a person or organisation as their responsibility.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 划归某个人或机构负责的区域或工作范围。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żona jew qasam ta' xogħol li persuna jew organizzazzjoni tkun inkarigata tieħu ħsiebu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由某个人或机构承担相应职责的区域或工作范围。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żona jew qasam li jaqa' taħt ir-responsabbiltà ta' persuna jew organizzazzjoni partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A responsibility area is an area or field of work that a particular person or organisation is assigned to manage.

collocations.en: the boundaries of the responsibility area

formal.mt: Id-dokument jiddefinixxi ż-żona ta' inkarigu ta' kull tim u jispeċifika x-xogħol li għandu jwettaq.
formal.en: The document defines each team's responsibility area and specifies the work it must carry out.
formal.zh: 该文件界定了各团队的职责范围，并明确了各自应完成的工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din it-triq tinsab fiż-żona ta' inkarigu tagħna? Mark: Iva, aħna responsabbli għaliha, allura ngħaddu minn hemm illum.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this street in our responsibility area? Mark: Yes, we are responsible for it, so we will go there today.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这条街在我们的负责区域内吗？Mark：是的，这条街由我们负责，所以我们今天会去那里。

messages.speaker: Maja (团队成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Din it-triq tinsab fiż-żona ta' inkarigu tagħna?
messages.mt_standard: Din it-triq tinsab fiż-żona ta' inkarigu tagħna?
messages.zh: 这条街在我们的负责区域内吗？
messages.en: Is this street in our responsibility area?

messages.speaker: Mark (团队负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, aħna responsabbli għaliha, allura ngħaddu minn hemm illum.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, aħna responsabbli għaliha, allura ngħaddu minn hemm illum.
messages.zh: 是的，这条街由我们负责，所以我们今天会去那里。
messages.en: Yes, we are responsible for it, so we will go there today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把地图上的一片区域想成贴着负责人姓名的任务区，看到 żona ta' inkarigu 就联想“这一片归谁负责”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area of an electricity system within which load-frequency control is coordinated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 电力系统中协调实施负荷频率控制的区域，用于维持有功功率平衡和系统频率。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żona ta' sistema tal-elettriku li fiha jiġi kkoordinat il-kontroll tal-bilanċ bejn il-ġenerazzjoni u t-tagħbija sabiex tinżamm il-frekwenza tas-sistema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 负荷频率控制区，即协调实施负荷频率控制的电力系统区域；LFC 为该控制的英文缩写。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żona tas-sistema tal-elettriku li fiha jiġi kkoordinat il-kontroll tat-tagħbija u tal-frekwenza, magħruf bl-abbrevjazzjoni Ingliża LFC.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An LFC area is a defined part of an electricity system within which load-frequency control is coordinated.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电力系统中通过协调控制来维持有功功率平衡和系统频率的区域。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żona definita tas-sistema tal-elettriku li fiha l-ġenerazzjoni tiġi aġġustata b'mod ikkoordinat biex jinżamm il-bilanċ mat-tagħbija u tiġi kkontrollata l-frekwenza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A load-frequency control area is a defined electricity system area in which generation is coordinated to maintain power balance and system frequency.

collocations.mt: tiddefinixxi żona ta' kontroll tal-frekwenza tat-tagħbija
il-konfini taż-żona ta' kontroll tal-frekwenza tat-tagħbija
collocations.en: the boundaries of the load-frequency control area
collocations.zh: 负荷频率控制区的边界

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika ż-żona ta' kontroll tal-frekwenza tat-tagħbija u jiddeskrivi kif tiġi kkoordinata l-ġenerazzjoni fiha.
formal.en: The report identifies the load-frequency control area and describes how generation is coordinated within it.
formal.zh: 该报告标明了负荷频率控制区，并说明了区内发电的协调方式。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din il-mappa turi ż-żona ta' kontroll tal-frekwenza tat-tagħbija? Pawlu: Iva, il-linja blu turi l-konfini tagħha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this map show the load-frequency control area? Pawlu: Yes, the blue line shows its boundaries.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这张地图显示的是负荷频率控制区吗？Pawlu：是的，蓝线标出了它的边界。

messages.speaker: Lara (实习工程师)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-mappa turi ż-żona ta' kontroll tal-frekwenza tat-tagħbija?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-mappa turi ż-żona ta' kontroll tal-frekwenza tat-tagħbija?
messages.zh: 这张地图显示的是负荷频率控制区吗？
messages.en: Does this map show the load-frequency control area?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (电网工程师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-linja blu turi l-konfini tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-linja blu turi l-konfini tagħha.
messages.zh: 是的，蓝线标出了它的边界。
messages.en: Yes, the blue line shows its boundaries.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把长词组分成“区域—控制—频率—负荷”四块来记，再想象电网控制室协调发电与用电，帮助记住“负荷频率控制区”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area in which conditions or activities are systematically observed and recorded.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为持续了解状况或活动而进行有组织观察和记录的区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żona li fiha jiġu osservati u rreġistrati b'mod sistematiku kundizzjonijiet jew attivitajiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对特定状况、变化或活动进行系统观察和记录的区域。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żona magħżula fejn isiru osservazzjonijiet u jinġabru rekords b'mod regolari sabiex jiġu segwiti kundizzjonijiet, bidliet jew attivitajiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A monitoring area is a defined area in which conditions or activities are observed and recorded to track their state or changes.

collocations.en: collect data in the monitoring area
collocations.zh: 在监测区域内收集数据

formal.mt: It-tim stabbilixxa żona ta' monitoraġġ madwar il-lag biex jiġbor data regolari dwar il-kwalità tal-ilma.
formal.en: The team established a monitoring area around the lake to collect regular data on water quality.
formal.zh: 团队在湖泊周围设立了监测区域，以定期收集水质数据。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dak is-sinjal juri fejn tibda ż-żona ta' monitoraġġ? Toni: Iva, minn hemm nibdew niġbru l-kampjuni tal-ilma.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does that sign show where the monitoring area begins? Toni: Yes, that is where we start collecting water samples.
colloquial.zh: Nina：那个标志是不是标出了监测区域的起点？Toni：是的，我们从那里开始采集水样。

messages.speaker: Nina (实地调查员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak is-sinjal juri fejn tibda ż-żona ta' monitoraġġ?
messages.mt_standard: Dak is-sinjal juri fejn tibda ż-żona ta' monitoraġġ?
messages.zh: 那个标志是不是标出了监测区域的起点？
messages.en: Does that sign show where the monitoring area begins?

messages.speaker: Toni (监测组长)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, minn hemm nibdew niġbru l-kampjuni tal-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, minn hemm nibdew niġbru l-kampjuni tal-ilma.
messages.zh: 是的，我们从那里开始采集水样。
messages.en: Yes, that is where we start collecting water samples.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żona ta' monitoraġġ 想成地图上圈出的观测范围，圈内有人定期测量、记录变化，就能记住“监测区域”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area within which something can be observed or monitored.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够对某个对象或现象进行观察或监测的区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żona li fiha jkun possibbli li jiġu osservati jew immonitorjati oġġetti, attivitajiet jew fenomeni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可对对象或现象进行观察、监测的区域。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żona li fiha oġġett jew fenomenu jista' jiġi osservat jew immonitorjat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An observability area is a region within which an object or phenomenon can be observed or monitored.

collocations.en: the boundaries of the observability area

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi ż-żona ta' osservabilità u jindika liema partijiet tal-għalqa jistgħu jiġu mmonitorjati.
formal.en: The report describes the observability area and indicates which parts of the field can be monitored.
formal.zh: 报告描述了可观测区域，并说明田地中的哪些部分可以受到监测。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din is-siġra tinsab fiż-żona ta' osservabilità? Pawlu: Iva, tidher minn hawn, iżda s-siġra ta' warajha ma tidhirx.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this tree within the observability area? Pawlu: Yes, it is visible from here, but the tree behind it is not.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这棵树在可观测区域内吗？保罗：在，从这里看得见，但它后面的那棵树看不见。

messages.speaker: Maja (实习生)
messages.mt_spoken: Din is-siġra tinsab fiż-żona ta' osservabilità?
messages.mt_standard: Din is-siġra tinsab fiż-żona ta' osservabilità?
messages.zh: 这棵树在可观测区域内吗？
messages.en: Is this tree within the observability area?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (观察员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tidher minn hawn, iżda s-siġra ta' warajha ma tidhirx.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tidher minn hawn, iżda s-siġra ta' warajha ma tidhirx.
messages.zh: 在，从这里看得见，但它后面的那棵树看不见。
messages.en: Yes, it is visible from here, but the tree behind it is not.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语想成地图上圈出的“能够观察到的范围”，用圈内看得见、圈外看不见的画面记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area used to organize the times of tasks, events, or appointments.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于安排任务、活动或预约时间的区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żona maħsuba biex jiġu organizzati l-ħinijiet ta' kompiti, attivitajiet jew appuntamenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于编排任务、活动或预约时间的区域。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żona fejn jiġu stabbiliti u organizzati l-ħinijiet ta' kompiti, attivitajiet jew appuntamenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A scheduling area is a space used to arrange when tasks, events, or appointments will take place.

formal.mt: Biex tibbukkja appuntament, iftaħ iż-żona ta' skedar u agħżel data u ħin disponibbli.
formal.en: To book an appointment, open the scheduling area and select an available date and time.
formal.zh: 如需预约，请打开排程区域，选择一个可用的日期和时间。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn nista' nbiddel il-ħin tal-laqgħa? Mark: Iftaħ iż-żona ta' skedar; hemmhekk tista' tagħżel ħin ieħor.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where can I change the meeting time? Mark: Open the scheduling area; you can choose another time there.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我在哪里可以更改会议时间？马克：打开排程区域，在那里可以选择其他时间。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 我在哪里可以更改会议时间？
messages.en: Where can I change the meeting time?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iftaħ iż-żona ta' skedar; hemmhekk tista' tagħżel ħin ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Iftaħ iż-żona ta' skedar; hemmhekk tista' tagħżel ħin ieħor.
messages.zh: 打开排程区域，在那里可以选择其他时间。
messages.en: Open the scheduling area; you can choose another time there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语与日历界面中安排时间的那一块联系起来：进入这个区域，就可以把事情排进时间表。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An electricity market area for which an imbalance price is determined and applied.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 电力市场中确定并适用不平衡结算价格的区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żona fis-suq tal-elettriku li għaliha jiġi stabbilit u applikat prezz għas-saldu tal-iżbilanċi bejn il-kwantitajiet skedati u dawk effettivi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电力市场中用于确定和适用不平衡结算价格的区域；该价格用于结算计划电量与实际电量之间的偏差。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żona definita fis-suq tal-elettriku li għaliha jiġi kkalkolat u applikat prezz biex jiġu saldati d-differenzi bejn il-kwantitajiet tal-elettriku skedati u dawk effettivi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An imbalance price area is a defined electricity market area for which prices are determined to settle differences between scheduled and actual electricity quantities.

collocations.en: the price applicable in the imbalance price area
collocations.zh: 不平衡价格区内适用的价格

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika ż-żona tal-prezz tal-iżbilanċ u jagħti l-prezz applikabbli għall-perjodu ta' saldu indikat.
formal.en: The report identifies the imbalance price area and gives the price applicable to the stated settlement period.
formal.zh: 该报告标明了不平衡价格区，并列出了所述结算时段适用的价格。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din it-tabella tirreferi għaż-żona tal-prezz tal-iżbilanċ tagħna? David: Iva, imma ara wkoll il-perjodu ta' saldu qabel tuża l-prezz.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does this table refer to our imbalance price area? David: Yes, but also check the settlement period before using the price.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这张表对应我们所在的不平衡价格区吗？David：是的，不过使用这个价格前，也要核对结算时段。

messages.speaker: Sara (电力市场分析员)
messages.mt_spoken: Din it-tabella tirreferi għaż-żona tal-prezz tal-iżbilanċ tagħna?
messages.mt_standard: Din it-tabella tirreferi għaż-żona tal-prezz tal-iżbilanċ tagħna?
messages.zh: 这张表对应我们所在的不平衡价格区吗？
messages.en: Does this table refer to our imbalance price area?

messages.speaker: David (结算专员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ara wkoll il-perjodu ta' saldu qabel tuża l-prezz.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ara wkoll il-perjodu ta' saldu qabel tuża l-prezz.
messages.zh: 是的，不过使用这个价格前，也要核对结算时段。
messages.en: Yes, but also check the settlement period before using the price.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象电量计划与实际之间有一个差额，再给地图上的结算区域贴上价格标签，把“区域—价格—不平衡”连成记忆画面。

gloss_zh: 界定的地理区域；已识别的地理区域

teaching_sense.en_definition: A geographical area whose extent or identity has been clearly established.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 范围已经明确界定，或已被识别并明确指出的地理区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żona fuq il-wiċċ tad-dinja li l-firxa jew l-identità tagħha tkun ġiet stabbilita b'mod ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 界定的地理区域；其范围或边界已经明确划定的一片地域。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żona ġeografika li l-firxa jew il-konfini tagħha jkunu ġew stabbiliti b'mod ċar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A defined geographical area is a region whose extent or boundaries have been clearly established.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已识别的地理区域；已被辨认并明确指出是哪一片地域的区域。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żona ġeografika li tkun ġiet rikonoxxuta u indikata b'mod li jkun ċar għal liema post qed issir referenza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An identified geographical area is a region that has been recognized and specified so that its location is clear.

collocations.en: the boundaries of a defined geographical area
a study of a defined geographical area
collocations.zh: 针对某一界定地理区域的研究

formal.mt: L-istudju jiġbor data minn żona ġeografika ddefinita, li l-konfini tagħha huma mmarkati b'mod ċar fuq il-mappa mehmuża.
formal.en: The study collects data from a defined geographical area whose boundaries are clearly marked on the attached map.
formal.zh: 本研究从一个界定的地理区域收集数据，该区域的边界已在附图上清楚标明。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għal dan l-eżerċizzju, nistgħu nagħżlu kwalunkwe post? Mark: Agħżlu żona ġeografika ddefinita u mmarkaw il-konfini tagħha fuq il-mappa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can we choose any place for this exercise? Mark: Choose a defined geographical area and mark its boundaries on the map.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个练习可以任选一个地方吗？Mark：选一个范围明确的地理区域，再把它的边界标在地图上。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal dan l-eżerċizzju, nistgħu nagħżlu kwalunkwe post?
messages.mt_standard: Għal dan l-eżerċizzju, nistgħu nagħżlu kwalunkwe post?
messages.zh: 这个练习可以任选一个地方吗？
messages.en: Can we choose any place for this exercise?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Agħżlu żona ġeografika ddefinita u mmarkaw il-konfini tagħha fuq il-mappa.
messages.mt_standard: Agħżlu żona ġeografika ddefinita u mmarkaw il-konfini tagħha fuq il-mappa.
messages.zh: 选一个范围明确的地理区域，再把它的边界标在地图上。
messages.en: Choose a defined geographical area and mark its boundaries on the map.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象在地图上圈定并标出一片地域：“界定”侧重范围清楚，“识别”侧重明确是哪一片地方，用两种视角区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The practice and technical study of breeding, feeding, and caring for farm animals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对农场动物进行繁育、饲喂和照料的实践及其技术研究。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-prattika u l-istudju tekniku tat-tnissil, l-għalf u l-kura tal-annimali tar-razzett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 畜牧业；对农场动物进行繁育、饲养和日常管理的实践。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-prattika tat-trobbija, it-tnissil, l-għalf u l-kura tal-annimali tar-razzett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Animal husbandry is the practice of breeding, feeding, and caring for animals kept on a farm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 畜牧技术学；研究和应用农场动物繁育、营养及饲养管理技术的学科。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qasam tekniku u xjentifiku li jistudja u japplika metodi għat-tnissil, in-nutrizzjoni u l-ġestjoni tal-annimali tar-razzett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Zootechnics is the technical and scientific study of methods used to breed, feed, and manage farm animals.

formal.mt: Il-kors fiż-żooteknika jinkludi t-tnissil, in-nutrizzjoni u l-kura tal-annimali tar-razzett.
formal.en: The course in zootechnics covers the breeding, nutrition, and care of farm animals.
formal.zh: 这门畜牧技术学课程涵盖农场动物的繁育、营养和照料。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'qed tistudja bħalissa? Ġanni: Qed nagħmel kors fiż-żooteknika u nitgħallem kif nieħu ħsieb l-annimali tar-razzett.
colloquial.en: Sara: What are you studying at the moment? Ġanni: I am taking a course in animal husbandry and learning how to care for farm animals.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你最近在学什么？詹尼：我在上畜牧课程，学习怎样照料农场动物。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你最近在学什么？
messages.en: What are you studying at the moment?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (农业专业学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nagħmel kors fiż-żooteknika u nitgħallem kif nieħu ħsieb l-annimali tar-razzett.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nagħmel kors fiż-żooteknika u nitgħallem kif nieħu ħsieb l-annimali tar-razzett.
messages.zh: 我在上畜牧课程，学习怎样照料农场动物。
messages.en: I am taking a course in animal husbandry and learning how to care for farm animals.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“农场里的饲养实践”和“课堂里的畜牧技术”两幅画面记忆同一个词，分别对应畜牧业和畜牧技术学。

gloss_zh: 说话粗声粗气的；举止粗鄙的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rough or abrupt in voice or manner, or lacking polite and refined behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容声音或态度粗硬生 brusque，或举止缺乏礼貌和文雅。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu leħen jew manjieri ħorox, jew li jġib ruħu bla edukazzjoni u bla raffinament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 说话粗声粗气、语气生硬的；态度粗硬的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jitkellem b'leħen oħxon u aħrax jew li juża manjieri xotti u bruski.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is gruff speaks in a rough, abrupt way that can seem unfriendly.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 举止粗鄙、缺乏教养或不懂礼貌的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jġib ruħu b'mod goff u mhux raffinat, mingħajr manjieri edukati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is uncouth behaves in a rude or unrefined way that others may find unpleasant.

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-karattru jitkellem b'leħen żorr, iżda l-għemejjel tiegħu juru li għandu qalb tajba.
formal.en: In the novel, the character speaks in a gruff voice, but his actions show that he has a kind heart.
formal.zh: 在小说中，这个人物说话粗声粗气，但他的行为表明他心地善良。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex kellimtu b'leħen daqshekk żorr? Mark: Kont għajjien u ma ndunajtx bit-ton tiegħi. Se nitlob skuża.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you speak to him in such a gruff voice? Mark: I was tired and did not notice my tone. I will apologize.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么用那么生硬的语气跟他说话？马克：我当时累了，没注意自己的语气。我会道歉的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么用那么生硬的语气跟他说话？
messages.en: Why did you speak to him in such a gruff voice?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont għajjien u ma ndunajtx bit-ton tiegħi. Se nitlob skuża.
messages.mt_standard: Kont għajjien u ma ndunajtx bit-ton tiegħi. Se nitlob skuża.
messages.zh: 我当时累了，没注意自己的语气。我会道歉的。
messages.en: I was tired and did not notice my tone. I will apologize.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词记成两种“粗”：声音和语气的粗硬对应 gruff，待人接物的粗鄙对应 uncouth；结合语境区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Words or behaviour that ridicule someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用言语或行为取笑、贬低某人或某事的嘲弄。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kliem jew imġiba li jwaqqgħu lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa għaċ-ċajt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以取笑或奚落的方式贬低某人或某事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żuffjett huwa kliem jew imġiba li bihom wieħed iwaqqa' lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa għaċ-ċajt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Mockery is speech or behaviour that makes someone or something appear foolish or ridiculous.

formal.mt: L-għalliem spjega li ż-żuffjett jista' jweġġa' lil ħaddieħor u talab lill-istudenti jitkellmu b'rispett.
formal.en: The teacher explained that mockery can hurt others and asked the students to speak respectfully.
formal.zh: 老师解释说，嘲弄会伤害别人，并要求学生说话时尊重他人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Iż-żuffjett tiegħek qed iweġġagħni. Mark: Skużani, Lara. Nieqaf u nitkellem miegħek b'rispett.
colloquial.en: Lara: Your mockery is hurting me. Mark: I'm sorry, Lara. I'll stop and speak to you respectfully.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你的嘲弄让我很难受。马克：对不起，拉拉。我会停下来，好好跟你说话。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的嘲弄让我很难受。
messages.en: Your mockery is hurting me.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Skużani, Lara. Nieqaf u nitkellem miegħek b'rispett.
messages.mt_standard: Skużani, Lara. Nieqaf u nitkellem miegħek b'rispett.
messages.zh: 对不起，拉拉。我会停下来，好好跟你说话。
messages.en: I'm sorry, Lara. I'll stop and speak to you respectfully.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人被当众奚落后感到难受，把 żuffjett 和“伤人的嘲弄”这个场景一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A trick played on someone for amusement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了逗乐而对别人施行的恶作剧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċajta li ssir lil xi ħadd billi jiġi mqarraq jew sorpriż biex ħaddieħor jidħaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为逗乐而捉弄别人的一次恶作剧。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żuffjettata hija ċajta li fiha xi ħadd jiġi mqarraq jew sorpriż biex tqanqal id-daħk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A prank is a trick that someone plays on another person for amusement.

formal.mt: L-istudent ħeba l-basket ta' sieħbu bħala żuffjettata, iżda tahulu lura malli ra li kien inkwetat.
formal.en: The student hid his classmate's bag as a prank, but returned it as soon as he saw that his classmate was worried.
formal.zh: 那名学生把同学的包藏起来搞恶作剧，但一看到同学着急，就把包还给了他。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min ħeba l-kikkra tiegħi? Pawlu: Jien, kienet żuffjettata! Hawn hi, wara l-kaxxa. Nina: Tajjeb, imma terġax taħbihieli.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who hid my mug? Pawlu: I did; it was a prank! Here it is, behind the box. Nina: All right, but don't hide it from me again.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：谁把我的杯子藏起来了？保罗：是我，就是个恶作剧！在这儿，盒子后面。妮娜：好吧，但别再藏我的杯子了。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把我的杯子藏起来了？
messages.en: Who hid my mug?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, kienet żuffjettata! Hawn hi, wara l-kaxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, kienet żuffjettata! Hawn hi, wara l-kaxxa.
messages.zh: 是我，就是个恶作剧！在这儿，盒子后面。
messages.en: I did; it was a prank! Here it is, behind the box.

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 好吧，但别再藏我的杯子了。
messages.en: All right, but don't hide it from me again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“偷偷藏起朋友的杯子”记住 żuffjettata：这是一次具体的恶作剧，重点在捉弄人的行动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An animal whose fur has several different colours.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身上的毛具有多种颜色的动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal li l-pil tiegħu għandu diversi kuluri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 毛皮呈现多种颜色的动物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żunnara hija annimal li għandu aktar minn kulur wieħed fil-pil tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An animal described as a żunnara has fur displaying several different colours.

collocations.en: an animal with multicoloured, soft fur
collocations.zh: 毛色多样、毛质柔软的动物

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt tidher żunnara b'pil kannella, iswed u abjad, u l-istudenti ntalbu jiddeskrivu dawn il-kuluri.
formal.en: The photograph shows an animal with brown, black and white fur, and the students were asked to describe these colours.
formal.zh: 照片中有一只毛色棕、黑、白相间的动物，学生被要求描述这些颜色。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dik iż-żunnara ħdejn is-siġra! Toni: Kemm għandha kuluri fil-pil! Nara l-abjad, l-iswed u l-kannella.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that animal with multicoloured fur beside the tree! Toni: Its fur has so many colours! I can see white, black and brown.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看树旁那只毛色多样的动物！托尼：它身上的毛有好多种颜色！我看到了白色、黑色和棕色。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看树旁那只毛色多样的动物！
messages.en: Look at that animal with multicoloured fur beside the tree!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm għandha kuluri fil-pil! Nara l-abjad, l-iswed u l-kannella.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm għandha kuluri fil-pil! Nara l-abjad, l-iswed u l-kannella.
messages.zh: 它身上的毛有好多种颜色！我看到了白色、黑色和棕色。
messages.en: Its fur has so many colours! I can see white, black and brown.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑海里画一只毛色像拼色毯子的动物，用“多种毛色”记住 żunnara，不把它限定成某一种动物。

gloss_zh: 与 Żurrieq 镇有关的称谓

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun indicating an association with the town of Żurrieq.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示与 Żurrieq 镇有联系的名词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li jindika rabta mal-belt ta' Żurrieq.

sense_translations.en_definition: related to the town of Żurrieq
sense_translations.zh_definition: 与 Żurrieq 镇有关；此处作为表示这种联系的名词使用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kelma żurriqija hija nom li jindika li hemm rabta mal-belt ta' Żurrieq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The noun żurriqija indicates an association with the town of Żurrieq.

collocations.en: the meaning of the word żurriqija
the use of the word żurriqija

formal.mt: Fin-noti tal-lezzjoni, il-kelma żurriqija hija ppreżentata bħala nom li jindika rabta mal-belt ta' Żurrieq.
formal.en: In the lesson notes, the word żurriqija is presented as a noun indicating an association with the town of Żurrieq.
formal.zh: 在课堂笔记中，żurriqija 被列为表示与 Żurrieq 镇有联系的名词。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Xi tfisser żurriqija f'din il-lista? Marija: Hawnhekk hija nom li jindika rabta ma' Żurrieq. Lina: Mela niftakarha flimkien mal-isem tal-belt.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does żurriqija mean in this list? Marija: Here it is a noun indicating an association with Żurrieq. Lina: Then I'll remember it together with the town's name.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这张词表里的 żurriqija 是什么意思？玛丽娅：这里它是一个表示与 Żurrieq 有联系的名词。莉娜：那我就把它和这个镇的名字一起记。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: 这张词表里的 żurriqija 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does żurriqija mean in this list?

messages.speaker: Marija (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk hija nom li jindika rabta ma' Żurrieq.
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk hija nom li jindika rabta ma' Żurrieq.
messages.zh: 这里它是一个表示与 Żurrieq 有联系的名词。
messages.en: Here it is a noun indicating an association with Żurrieq.

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: 那我就把它和这个镇的名字一起记。
messages.en: Then I'll remember it together with the town's name.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żurriqija 和地名 Żurrieq 写在同一张记忆卡上，用连线表示“与该镇有关”，帮助记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A moth of the kind known as a tiger moth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 灯蛾，一类称为 tiger moth 的蛾。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' farfett tal-lejl magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala tiger moth.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灯蛾，一种蛾类昆虫。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żurżar huwa tip ta' farfett tal-lejl magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala tiger moth.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tiger moth is a particular kind of moth.

collocations.en: a tiger moth on a leaf
a photograph of a tiger moth

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-ġnien, l-istudenti raw żurżar fuq werqa u ħadu ritratt tiegħu.
formal.en: While observing the garden, the students saw a tiger moth on a leaf and photographed it.
formal.zh: 观察花园时，学生们看到一只停在叶片上的灯蛾，并给它拍了照。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara, hemm żurżar fuq il-werqa! Mark: Fejn? Maja: Ħdejn dik il-fjura. Mark: Rajtu! Se nieħu ritratt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look, there's a tiger moth on the leaf! Mark: Where? Maja: Next to that flower. Mark: I see it! I'll take a photo.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看，叶片上有只灯蛾！马克：在哪儿？玛雅：那朵花旁边。马克：看到了！我要拍张照。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看，叶片上有只灯蛾！
messages.en: Look, there's a tiger moth on the leaf!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 在哪儿？
messages.en: Where?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那朵花旁边。
messages.en: Next to that flower.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了！我要拍张照。
messages.en: I see it! I'll take a photo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żurżar 写在灯蛾图片旁，再配上“叶片上的灯蛾”这个短语，用图像和场景一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The scientific study of animals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究动物及其结构、行为和生活方式的科学。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xjenza li tistudja l-annimali, l-istruttura tagħhom, l-imġiba tagħhom u kif jgħixu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 动物学，研究动物的结构、行为及生活方式等的科学。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iż-żuwologija hija x-xjenza li tistudja l-annimali, inklużi l-istruttura, l-imġiba u l-ħajja tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Zoology is the scientific study of animals, including their structure, behaviour, and ways of life.

formal.mt: Fil-kors taż-żuwologija, l-istudenti jistudjaw l-istruttura u l-imġiba ta' diversi annimali.
formal.en: In the zoology course, students study the structure and behaviour of various animals.
formal.zh: 在动物学课程中，学生研究各种动物的结构和行为。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'qed tistudja din is-sena? Pawlu: Iż-żuwologija. Sara: Għax tħobb l-annimali? Pawlu: Iva, u nixtieq nifhem aħjar kif jgħixu.
colloquial.en: Sara: What are you studying this year? Pawlu: Zoology. Sara: Because you like animals? Pawlu: Yes, and I'd like to understand better how they live.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你今年在学什么？保罗：动物学。萨拉：因为你喜欢动物吗？保罗：对，而且我想更好地了解它们怎样生活。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你今年在学什么？
messages.en: What are you studying this year?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 动物学。
messages.en: Zoology.

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 因为你喜欢动物吗？
messages.en: Because you like animals?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u nixtieq nifhem aħjar kif jgħixu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u nixtieq nifhem aħjar kif jgħixu.
messages.zh: 对，而且我想更好地了解它们怎样生活。
messages.en: Yes, and I'd like to understand better how they live.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一本封面画满动物的课本，把 żuwologija 与“研究动物的学科”一起记，区别于单指动物本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An unfavourable condition or negative feature that makes something harder or less useful.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人处于不利地位的条件，或使某事物不够理想的缺点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni sfavorevoli jew aspett negattiv li jagħmel xi ħaġa aktar diffiċli jew inqas utli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不利条件；使某人较难成功或处于较差地位的因素。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żvantaġġ huwa kundizzjoni jew fattur li jqiegħed lil xi ħadd f'pożizzjoni inqas favorevoli u jagħmilha aktar diffiċli għalih li jirnexxi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A disadvantage is a condition that makes it harder for someone to succeed or compete.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弊端；某个计划、选择或事物中降低其实用性或吸引力的缺点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żvantaġġ huwa aspett negattiv ta' pjan, għażla jew ħaġa li jnaqqas l-utilità tagħha jew jagħmilha inqas mixtieqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A drawback is a negative feature that makes a plan, choice, or thing less useful or attractive.

formal.mt: L-iżvantaġġ ewlieni tal-proposta huwa l-ispiża għolja tat-trasport, li tista' tqiegħed lin-negozji ż-żgħar fi żvantaġġ.
formal.en: The main drawback of the proposal is the high transport cost, which may put small businesses at a disadvantage.
formal.zh: 该提案的主要弊端是运输成本高，这可能使小企业处于不利地位。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-flat jogħġobni, imma għandu żvantaġġ wieħed. Ben: X'inhu? Lara: Huwa 'l bogħod mix-xogħol. Ben: Mela ejja naraw kemm idum il-vjaġġ.
colloquial.en: Lara: I like this flat, but it has one drawback. Ben: What is it? Lara: It's far from work. Ben: Then let's see how long the journey takes.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我喜欢这套公寓，不过它有一个缺点。本：是什么？拉拉：离上班的地方远。本：那我们看看路上要花多久吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (租房者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-flat jogħġobni, imma għandu żvantaġġ wieħed.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-flat jogħġobni, imma għandu żvantaġġ wieħed.
messages.zh: 我喜欢这套公寓，不过它有一个缺点。
messages.en: I like this flat, but it has one drawback.

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 是什么？
messages.en: What is it?

messages.speaker: Lara (租房者)
messages.zh: 离上班的地方远。
messages.en: It's far from work.

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ejja naraw kemm idum il-vjaġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Mela ejja naraw kemm idum il-vjaġġ.
messages.zh: 那我们看看路上要花多久吧。
messages.en: Then let's see how long the journey takes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用租房清单记 żvantaġġ：房子虽好，但路远是“缺点”；若因此竞争吃亏，就是“处于不利地位”。

gloss_zh: 揭示；透露；使原先未知的事情为人所知

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making a previously hidden or unknown fact known.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 揭示或透露原先隐藏、保密或不为人知的信息这一行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tagħmel magħruf fatt jew tagħrif li qabel kien moħbi jew mhux magħruf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 揭示；透露，即使原先隐藏或未知的信息为人所知。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tagħmel magħruf lil ħaddieħor xi fatt jew tagħrif li qabel kien moħbi, sigriet jew mhux magħruf.
sense_translations.en_explanation: To reveal something means to make it known after it has been hidden or unknown.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport ġie żvelat li l-proġett kien se jiswa aktar milli kien ippjanat.
formal.en: The report revealed that the project would cost more than planned.
formal.zh: 报告披露，该项目的成本将高于原计划。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ġie żvelat min rebaħ il-premju? Karl: Le, għadu ma ġiex żvelat. Nina: Meta se jgħidulna? Karl: Illejla, waqt il-programm.
colloquial.en: Nina: Has it been revealed who won the prize? Karl: No, it hasn't been revealed yet. Nina: When will they tell us? Karl: Tonight, during the programme.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：谁得奖已经公布了吗？卡尔：没有，还没公布。妮娜：他们什么时候告诉我们？卡尔：今晚，节目播出的时候。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁得奖已经公布了吗？
messages.en: Has it been revealed who won the prize?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.zh: 没有，还没公布。
messages.en: No, it hasn't been revealed yet.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 他们什么时候告诉我们？
messages.en: When will they tell us?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.zh: 今晚，节目播出的时候。
messages.en: Tonight, during the programme.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żvelat 放进“秘密被揭开”的画面，连同 ġie żvelat 一起记，看到它就想到信息从隐藏变为公开。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A clock that sounds an alarm at a time you have set.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能在预先设定的时间发出响声，用于叫醒或提醒人的钟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arloġġ li jdoqq f'ħin issettjat minn qabel biex iqajjem lil xi ħadd jew ifakkru f'xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可预先设定响铃时间、用来叫醒或提醒人的闹钟。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żveljarin huwa arloġġ li jista' jiġi ssettjat biex idoqq f'ħin partikolari, speċjalment biex iqajjem lil xi ħadd.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An alarm clock is a clock that you set to make a sound at a particular time, usually to wake you up.

collocations.en: set the alarm clock for six

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti għandhom jissettjaw iż-żveljarin għas-sitta sabiex jaslu fil-ħin għat-tluq.
formal.en: Participants should set their alarm clocks for six so that they arrive in time for departure.
formal.zh: 参加者应把闹钟设在六点，以便按时赶上出发。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għal x'ħin issettjajt iż-żveljarin? Mark: Għas-sebgħa, imma għada rrid inqum qabel.
colloquial.en: Maja: What time did you set the alarm clock for? Mark: For seven, but tomorrow I need to get up earlier.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你把闹钟设在几点了？马克：七点，不过明天我得更早起床。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你把闹钟设在几点了？
messages.en: What time did you set the alarm clock for?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għas-sebgħa, imma għada rrid inqum qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Għas-sebgħa, imma għada rrid inqum qabel.
messages.zh: 七点，不过明天我得更早起床。
messages.en: For seven, but tomorrow I need to get up earlier.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żveljarin 写在床头闹钟的图旁，再连着记 għas-sitta（设在六点），用起床画面记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A clock that makes a sound at a chosen time to wake or remind someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在选定时间发出响声，用来叫醒或提醒人的闹钟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arloġġ li jagħmel ħoss f'ħin magħżul biex iqajjem lil xi ħadd jew ifakkru f'xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够设定时间并在到点时响铃的闹钟，通常用于叫醒人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żverjalin huwa arloġġ li jdoqq fil-ħin li jkun issettja l-utent, normalment biex iqajmu mill-irqad.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An alarm-clock is a clock that makes a sound at a time you choose, especially when you need to wake up.

formal.mt: Qabel l-irqad, iċċekkja li ż-żverjalin ikun issettjat għall-ħin korrett.
formal.en: Before going to sleep, check that the alarm clock is set for the correct time.
formal.zh: 睡前请检查闹钟是否设在正确的时间。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex għadek fis-sodda? Pawlu: Ma smajtx iż-żverjalin dalgħodu!
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you still in bed? Pawlu: I didn't hear the alarm clock this morning!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你怎么还在床上？保罗：今天早上我没听见闹钟响！

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 你怎么还在床上？
messages.en: Why are you still in bed?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 今天早上我没听见闹钟响！
messages.en: I didn't hear the alarm clock this morning!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用旅行箱里的小闹钟作记忆画面，把 żverjalin 与“到点响铃”联系起来，并按本词字母顺序单独练习拼写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of growing, improving, or creating something over time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人、事物或社会逐步成长、改善的过程，也指新事物的开发。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih persuna, ħaġa jew soċjetà tikber jew titjieb, jew li bih tinħoloq xi ħaġa ġdida.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 成长、发展或逐步完善的过程；也可指产品、项目等的开发。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żvilupp huwa proċess ta' tkabbir, titjib jew bidla maż-żmien, jew ix-xogħol biex tinħoloq xi ħaġa ġdida.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Development is the process in which someone or something grows, improves, or takes shape over a period of time.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jenfasizza li l-investiment fl-edukazzjoni huwa essenzjali għall-iżvilupp ekonomiku tal-pajjiż.
formal.en: The report emphasizes that investment in education is essential for the country's economic development.
formal.zh: 报告强调，教育投资对于国家的经济发展至关重要。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif sejjer l-iżvilupp tal-logħba? David: Sewwa! Issa nistgħu nippruvaw l-ewwel verżjoni.
colloquial.en: Lara: How is development of the game going? David: Well! We can try the first version now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：游戏开发进展怎么样？戴维：挺好！现在可以试试第一个版本了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 游戏开发进展怎么样？
messages.en: How is development of the game going?

messages.speaker: David (游戏开发者)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa! Issa nistgħu nippruvaw l-ewwel verżjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa! Issa nistgħu nippruvaw l-ewwel verżjoni.
messages.zh: 挺好！现在可以试试第一个版本了。
messages.en: Well! We can try the first version now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象幼苗逐渐长成树，把整个成长过程标为 żvilupp；再用“经济发展、个人成长、游戏开发”三个搭配扩展记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having reached an advanced stage of growth, progress, or organization.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已达到较高发展程度或较成熟阶段的；形容国家时常指经济和基础设施发达的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li laħaq livell avvanzat ta' tkabbir, progress jew organizzazzjoni; dwar pajjiż, li għandu ekonomija u infrastruttura avvanzati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发展程度较高的、发达的，或已经成长、完善到较成熟阶段的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa żviluppata tkun laħqet stadju avvanzat ta' tkabbir jew titjib; pajjiż żviluppat ikollu ekonomija u servizzi avvanzati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is developed has reached an advanced stage of growth or progress, often with established systems and facilities.

formal.mt: Pajjiż żviluppat jeħtieġ li jkompli jinvesti fl-edukazzjoni u fl-infrastruttura biex iżomm il-livell tas-servizzi tiegħu.
formal.en: A developed country needs to continue investing in education and infrastructure to maintain the standard of its services.
formal.zh: 发达国家需要持续投资教育和基础设施，以维持其服务水平。

colloquial.mt: Nina: It-trasport pubbliku hemmhekk huwa żviluppat sew? Mark: Iva, hemm ħafna rotot u l-karozzi tal-linja jgħaddu spiss.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is public transport well developed there? Mark: Yes, there are many routes and the buses run frequently.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：那里的公共交通发达吗？马克：是的，线路很多，公交车班次也很密。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-trasport pubbliku hemmhekk huwa żviluppat sew?
messages.mt_standard: It-trasport pubbliku hemmhekk huwa żviluppat sew?
messages.zh: 那里的公共交通发达吗？
messages.en: Is public transport well developed there?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm ħafna rotot u l-karozzi tal-linja jgħaddu spiss.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm ħafna rotot u l-karozzi tal-linja jgħaddu spiss.
messages.zh: 是的，线路很多，公交车班次也很密。
messages.en: Yes, there are many routes and the buses run frequently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żviluppat 放在交通完善、服务成熟的城市图片旁，记住它描述“已经发展到较高水平”的状态，并连读 pajjiż żviluppat。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or company that creates or develops something, such as software or buildings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从事产品、软件或建筑项目等开发工作的个人或公司。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija li toħloq jew tiżviluppa xi ħaġa, bħal programmi tal-kompjuter jew proġetti ta' bini.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开发者；从事软件、产品或房地产项目开发的个人或公司。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija li taħdem fuq il-ħolqien jew l-iżvilupp ta' programmi, prodotti jew proġetti ta' bini.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A developer is a person or company whose work involves creating or developing things such as software or buildings.

formal.mt: L-iżviluppatur tas-softwer ippreżenta verżjoni ġdida tal-programm lill-klijenti.
formal.en: The software developer presented a new version of the program to the clients.
formal.zh: 这位软件开发者向客户展示了程序的新版本。

gloss_zh: 表达或发泄愤怒（动词）；突然迸发（名词）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To express or release the anger that one feels.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把心中的愤怒表达或发泄出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jesprimi jew joħroġ ir-rabja li jkun qed iħoss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表达愤怒；把心中的怒气发泄出来。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Juri jew jesprimi r-rabja li jkun qed iħoss.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone expresses anger, they show or release the angry feelings they have.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 突然且短暂的迸发或爆发。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħruġ jew manifestazzjoni qawwija u f'daqqa ta' xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A burst is a sudden and brief release or outbreak of something.

collocations.en: he expressed his anger in words

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, ir-rappreżentant żvoga r-rabja tiegħu dwar id-dewmien fil-proġett.
formal.en: During the meeting, the representative expressed his anger about the delay in the project.
formal.zh: 会议期间，这位代表表达了对项目延误的愤怒。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex kien qed jgħajjat Mark? Lara: Kien irrabjat u żvoga ftit. Maja: Issa kkalma? Lara: Iva, issa nistgħu nitkellmu miegħu bil-kalma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why was Mark shouting? Lara: He was angry and vented for a bit. Maja: Has he calmed down now? Lara: Yes, we can talk to him calmly now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克刚才为什么大喊？拉拉：他很生气，发泄了一会儿。玛雅：他现在平静下来了吗？拉拉：是的，现在我们可以心平气和地跟他谈了。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A point at which a situation begins to develop in a significantly different way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某种局面或发展过程开始发生重要变化的时刻或阶段。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mument jew stadju li fih sitwazzjoni tibda tiżviluppa b'mod differenti u sinifikanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 转折点；事情的发展方向发生重要变化的时刻或阶段。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mument jew stadju li jimmarka bidla importanti fid-direzzjoni jew fl-iżvilupp ta' sitwazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A turning point is a moment when a situation changes significantly and begins to develop in a different direction.

collocations.en: a turning point in a career

formal.mt: Il-ftehim il-ġdid immarka żvolta importanti fir-relazzjonijiet bejn iż-żewġ organizzazzjonijiet.
formal.en: The new agreement marked an important turning point in relations between the two organizations.
formal.zh: 这项新协议标志着两个组织之间的关系出现了重要转折。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak ix-xogħol ġdid għamel differenza għalik? Mark: Iva, kien żvolta fil-karriera tiegħi. Maja: X'inbidel? Mark: Bdejt nagħmel ix-xogħol li dejjem xtaqt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did that new job make a difference for you? Mark: Yes, it was a turning point in my career. Maja: What changed? Mark: I started doing the work I had always wanted to do.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那份新工作给你带来变化了吗？马克：是的，那是我职业生涯的转折点。玛雅：有什么变化？马克：我开始做自己一直想做的工作了。
